### **Location:** Remote / Flexible   
Job Type: Entry-Level Placement

### **Experience Required: No previous HR qualifications or experience required**

e-Careers is a dynamic and forward-thinking training company dedicated to changing lives through innovative training and career development solutions.

Human Resources remain essential across every industry, creating opportunities for motivated individuals who want to build practical skills and begin a long-term professional career.

e-Careers will provide you with the training to help you gain an CIPD qualification, then introduce you to a host company that will offer you a guaranteed remote internship placement. If successful, the host company may offer you a full-time paid role in Human Resources.

Are you organised, people-focused, and interested in how businesses attract and support great talent? A growing number of employers are expanding their HR and Talent Acquisition teams, creating opportunities for individuals looking to begin a long-term career in this field.

We are working alongside employers across multiple industries who are seeking motivated individuals ready to develop practical HR knowledge and step into entry-level opportunities.

### **What the Traineeship Offers:**

* CIPD qualification through an online, self-paced learning environment

* Full tutor support

* Guaranteed remote internship (part-time or full-time)

* 1 in 4 people offered a job from their host company after their internship

* Practical exposure to HR, recruitment support and workplace communication

* A career pathway into HR, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development or People Operations

* Every element of the programme (including the training and internship) is remote. So is suitable to candidates based anywhere, or those that do not wish to travel.

### The Process

**Online Training → CIPD Qualification → Remote Internship → Potential Paid Employment**

### **Who Should Apply**

Anyone who is interested in starting a career in Human Resources, Talent Coordination, recruitment or people-focused roles, regardless of previous experience or knowledge, but is willing to complete a structured training programme before being introduced to a host company for a guaranteed internship.

**Requirements**

### NO EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

You should:

* No previous HR qualifications or experience required
* A good grasp of English is essential
* Strong communication skills and an interest in working with people
* Good organisation and attention to detail
* Motivated to learn and develop professionally
* Able to work independently and manage tasks effectively

**Benefits**

* Proven to be the most effective way to launch a career in HR with over 4,000 individuals placed
* Become CIPD-qualified
* Guaranteed remote internship
* A practical way to begin a career in HR, even with little or no prior experience
* Build valuable HR knowledge and workplace skills aligned with employer expectations
* All training is completed online and the internship is remote
* 1 in 4 learners offered a job by their host company
* A pathway into HR Administration, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Employee Relations and People Operations

### How to Apply

If you're looking to launch a career in HR and Talent Coordination, this is your starting point.

Click "Apply" to register your free place on our HR Career Webinar, where our experts will walk you through the industry, role expectations, and your development pathway. Your date, time, and joining link will be sent straight to you by e-Careers.

By applying, you consent to receiving your joining link and programme information from e-Careers. Unsubscribe anytime.

KBR is looking for Commercial Head-Responsible to manage all activities related for getting Contracts to execute maintenance activities into the Maintenance Department , including requesting and tutoring to develop scopes of work, completion of documentation, define prospective bidders, call for tenders, awarding and contractor authorizing for beginning of works, accomplishing with requirements for operational areas to achieve a World Class performance in the maintenance Department Responsibilities: Develop scopes of work for maintenance activities to be executed via contractors, during normal operation of the refinery. To develop Evaluation Criteria and preliminary cost estimation for contracts To coordinate and manage all activities related to prepare Instructions to Bidders, kick of meeting with Contractors and evaluation of economical offers after being evaluated technical offers by contract responsible. To ensure that company HSSEQ policies/programs are implemented within the different contracts to be developed and managed under his responsibility. To ensure that QA/QC requirements and KPI's are included in all-Maintenance Contractors. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering Minimum 12+years’ experience of Contracting. Fluent in writing and reading English. Good knowledge of SAP system. Strong understanding of supervising and Coordinating Bidding processes for maintenance activities. Strong understanding of Contracts administration, cost and controlling budget. Good technical understanding of maintenance execution management. Good technical understanding of People management. Well organized and proactive Excellent communication skills Proven leadership skills with large organizations Maturity of judgment under pressure and ability to resolve problems Strategic thinking, open to new ideas An ability to achieve business results working in a multi- cultural environment Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

**Who Are We❓  
***We Are Foodics!* a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.

**The Job in a Nutshell💡**

 You will lead a team of Renewal Specialists on site and run the team's daily work. You will work closely with the Renewals Manager. You will be the main on-site point of contact for the team. You are responsible for making sure the team hits its retention, churn, and ARR targets.

**What Will You Do❓**

  
*Team leadership and daily operations*  

* Lead, coach, and support a team of Renewal Specialists on site every day.
* Plan daily and weekly work: portfolio coverage, call plans, and follow-ups.
* Run daily stand-ups and monthly 1:1s with team members.
* Make sure the team follows renewal processes, playbooks, and quality standards.
* Handle team attendance, schedules, and coverage during leaves or absences.

* *Performance and targets*  
    

* Own team targets for renewal rate, churn, and ARR retention.
* Track each specialist's performance and give clear, regular feedback.
* Spot low performance early and build improvement plans with the Manager.
* Review call quality, CRM updates, and health-check completion (minimum 4 per customer per year).

* *Escalations and risk*  
    

* Act as the first escalation point for at-risk customers, complaints, and hard renewal cases.
* Join or lead calls with high-risk or high-value customers when needed.
* Work with other teams to remove blockers for the team.
* Make day-to-day decisions within agreed limits, and escalate larger decisions to the Manager.

* *Reporting and communication*  
    

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on team results, risks, and churn reasons.
* Keep the Manager updated on team status, issues, and wins through regular syncs.
* Share customer feedback and churn insights with internal teams.

* *Process and growth*  
    

* Suggest and help roll out improvements to renewal processes and tools.
* Help onboard and train new team members.
* Help with hiring, including interviews and assessments.

**What Are We Looking For❓**

* 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Renewals.
* At least 1 year of leading, coaching, or mentoring a team, either formally or as a senior member.
* Experience with SaaS or subscription-based products.
* Proven track record of meeting retention, churn, or ARR targets.
* Strong communication skills (Arabic required; good English required for reporting and working with internal teams).
* Good with data: comfortable reading dashboards, tracking KPIs, and building simple reports.

**Who Will Excel❓**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and Zendesk (or a similar ticketing tool).
* Experience with customers in the Saudi or GCC market, especially F&B.
* Experience running a team with a remote or part-time on-site manager.
* Calm under pressure and able to handle difficult customer conversations.

**What We Offer You❗**  
We believe you will love working at Foodics!

* We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility.
* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

job_title: Senior Manager - Performance Improvement & Value Creation. SN7
description:
Drive operational performance, efficiency, and value creation across City Operations by identifying revenue opportunities, improving productivity, supporting performance management, and providing robust inputs to annual and multi-year planning. The role will act as an internal advisor to City Operations functions, translating operational data and business insights into practical initiatives with measurable financial and operational outcomes.

**Value Creation & Revenue Optimization**

·    Identify, assess, and prioritize revenue opportunities across City Operations, including Operations & Maintenance, Fire & Life Safety, Medical Operations, Command & Control, Health, Safety & Environment, Technology, Events Operations, and other operational functions

·    Develop business cases supported by the Finance department on financial models to evaluate commercial opportunities, cost-recovery mechanisms, pricing options, and operational sustainability

·    Partner with operational functions and relevant corporate teams to shape opportunities, validate assumptions, define ownership, and support implementation.

·    Benchmark commercial and operating practices against relevant city, infrastructure, utility, real estate, transport, and public-sector operators.

**Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement**

·    Identify efficiency opportunities through process optimization, service redesign, productivity improvement, demand and capacity analysis, automation, sourcing, and better use of assets and technology.

·    Conduct structured diagnostic and root-cause analysis to understand cost, quality, productivity, and service-performance gaps.

·    Build an integrated pipeline of improvement initiatives, including quantified benefits, delivery milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, and risks.

·    Coordinate benefit tracking with relevant functions to ensure that approved savings and improvements are implemented, measured, and sustained.

**Performance Management support**

·    Coordinate with the Performance Management function to define and refine KPIs, targets, service levels, and performance measures for City Operations.

·    Support in the analysis of performance trends and variances, identify root causes of underperformance, and recommend targeted corrective actions.

·    Support executive performance reviews by translating operational data into clear insights, decisions, and actions.

·    Follow up on agreed corrective actions and assess whether they are delivering the intended operational and financial results.

**Planning & Strategic Support**

·    Coordinate with the Operational Planning function to provide analytical inputs to annual and multi-year planning cycles.

·    Provide evidence-based inputs for workforce planning, budgets, contracts, operational priorities, and strategic initiatives.

·    Support the development of improvement roadmaps aligned with City Operations priorities and Qiddiya-wide objectives.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Governance**

·    Build trusted working relationships across City Operations and relevant enabling functions, facilitating fact-based and constructive challenge.

·    Prepare concise executive materials that clearly articulate the opportunity, evidence, financial impact, implementation requirements, risks, and decisions required.

·    Establish appropriate governance for value-creation and efficiency initiatives, including a consistent approach to prioritization, approvals, tracking, and reporting.

·    Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, commercial awareness, and data-led decision-making.

**Requirements**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Finance, Operations Management, or a related discipline.

Postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification is advantageous.

**Experience**

Approximately 8-12 years of relevant experience across management consulting, operational excellence, value creation, business planning, performance management, corporate strategy, or a comparable field.

Demonstrated experience identifying and delivering revenue, cost-efficiency, productivity, or service-improvement opportunities.

Experience developing business cases, financial models, executive recommendations, and implementation roadmaps.

Experience in complex operating environments such as cities, infrastructure, utilities, real estate, transport, healthcare, public safety, technology operations, or the public sector is advantageous.

Experience engaging senior stakeholders and working across multiple functions with different operational priorities.

We are looking for an experienced Inventory Management Supervisor to oversee and optimize inventory operations across our supply chain network. This role will focus on inventory accuracy, stock availability, process standardization, and compliance with inventory control procedures.

The successful candidate will drive inventory optimization, minimize stock losses and excess inventory, improve replenishment processes, and provide data-driven insights to support operational efficiency and business objectives.

**Requirements**

* 4–6 years of progressive experience in inventory control, inventory management, warehousing, or supply chain operations.

* Previous experience as an Inventory Controller, Stock Controller, Inventory Specialist, or in a similar role.

* Strong knowledge of inventory control, replenishment planning, and inventory optimization.

* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Microsoft Excel.

* Experience conducting inventory audits, cycle counts, variance investigations, and root cause analysis.

* Strong understanding of inventory KPIs, including DOI, inventory turnover, stock aging, inventory accuracy, and holding costs.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor inventory accuracy across distribution centers and stores through cycle counts, physical inventories, and regular stock checks.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop, implement, and standardize inventory control procedures and SOPs across the network.
* Ensure compliance with inventory policies, control procedures, and audit requirements.
* Monitor stock levels and coordinate inventory transfers and balancing across distribution centers and stores.
* Identify and reduce excess inventory, stock stagnation, shrinkage, and inventory losses.
* Analyze demand patterns and support replenishment planning and inventory allocation.
* Optimize Days of Inventory (DOI), stock coverage, and inventory turnover.
* Conduct root cause analysis for inventory discrepancies, damages, and recurring stock issues.
* Track inventory KPIs and prepare reports and dashboards covering inventory accuracy, stock aging, turnover, holding costs, and shrinkage.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain, Warehouse Operations, Distribution Centers, Store Operations, Procurement, Demand Planning, Finance, and Commercial teams.

description:
**Job Description:**

Job Summary  
We are seeking a skilled Front End Washer Mechanic to maintain and troubleshoot specialized machinery within our can manufacturing facility. This role ensures optimal performance and reliability of our front-end washing equipment.  
  
Job Responsibilities  
\* Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and preventative measures on front-end washing machines and related auxiliary equipment.  
\* Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic issues on washers, dryers, and associated conveyance systems.  
\* Troubleshoot complex machinery malfunctions, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions to minimize downtime.  
\* Execute scheduled and unscheduled repairs, including component replacement, alignment, and calibration.  
\* Read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and blueprints to aid in troubleshooting and repair activities.  
\* Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, and parts inventory.  
\* Collaborate with production teams to optimize machine performance and efficiency.  
\* Adhere to all safety protocols and company policies, ensuring a safe working environment.  
\* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and training programs.  
  
Job Qualifications  
\* High school diploma or equivalent; vocational training or an associate's degree in mechanical, electrical, or industrial maintenance is preferred.  
\* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a maintenance mechanic, preferably in a manufacturing environment.  
\* Proven experience with the maintenance and repair of industrial washing equipment or similar automated machinery.  
\* Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.  
\* Proficient in reading and interpreting mechanical blueprints, electrical schematics, and technical manuals.  
\* Knowledge of pneumatic and hydraulic systems.  
\* Basic understanding of electrical systems and controls (e.g., sensors, motors, PLCs).  
\* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.  
\* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.  
\* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.  
\* Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for extended periods.

  

Crown Holdings, Inc. through it's subsidiaries, is a world leader in the metal packaging production process. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative and sustainable metal packaging solutions and products. Our clients are some of the largest and most respected companies in the world.

job_title: Assistant Director of Sales – Government & Royal Affairs (Saudi National)
description:
The Assistant Director of Sales – Government & Royal Affairs supports the Director of Sales in driving the hotel’s commercial strategy and revenue performance, with a primary focus on Government, Royal Affairs, Diplomatic, and strategic institutional accounts across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
The role is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key government entities, royal offices, ministries, authorities, embassies, diplomatic missions, government-related organizations, and strategic decision-makers. The Assistant Director of Sales will identify and convert high-value business opportunities while ensuring the hotel is positioned as a preferred destination for government, royal, diplomatic, VIP, corporate, MICE, and high-profile events .
Working closely with the Director of Sales and the wider Commercial team, the role will lead day-to-day sales activities, account development, prospecting, relationship management, contract negotiations, and business conversion within the assigned market.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Support the Director of Sales in developing and executing the hotel’s annual Government & Royal Affairs sales strategy , business plan, account plans, and revenue objectives.

Take ownership of the day-to-day development and management of key government, royal, diplomatic, and strategic institutional accounts .

Develop and maintain strong relationships with ministries, government authorities, royal offices, government entities, sovereign and strategic organizations, embassies, diplomatic missions, and government-related companies .

Identify key decision-makers and influencers within target organizations and establish long-term commercial relationships at senior levels.

Proactively identify new government and institutional business opportunities and develop strategies to convert them into long-term and recurring revenue.

Build and maintain a strong pipeline of government, royal, diplomatic, VIP, corporate, MICE, and strategic account opportunities.

Manage and grow a portfolio of high-value accounts while ensuring regular account reviews, production tracking, action plans, and revenue development.

Develop strategic account plans for key government and royal accounts, including business potential, production history, contacts, opportunities, competitor positioning, and future business forecasts.

Identify opportunities for VIP stays, government delegations, official visits, diplomatic travel, executive accommodation, long stays, meetings, conferences, state-related events, private functions, and exclusive hotel buyouts .

Lead and support negotiations for government rates, preferred agreements, corporate agreements, long-stay arrangements, accommodation contracts, event agreements, and strategic partnerships , ensuring commercial value and compliance with hotel policies.

Maintain a thorough understanding of government procurement processes, tender opportunities, preferred supplier requirements, and relevant business practices within the Saudi market.

Proactively monitor government calendars, major national initiatives, international delegations, conferences, exhibitions, summits, sporting events, entertainment programs, and other major events that may generate hotel demand.

Develop strong relationships with protocol teams, executive assistants, procurement departments, travel coordinators, event organizers, government representatives, diplomatic personnel, and other key stakeholders .

Conduct regular sales calls, executive meetings, presentations, client visits, site inspections, familiarization visits, client entertainment, and relationship-building activities.

Coordinate and host high-profile government, royal, diplomatic, and VIP clients during hotel visits and ensure that their requirements are communicated effectively to all relevant departments.

Work closely with Operations, Front Office, Guest Relations, Events, Security, Reservations, and other departments to ensure seamless delivery of VIP, government, royal, and diplomatic stays and events .

Ensure all business generated through government and strategic accounts is accurately handed over to the relevant operational teams with clear requirements, expectations, and timelines.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date account information, contacts, activities, opportunities, pipelines, production, contracts, and account plans.

Monitor account production and performance against agreed targets, identifying gaps and implementing corrective action where required.

Support the Director of Sales in leading, coaching, and developing the Sales team, sharing government market knowledge and ensuring a disciplined and proactive approach to account management and business development.

Work collaboratively with all Commercial and operational departments to ensure the hotel delivers a consistent, discreet, and exceptional experience for government, royal, diplomatic, and VIP guests.

Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, discretion, professionalism, integrity, and relationship management when dealing with government, royal, diplomatic, and high-profile clients.

Minimum 5 years of progressive sales experience within luxury hospitality, with significant exposure to the Saudi market.

Proven experience managing Government, Royal Affairs, Diplomatic, or strategic institutional accounts in Saudi Arabia.

Established network and strong relationships with relevant Saudi government entities, ministries, authorities, royal offices, embassies, and strategic organizations .

Strong understanding of the Saudi hospitality, government, corporate, and MICE landscape.

Proven track record of generating and converting high-value business and achieving sales and revenue targets.

Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

Ability to build trusted relationships with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers.

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities and translate relationships into measurable revenue.

Experience with CRM systems, account management, sales reporting, forecasting, and commercial planning.

Strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards and the expectations of VIP and high-profile guests.

Professional appearance, strong interpersonal skills, discretion, and the ability to represent an ultra-luxury hotel at the highest level.

The Accounts Payable role is a vital pillar of our Finance team, ensuring every transaction is handled with accuracy, integrity, and the refined sophistication that defines the Faena experience.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Coordinate with Purchasing, Receiving, and department leaders to ensure all invoices and Purchase Orders are accurately collected, verified, and entered into the financial system.
Match invoices against approved POs and receiving documentation to confirm accuracy before posting to Accounts Payable.

Track payment due dates and process approved payments in alignment with Faena financial policies and vendor agreements.

Maintain a structured, compliant filing system for all invoices, PO documentation, and receipts in both physical and digital formats.

Proactively investigate discrepancies between supplier invoices and received goods or services to prevent delays and disputes.

Handle supplier inquiries with professionalism, providing timely resolutions and reinforcing Faena as a trusted, high‑quality hospitality partner.

Liaise with vendors to document follow‑ups, explanations, and outcomes, ensuring clear audit trails and transparency.

Reconcile vendor statements with internal records to ensure payables remain current, accurate, and audit‑ready.

Prepare regular AP reports — including aging summaries and variance analysis — to support finance leadership and strategic planning.

Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation, clarity, and accurate records.

Maintain impeccable audit trails and ensure all payment activities conform to Faena and corporate finance standards.

Execute responsibilities within established SOPs, financial protocols, and Faena brand standards, ensuring consistency and operational excellence.

Partner with Purchasing, Cost Control, Receiving, and Operations to maintain alignment on payment cycles, contract compliance, and budget considerations.

Ensure invoices and POs are properly validated, coded, and approved by relevant HODs before processing.

Continuously seek opportunities to enhance AP efficiency, accuracy, and innovation.

Uphold all Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards, fostering a culture of responsibility and refinement in every financial interaction.

Perform additional duties or tasks as requested by leadership with discretion, professionalism, and commitment to excellence.

Minimum 2 years of Accounts Payable experience, ideally within luxury hospitality, lifestyle brands, or high‑volume environments.

Strong understanding of end‑to‑end AP cycles, vendor reconciliation, and international payment procedures.

Working proficiency in hotel financial systems and ERP platforms (e.g., SUN, Oracle, or equivalent), with strong Excel capabilities.

Exceptional attention to detail, analytical thinking, and time‑management skills.

Ability to thrive in a pre‑opening environment — adaptable, solutions‑driven, and calm under pressure.

Demonstrates professionalism, integrity, and discretion when handling financial information and supplier relationships.

Fluency in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

SKILLS
Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Excellent numerical and analytical skills

Ability to process invoices and payments efficiently

Reconciliation and record-keeping skills

Time management and ability to meet deadlines

Good communication and vendor relationship management

Problem-solving and discrepancy resolution

Data entry and reporting skills

Organizational and multitasking abilities

**Title:**

Commercial Director

### LOCATION

  

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

  

**project description**

The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets.  KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.

  

**THE ROLE**

  

Reporting to the Programme Director, the Commercial Director is responsible for coordinating with PMCs for management of executive commercial reporting, control, recommending the most appropriate commercial strategy, pre and post contract management, provision of accurate status reports that allow timely decisions to be made to prevent schedule slippage and cost overruns, and production of close out reports for each project.

  
  

## MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

·       Develop, implement, and govern standard cost and commercial reporting formats for use by the PMCs.

·       Develop and maintain a database of all Insurances, Guarantees, Warranties.

·       Coordinates with PMCs to compile and validate analytical commercial data.

·       Manages executive risk reporting.

·       Develop the Project Cost Report (PCR), Commercial Executive Report and Cashflows within Unifier and integrate with other platforms for consistency of data.

·       Review of existing procurement guidelines for BoQ and tender documents for development of standards for the PMCs.

·       Prepare the programme-wide consolidated cost reports consistent with the agreed reporting requirements, including those of DevCo, BOD, Excom, Treasury, PIF, and HRH.

·       Collate annual programme wide budgets and prepare monthly cashflow reports for submission to the client for review and approval.

·       Prepare and develop t cost benchmark reports for Tender Price Index, Professional Fees Benchmark, Construction Cost Benchmark for above ground Assets and Infrastructure, efficiency benchmarks including GFA/ BUA, Floor/ Ceilings, KSA Key Input Market Price Analysis (monthly), and KSA Market Insight (quarterly).

·       Participate in the development and implementation of programme change control

·       procedure(s).

·       Prepare programme wide project cost reports, including trend analysis and change reporting.

·       Review cost risks and opportunities.

·       Reporting seamlessly between Cost Break Down Structure and Work Brown Structure linking Cost and Schedule including Earned Value.

·       Prepare updates for changes on the Programme baseline budget

·       Supporting the Business Plan exercise.

·       Provide portfolio-wide risk management services to support effective governance, decision-making, and assurance across the portfolio, in alignment with approved risk policies, frameworks, and systems.

·       Consolidate PMC risk registers into programme-level and departmental risk registers for escalation and reporting.

·       Assist the Client with development of commercial strategy.

·       Leads and direct contracts, risk, and other support service departments. In doing so, ensures timely production of all required commercial deliverables by KBR.

·       Production of Commercial Reports throughout the project’s life cycle.

## Company:

Oliver Wyman

## Description:

**Oliver Wyman is looking for a seasoned professional as a Global Mobility Specialist to join our IMEA (India, Middle East & Africa) Mobility & Security team!**

**This role will be based in our Riyadh office.**

**Job Overview:**

The Global Mobility Specialist – IMEA supports the Global Mobility Manager – IMEA in delivering compliant, timely and employee focused Global Mobility services, primarily across Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain, with additional support across other GCC countries as required.

The role is responsible for coordinating immigration and mobility activities, maintaining accurate records and supporting employees throughout relevant processes. It also provides related administrative support, including the preparation and issuance of employee letters and documentation.

Working closely with HC Operations, Recruiting, Talent Management, business stakeholders and external service providers, the Global Mobility Specialist contributes to efficient and consistent employee experience while ensuring local requirements and Oliver Wyman policies are appropriately followed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day Global Mobility and immigration activities across Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain, with support for other GCC countries as required.
    
* Advise and support employees, candidates, Talent Management, project teams and other key stakeholders on immigration requirements for cross-border project staffing, business travel, onboarding and international transfers, coordinating required approvals and documentation.
    
* Manage immigration cases from initiation through completion, including residence permits, Iqamas/QIDs, work authorization, business visas, renewals, transfers and cancellations, providing clear guidance on requirements, documentation, fees and timelines.
    
* Support in-country processes, including medical examinations, biometrics and business visa health insurance, as well as relocation processes and applicable benefits, coordinating with HC Operations and relevant external vendors as required.
    
* Monitor immigration regulations, restrictions and process changes, assess their impact/risk on employees and project staffing as well as the OW organization, and ensure relevant stakeholders, guidance and Oliver Wyman internal communication templates/sites are updated accordingly.
    
* Prepare and issue immigration, mobility and employee documentation, including required letters and certificates, and provide related administrative support to the Global Mobility Manager and HC team, including document coordination, tracking, filing and attestation.

**SECTION I: Job Summary**

The QC Inspector – Structural performs inspection and testing of structural steel fabrication and erection activities to verify compliance with drawings, specifications, and applicable codes and standards.

**SECTION II: Job Analysis**

Duties & Responsibilities

·         Perform in-process and final inspections on structural steel fabrication and erection works.

·         Witness structural bolting, welding, and alignment checks per the ITP.

·         Verify structural steel installation against approved drawings, erection plans, and tolerances.

·         Verify materials (structural steel, bolts, coatings) against material certificates and specifications.

·         Record inspection results and raise Non-Conformance Reports as required.

·         Coordinate hold points and inspections with client/third-party inspectors.

·         Maintain inspection records, checklists, and daily QC reports.

·         Verify calibration status of measuring and test equipment used on site.

·         Support punch-list generation and verification of closure for structural works.

·         Ensure work fronts comply with approved method statements and structural codes (AISC, etc.).

·         Support preparation of quality documentation for structural handover dossiers.

**Requirements**

**SECTION III: Performance Indicators**

Evaluated Based on

·         **Inspection accuracy and completeness**

·         **Timely identification and reporting of non-conformances**

·         **First-time inspection pass rate on assigned work fronts**

·         **Adherence to inspection schedules/hold points**

·         **Quality of inspection documentation**

**SECTION IV: Required Skills & Abilities**

Core Competencies

* Attention to Detail
* Integrity
* Analytical Thinking
* Communication Skills
* Time Management

Technical Skills

·         Structural Steel Inspection Techniques

·         Reading Structural/Erection Drawings

·         Bolting & Welding Inspection Standards (Structural)

·         Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs)

·         Measuring & Alignment Equipment Use

·         QC Documentation & Reporting

**SECTION V: Required Experience and Education**

Experience

Education

·          QC/inspection certification preferred.

Cluster Director of HR

Job Description

The Cluster Director of Human Resources is a key member of the cluster leadership team, responsible

for leading the people strategy across multiple hotels within the portfolio.

Reporting to the Cluster General Manager, this role serves as a strategic business partner to hotel

leadership and ownership. The Cluster Director of Human Resources will oversee all aspects of

human capital management across hotels with different positioning, operating models, and staffing

requirements.

The role will play a critical part in the successful pre-opening, opening, and stabilization of the hotels

by developing workforce strategies, establishing organizational structures, building leadership teams,

implementing HR systems and policies, and ensuring the portfolio attracts, develops, and retains

talented employees while maintaining compliance with all local regulations and company standards.

The successful candidate will combine commercial awareness with strong people leadership

capabilities to support business performance, organizational effectiveness, employee engagement,

and long-term talent sustainability across the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Human Resources Leadership**

• Develop and execute a cluster-wide Human Resources strategy aligned with business

objectives, hotel operating models, ownership priorities, and brand requirements.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to the Cluster General Manager and hotel leadership teams on all

people-related matters.

• Establish organizational structures, workforce plans, and staffing strategies appropriate for

each property's positioning and operating model.

• Drive a high-performance culture focused on accountability, development, engagement, and

service excellence.

• Support long-term talent planning and organizational effectiveness across the portfolio.

Pre-Opening Human Resources Management

• Lead all Human Resources pre-opening activities from project handover through opening

and stabilization.

• Develop and manage the Human Resources pre-opening critical path and readiness plan.

• Support the preparation, review, and management of Human Resources Pre-Opening

Budgets (POB).

• Develop pre-opening staffing plans, mobilization strategies, and recruitment timelines.

• Establish hotel organizational structures, position control frameworks, grading structures, and

manpower plans.

• Implement HR policies, procedures, systems, and employee lifecycle processes prior to

opening.

• Coordinate onboarding, orientation, and hotel opening induction programs.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

• Lead recruitment strategies for all hotels across the cluster.

• Ensure leadership and critical positions are filled in accordance with opening timelines.

• Develop recruitment partnerships with hospitality schools, training providers, and external

agencies.

• Implement workforce planning initiatives to optimize labor resources across the portfolio.

• Support cluster-wide recruitment campaigns and talent pipeline development programs.

• Establish succession planning strategies for key operational and leadership roles.

**Saudi National Development & Compliance**

• Develop and implement Saudization strategies aligned with regulatory requirements and

business objectives.

• Establish recruitment, training, and development programs for Saudi nationals.

• Partner with government agencies, universities, hospitality academies, and training

institutions to develop future talent pipelines.

• Monitor compliance with labor legislation, Saudization targets, GOSI requirements, and

employment regulations.

• Ensure proper workforce reporting and government compliance across all properties.

**Learning & Development**

• Establish cluster training and development strategies.

• Develop leadership development and succession planning programmes.

• Implement pre-opening training, service culture, and onboarding initiatives.

• Support operational departments in building technical and leadership capabilities.

• Monitor training effectiveness and organizational capability development.

• Foster a culture of continuous learning and career development.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

• Lead employee engagement initiatives, culture-building activities, and recognition

programmes.

• Develop programs that promote collaboration across the hotel portfolio.

• Drive employee well-being, inclusion, and retention initiatives.

• Monitor engagement survey results and implement action plans.

• Support the development of a strong employer brand and employee value proposition

**Performance Management & Organizational Development**

• Establish performance management frameworks across the portfolio.

• Support leaders in performance coaching, talent reviews, and development planning.

• Drive organizational effectiveness and change management initiatives.

• Support leadership teams in managing performance, employee relations, and workforce

challenges.

• Promote accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Compensation & Benefits**

• Oversee compensation and benefits programmes across the hotel cluster.

• Ensure compensation structures remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with market

conditions.

• Support annual salary review, incentive planning, and workforce budgeting processes.

• Monitor labor costs and staffing productivity metrics.

• Partner with Finance and Operations teams to align manpower and compensation strategies

with business objectives.

**Financial Management**

• Prepare and manage Human Resources operating budgets and pre-opening budgets.

• Support manpower budgeting and labor cost forecasting across the portfolio.

• Monitor recruitment costs, training investments, employee housing budgets, transportation

costs, uniforms, and other HR-related expenditures.

• Identify opportunities to improve productivity and optimize labor resources.

• Ensure HR initiatives deliver measurable business value and return on investment.

**Stakeholder Management**

• Act as the primary Human Resources representative for ownership, hotel leadership, and

external stakeholders.

• Build strong relationships with government authorities, educational institutions, training

providers, and recruitment partners.

• Provide workforce analytics and people insights to support strategic decision-making.

• Participate in project meetings, business reviews, and opening readiness assessments.

**Requirements**

**The Ideal Candidate**

The successful candidate will be a commercially minded and people-focused HR leader with a strong

track record of supporting hotel openings, workforce mobilization, organizational development, and

talent strategies across multiple properties.

You will bring:

• Proven Human Resources leadership experience within hotels, hospitality portfolios, mixeduse

developments, or complex service organizations.

• Strong pre-opening experience including workforce planning, recruitment mobilization, HR

systems implementation, and opening readiness activities.

• Experience preparing manpower budgets, staffing structures, and Human Resources Pre-

Opening Budgets (POB).

• Strong understanding of labor laws, employment regulations, Saudization requirements, and

workforce compliance in Saudi Arabia.

• Demonstrated expertise in talent acquisition, employee relations, organizational

development, succession planning, compensation, and performance management.

• Experience establishing organizational structures and staffing models for hotels with varying

positioning and operating requirements.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with

ownership, operating team, and government authorities.

• A collaborative leadership style with a passion for developing talent and building highperforming

teams.

• Strong commercial awareness and the ability to align people strategies with business goals.

• Excellent communication, coaching, and change management capabilities.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or

a related field.

• Professional HR certifications are advantageous.

• Minimum 10 years of progressive Human Resources experience within hospitality or service

industries.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior Human Resources leadership role.

• Previous multi-property, cluster, or portfolio Human Resources experience preferred.

• Proven pre-opening hotel experience strongly preferred.

• Experience managing large-scale recruitment and workforce mobilization programs.

• Strong understanding of Saudi labor legislation and hospitality workforce requirements.

2026-09-24

**Business Overview :**

Collins Aerospace, one of the three business units comprising RTX, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defense industry. Created in 2018 by bringing together UTC Aerospace Systems and Rockwell Collins, Collins Aerospace has the capabilities, comprehensive portfolio, and expertise to solve customers' toughest challenges and to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving global market. From the smallest details to the highest pursuits, Collins Aerospace is dedicated to redefining aerospace.

**Role Overview / Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to lead business development efforts across the Collins Aerospace and Defense portfolio with a specific focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), Turkey, and Pakistan. This position will be responsible for driving product-agnostic growth across Collins Aerospace’s full portfolio, including defense solutions, while leveraging expertise in Direct Commercial Sales (DCS), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), and U.S. Government (USG) procurement processes. The ideal candidate will excel in regional prospecting, defense market engagement, customer relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration, ensuring sustainable revenue growth and long-term partnerships in these key markets.

  

This role will  be based with our Collins team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Product-Agnostic Portfolio Coverage with Defense Focus**:

* Drive business development opportunities across Collins Aerospace’s full portfolio, including all Strategic Business Units (SBUs), sustainment offerings, and defense-specific solutions.
* Ensure a comprehensive approach to regional market penetration, leveraging the full breadth of the company’s aerospace and defense capabilities.
* Act as a key driver of Collins Aerospace’s defense strategy, identifying and capitalizing on opportunities in military and government sectors.

  

**Regional Prospecting, Opportunity Conversion, and Pursuit Governance:**

* Hold full accountability for identifying, developing, and converting new business opportunities in KSA, Turkey, and Pakistan, with a focus on defense.
* Lead pursuit governance efforts to ensure strategic alignment and effective consumption choices across opportunities, particularly in defense-related programs and contracts.
* Build and maintain a robust pipeline of defense DCS & FMS opportunities to drive sustainable revenue expansion.

  

**Key Account & Stakeholder Management**:

* Establish and nurture senior-level relationships with key customers, including military organizations, defense ministries, government entities, and commercial partners, to strengthen long-term partnerships.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to key defense accounts, ensuring alignment with their mission-critical needs and objectives.

  

**Customer Engagement & Representation:**

* Act as the senior representative of Collins Aerospace in the region, leading executive engagements and negotiations for defense in aforementioned region.
* Drive high-value deal closures, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic priorities, including defense-related pursuits.
* Represent the organization effectively in government, military, and industry forums to enhance the company’s visibility and influence.

  

**Reporting & Executive Communication**:

* Provide regular updates to senior leadership, including performance metrics, strategic insights, and recommendations for defense initiatives.
* Ensure transparent and timely communication of regional developments and progress, with a focus on defense program opportunities and risks.

  

**Minimum Qualifications & Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing or Professional Sales,  Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) would be preferred.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in business development or related roles, with a strong focus on aerospace, defense, DCS, FMS, and USG procurement processes.
* Culturally astute, appreciates differences and leverages those differences to inform regional/country business development strategies.

* Excellent Communication (written & verbal) & presentation ability in English.
* Experience engaging effectively with C-suite, senior government, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Ability to think strategically and recognize trends and business opportunities and marshal resources to pursue them.
* Demonstrates an understanding of the social, political and economic global trends and is able to interpret impact to the business and recommend adjustment to  strategies appropriately.
* Strong business acumen, problem solving and financial skills
* Well, organized with ability to adapt and adjust to changing priorities
* Proficiency in MS Office suite tools such as Outlook, PowerPoint , Word , Excel
* Ability to travel frequently (50%) across MEA and internationally as maybe required
* Applicants must hold, or be fully eligible to obtain, a valid work permit and residency visa (Iqama)to live and work in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

  

**Relevant Work experience would be:**

o   Prior in-depth business development experience within the aerospace and defense industry.

o   Experience operating across multiple regions (e.g. APAC, EMEA, Americas), managing complex sales cycles and deal structures, and owning revenue targets through effective pursuit management and pipeline development.

o   Prior work experience in a highly regulated industry, similar to aerospace / defense for a large organization with a geographically dispersed workforce and a highly matrixed work environment.

o   Prior work experience in defense leveraging stakeholder relationships to influence executive policy, regulation, legislation and stakeholder procurement decisions.

o   Prior experience in developing a cross-functional collaborative team-based approach to strategy, pursuit, and stakeholder relationship development - demonstrating the ability to build credibility and interaction through influencing suppliers, customers, and key stakeholders.

o   Familiarity with competitive landscapes and procurement processes (DCS, FMF, FMS).

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Ability to communicate in the Arabic Language.
* Work experience in the military.

Our client, a growing luxury interior design and construction company in Riyadh, is seeking an Interior Design Engineer to turn client ambitions into thoughtfully designed, carefully executed interiors.

A compelling concept is only the beginning. The real achievement is preserving its character through every drawing, material selection, and finishing detail.

In this role, you’ll connect creative direction with practical delivery. Working closely with clients, design teams, contractors, and suppliers, you’ll help ensure that finished spaces reflect the approved vision while meeting functional requirements and project timelines.

For a hands-on designer, this is an opportunity to stay involved where your decisions matter: from the first client conversation to the final site inspection.

About Our Client

Our client specialises in luxury interior design and construction execution for corporate and private clients. Based in Riyadh, the company manages projects across the full lifecycle, bringing together concept development, design, project management, and on-site delivery.Its work requires more than visual appeal. **Requirements**

What You’ll Own

You’ll take an active role across the design and execution journey, with responsibilities that extend beyond the drawing board.

* Translate client ambitions into a clear design direction. Develop mood boards, color schemes, and material palettes that balance aesthetic preferences with the practical needs of each space. Create photorealistic visualizations using 3ds Max with V-Ray or Corona to help clients understand and confidently approve the concept.
* Turn approved concepts into buildable details. Produce accurate Revit and AutoCAD execution drawings, architectural layouts, joinery details, and finishing specifications that give execution teams clear guidance.
* Bring the right materials into the finished space. Source and evaluate materials, select and approve samples, coordinate with suppliers, negotiate terms, and manage delivery schedules to support project progress.
* Protect design quality on-site. Conduct regular visits during finishing stages, review work against approved drawings, and collaborate with contractors to resolve discrepancies and practical challenges.
* Keep clients informed and projects moving. Lead design presentations, explain recommendations clearly, communicate progress, and address design questions as they arise throughout execution.

###   
**What Makes You Successful**

* You’re a designer who cares as much about how a space is built as how it looks. You can move confidently between creative exploration, technical documentation, and on-site problem-solving without losing sight of the client’s priorities.
* You hold a bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or Architectural Engineering, supported by proven experience in both concept development and on-site finishing supervision.
* Your technical capabilities include strong proficiency in 3ds Max, Revit, AutoCAD, and Photoshop, alongside a sound understanding of materials, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), joinery, and interior construction details. Additional skills in SketchUp, Lumion, or V-Ray are an advantage.
* You understand the Saudi design, construction, events, and luxury projects market. Just as importantly, you communicate effectively, handle client requirements thoughtfully, and coordinate multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Your portfolio should tell the complete project story: initial concepts, 3D renders, execution drawings, and photographs of completed spaces.

**Benefits**

What’s In It for You

This opportunity brings together the creative and technical sides of interior design in one role. You’ll work on luxury interiors, engage directly with clients, and stay connected to the execution of your designs rather than handing them off at the visualisation stage.

The breadth of the work offers practical opportunities to deepen your expertise in material selection, supplier coordination, construction detailing, and site supervision while contributing to a growing business in Riyadh.

### **Bring Your Best Work to Life**

If you’re ready to take your designs from concept to completed space, we’d like to see what you can create and deliver.

Apply with your CV and portfolio, showcasing the projects you’ve helped shape from the first idea to the final finish.

* Remote Working Holidays - possibilities to Travel and Work anywhere in the world!

* Employee Discounts. Access to lots of great travel and entertainment discounts as our clients’ members would!

* Be part of our global, dynamic, and inclusive Team, with diversity at its core.

* Genuine career opportunities within a dynamic and international company.

**Ten Lifestyle Group** is a global luxury concierge service and our travel department is offering a unique opportunity to join a vibrant team. Our clients and colleagues are the cornerstones of what we do, and we serve High-Net Worth (HNW) and UHNW clients with their requests for leisure travel. At Ten our goal is simple, to become the most trusted service business in the world.

We deliver our service through a combination of Ten’s proprietary, unique technology-enabled platform and the expertise of our highly trained lifestyle managers. critical role throughout the pre-opening, opening, and operational phases, ensuring successful

job_title: Chief Clinical Officer (CCO) (Senior Healthcare Experience Essential) 50013023
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

Key internal interfaces include the CEO, executive leadership team, healthcare asset leaders, quality and patient safety teams, clinical operations, digital health, legal and compliance, talent acquisition, and partnership teams. Key external interfaces include regulators, accreditation bodies, clinical partners, academic institutions, sports federations, professional teams, and other strategic healthcare partners.

The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) is QHC’s most senior clinical executive and the single accountable owner of enterprise clinical strategy, medical governance, quality, patient and athlete safety, and clinical standards across all QHC healthcare assets. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the CMO brings clinical leadership, standards-setting, assurance, and medical advisory authority under one role, ensuring clear and consistent clinical accountability while operational delivery remains with the respective healthcare businesses and functions.

The CMO ensures that clinical delivery across all QHC healthcare assets follows the  QHC’s clinical and wellness standards, quality expectations, and readiness requirements, reflecting international evidence-based practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements.

As a member of the QHC executive leadership team, the CMO translates the Kingdom's Vision 2030 and Qiddiya’s healthcare ambitions into governed, accountable practice, championing patient and athlete safety, clinical research and academic collaboration, and positioning QHC as a regionally recognized centre of clinical excellence.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

The role sets enterprise clinical standards, quality expectations, and governance requirements for all QHC healthcare assets, while day-to-day operational delivery, staffing deployment, and business-unit execution remain accountable to the relevant operating leaders.

**1.  Enterprise Clinical Strategy & Medical Affairs**

•    Provide overall clinical leadership and set the enterprise clinical strategy for QHC across all current and future service lines, in alignment with the QIC and Vision 2030 healthcare transformation objectives.

•    Serve as the principal clinical voice on the executive leadership team, advising the CEO / MD and the Board and Medical Advisory Committee on clinical strategy, service development, clinical risk and medical policy.

•    Provide clinical and wellness input into service models and define the clinical standards, quality expectations and readiness requirements for all healthcare assets.

•    Represent QHC's clinical capabilities to sports federations, professional teams, government stakeholders, regulators and strategic partners.

**2.  Clinical** **Governance, Quality & Patient / Athlete Safety**

•    Establish QHC’s overarching clinical governance and quality framework, setting expectations for patient and athlete safety, clinical quality, risk and compliance across all healthcare assets.

•    Provide a consistent enterprise-wide framework for clinical quality and accountability, ensuring clear standards and expectations across all healthcare assets.

•    Define, monitor, and report enterprise clinical KPIs and quality dashboards for clinical partnership or assets under direct operation of QHC.

•    Define clinical governance and escalation requirements, ensure appropriate review of priority quality, safety, and service issues, and provide senior clinical guidance on corrective actions, risk mitigation, and follow-up accountability.

**3.  Clinical Excellence, Protocols & Care Pathways**

•    Set QHC’s enterprise clinical excellence, safety and wellness standards across all healthcare assets, aligned with evidence-based international practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements

•    Provide clinical and wellness guidance to all healthcare assets on service models, safety requirements and areas for clinical improvement

•    Develop and continuously review clinical policies, evidence-based care pathways, treatment protocols and standard operating procedures of clinical partners and QHC operated assets aligned with international best practice.

•    Promote evidence-based, person-centred models of care that integrate physical, psychological and social dimensions of health, wellbeing and performance, as relevant to the populations served.

•    Set enterprise clinical requirements for documentation, information governance, patient confidentiality and related clinical compliance, in line with applicable Saudi regulatory requirements and relevant international standards.

**4.  Sports Medicine & Citywide Healthcare Clinical Advisory**

•    Provide clinical and wellness advisory support to all healthcare assets, providing input into service models, clinical readiness requirements, quality expectations and relevant performance measures.

•    Advise on multidisciplinary and integrated approaches to care, supporting alignment with QHC’s clinical standards and evidence-based practice.

•    Provide clinical guidance on priority service areas and readiness requirements, identifying clinical gaps, risks and opportunities for improvement.

**5.  Partnerships, Research & Academic Collaboration**

•    Contribute to the development and implementation of clinical partnerships with institutions by supporting knowledge exchange, capability building, and the integration of leading practices into clinical care.

•    Support research, innovation, and academic collaboration initiatives, facilitating clinical engagement in research, education, and evidence-generation activities.

•    Participate in evaluating and adopting emerging clinical technologies, digital health solutions, and clinical analytics that enhance clinical practice and support data-driven decision-making.

Role success will be measured by the design and deployment of all QHC healthcare assets, engagement of QHC clinical partnerships, achievement of clinical readiness milestones, compliance with applicable Saudi regulatory and accreditation requirements, adoption of approved clinical standards and care pathways, strength of clinical partner engagement, and sustained improvement in patient and athlete safety, quality and cost indicators through value based care.

**Requirements**

**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**

Medical degree (MD, MBBS, MBChB, or equivalent) with board certification or postgraduate specialty qualification in a relevant discipline is required. Additional qualifications or experience in clinical leadership, sports medicine, population health or related fields are preferred

Active registration and licensure with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) at Consultant level, or clear eligibility for SCFHS Consultant classification, is required. Dataflow primary source verification and SCFHS Mumaris Plus registration must be completed prior to commencement.

15+ years of progressive clinical experience, with a substantial track record in senior clinical leadership, medical director or chief-level roles within accredited healthcare institutions. Experience delivering care to professional athletes, elite teams or comparable high-performance environments is highly desirable.

Proven expertise in clinical governance, patient-safety management, multidisciplinary team leadership and quality improvement within a regulated healthcare environment. Prior experience in JCI and/or CBAHI accredited institutions and within partnership or joint-venture clinical models is highly preferred.

Strong working knowledge of Saudi MOH and SCFHS licensing and regulatory frameworks, and of the clinical operating requirements of a startup or greenfield healthcare organization.

At Horizontal Digital, we hold ourselves to one key belief: you're only as good as your worst customer experience. This mantra drives our digital consultancy to think beyond the easy answers and create websites, apps, portals and other experiences that solve customer needs for ambitious companies in intuitive and empathetic ways. **About the role**

We're looking for a Salesforce Technical Architect based in Saudi Arabia to lead the technical design of a large-scale, integration-heavy Salesforce programme for a major enterprise client in the Kingdom. You'll own the technical architecture across the Salesforce ecosystem and the systems it connects to, and make sure the solution meets both business and technical requirements.

This is a hands-on, player/coach role. You'll guide development teams while taking an active part in technical design, solution reviews and delivery. You'll work across the functional, technical, integration and data workstreams, and explain solution choices clearly to both business and IT stakeholders, in Arabic and English. The role needs strong Salesforce and system integration expertise, and a mindset focused on learning and continuous improvement.

**What you'll do**

* Design and own the end-to-end Salesforce architecture across Sales, Service, Experience, Marketing, Data Cloud and industry-specific clouds

* Work with business stakeholders and functional leads to turn requirements into scalable technical solutions

* Evaluate and design integration patterns between Salesforce and external systems, using APIs, middleware and event-driven approaches

* Make sure all solutions meet enterprise architecture standards for scalability, security and performance

* Guide development teams through design reviews, best practice and code quality oversight

* Define API standards and data models, including canonical models, to support a well-architected approach

* Support pre-sales activity through solutioning, effort estimation and architecture advice

* Create and maintain technical documentation, including ERDs, sequence diagrams, data mappings and architecture blueprints

**Who you are**

* You have a track record of designing and delivering scalable Salesforce technical architectures

* You prepare and present the technical design rationale, discuss it with key stakeholders, and drive decisions that provide greater clarity and direction to the team

* You're comfortable working directly with clients to shape technical solutions around their business goals

* You're fluent in Arabic (preferred) and English (essential), and can explain complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to business and technical stakeholders in both languages

* You're skilled at guiding and mentoring developers, and at running code and design reviews

* You take end-to-end ownership of the architecture, staying hands-on in validating your design and maintaining the Architecture Decision Records throughout the project.

* You have a deep understanding of Salesforce platform limits, the security model, deployment architecture and performance considerations

* You have a strong background in integration, including RESTful APIs, middleware platforms, and batch and real-time interfaces

* You're familiar with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and Salesforce release strategies

* You leverage AI tools such as Claude Code across the delivery lifecycle to accelerate design and development, while analysing the impact of changes and ensuring they are safely validated and rolled out.

* You are able to design data migration strategies across different Salesforce clouds and define mechanisms to validate data accuracy and completeness throughout the migration.

**What you bring**

**Essential**

* 8+ years of client-facing consulting experience focused on Salesforce architecture and solution design

* 8+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, Marketing Cloud (Good to have).

* Fluent Arabic and English, spoken and written

* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Riyadh or Jeddah

* Experience working in cross-functional project teams to understand requirements and deliver secure, scalable solutions

* Strong system documentation skills (ERDs, process flows, sequence diagrams, etc.)

* Proven experience designing scalable integration patterns with external systems

* Salesforce certifications: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce, and one or more Salesforce Architect domain certifications (e.g. Application Architect, System Architect)

* Experience with agile methods, including estimation and planning across multi-disciplinary teams

**Nice to have**

* Experience with event streaming on Kafka / Confluent, including consumer groups, Schema Registry and Avro/JSON serialisation
* Experience with data transformation and mapping, especially from nested JSON and EDIFACT into a canonical relational model

* Experience with Data Cloud, MuleSoft, Field Service or Revenue Cloud
* Previous delivery experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC

**Our KSA benefits include:**

* 22 days holiday

* Comprehensive medical insurance plan for employee and spouse and children

* Visa for employee and spouse and children

* Flexible office times and working from home twice per week

* Remote working from a place of your choice for 2 weeks a year
