* Prepare and review Method Statements in coordination with project and technical teams.
* Prepare, review, and implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
* Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contracts, and applicable Saudi Building Code requirements.
* Monitor quality performance and submit regular reports to the Project Department Manager.

**Site Inspections and Quality Control**

* Conduct daily inspections and quality walkthroughs across assigned project sites.
* Verify that executed works comply with approved drawings, specifications, approved material submittals, and workmanship standards.
* Raise, track, and follow up Inspection Requests.
* Attend inspections with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor field and laboratory test results.
* Ensure materials are approved before use on site.
* Inspect structural, architectural, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP-related works.

**Non-Conformance and Corrective Actions**

* Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for non-compliant works or materials.
* Follow up on Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Coordinate with site and subcontractor teams to close observations within approved timelines.
* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Request rework or corrective action for works that fail to meet approved requirements.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports.
* Maintain inspection records, quality logs, material approvals, test reports, technical submittals, and NCR registers.
* Track inspection outcomes, consultant comments, and corrective-action closures.
* Prepare quality KPI reports and management summaries.

**Coordination**

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Technical Office, consultants, clients, subcontractors, and approved laboratories.
* Ensure subcontractors comply with ACSC quality procedures and project requirements.
* Support project teams in resolving quality issues before they affect project cost, programme, or handover.

**Requirements**

### Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or architecture.
* Minimum 8 years of QA/QC experience in construction projects.
* Proven experience in villas, residential compounds, multi-storey residential buildings, or similar projects.
* Strong knowledge of the Saudi Building Code and relevant construction standards.
* Practical experience in concrete, blockwork, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP inspections.
* Experience dealing with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and testing laboratories.
* ISO 9001 Internal Auditor certification is preferred.
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is an added advantage.

### Technical Skills

* Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications.
* Experience preparing and reviewing ITPs and Method Statements.
* Practical experience in NCR and CAPA management.
* Knowledge of inspection procedures for structural, architectural, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP works.
* Ability to review material submittals, test reports, and technical approvals.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AutoCAD.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel for quality reports and tracking logs.
* Knowledge of material approval procedures, laboratory testing, and consultant inspection requirements.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, including Odoo, is preferred.

### Personal Skills

* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Confident personality with the ability to raise and manage quality issues professionally.
* Strong reporting, documentation, and analytical skills.
* High attention to detail.
* Problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple project priorities.
* Strong time-management skills.

### Ideal Candidate Profile

**Work Experience**

* Experience coordinating inspections with consultants.
* Experience reviewing material submittals, technical approvals, test reports, and inspection requests.
* Experience issuing, managing, and closing NCRs, CAPA, and inspection requests.
* Experience reducing rework and improving first-pass inspection outcomes.
* Experience preparing weekly and monthly quality reports.

**Language Proficiency**

* Fluent Arabic communication skills.
* Good English communication skills, including technical reporting and correspondence.

**Legal and Regulatory Requirements**

* Must be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.

**Methodologies and Frameworks**

* Practical experience preparing and implementing Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
* Practical experience preparing and reviewing Method Statements.
* Experience with NCR and CAPA processes.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 Quality Management System principles.
* Experience with root-cause analysis and preventive quality actions.
* Experience maintaining quality records, inspection logs, and project quality documentation.

**Physical Requirements**

* Able to conduct regular site inspections, walk construction sites, access different work areas, and work in an active construction environment.

**Availability**

* Available to join within 30 days or less.

**Reporting Line:** Internal Audit Functionally to the Audit Committee

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Employment Type:** Full-time | On-site

### About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and independent Senior Internal Audit Specialist to support the internal audit function of Alomar Holding Company and its subsidiaries.

### Key Responsibilities

* Execute approved risk-based internal audit assignments across the holding company and its subsidiaries.
* Review financial, operational, procurement, HR, project, and compliance processes.
* Assess the design and effectiveness of internal controls, approval workflows, delegated authorities, policies, and procedures.
* Audit payment cycles, procurement activities, contracts, vendor onboarding, receivables, payroll, fixed assets, inventory, and cash management.
* Review project controls including budgets, BOQs, variations, contractor payments, tender evaluations, cost overruns, and project documentation.
* Identify control gaps, compliance breaches, financial risks, operational inefficiencies, and potential fraud indicators.
* Prepare audit working papers, evidence files, audit observations, risk ratings, root-cause analysis, and recommended corrective actions.
* Draft clear audit reports and presentations for management and the Audit Committee.
* Maintain audit findings trackers and follow up with responsible departments until corrective actions are closed.
* Support investigations related to suspected fraud, policy violations, conflicts of interest, or financial irregularities.
* Assist in preparing the annual audit plan, audit universe, risk assessments, and periodic Audit Committee reporting.
* Maintain confidentiality, professional skepticism, and independence throughout all audit engagements.

**Requirements**

### Mandatory Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Internal Audit, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, external audit, risk, compliance, or financial controls.
* Minimum 2 years of direct internal audit experience.
* Practical experience auditing financial controls, procurement, payment cycles, contracts, payroll, and operational processes.
* Strong understanding of internal control principles, risk assessment, audit documentation, and audit reporting.
* Strong Excel skills.
* Business-fluent English.
* Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.

### Preferred Qualifications

* CIA, SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, CISA, or CRMA certification, or progress toward one of these certifications.
* Experience auditing multiple entities, subsidiaries, or a group structure.
* Experience in real estate, construction, contracting, investment, or diversified holding groups.
* Experience using ERP systems such as Odoo, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar.
* Familiarity with Saudi compliance requirements, VAT, ZATCA controls, and corporate governance practices.
* Proficiency in Arabic.
* Available to join within 30–60 days.

### What We Are Looking For

* Able to independently conduct audits while maintaining objectivity and escalating significant issues appropriately.
* Excellent report writing, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills, with experience preparing clear, evidence-based audit reports, presentations, and audit follow-up updates for senior leadership and the Audit Committee.
* Comfortable presenting significant audit findings, control weaknesses, high-risk issues, and overdue corrective actions to the Audit Committee.
* Comfortable engaging with CEOs, CFOs, finance, procurement, HR, operations, project teams, and subsidiary management to obtain audit evidence and follow up on remediation actions.

**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role  
Leverage your expertise and our comprehensive capabilities in this dynamic role. As a Consult Partner working in the Kyndryl Consult team, the organization’s fastest-growing business, you’ll craft innovative solutions for some of Kyndryl’s largest accounts. Join us at a unique time in our history where you can shape how our consulting practice operates today and evolves for the future.  
  
You will play a key leadership role across multi-disciplinary teams, guiding them through complex consulting engagements, and leading your team to success. Your leadership will be critical in fostering talent development and innovation within the organization.  
  
You’ll be responsible for creating and positioning strategic change agendas within Kyndryl's largest accounts across the C-suite, spanning the intersection between complex business and IT customer solutions. Transformations that bring AI and infrastructure together to create outcomes that scale across the entire customer eco-system.  
  
With customer engagement being a core part of the job, this role demands a strong presence, industry expertise, and the ability to cultivate relationships with CXO-level customers.  
  
What you will do  
Contribute to Profitable Growth  
•Sustain growth: Drive significant financial outcomes through signings and revenue targets. Manage margin expectations and backlog growth.  
•Spot opportunities: Support the identification, pursuit and conversion of a pipeline of business development opportunities.  
•Determine scope: Undertake scoping and fee negotiation on engagements, while ensuring profitability and understanding and containing risk.  
  
Build Customer Engagement  
•Get connected: Build and maintain deep relationships with customer CXOs and be seen as the 'go-to' person and a trusted advisor by senior executives.  
•Take the lead: Lead C-level customer interactions and consulting initiatives, deliverables and outputs of a deal engagement.  
•Inform and advise: Demonstrate credibility and experience to advise and deliver on complex consulting engagement.  
•Keep customers happy: Enhance customer satisfaction, as measured by Net Promoter Score (NPS) and new relationship development. Secure customer references.  
  
Achieve Operational Excellence  
•Hit your goals: Achieve individual and team utilization targets.  
•Take control: Lead the design of complex engagements and take responsibility for oversight of delivery, ensuring high performance and customer satisfaction.  
  
Lead and Collaborate  
•Lead by example: Foster a culture of continuous personal and professional development and challenging our people to be curious and innovative and supportive of each other. At the same time ensure that all outcomes are commercially focused, value adding and effectively executed.  
  
Contribute to Strategic Goals  
•Shape strategy: Utilize industry and technology expertise to shape and drive the company’s strategic initiatives.  
•Pursue the vision: Align with Kyndryl’s strategic vision and contribute to its execution.  
•Boost brand: Drive external eminence and innovation, establishing a strong personal and organizational brand in the industry. Proactively develop thought leadership and intellectual capital.

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience  
  
•Extensive experience in customer engagement and relationship management at the CXO level  
•Demonstrable ability to build and commercialize relationships with senior executives  
•Proven track record of leading and executing complex projects with multidisciplinary teams in a consulting, corporate or public sector environment  
•Effective financial acumen with experience in driving revenue growth and managing margins  
•Experience of managing or supporting high-value business development activities with senior stakeholders  
•Deep understanding of industry trends and technology.  
•Sound personal brand and presence in the industry  
•Demonstrated ability to innovate and drive change

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

**Who Are We❓**

*We Are Foodics!* a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.  

**The Job in a Nutshell💡**

We’re looking for a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Specialist with a strong IT and

Disaster Recovery (DR) background to support, maintain, and enhance our BCM and IT resilience

framework. In this role, you’ll play a key part in ensuring the organization’s ability to respond to

and recover from disruptions by coordinating DR activities, supporting BCM lifecycle processes,

and working closely with IT, Information Security, and business stakeholders.

You’ll be involved in DR planning and testing, business impact analysis, risk assessments, and

regulatory compliance, while acting as a bridge between technical teams and business units to

ensure resilience requirements are effectively implemented and maintained.

**Key Responsibilities:  
**

* Support the implementation and maintenance of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) and IT Disaster Recovery (DR) frameworks.  
    

* Coordinate and support DR planning, testing, and execution in collaboration with IT and technology teams.  
    

* Assist in conducting Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and risk assessments across business and IT functions.  
    
* Monitor and track BCM and DR action plans, ensuring timely closure and reporting to management.  
    
* Support the development, review, and maintenance of BCP and DR documentation,  
    including recovery strategies and procedures.
* Participate in BCM and DR tests, exercises, and simulations, and support post-test  
    
* reviews and improvement actions.  
    
* Liaise with internal stakeholders to ensure BCM and DR requirements are clearly understood and implemented.  
    
* Support regulatory, audit, and internal assessment requirements related to BCM and IT resilience.  
    
* Prepare BCM and DR reports, dashboards, and metrics for management and committee reporting.  
    

**What Are We Looking For❓**

* 2+ Years of experience in Business Continuity Management, IT Disaster Recovery,  
    or IT Risk/Resilience roles.  
    
* Strong understanding of DR technologies, IT infrastructure, and application recovery  
    concepts.  
    
* Good knowledge of BCM lifecycle activities including BIA, risk assessment, strategy  
    development, and testing.  
    
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements (e.g., SAMA) related to BCM, DR, and  
    operational resilience.  
    
* Good skills in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).  
    
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment and manage multiple priorities.  
    
* Good command of English (Arabic is a strong advantage).  
      
      
    
* **Important note**: This role is not open to fresh graduates and requires hands-on experience in  
    BCM and IT/DR domains.  
      
    

**What We Offer You❗**

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

* We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-offices.
* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

**Title:**

Project Control Manager

Project Control Manager

### LOCATION

  

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

  

**project description**

The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets. KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.

  

**THE ROLE**

  

Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Project Controls Manager is responsible to maintain, govern, implement and provide pre and post contract implementation governance for the suite of Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes, in support of reporting requirements and systems, i.e. Aconex, Unifier, P6 etc. The Project Control Manager is required to perform regular review and update of the existing governance documents on quarterly / annual basis.

  

## MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  

·       Onboarding and training of the PMCs to facilitate the understanding of the Programme, policies, processes and associated project management information systems and applications.

·       Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents and continuously update the PMC onboarding tracker.

·       Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all levels downstream.

·       Review the existing structure, propose improvements, and align with on required updates/changes.

·       Maintain, review and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans., manuals, guidelines, templates, etc.

·       Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive programme meeting and reporting Calendar for assigned District/Master Plan.

·       Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparation and creation of the new required BI dashboards and data entry registers through the approved systems, i.e. SharePoint, Unifier, etc.

·       Compile data from PMCs for standardised weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards.

·       Perform project level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, change management.

·       Responsible for ensuring consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports.

·       Assist with the preparation of training material to provide the required training to PMCs on the use of the implemented systems and population of data/registers.

·       Provide support to the client for Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements.

·       Responsible to maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring the PMC's performance against agreed KPI's, and produce a monthly report highlighting each PMC performance with the any required corrective actions.

·       Update the status of corrective actions during the subsequent reporting cycles.

·       Assess existing monitoring system and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process.

·       Ensure that PMC’s reporting schedules are consistent with the PMO preparation of executive reports.

·       Review and collate the District/Master Plan programmes to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).

·       Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies.

·       Implement processes and systems to monitor the timely completion of Stage Gate Reviews and the reporting across assigned District/Master Plan highlighting issues and/or risks that may impact the delivery of the programme.

·       Maintain issue the “KPI's Report” on monthly basis with highlight of key areas of concern with corrective measures and mitigation.

·       Produce a “Key Actions Required” report and escalation process to ensure all required actions are presented to executive management for escalation and action plans.

·       Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report that highlights the overall programme, district and individual project’s status and progress including each project’s status against the approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues hindering project progress.

·       Managing and updating the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded within the WBS change register.

·       Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects.

·       Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Report that highlights the overall programme level, District levels, and individual project’s level status and progress.

·       Prepare required inputs for preparation of Executive Reports including programme and commercial update information and programme “asks” requirements from collate information from the client.

·       Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates with communication and training provided to PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost)

·       Develop and maintain a standardised Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programmes and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting with alignment between CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements.

·       Develop maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure that all projects scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery.

**.  PURPOSE OF THE POSITION**

The Support Manager consolidates under a single leadership the technical know-how, information systems, supply chain, inventory and investment project functions of Metals, ensuring that the operating divisions receive consistent, timely and fact-based support.

The position exists to guarantee that technical knowledge is captured, standardised and transferred across the organisation; that information systems and data integrity underpin management decisions; that materials, supplies and inventories are managed with the accuracy and discipline required by a non-ferrous manufacturing environment; and that investment projects are centrally structured, evaluated and followed through to completion.

The role operates primarily on a project basis: each priority initiative is set up as a defined project with objectives, scope, resources, milestones and measurable results, coordinating the contribution of the different areas involved. Beyond the direct management of the functions listed above, the Support Manager acts as an integrating and impartial interface between the departments of Metals and, where relevant, its counterparts within the Electric Group, translating operational issues into structured analysis and actionable recommendations for Executive Management.

**2.  AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY**

**2.1  Know-How: Process Engineering, Materials and Continuous Improvement**

▪     Own the Company's technical standards for manufacturing processes, including operating parameters, process windows, capability studies and troubleshooting methodologies.

▪     Lead root-cause analysis of recurring process deviations, quality incidents and yield losses, ensuring corrective actions are verified and sustained.

▪     Manage the materials function: raw material and consumable specifications, technical qualification of suppliers, incoming acceptance criteria, alternative material evaluation and failure analysis.

▪     Direct the continuous improvement programme (Lean / Six Sigma / Kaizen), with measurable targets on OEE, scrap and yield, changeover time, energy consumption and cost per tonne.

▪     Build and maintain the Company's technical documentation and know-how repository, ensuring that best practices developed in one division are transferred and standardised across the others.

▪     Provide technical support to capital projects: specification review, technology benchmarking, commissioning support and post-investment performance verification.

**2.2  Information Technology**

▪     Define and execute the IT roadmap in alignment with the Company's operational and commercial priorities.

▪     Ensure the reliability, availability and security of infrastructure, networks and business applications, including cybersecurity policy and business continuity planning.

▪     **Act as the business owner of the ERP.** Working hand in hand with the IT Analyst, define and maintain the fundamentals on which the system is built — organisational structure, product and material coding, bills of materials, routings, costing model, stock movements and transaction logic — ensuring at all times that the ERP reflects how the business actually operates rather than the reverse.

▪     **Keep the ERP aligned with the evolution of the business:** assess the impact of new products, processes, divisions, plants or commercial models on the system's design, and lead the corresponding configuration or development changes in a controlled and documented manner.

▪     Translate business requirements into functional specifications for the IT Analyst and external providers, validate the resulting solutions before deployment, and ensure user training and adoption.

▪     Own master data governance, process mapping, user discipline and the integrity of the data used for management reporting, guaranteeing a single, reliable source of information for decision-making.

▪     Drive digitalisation of shop-floor data capture, production reporting and management dashboards, reducing manual consolidation and reporting lead times.

▪     Manage IT budgets, service providers, licensing and service levels.

**2.3  Supply Chain**

▪     Ensure continuity of supply of raw materials, consumables, spare parts and services at competitive total cost, in coordination with Procurement and Production Planning.

▪     Establish and monitor supplier performance in delivery, lead time, documentation and technical compliance, escalating deviations with supporting evidence.

▪     Oversee logistics, imports and customs coordination, ensuring compliance with local regulations and correct documentation flow.

▪     Support the sales and operations planning cycle, aligning demand forecasts, production capacity and material availability.

**2.4  Inventory Management**

▪     Own inventory accuracy across all locations, implementing cycle counting, reconciliation procedures and clear accountability for stock movements.

▪     Define and maintain stock policies: minimum and maximum levels, reorder points, safety stock and coverage targets by material category.

▪     Control slow-moving, obsolete and non-conforming stock, proposing disposal, reprocessing or re-use routes.

▪     **Work side by side with the Cost Controlling Department,** ensuring full consistency between physical stock records, standard and actual costs, consumption variances and month-end valuation; jointly investigate and explain any deviation.

▪     Ensure rigorous metal balance reconciliation between physical inventory, production records and financial records.

▪     Optimise working capital tied up in inventory without compromising service levels to production and customers.

**2.5  Investment Projects**

▪     **Act as the single point of centralisation for the Company's investment projects,** maintaining a consolidated portfolio with scope, status, budget, schedule and expected returns.

▪     Standardise the investment process: preparation of investment requests, technical specification, supplier and technology benchmarking, quotation comparison and risk assessment.

▪     Build the economic evaluation of each project — CAPEX, operating cost impact, payback, IRR and sensitivity analysis — in cooperation with Cost Controlling and Finance, and present it to the Investment Committee in decision-ready format.

▪     Coordinate project execution across engineering, production, maintenance, supply chain, IT and external contractors, ensuring milestones, budget and safety requirements are met.

▪     Manage commissioning, ramp-up and hand-over to operations, followed by post-investment review comparing actual performance against the approved business case.

**2.6  Coordination with the Systems Department — Environment, Health & Safety**

▪     Coordinate with the Systems Department to ensure that environmental and safety requirements are embedded in process design, materials selection, IT systems and supply chain practices.

▪     Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Company's certified management systems (quality, environment, occupational health and safety, energy) within the scope of the areas under this position.

▪     Ensure that technical and improvement projects incorporate environmental compliance, emissions, waste and safety considerations from the design stage.

**3.  CROSS-FUNCTIONAL MANDATE**

▪     Structure the Company's priority initiatives as defined projects — objectives, scope, resources, milestones, owners and measurable results — and lead them personally, mobilising the different areas involved without duplicating their line responsibilities.

▪     Act as a neutral facilitator between the operational, technical and commercial departments of Metals and its counterparts within the Electric Group, resolving interface issues before they escalate into operational or client-facing problems.

▪     Chair or coordinate cross-departmental review meetings on matters involving more than one division, ensuring that agreed actions have owners, deadlines and verified closure.

▪     Prepare consolidated, fact-based analyses and recommendations for Executive Management, including options, risks, quantified impact and implementation requirements.

▪     Follow up on the execution of management decisions across departments, reporting progress and deviations objectively.

▪     Lead special assignments and cross-company projects entrusted by the Chief Executive Officer, including feasibility studies, benchmarking exercises and organisational or process reviews.

▪     Represent the Company's technical and support functions before external parties — suppliers, technology providers, auditors and institutional counterparts — when required.

**4.  KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**AREA**

**INDICATORS**

**Know-how**

Yield and scrap rate, OEE, number and savings value of implemented improvement projects, recurrence rate of process deviations

**Materials**

Cost per tonne of consumables, supplier technical non-conformities, material substitution savings

**Information Technology**

System availability, ERP data accuracy and alignment with business processes, reporting cycle time, cybersecurity incidents, IT budget compliance

**Supply Chain**

On-time in-full supply, supplier lead-time compliance, stock-out incidents, landed cost variance

**Inventory**

Inventory accuracy, days of coverage, obsolete and slow-moving stock ratio, metal balance variance, consistency with Cost Controlling records

**Investment Projects**

Adherence to approved CAPEX and schedule, achievement of business case targets after ramp-up, quality of post-investment reviews

**EHS Coordination**

Closure rate of environmental and safety actions within scope, audit findings, certification maintenance

**Cross-functional**

On-time closure of cross-departmental actions, quality and timeliness of executive analyses

**Requirements**

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

**EDUCATION**

▪     Bachelor's degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Materials, Metallurgical or Electrical Engineering. A postgraduate qualification in operations, supply chain or business administration is an advantage.

**EXPERIENCE**

▪     Minimum 10 years in industrial manufacturing environments, of which at least 5 in a multi-departmental management role.

▪     Demonstrated experience in process engineering and structured problem-solving in a continuous or semi-continuous production environment; experience in non-ferrous metals, cable, wire or heavy process industry is strongly preferred.

▪     Proven track record in leading continuous improvement programmes with quantified results.

▪     Practical experience as a business owner or key user of an ERP in a manufacturing environment — including data structures, costing models and change management — capable of directing IT professionals without necessarily being an IT specialist.

▪     Solid command of supply chain and inventory management practices in an industrial setting.

▪     Demonstrated experience in leading industrial investment projects from justification through to commissioning and post-investment review.

▪     Experience working in multicultural organisations; GCC experience is an advantage.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

▪     Advanced analytical and problem-solving methodologies (8D, DMAIC, FMEA, Ishikawa, statistical process control).

▪     Strong data analysis and reporting capability; advanced Excel and business intelligence tools.

▪     Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.

▪     Sound understanding of cost structures, working capital and investment evaluation.

**LANGUAGES**

▪     **Arabic:** native speaker — essential.

**6.  COMPETENCIES**

**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.           
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a strategic, service-driven, and highly experienced **Director of Residences** to join the team at **Four Seasons Resort and Residence Red Sea at Shura Island**. Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will be responsible for leading the full residential operation and ensuring that all residence owners, residents, and guests receive the highest levels of personalized service, care, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will oversee all aspects of the residences experience, including owner relations, residential services, property management coordination, service standards, financial oversight, and team leadership. You will play a key role in creating a seamless connection between the resort and residences while ensuring that Four Seasons standards are consistently delivered.

As a senior leader, you will also promote the Four Seasons Golden Rule by creating a respectful, supportive, and service-focused environment for residents, guests, and employees.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead and oversee all **Residences operations**, ensuring exceptional service delivery and consistent adherence to Four Seasons standards.
    
* Build and maintain strong relationships with residence owners, residents, and key stakeholders, ensuring their needs and expectations are understood and met.
    
* Oversee residential services, including owner requests, arrivals and departures, housekeeping coordination, maintenance follow-up, concierge support, and lifestyle services.
    
* Work closely with Rooms, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Finance, Food & Beverage, and People & Culture to ensure seamless support for the residences.
    
* Implement, and monitor operating procedures, service standards, and quality controls for all residential services.
    
* Ensure that all residence areas are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, comfort, and presentation.
    
* Manage owner and resident feedback, concerns, and service recovery with professionalism, discretion, and urgency.
    
* Support the preparation and management of residential budgets, service charges, forecasts, and operational expenses.
    
* Monitor performance indicators, service trends, owner satisfaction, and operational effectiveness, implementing improvements where required.
    
* Ensure compliance with local regulations, property policies, brand standards, and management agreements related to the residences.
    
* Lead, coach, train, and develop the Residences team, fostering a culture of accountability, service excellence, and genuine care.
    
* Support operation activities, residential readiness, handover processes, system implementation, and owner communication plans.
    
* Represent the residences professionally in meetings, inspections, owner interactions, and operational planning sessions.
    
* Promote the Four Seasons Golden Rule by creating a trusted, respectful, and highly personalized residential experience.
    

**What You Bring**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Real Estate Management, or a related field preferred.
    
* Proven experience as a **Director of Residences**, Residences Manager, Director of Rooms, or senior operations leader within a luxury hotel, branded residences, or high-end residential environment.
    
* Strong understanding of luxury residential operations, owner relations, property management, and personalized service standards.
    
* Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to build, coach, and develop a high-performing team.
    
* Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgets, service charges, cost control, and operational planning.
    
* High level of discretion, professionalism, integrity, and emotional intelligence when dealing with owners and residents.
    
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
    
* Ability to work closely with resort operations while maintaining the privacy and expectations of residence owners and residents.
    
* Fluency in **English** is essential.
    
* Suitable candidates must be eligible to work in**, Saudi Arabia**.
    

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary in a tax-free environment.
    
* Travel allowance, if applicable
    
* 30 days of vacation plus public holidays.
    
* Complimentary meals and uniform cleaning.
    
* Medical and life insurance.
    
* Employee Assistance Program and worldwide complimentary room nights.
    
* Leadership development and career growth opportunities.
    
* Additional family benefits.
    

**Schedule & Hours**

This is a full-time role.

  

Dedicated to perfecting the travel experience through continual innovation and the highest standards of hospitality, Four Seasons can offer what many hospitality professionals dream of -the opportunity to build a life-long career with global potential and a real sense of pride in work well done.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Traffic & Detour Inspector will be responsible for planning, developing, implementing, and monitoring traffic management and detour strategies for the Projects. The role focuses on ensuring the safe and efficient movement of vehicles, pedestrians, emergency services, and public transport throughout all phases of bridge and infrastructure construction.

## Your role

**Traffic Management Planning**

* Develop and implement Temporary Traffic Management Plans (TTMPs) for bridge and infrastructure construction activities.
* Prepare traffic diversion and detour schemes to support phased construction works.
* Review construction staging and identify traffic impacts associated with bridge erection, road closures, utility relocations, and infrastructure works.
* Ensure traffic management plans comply with clients, MOT, and applicable Saudi standards and guidelines.
* Coordinate traffic management requirements during project planning and construction phases.
* Bridge & Infrastructure Traffic Coordination
* Develop traffic phasing plans that maintain network functionality during bridge construction activities.
* Coordinate lane closures, temporary alignments, and traffic diversions required for construction operations.
* Review traffic impacts associated with bridge launching, girder erection, heavy lifting activities, and major structural works.

**Traffic Studies & Analysis**

* Conduct traffic assessments and analyze construction-related impacts on road users.
* Review traffic volumes, intersection performance, queue lengths, and operational constraints.
* Evaluate alternative traffic diversion routes and recommend optimal solutions.
* Assess pedestrian and cyclist movement requirements within construction zones.
* Support traffic simulation and modelling exercises where required.

**Traffic Safety & Road User Protection**

* Ensure all traffic management measures are designed and implemented with safety as the primary objective.
* Monitor compliance with approved traffic control layouts and road safety requirements.
* Inspect temporary signage, barricades, road markings, lighting systems, and directional guidance measures.
* Support Road Safety Audits (RSA) and traffic safety inspections.

**Construction Interface Management**

* Coordinate with construction and engineering teams to align traffic diversion plans with project schedules.
* Review contractor traffic management proposals and provide technical recommendations.
* Ensure traffic requirements are incorporated into construction methodologies and work packages.
* Support planning and sequencing of road closures and restricted access activities.
* Minimize traffic disruption while maintaining project productivity.

**Stakeholder & Authority Coordination**

* Facilitate approvals for traffic diversions, detours, and road closure requests.
* Participate in stakeholder meetings and traffic coordination workshops.
* Ensure all authority requirements are incorporated into project traffic plans.

**Monitoring & Reporting**

* Conduct regular inspections of temporary traffic management installations.
* Monitor traffic performance and public feedback during implementation of diversion plans.
* Maintain traffic management records, approvals, inspection reports, and compliance documentation.

**Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance**

* Ensure traffic management activities comply with project HSE requirements.
* Promote a culture of road safety within construction zones.
* Support emergency response and incident management planning.
* Ensure environmental impacts associated with traffic diversions are properly managed.

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Highway Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Transportation Engineering is desirable.
* Professional Engineering registration or membership of a recognized engineering institution is preferred.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in traffic engineering and transportation infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting major bridge, highway, or urban infrastructure projects.
* Previous Saudi Arabia or GCC experience is highly desirable.
* Experience working on large-scale government infrastructure and transportation projects is preferred.

**Key Skills**

* Strong traffic planning and analytical skills.
* Excellent understanding of urban mobility and roadway operations.

## Overview

The Cost Control Manager will be responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and controlling project costs throughout the lifecycle of the Projects. The role will support project management in maintaining budget compliance, cost forecasting accuracy, financial reporting, and effective commercial decision-making.

## Your role

**Cost Planning & Budget Management**

* Develop, maintain, and monitor project budgets and cost control systems.
* Establish cost breakdown structures (CBS) aligned with project work packages and contract requirements.
* Track project expenditures against approved budgets and identify cost variances.
* Support the preparation of baseline budgets for bridge and infrastructure construction activities.
* Monitor commitments, actual expenditures, and forecasted costs throughout the project lifecycle.

* Prepare detailed cost forecasts and cash flow projections.
* Perform monthly cost reviews and analyze project cost performance.
* Identify potential cost overruns and recommend mitigation measures.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.
* Ensure accurate forecasting of final project costs and estimate-at-completion (EAC) values.
* Earned Value Management (EVM)
* Implement and maintain Earned Value Management (EVM) processes.
* Analyze project trends and provide recommendations for corrective actions.
* Support management decision-making through performance analysis.

* Support change control processes and maintain change registers.
* Coordinate with commercial and engineering teams to quantify cost impacts.
* Prepare cost assessments and recommendations for approval.

* Monitor procurement budgets and commitments.
* Review purchase orders, subcontract agreements, and material commitments.

* Coordinate with procurement teams to evaluate cost implications of sourcing strategies.

* Support commercial and contract administration teams in cost-related matters.
* Review interim payment applications and evaluate cost trends.
* Assist in the assessment of contractor claims, variations, and commercial submissions.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Interface Manager will be responsible for managing, coordinating, and controlling all technical, construction, stakeholder, utility, and operational interfaces . The role is critical to ensuring seamless integration between bridge structures, roadway works, utility diversions, traffic management systems, public realm elements, contractors, consultants, and external stakeholders.

## Your role

**Interface Management Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and implement the Project Interface Management Plan in accordance with project requirements and client standards.
* Establish interface management procedures, protocols, and governance frameworks.
* Identify, define, and manage all project interfaces throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive Interface Registers and Interface Matrices.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of interface-related issues.
* Facilitate effective communication between all project stakeholders.

**Design & Construction Integration**

* Coordinate between engineering, design, construction, and project controls teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Review design deliverables to identify interface risks and potential conflicts.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary design coordination workshops.
* Ensure engineering solutions are fully coordinated between various disciplines.
* Track design changes and assess impacts on project interfaces.
* Resolve clashes affecting bridge, roadway, utility, and transportation infrastructure works.

**Utility & Third-Party Coordination**

* Monitor utility relocation and protection programs.
* Ensure utility interfaces are effectively integrated into project schedules and construction plans.
* Facilitate technical reviews and utility approval processes.

**Traffic & Operational Interface Management**

* Coordinate traffic management and diversion interfaces associated with bridge construction activities.
* Ensure alignment between construction staging plans and traffic management strategies.
* Coordinate with transportation authorities for road closures, lane shifts, and traffic diversions.
* Manage interfaces between ongoing construction activities and live operational road networks.
* Support implementation of mobility and transportation management plans.

**Interface Risk Management**

* Identify interface-related risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Maintain Interface Risk Registers and mitigation plans.
* Escalate critical interface risks to project leadership when necessary.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented and monitored to closure.

**Construction Phase Interface Management**

* Monitor interface activities during bridge and infrastructure construction.
* Coordinate sequencing and access requirements between multiple contractors and work packages.
* Ensure construction activities are executed without adversely impacting adjacent project works.
* Support construction planning and work-front management activities.

**Testing, Commissioning & Handover Interfaces**

* Coordinate interfaces associated with testing and commissioning activities.
* Ensure readiness of bridge systems, infrastructure assets, and supporting facilities.
* Support handover planning and operational integration activities.

* Monitor interface risks that could impact site safety.
* Support environmental compliance and sustainability objectives.
* Participate in project safety reviews and leadership initiatives.

The Quantity Surveyor Manager will be responsible for managing all quantity surveying, measurement, valuation, cost control, and commercial administration activities associated with the Projects. The role will ensure effective cost management throughout the project lifecycle, from construction through final account settlement, while maintaining compliance with contractual, commercial, and client requirements.

**Quantity Measurement & Cost Management**

* Measure and quantify construction works in accordance with contract requirements and approved drawings.
* Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and verify contractor-reported quantities.
* Monitor project costs against approved budgets and forecasts.
* Track quantities associated with bridge, highway, and infrastructure works throughout the construction lifecycle.

* Review contractor interim payment applications.
* Verify quantities, progress achievements, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with site engineers and inspectors to confirm work completion status.
* Prepare valuation reports and payment recommendations.
* Ensure payment certification is carried out in accordance with contractual requirements.

* Prepare quantity assessments and cost estimates for proposed scope changes.
* Analyze commercial implications of design modifications, site instructions, and additional works.
* Maintain variation registers and monitor approval status.
* Support negotiation and agreement of variation values with contractors.

* Monitor project expenditure and identify cost trends.
* Prepare project cost forecasts and cash flow projections.
* Identify potential cost overruns and recommend mitigation measures.
* Support project managers and commercial teams in budget management activities.

* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and commercial procedures.
* Support contract change management and claims administration processes.
* Provide commercial advice to project stakeholders when required.

* Review supporting documentation and contract entitlement.
* Support preparation of commercial recommendations and responses.
* Assist in preparation and agreement of final accounts with contractors and suppliers.

* Prepare quantity take-offs and cost estimates for tender packages.

## Overview

The Mechanical SME will serve as the technical authority for all mechanical engineering aspects of the Projects, providing specialist expertise during design review, construction supervision, testing, commissioning, and handover of bridge-related and infrastructure mechanical systems.

## Your role

**Technical Leadership & Subject Matter Expertise**

* Act as the lead Mechanical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Clients.
    
* Provide technical guidance and specialist support to project management, engineering, construction, and commissioning teams.
    
* Review and validate mechanical engineering designs, specifications, calculations, and technical submissions.
    
* Ensure project mechanical systems are designed and constructed in accordance with project requirements, international standards, and client guidelines.
    
* Lead technical reviews and provide recommendations for optimizing system performance, reliability, and maintainability.
    

**Design Review & Engineering Coordination**

* Review mechanical design packages for compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
    
* Evaluate contractor shop drawings, material submittals, calculations, and technical proposals.
    
* Coordinate with civil, structural, electrical, ITS, utility, traffic, and architectural disciplines.
    
* Resolve design conflicts and multidisciplinary interface issues.
    
* Participate in value engineering and design optimization initiatives.

## Overview

The Logistics Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing all logistical aspects of a construction project to ensure smooth site operations. This role involves managing the delivery, storage, and distribution of materials and equipment, organizing site access and traffic flow, and ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. The manager works closely with project teams, suppliers, and contractors to optimize resource utilization, minimize delays, and maintain accurate documentation. Their primary goal is to keep the site efficient, safe, and well-organized throughout the project lifecycle.

## Your role

**Performance**

* Effective delivery of site-wide logistics through the procurement of a site-wide Logistics management contractor.
    
* Define and monitor that the scope of services is delivered satisfactorily through setting and monitoring of measurable goals and objectives around the following broad key enablers.
    
* Orderly, safe and efficiently movement of labour, plant, and materials around site.
    
* Creation of a secure, well maintained site with regular logistics meetings.
    
* Efficient and orderly management of any worker’s accommodation.
    
* Development of processes, procedures and induction programmes.
    
* Supply chain management, movement plans and lookahead forecasting.
    
* Ensuring logistics activities are not a constraining factor on the program.
    
* Creating of site-specific safety manual, with appropriate first aid cover and equipment present.
    
* Develop, maintain and update the Site Emergency Plan.
    
* Ensuring information is communicated effectively around the site.
    
* Planning for effective signage in line with corporate branding.
    
* Efficient management of any special public access roads – access to show houses/sales pavilions etc.
    
* Provision of an effective security management system that ensures all the above is achievable.
    

**Change Management**

* Variations and adjustments to Logistics Contractors scope, review the requirements and assess the impacts. Monitor construction change management process via the Engineer.
    

**Permitting**

* The Logistics Contractor’s acquisition of all necessary permits for smooth logistics operations.
    

**Cost**

* Review completeness of established budgets and review cost plans. Ensure that work is re-measured and work is signed off in accordance with the contract.
    

**Planning**

* The monthly detailed graphical time slice showing plot and infrastructure activities and how logistics will support.
    
* Review weekly plans, confirm the activities are accurate and coordinated across stakeholders.
    

**Risk**

* Review detailed risk register developed by logistics contractor and team coordinated with all site stakeholders, complete with implement mitigation plan.
    

**Interface**

* Provide coordination across all programme consultants and stakeholders related to logistics works.
    
* Provide support to plots in terms of external access and influences that impact plot activities.
    

**Communication**

* Through regular meetings, highlight issues, concerns and roll out weekly directions to stakeholder’s team managers. Seek resolution to any issues with the respective plot, infrastructure or logistics teams or escalate with the proposed mitigation plan.
    

**Reporting**

* Weekly issues through detailed logistics dashboards.
    

**Assurance**

* Submission of checklists of all logistics contractor self-audits (QA, Safety, Environmental, Welfare etc.) review and report on status.
    

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management or Real Estate Development
    
* Chartership preferred.
    
* CSCS, SMSTS/SSSTS, Recognised safety programme (qualified and up to date), First Aid, Lifting Supervisor Certification, Traffic management, Institutional membership.

* More than 15 years as a Sitewide Logistics expert in management of complex, matrixed team environments across multiple cultures.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

  

The Sr. Logistics Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing all logistical aspects of a construction project to ensure smooth site operations. This role involves managing the delivery, storage, and distribution of materials and equipment, organizing site access and traffic flow, and ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. The manager works closely with project teams, suppliers, and contractors to optimize resource utilization, minimize delays, and maintain accurate documentation. Their primary goal is to keep the site efficient, safe, and well-organized throughout the project lifecycle.

  

## Your role

  

**Performance**

  

* Effective delivery of site-wide logistics through the procurement of a site-wide Logistics management contractor.
* Define and monitor that the scope of services is delivered satisfactorily through setting and monitoring of measurable goals and objectives around the following broad key enablers.
* Orderly, safe and efficiently movement of labour, plant, and materials around site.
* Creation of a secure, well maintained site with regular logistics meetings.
* Efficient and orderly management of any worker’s accommodation.
* Development of processes, procedures and induction programmes.
* Supply chain management, movement plans and lookahead forecasting.
* Ensuring logistics activities are not a constraining factor on the program.
* Creating of site-specific safety manual, with appropriate first aid cover and equipment present.
* Develop, maintain and update the Site Emergency Plan.
* Ensuring information is communicated effectively around the site.
* Planning for effective signage in line with corporate branding.
* Efficient management of any special public access roads – access to show houses/sales pavilions etc.
* Provision of an effective security management system that ensures all the above is achievable.

  

**Change Management**

  

* Variations and adjustments to Logistics Contractors scope, review the requirements and assess the impacts. Monitor construction change management process via the Engineer.

  

**Permitting**

  

* The Logistics Contractor’s acquisition of all necessary permits for smooth logistics operations.

  

**Cost**

  

* Review completeness of established budgets and review cost plans. Ensure that work is re-measured and work is signed off in accordance with the contract.

  

**Planning**

  

* The monthly detailed graphical time slice showing plot and infrastructure activities and how logistics will support.
* Review weekly plans, confirm the activities are accurate and coordinated across stakeholders.

  

**Risk**

  

* Review detailed risk register developed by logistics contractor and team coordinated with all site stakeholders, complete with implement mitigation plan.

  

**Interface**

  

* Provide coordination across all programme consultants and stakeholders related to logistics works.
* Provide support to plots in terms of external access and influences that impact plot activities.

  

**Communication**

  

* Through regular meetings, highlight issues, concerns and roll out weekly directions to stakeholder’s team managers. Seek resolution to any issues with the respective plot, infrastructure or logistics teams or escalate with the proposed mitigation plan.

  

**Reporting**

  

* Weekly issues through detailed logistics dashboards.

  

**Assurance**

  

* Submission of checklists of all logistics contractor self-audits (QA, Safety, Environmental, Welfare etc.) review and report on status.

  

## About you

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management or Real Estate Development
* Chartership preferred.
* CSCS, SMSTS/SSSTS, Recognised safety programme (qualified and up to date), First Aid, Lifting Supervisor Certification, Traffic management, Institutional membership.

  

**Experience**

  

* More than 15 years as a Sitewide Logistics expert in management of complex, matrixed team environments across multiple cultures.
* Prior Abu Dhabi projects experience is mandatory (Hospitality, Mixed use, Residential projects).
* Fluent in English (read, write and speak).

## Overview

We are seeking an experienced Field Engineer – Architectural Finishes to supervise and monitor architectural finishing works for a prestigious large-scale development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all architectural finishes are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, design intent, and project schedules. Working closely with the Resident Engineer, Construction Manager, architects, interior designers, contractors, and specialist suppliers, the Field Engineer will play a vital role in delivering high-quality finishes across convention centers, hospitality facilities, mixed-use developments, and landmark building projects.

## Your role

* Supervise and inspect architectural finishing works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and contract requirements.
* Monitor installation of architectural finishes including wall finishes, ceilings, flooring, cladding, joinery, millwork, decorative elements, waterproofing, and façade-related finishes.
* Ensure finishes are delivered in accordance with design intent, approved material samples, mock-ups, and quality standards.
* Review shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical submissions related to architectural works.
* Conduct regular site inspections to verify workmanship quality and compliance with approved standards.
* Coordinate with architectural, structural, MEP, interior design, and specialist contractor teams to resolve interface issues.
* Monitor contractor progress and ensure finishing activities are aligned with approved construction schedules.
* Review mock-ups and sample installations and recommend acceptance or corrective actions.
* Verify that materials delivered to site comply with approved specifications and material submittals.
* Witness inspections and testing activities related to finishes, waterproofing systems, sealants, coatings, and façade elements.
* Ensure compliance with approved Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures.
* Identify quality deficiencies and issue site observations, non-conformance reports, and corrective action recommendations.
* Support the review and resolution of Requests for Information (RFIs), technical queries, and site instructions.
* Monitor contractor workmanship standards and ensure corrective actions are implemented where necessary.
* Participate in progress meetings, inspections, design coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
* Assist in verifying completed works for progress reporting and payment certification.
* Conduct snagging and de-snagging inspections and ensure timely closure of punch list items.
* Support testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and project handover activities.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental requirements during finishing operations.
* Maintain detailed records of inspections, approvals, observations, and project documentation.

* Experience reviewing shop drawings, materials, mock-ups, and technical submittals.

* Lead the design, analysis, and delivery of steel bridge structures across all project phases, from concept and preliminary design through detailed design, construction supervision, and project closeout.

Prepare, issue, and track document transmittals to clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders.

Control document revisions and ensure that only the latest approved versions of documents are available and used by the project team.

Monitor document review and approval workflows, follow up on outstanding submissions, and highlight delays that may impact project schedules or deliverables.
Manage and track project deliverables, including RFIs, shop drawings, technical submittals, material approvals, method statements, inspection requests, quality records, NCRs, reports, and other project documentation.
Support the preparation, submission, tracking, and maintenance of project quality documentation in coordination with the QA/QC team.
Ensure all document control activities are performed in compliance with the Company Quality Management System (QMS), project procedures, contractual requirements, and client requirements.
Prepare and maintain periodic document control reports, including document status reports, overdue submittal reports, outstanding review comments, and project KPI reports.
Support internal and external audits by providing accurate, complete, and traceable project records and documentation.
Coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, subcontractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders regarding document submissions, reviews, approvals, and close-out requirements.
Maintain complete project records throughout the project lifecycle, including defect liability, warranty, and contractual retention periods, in accordance with contractual, company, and legal requirements.
Compile, manage, and control project close-out documentation, including test reports, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, as-built drawings, authority approvals, handover packages, and final records.

## Overview

Engineering Services are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Communications Engineer to lead the development and implementation of our next-generation telecommunications systems and infrastructure, focusing on radio communications (particularly in the new area of 450MHz range), satellite, 5G, 6G, and next evolutions. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Instrumentations and Controls engineers, alongside operating sites, facility planning, and project management, to ensure the performance, reliability, and scalability of our industrial communications systems and infrastructure.

The Communications Engineer will provide professional advice and technical expertise to various teams, including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting communications systems. The candidate must be able to work with different disciplines and have excellent communication skills. The Engineer is expected to participate in company initiatives, including innovation programs, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing. Travel to different sites may be required, and the ability to work with others in a fast-paced environment is essential.

The Communications Engineer will serve as a technical expert and representative for the company in matters related to telecommunications and radio communications, providing expert technical recommendations to vendors, manufacturers, and design firms. The candidate should have a deep understanding of the latest advancements in 5G, 6G, satellite, and radio communications, as well as experience in designing and implementing robust and secure communications infrastructure

## Key Responsibilities

Provide technical support and expertise for the development, implementation, and troubleshooting of telecommunications systems and infrastructure, including radio communications, satellite communications, and 5G/6G technologies.

Originate and carry out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.

Work with and/or lead task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems, and undertake special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.

Develop and maintain company standards, material specifications, procedures, and best practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to telecommunications.

Review and evaluate capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services to the company, and act as a company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.

Evaluate and introduce best practices and new technologies to enable the company to achieve Best in Class performance in the telecommunications industry.

Perform cost analyses and Value Engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.

Conduct seminars and technical exchange meetings to promote new technologies and best practices to personnel from other engineering organizations and facilities.

Publish papers for peer-reviewed journals and deliver presentations to international audiences at technical exchange meetings.

Deliver technical courses to young talent in the company through the Technical Services Professional Academy (TSPA).

## Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Telecommunications, or Electronics and Communication), or a related field from an accredited university.

20 years of progressive experience in telecommunications, including at least 5 years focused on radio communications, satellite communications, and 5G technologies.

Must have knowledge of telecommunications systems, including network architecture, protocol, infrastructure design, and performance optimization. These include but not limited to: Experience in IoT/IIOT and its applications in telecommunications, experience in civil engineering and underground infrastructure, including the design and implementation of fiber-optic cables and other telecommunications infrastructure, experience in wireless communications, including Industrial wireless protocols (i.e., ISA100 and WirelessHART), strong understanding of telecommunications standards and regulations, including those related to 5G, 6G, satellite, and radio communications.

Must be recognized as a proven expert within the industry and professional societies and industrial organizations.
