## Job Description

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in GIS data conversion, cleansing, validation, and quality assurance, with a proven track record in converting utilities and infrastructure as-built drawings and data into structured, accurate, and topologically valid Enterprise GIS datasets.

The role will involve working closely with GIS teams, technical stakeholders, and clients to ensure the quality, accuracy, connectivity, and integrity of enterprise GIS data and support utilities and infrastructure data transformation initiatives.

## Qualifications

**1\. GIS Data Conversion & Transformation**

* Convert utilities and infrastructure as-built drawings and data into structured GIS datasets.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and preparation for Enterprise GIS environments.
* Ensure converted datasets comply with defined GIS data models, standards, and specifications.

**2\. GIS Data Quality Assurance & Validation**

* Conduct comprehensive GIS data validation and QA/QC activities.
* Identify and resolve spatial, attribute, topology, and connectivity issues.
* Ensure GIS datasets meet defined accuracy, completeness, consistency, and quality requirements.
* Validate network connectivity and applicable spatial and topological rules.

**3\. Utilities & Infrastructure GIS**

* Work with utilities, infrastructure, and land-related GIS datasets.
* Understand spatial relationships, network structures, and topological behaviors across utility and infrastructure assets.
* Apply appropriate validation and connectivity rules to ensure data integrity.
* Support the development and maintenance of reliable Enterprise GIS datasets.

**4\. Enterprise GIS & Geodatabase Management**

* Work extensively with the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem, particularly ArcGIS Pro and Enterprise Geodatabases.
* Support the development and implementation of enterprise geodatabase structures.
* Work with feature classes, relationships, domains, subtypes, topology, and network-related data structures.
* Ensure GIS data is properly structured and maintained according to enterprise requirements.

**5\. GIS Data Automation & Process Improvement**

* Develop and automate GIS data transformation and ETL workflows using Python, ArcGIS ModelBuilder, and/or FME.
* Identify opportunities to improve GIS data conversion, validation, and QA/QC processes.
* Support the optimization and standardization of GIS data management workflows.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geomatics, Geography, Surveying, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Additional qualifications in GIS or spatial data management are preferred.

**Professional Experience**

* 7+ years of hands-on experience specifically in utilities and infrastructure as-built conversion to GIS.
* Strong experience in GIS data extraction, conversion, cleansing, validation, and QA/QC.
* Strong experience working with utilities, infrastructure, and land GIS datasets.
* Experience with spatial relationships, topological behaviors, network connectivity, and GIS validation rules.
* Experience working with Enterprise GIS environments.
* Experience in consulting or client-facing environments is preferred.
* Candidates must be native Arabic speakers.
* Ability to join as soon as possible due to the urgency of the requirement.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem.
* Strong proficiency in ArcGIS Pro.
* Strong experience with Enterprise Geodatabases.
* Knowledge of GIS data conversion, cleansing, validation, and QA/QC.
* Knowledge of GIS topology and network connectivity.
* Experience with Python, ArcGIS ModelBuilder, and/or FME for GIS data transformation and ETL automation is preferred.
* Knowledge of enterprise geodatabase design, including:
    * Feature classes
    * Relationships
    * Domains
    * Subtypes
    * Topology
    * Network-related data structures
* Understanding of satellite imagery types, characteristics, applications, and major satellite imagery/data vendors is preferred.

**Certifications**

* Esri-related GIS certifications.
* Professional GIS, Geomatics, or related certifications.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Consulting and client-facing mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and support urgent project requirements.

* **English:** Professional proficiency.
* **Arabic:** Native / Fluent.

Track usage patterns on your accounts and flag drops in adoption. Support training sessions, walkthroughs, and webinars to help clinicians and hospital staff get comfortable with the product. Proactively follow up with low/non-users, understand barriers, retrain where required and drive sustained adoption.
4. On-ground Implementation & Training : Be physically present at hospitals during onboarding/go-live, train clinicians and staff, conduct floor-walking/at-elbow support, onboard new users and drive them from training to actual usage.
5. Post-Go-Live Account Management
Track support tickets and recurring issues for your accounts. Run regular check-ins per the playbook. Escalate technical issues you can't resolve directly to Support or Engineering with clear, reproducible detail.
6. Value Tracking
Help track usage and outcome data for your accounts and contribute input toward value summaries and case studies your manager builds with the customer.
7. Knowledge Sharing
Participate in internal knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute learnings from your accounts to the team's best practices.
8. References & Testimonials
Where accounts are strong, help facilitate testimonials and reviews, coordinated through your manager.
9. Churn Risk Flagging
Watch for early signs of account unhappiness (usage drop, unresolved complaints, disengaged stakeholders) and flag them to your manager promptly — you are not expected to independently run churn recovery.
10. Growth/Business Support
Identify potential upsell/cross-sell signals on your accounts and log them for your manager and the Sales team to act on. Support demos, POCs and new customer engagements when required, identify opportunities within existing accounts, and support the team with account expansion.
11. Relationship Building
Build working relationships with day-to-day users and hospital IT/clinical staff on your accounts. Senior stakeholder relationships (CIOs, CMIOs, hospital leadership) are owned by your manager — you support, not lead, those conversations.

How Performance Will Be Measured

• Onboarding completion rate and time-to-active-usage for assigned accounts

• Ticket resolution time and adoption issue turnaround

• CSAT/NPS on assigned accounts

• Timeliness and quality of account touchpoints per the CS playbook

• Quality of churn-risk flags raised (early and accurate vs. missed)

Required Experience & Skills

• 2-3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role — health-tech or healthcare experience is a plus, not required

• Bachelor's degree in any field

• Fluent in Arabic and English (spoken and written) — this role requires day-to-day communication with hospital staff and clinicians across Saudi Arabia

• Good communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable being the point of contact for customer issues within a defined scope

• Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple accounts and follow a structured playbook

Preferred

• Familiarity with CS tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar)

• Basic exposure to SaaS products, APIs, or technical support workflows

• Prior experience in healthcare, medical technology, or hospital environments

• Familiarity with the Saudi healthcare market and regulatory landscape

Why This Role Matters
Adoption is won or lost in the details — a clinician who gets stuck once and doesn't get help fast enough stops trusting the tool. You're the person making sure that doesn't happen on your accounts and building the account management instincts that turn into full account ownership over time.

description:
## Company Description

Doka is a global leader in innovative formwork solutions and services across all areas of construction, and a worldwide supplier of comprehensive scaffolding systems for a broad range of applications. With more than 150 sales and logistics facilities in over 54 countries, Doka provides a high‑performing distribution network that ensures expert advice, customer service and technical support on site, with equipment delivered quickly regardless of project size or complexity. Employing 8,400 people worldwide, Doka is part of the Umdasch Group, a company that has stood for reliability, experience and trustworthiness for more than 150 years and serves as the parent organization for its directly affiliated divisions, including Doka, umdasch The Store Makers and umdasch Industrial Solutions.

  Saudi Arabia is the largest country in the Middle East, covering most of the Arabian Peninsula and home to Islam’s two holiest cities, Mecca and Medina. With some of the world’s largest proven oil reserves, the Kingdom plays a central role in global energy markets while actively diversifying its economy through ambitious large‑scale development initiatives.

The country continues to drive one of the world’s most dynamic construction markets, fueled by landmark giga‑projects such as the Red Sea developments, Qiddiya, and Diriyah Gate. These projects are setting new standards in scale, engineering complexity, sustainability, and digital construction, creating strong demand for advanced formwork, engineering expertise, and innovative on‑site solutions. This environment offers highly attractive opportunities for talent, with Saudi Arabia recently recognised as one of the region’s most attractive employers due to its long‑term investment in infrastructure, innovation, and workforce development.

## Job Description

As the Head of Engineering, you are an important member of the country management team, representing your function and collaborating closely with all departments and stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of the country strategy.

You will be fully accountable for all topics related to Engineering and Product Management. You develop and manage your team ensuring that they are given the resources and opportunities they need to succeed. You enable them to provide the most suitable formwork designs for the challenging projects of our clients and to collaborate successfully within their team, with other departments and external parties.

If you are passionate about formwork and keen to develop your career as part of a high-performing team we are looking forward to hearing from you.

**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead and manage the Engineering department, including workforce planning, structure, and performance management
    

* Define and drive engineering strategies aligned with country business objectives
    

* Ensure delivery of efficient, safe, and cost-effective engineering solutions
    

* Monitor and drive departmental KPIs (e.g. design efficiency, project execution, resource utilization)
    

* Drive adoption of BIM for formwork design to improve efficiency, coordination, and reduce rework
    

* Strengthening engineering capabilities in high-rise and complex projects, positioning the organization as a leading solution provider
    

**Business Partnering & Commercial Support**

* Act as a key business partner to the Country Manager on strategic and operational decisions
    

* Support project costing, technical-commercial proposals, and risk assessment
    

* Drive engineering contributions towards improving project margins and overall business performance
    

* Ensure engineering solutions are aligned with commercial and contractual requirements
    

* Support execution of product strategy in alignment with regional direction and market needs
    

**Project & Technical Oversight**

Promote and enforce strong project management practices across the Engineering function

* Coordinate Group Leaders and engineering activities across projects to ensure alignment, efficiency, and timely delivery
    

* Oversee engineering execution across all projects to ensure quality, safety, and compliance
    

* Provide technical leadership for complex projects, claims, and site challenges
    

* Ensure optimal balance between technical feasibility, cost efficiency, and customer expectations
    

* Ensure all structural calculations and technical designs are reviewed and approved by qualified personnel
    

* Ensure quality assurance standards are consistently applied for local production and engineering deliverables
    

* Ensure full technical compliance with applicable local regulations and statutory requirements
    

* Support resolution of internal and external technical issues, including claims and change requests
    

**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team
    

* Strengthening leadership capabilities among Team Leaders and senior engineers
    

* Drive succession planning and talent development within the department
    

* Foster a culture of accountability, feedback and performance
    

* Act as a role model in line with our company culture, values and code of conduct
    

* Promote a mindset of continuous improvement, encouraging adoption of new methods, products, and emerging technologies, including AI
    

**Cross-Functional & Regional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Operations, and other departments as part of the Country Management Team
    

* Collaborate closely with the Regional Engineering team to align standards, leverage best practices, and optimize synergies
    

* Act as the key interface between country operations and regional engineering functions
    

* Leverage regional resources to balance workload, optimize capacity, and support complex project execution
    

**Governance, Standards & Safety**

* Ensure compliance with Doka Group standards, local regulations, and engineering best practices
    

* Maintain strong focus on safety across all engineering and site-related activities
    

* Establish and enforce engineering processes and standards
    

**Financial & Operational Management**

* Manage Engineering department budget and cost control
    

* Optimize resource allocation to improve productivity and efficiency
    

* Support planning, forecasting, and capacity management
    

* Ensure alignment between engineering output and business demand
    

**Site Engagement & Market Awareness**

* Maintain visibility on site activities, project execution, and customer requirements
    

* Capture site feedback to enhance engineering solutions and product application
    

* Monitor competitor solutions and industry trends
    

## Qualifications

**Professional Requirements:**

* Degree in Civil / Structural Engineering or equivalent
    

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in engineering, preferably in construction or formwork industry
    

* Strong technical knowledge in formwork systems, construction methodologies, and project execution
    

* Good understanding of commercial aspects, including costing, contracts and project profitability
    

**Leadership & Personal Competencies:**

* Proven leadership experience in managing and developing teams
    

* Strong business acumen with ability to balance technical and commercial considerations
    

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels
    

* Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional and multinational environment
    

* Proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven mindset
    

* High level of accountability, ownership, and decision-making capability
    

* Demonstrated leadership skills, adept at managing diverse and partly remote teams and delivering results
    

* Innovative mindset with a natural curiosity for new technologies and tools
    

**Added Advantages (Good to have, not necessary):**

* Experience working with regional or international teams
    

* Knowledge of Doka systems and tools (e.g. DokaCalc, AutoCAD, Revit, Time Cockpit)
    

* Familiarity with the Formwork engineering Industry in Saudi Arabia and Middle East construction markets
    

* Proficiency in spoken Arabic
    

**Why Join Doka?**

Join a global leader where you will be empowered to grow your career, work on impactful projects, and be part of a high-performing, collaborative team.

Pinnacle Solutions is looking for a CH-47 Flight Engineer/Mechaic to work in Tabuk, SA.  The CH-47F FE is responsible for monitoring the aircraft systems, diagnosing and eliminating any problems that may arise, and ensuring that all maintenance faults have been recorded and properly corrected in accordance with service guidance. These duties will be performed day and night as well as under VMC and IMC The CH-47F will also perform aircraft maintenance, repairs, modifications, and inspections in accordance with approved methods and practices per specific Technical Manuals, Operator Manual, Maintenance Test Flight Checklist, and any other directives pertinent to the environment. The CH-47F FE will also provide technical direction and training to the Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Command when needed.  To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

  
**Responsibilities**  
  

* Performs flight crew work supporting heavy multi-engine aircraft and providing assistance to the pilot in the overall operation of the aircraft.
* Conducts APU operations, perform crew duties during a maintenance test flight (MTFs), and maintenance operational checks (MOCs).
    
* Performs CH-47F maintenance tasks and duties as required using Technical Manuals, Operator Manuals, Maintenance Test Flight Manual, Check List Manual, and any other directives pertinent to the environment.
    
* Removes, inspects, troubleshoots, and installs aircraft system and subsystem components and subcomponents to include, but not limited to, engines, rotors, gearboxes, transmissions, flight controls, and hydraulics.
    
* Performs scheduled/unscheduled maintenance activities to include PMS, servicing and lubrication, and MOC/MTF support functions.
    
* Uses and performs operator maintenance on tools, special tools/test equipment, and Aircraft Ground Support Equipment (AGSE) and Peculiar Ground Support Equipment (PGSE).
    
* Prepares, reviews, and updates aircraft maintenance forms and records.
    
* Uses common measuring tools, measuring gauges, and alignment fixtures.
    
* Provides On-the-Job Training (OJT), coaching, and mentoring to Royal Saudi Land Forces Aviation Command (RSLAC) personnel in all aspects of aircraft maintenance activities.
    
* Ensures that all related maintenance operations are conducted in a safe manner.
    
* Other tasks as directed by the PC Manager and Maintenance Lead.
    

  
**Qualifications**  
  

* Eight (8) years' experience as an aircraft mechanic on CH-47F series aircraft.
* Successfully completed and be qualified by the appropriate U.S. Government armed forces CH-47 aircraft mechanic maintenance course or civilian equivalent training.
    
* Proficient in the use of computer-hosted interactive technical manuals, aircraft maintenance forms or similar aviation maintenance management system, and other aircraft-related documentation.
    
* Professional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
    
* Ability to effectively communicate with the customer in a professional and courteous manner.
    
* Possess a valid state or Government issued driver’s license.
    
* Successfully pass an overseas deployment physical upon hire.
    
* US Citizenship required.
    
* HS diploma required.
    

**Desired Qualifications:** 

* Military FE school trained.

description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Product & Solutions, Merchant Solutions, West Arabia

Overview  
MPGS provides an end-to-end and omnichannel payment gateway solution for merchants, payment facilitators and acquirers.  
Reporting into the VP Commercialization – MPGS & Acceptance Easter Europe, Middle-East and Africa, this role will be responsible for responsible for driving revenue growth and market share expansion by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities across the EEMEA region.  
  
Role and responsibilities:  
• Drive revenue growth by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities for MPGS and Acceptance in the EEMEA region.  
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers, including merchants, financial institutions, and other key stakeholders.  
• Develop a strong understanding of customer needs, customers’ product strategy, region conditions, and industry characteristics as they relate to products and platforms offerings  
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of MPGS products and services to customers.  
• Develop and execute sales strategies and plans to achieve revenue targets and market share expansion.  
• Conduct market research and analysis to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and market trends to inform sales strategies and plans.  
• Lead and participate in sales presentations, business case development, proposals, and contract negotiations to close new business deals.  
• Active participation in the customer planning process led by the account teams  
• Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, including pipeline management, conversion rates, and revenue growth.  
  
About you:  
• Minimum of 7 years of experience in sales, business development, or related roles in the payments industry.  
• Proven track record of driving revenue growth and market share expansion in the payments industry.  
• Deep knowledge of the payments industry and the EEMEA market.  
• Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.  
• Superior verbal and written communication skills  
• Self-starter, ability to deal with ambiguity  
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and matrixed environment  
• Experienced with MS Excel modeling

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
    
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
    
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
    
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
Permanent

**IP Services Administrator**

  

**Job Purpose**

  

To handle administrative functions relating to the management and prosecution of trade marks, patents and designs.

  

**Job Requirements**

The main responsibilities of the role are to:

* Utilise tools within an intellectual property database to prepare trade mark, patent and design application forms and other routine English language documentation relating to the filing and prosecution of trade mark, patent and design applications.
* Organise the translation of correspondence between Clyde & Co and the Trade Marks and Patent Office (i.e. arranging for letters from the Office to be translated into English and for letters from Clyde & Co to the Trade Marks or Patent Office to be translated into English and Arabic).
* Liaise with case handlers to prepare routine letters and documents (based on precedents). This will include, for example, trade mark approval sheets, Powers of Attorney and standard letters instructing corresponding agents and reporting to clients.
* Management of original documents.
* Make telephone calls to the Trade Marks and Patent Offices.
* Accurately enter data into the trade mark database.
* Take responsibility for the quality of all work produced.
* Effectively monitor all case deadlines.
* Provide cover for team member absences.
* Ad hoc duties as directed by IP Operations Manager.

  

**Candidate Requirements**

We are interested in candidates with:

* Education up to high school level or equivalent; degree desirable.
* Previous administration experience gained within professional services; trade mark or patent administration experience essential.
* Excellent written and spoken Arabic and English.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent organisational skills.
* An ability to work in a team — the role will involve working as part of a team of administrators and receiving instructions from paralegals and case handlers.
* An ability to multi-task.
* An ability to prioritise a very busy workload and work effectively under pressure.

**About the company**  
Our client does AI match analysis for youth football. Fixed cameras at the pitch record every session. The models detect the events (passes, shots, goals), track the players, and read jersey numbers off low-res footage. Academies and parents get match stats, highlights and a per-player record. This is running today at a pilot academy in Dubai, on real matches, with paying pilots. They are now taking the same stack into a second industry. First customers are committed; details in conversation. This hire owns the platform across both: making the live sports models better, and building the new product on the same foundations.  
  
**What you own**  
• The shared CV platform, end to end: camera ingestion, detection and tracking, OCR, classification, and the reporting pipeline. It powers a product in production today and a second one launching.  
• From week one you ship to a live product: raising accuracy on the sports models with real users, while architecting the second industry's deployment on the same stack.  
• Architecture: model selection and training strategy, annotation and dataset operations, evaluation methodology, the on-prem/cloud split.  
• Shipping the new industry's first deployments, then hardening both products as one platform. • Technical leadership of the engineering team we build under you.  
  
**Hiring process  
**• Intro conversation: walk us through a CV system you built. Decisions, failures, numbers.  
• Technical deep-dive with senior engineers.  
• Case study on real footage: spec and prototype a detection task.  
• Founders' conversation, then offer.  
  
The whole process inside two weeks for the right person  
  

**Requirements**

**What we need to see**  
• 5+ years building computer vision systems that ran in production. Deployed systems with users, not notebooks.  
• Strong Python and PyTorch, hands-on with modern detection and tracking (YOLO family, ByteTrack/DeepSORT or similar).  
• Video pipeline experience: RTSP/IP cameras, scheduled or streaming inference, ffmpeg-level fluency.  
• You have built datasets, run annotation operations, and measured models honestly against ground truth.  
• You have fine-tuned open-source models (detection, OCR of the PaddleOCR/TrOCR class) and taken the next step: replacing them with your own models trained on validated annotations, with a working annotation-review loop.  
• Fluent in the modern CV tooling ecosystem: Roboflow or equivalent for dataset and annotation operations, experiment tracking, model registries.  
• Ownership temperament: you take a vague operational goal and return a working system without waiting for a spec.  
  
**Strong pluses**  
• OCR, action recognition or pose estimation in production.  
• Sports, retail, industrial or facility camera-analytics background.  
• Edge deployment (Jetson or similar) and cost engineering of inference.  
• Camera and IoT literacy: sensor and lens selection, PoE networking, ONVIF/RTSP, NVRs, weatherproof housings. You can spec a site, not just a model.

**Benefits**

Full-time. Remote friendly: we hire the best person, not the nearest. Working hours overlapping the Gulf, with travel to Dubai for installation and milestone weeks. Competitive package plus options.

## Company Description

Assystem is now one of the world's three leading independent nuclear engineering companies. With more than 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors, the group supports public and industrial players in the implementation of complex and strategic infrastructure projects, subject to high safety and security requirements.

Assystem mobilizes 8,000 experts in 13 countries and is involved in the entire project life cycle, in engineering, project management and digital solutions.

## Job Description

\*\*Job Responsibilities\*\*

For an upcoming major infrastructure project, we are scouting for the following talent to fill critical leadership positions:

\*\*Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure (15+ years exp)\*\*

* Oversee end-to-end project delivery for infrastructure components, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, budgets, and resource plans
* Lead cross-functional teams and coordinate with external stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution
* Monitor project performance against KPIs and implement corrective actions as needed
* Manage project risks, issues, and changes through established governance frameworks

\*\*Senior Project Manager - Building (15+ years exp)\*\*

* Direct all aspects of building construction and development, from planning through completion
* Ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and contractors to maintain project specifications
* Track construction progress and manage budget expenditures
* Facilitate communication between project teams and stakeholders

\*\*Senior Project Manager - Utilities (15+ years exp)\*\*

* Manage utility infrastructure projects including water, power, and telecommunications systems
* Coordinate with utility providers and regulatory agencies to ensure project compliance
* Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of utility systems
* Maintain detailed documentation and reporting on utility project milestones
* Address technical challenges and implement solutions to maintain project momentum

\*\*HSE Manager (15+ years exp)\*\*

* Develop and implement comprehensive health, safety, and environmental policies and procedures
* Conduct regular safety audits and inspections across all project sites
* Investigate incidents and implement preventive measures to minimize workplace hazards
* Provide safety training and awareness programs for all project personnel
* Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations and industry best practices

\*\*Contract and Procurement Manager (15+ years exp)\*\*

* Develop procurement strategies and manage vendor selection processes
* Negotiate contracts and agreements with suppliers and service providers
* Monitor contract performance and ensure adherence to terms and conditions
* Manage procurement budgets and track expenditures
* Maintain vendor relationships and resolve procurement-related disputes

\*\*Risk Manager (18+ years exp)\*\*

* Identify, assess, and quantify project risks across all disciplines
* Develop risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans
* Monitor risk indicators and provide regular risk reporting to senior leadership
* Facilitate risk workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions
* Implement risk management tools and processes throughout the project lifecycle

\*\*Stakeholder Manager (15+ years exp)\*\*

* Develop and execute stakeholder engagement strategies and communication plans
* Maintain relationships with government agencies, community groups, and other key stakeholders
* Organize and facilitate stakeholder meetings and public consultations
* Address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations throughout project delivery
* Prepare stakeholder reports and manage project communications

## Qualifications

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, project management, construction management, or relevant technical discipline
* Minimum 15+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, construction, or related project management (18+ years for Risk Manager role)
* Professional Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent)
* Demonstrated expertise in managing large-scale infrastructure projects with budgets exceeding $50 million
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices
* Proficiency in project management software and tools (MS Project, Primavera, or similar)

\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Advanced degree (Master's) in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
* Additional certifications relevant to specific role (e.g., NEBOSH for HSE, CIPS for Procurement, or Risk Management certifications)
* Experience with public-private partnerships (PPP) or government-funded infrastructure projects
* Track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget
* Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams across diverse stakeholder groups
* Knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for infrastructure projects
* Demonstrated leadership and mentoring capabilities for senior-level positions

## Additional Information

* Communications & Presentation Skills
* Quality Consciousness
* Attention to Details
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Results Orientation
* Planning and organizing with time management
* Relationship Management

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

## Company Description

Assystem is an international company with one mission: accelerate the energy transition around the world.  
  
Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia & Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low-carbon energy.  
  
We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.  
  
Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.  
  
To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all

**About Neuberger:**

Neuberger was founded in 1939 to do one thing: deliver compelling investment results for our clients over the long term. This remains our singular purpose today, driven by a culture rooted in deep fundamental research, the pursuit of investment insight and continuous innovation on behalf of clients, and facilitated by the free exchange of ideas across the organization.

As a private, independent, employee-owned investment manager, Neuberger is structurally aligned with the long-term interests of our clients. We have no external parent or public shareholders to serve, nor other lines of business to distract us from our core mission, and with our employees and their families invested alongside our clients - plus 100% of employee deferred cash compensation directly linked to team and firm strategies - we are truly in this together.

From offices in 40 cities worldwide, Neuberger manages a range of equity, fixed income, private equity and hedge fund strategies on behalf of institutions, advisors and individual investors worldwide. With more than 700 investment professionals and more than 2,900 employees in total, Neuberger has built a diverse team of individuals united in their commitment to client outcomes and investment excellence. Our culture has afforded us enviable retention rates among our senior investment staff and has earned us citations in the top-ranked firms (among those with 1,000 or more employees) in the Pensions & Investments “Best Places to Work in Money Management” survey each year since 2013.

For more information, please visit our website at www.neuberger.com.

We are seeking an experienced Office Manager & Executive Assistant to join us on a 5-month contract.

You will be a strong team player with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, along with the ability to demonstrate initiative — proactively anticipating the needs of your client base.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provide administrative support for members of the team

* Maintain and manage the log of annual general partner meetings and other industry conferences
* Register team members for conferences and events, coordinating all associated logistics
* Serve as a key liaison for the team with internal groups and support areas across the firm

*Finance & Vendor Management*

* Process business expenses for the team and perform monthly reconciliation of corporate card statements
* Coordinate print jobs with internal or external printers, as applicable
* Maintain office supplies and manage multiple office vendors and service providers, including facilities management, hospitality, and housekeeping

*Office & Facilities Management*

* Act as the main point of contact for office-related matters, including facilities, landlord communication, permits, and ongoing maintenance
* Ensure the Riyadh office remains fully operational, coordinating any office setup or operational requirements
* Liaise with IT on video conference setups or other matters requiring IT support
* Assist with yearly office archiving

*HR & Local Compliance (Riyadh)*

* Act as the Riyadh office point of contact for day-to-day HR matters
* Support the onboarding of new employees
* Manage local portals such as Qiwa and GOSI, including contracts, renewals, and employee follow-ups
* Coordinate employee visa applications and required travel documentation

* Experience as an Executive Assistant, Support Assistant, or in another relevant role within the financial services industry
* Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work confidently and professionally with senior-level individuals across the firm
* Excellent organizational skills, with a high level of attention to detail
* Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks efficiently
* Resourceful and adaptable, able to manage multiple and changing priorities
* Proactive approach to following up on details, anticipating issues, and closing out requests
* Excellent phone and in-person manner, with a strong customer service focus in a demanding work environment
* Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information
* Team-oriented, while also capable of working independently with minimal guidance
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook)

The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the review, coordination, and supervision of all mechanical aspects of AAR's construction projects, ensuring compliance with project requirements, design intent, quality standards, operational needs, and applicable regulations.

**Job Description:**

**Design & Technical Review**

* Review mechanical drawings, calculations, technical submittals, shop drawings, material approvals, and method statements.

* Support design reviews and provide technical recommendations to optimize system performance, maintainability, and cost efficiency.

* Provide technical recommendations to improve functionality, constructability, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.

  

**Site Supervision & Construction Monitoring**

* Review and supervise the installation of mechanical systems, ensuring compliance with design documents, technical specifications, and applicable codes and standards.

* Review and supervise mechanical works, including plumbing and fire protection systems, to ensure compliance with approved drawings, technical specifications, project requirements, and applicable codes and standards.

* Monitor construction activities to ensure proper implementation of mechanical systems, identifying and resolving technical issues when required.

* Coordinate with other engineering disciplines (civil, architectural, electrical) to ensure proper integration of all systems.

  

**Inspection, Testing & Quality Control**

* Track, review, and approve the full inspection cycle: vendor, subcontractor, material, and testing-laboratory approval; verification of materials on delivery; stage-by-stage inspection and acceptance of works; testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and final handover; and support for quantity verification, progress measurement, and payment certification.

* Participate in inspections, testing, commissioning activities, and final acceptance procedures.

* Verify compliance with quality assurance and quality control requirements related to mechanical works.

  

**Coordination & Procurement Support**

* Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and site supervisors on all mechanical engineering matters.

* Support procurement activities by reviewing technical specifications, evaluating suppliers, and participating in technical bid assessments.

  

**Reporting & Risk Management**

* Monitor project progress related to mechanical activities and report potential risks, delays, or technical concerns.

* Prepare technical reports, site observations, punch lists, and progress updates for project management and clients.

  

**HSE Compliance**

Ensure mechanical installations comply with health, safety, and environmental requirements.

description:

The successful Insider Threat Analyst must be a team player as well as an individual contributor. • Strong problem-solving skills, ability to analyze complex multivariate problems and use a systematic approach to gain quick resolution

• Ability to access and analyze data using industry standard tools (e.g. Microsoft Excel / Power BI, Tableau, MySQL, PostgreSQL, R, MS SQL, ElasticSearch / Opensearch, Lucene, Kibana, Tableau, Crystal Reports).

• Excellent communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills, both internally and externally. Ability to communicate findings to all levels of Management team to include Director and C-Suite levels.

Joining DTEX means working on some of the most complex and high-impact security challenges facing enterprises today.

[Snap Inc](https://www.snap.com/en-US/) is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

  

The Company operates [Snapchat](http://snapchat.com/?lang=en-US), a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and [Specs Inc.](https://www.specs.com/), a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to [Bitmoji](http://bitmoji.com/), Saturn, and other digital services.

  

The Global Brand Experience (GBX) team brings Snap’s brands to life, while reinforcing what we stand for as a company — real friendship, free and authentic expression, human-centered design, and a playful irreverence. The team does this globally through in-person and virtual experiences for our clients & partners, current and future employees and our community of creators and users.  The GBX team’s mission is to educate our broader community on Snap’s brands by creating opportunities to connect with them on a more emotional level. The team looks for extraordinary and diverse talent who learn quickly, take big risks, and relish in surprising and delighting our community.

We’re looking for a Global Brand Experience Lead to join the Global Brand Experience team at Snap Inc! Working from our Riyadh office, you’ll play an important role in bringing Snapchat’s brand to life in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, as well as external partners and vendors, to develop and execute events and experiences.

What you’ll do:

* Partner closely with the Head of GBX MENA to shape and execute the regional brand experience strategy.
    
* Lead the conceptualization and execution of high-impact events, activations, and programs across the Middle East, with a primary focus on KSA.
    
* Build and deliver a regional roadmap of experiences that bring Snap’s products, technology, and innovation to life.
    
* Identify strategic opportunities to showcase Snapchat’s priorities, new products, and creative solutions through inspiring activations that drive client engagement and revenue growth.
    
* Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, budgets, deliverables, and success metrics, in collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Comms, and other cross-functional teams.
    
* Manage end-to-end execution — from ideation and creative development to logistics, production, branding, and on-site delivery.
    
* Build and maintain strong relationships with venues, vendors, agencies, and production partners across KSA.
    
* Manage the budget tracking and financial management for GBX MENA initiatives.
    
* Measure and optimize event ROI, ensuring clear business impact and alignment with company priorities.
    

## Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
    
* Excellent negotiation skills and a solid understanding of vendor, venue, and agency contracts.
    
* Established network within Riyadh and across KSA’s events and entertainment ecosystem.
    
* Proven experience delivering partner-driven activations and navigating legal and contractual frameworks.
    
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
    
* Meticulous attention to detail across creative, production, and brand execution.
    
* Solutions-oriented mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
    
* Deep awareness of regional cultural moments and industry trends.
    
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, Apple tools, and emerging AI platforms.
    

## Minimum Qualifications

* BS/BA degree or equivalent professional experience.
    
* 5+ years of experience successfully managing and producing large-scale events or experiential activations.
    
* Ability to travel up to 30% of the time.
    
* Fluency in English and Arabic.
    

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting sales and advertising initiatives within a tech, media, or production environment.
    
* Proven track record of delivering culturally relevant and innovative brand activations.
    
* Strong business acumen with a clear understanding of event-driven revenue impact.
    
* Passion for the Snapchat brand and its community.

description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

We are looking for a Territory Lead to support the growth of our Endoscopy and Sports Medicine Division in the Central Region of KSA:  
  
**What you will do:**

* Establishing and developing relationships with current and potential customers in their area of responsibility and maintaining its continuity 
* Tracking trends, competitors, developments in specific products and legal regulations in their area of responsibility and reporting to their manager 
* Carrying out the sales-related activities in accordance with the regional sales targets determined in line with the company's strategies and sales targets and preparing the sales reports requested by the manager 
* Planning, implementing and reporting customer/partner visits and demos in accordance with the sales targets and customer demands 
* Evaluating the requests for proposals from the customer/partners in their area of responsibility and preparing a complete list of materials according to the customer needs 
* Informing customers about purchasing methods (tender, intermediate purchase, leasing, external purchase etc.) and cooperating with the tender department in the projects decided to be procured and supporting the completion and reporting of the projects. 
* Keeping track of material delivery dates in their area of responsibility and informing customers 
* Carrying out the delivery and installation of the materials, providing post-sales user training for product portfolio and attending the surgery cases. 
* Bringing customer bills to the accrual stage and following up the collections with the Finance and Accounting department to ensure that the collections are made at given due dates 
* Communicating customer feedback (complaint) to the Quality Management Representative and Manager, evaluating the feedback in their own area of responsibility, taking necessary actions and reporting them to the customer and related persons 
* Preparing the Congress/Demo materials, using them appropriately and delivering the materials to the storehouse in a sterilized and non-damaged condition 
* Communicating scientific support requests & plans to the marketing department in the regions where they work and supporting the process. 
* Providing support to the logistics team when needed. 

**What you need:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, medical or related 
* 2-3 years commercial experience as territory lead or similar
* Experience in Sports Medicine 
* Proficiency in English 

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Endoscopy

Travel Percentage: 80%

  

Stryker is one of the world’s leading medical technology companies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. We offer innovative products and services in Orthopaedics, Medical and Surgical, and Neurotechnology and Spine that help improve patient and hospital outcomes. **We are proud to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces!** For more information, visit: [www.stryker.com](https://www.stryker.com)

**Work Flexibility**

* **Remote** – Role allows you to work the majority to 100% of time from an alternate workplace. These roles could have travel expectations, and you must work within the country of the job requisition location.

* **Field-based** – You can expect to regularly work a majority to 100% of time at customer facilities and has a set territory or expectation to travel within a set boundary. Almost all sales roles would likely be qualified as field-based.

* **Onsite –** Role is 100% located at a Stryker facility. Some ad hoc flexibility may be available depending on role, level, and job requirements. Manufacturing roles and any role that requires physical presence at the office would qualify under this category.

* **Hybrid** – You can expect to regularly work in both an alternate workplace and a Stryker facility. Roles that are partially remote or co-located would qualify as hybrid, and the expectation to be onsite would be defined and agreed upon by your manager/supervisor.

job_title: Product and Application Manager - (Tissue Diagnostics - Histopahtology)
description: Product & Application Manager Leica Biosystems | Saudi Arabia About Leica Biosystems At Leica Biosystems , our mission is Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives . As a global leader in anatomical pathology solutions and part of Danaher, we support the pathology workflow from biopsy to diagnosis, helping laboratories and healthcare professionals deliver the answers patients need. Join us to bring this mission to life across Saudi Arabia. You will combine your histopathology expertise with product and people leadership to help customers adopt solutions that strengthen laboratory performance and support cancer diagnostics. Your Role As Product & Application Manager , you will lead product strategy and application excellence for the Leica Biosystems histopathology portfolio in Saudi Arabia. You will manage and develop the Application Consultant team , drive product adoption and market penetration, and support product launches and expansion projects. You will also own tender response strategy and execution, including NUPCO and major institutional tenders , and lead market feasibility assessments to identify opportunities for portfolio growth. Working closely with Sales, Service, Marketing, and Shared Services, you will turn customer needs and market insights into clear priorities and coordinated action. A strong, hands-on histopathology background is essential. You should be confident engaging with pathologists and laboratory leaders, guiding application teams, and explaining the clinical, operational, and commercial value of our solutions. Your Responsibilities Product Strategy & Market Development Lead local product strategy and execution across the histopathology portfolio, aligned with regional and global priorities. Drive product adoption, market penetration, launches, and expansion projects through clear plans developed with commercial and application teams. Lead market feasibility assessments to evaluate customer demand, portfolio gaps, competitive positioning, and new business opportunities. Share market intelligence and customer feedback with regional and global teams to inform portfolio priorities and investment decisions. Application Excellence & Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the Application Consultant team, setting clear objectives and strengthening histopathology expertise, customer engagement, and technical capability. Ensure high-quality product demonstrations, evaluations, validation support, and customer training across the histopathology workflow. Act as the histopathology subject matter expert for complex opportunities, scientific discussions, and key customer engagements. Build trusted relationships with pathologists and laboratory stakeholders, and partner with Sales and Service to resolve application challenges and support successful product adoption. Tender Strategy & Project Ownership Own the end-to-end tender response process for NUPCO and major institutional opportunities, from requirements review and response strategy through submission and follow-up. Coordinate Tendering, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Legal teams to deliver compliant, competitive submissions within agreed timelines. Lead the development of technical responses and customer value propositions, ensuring product specifications and supporting documentation are accurate and complete. Support post-tender clarifications and coordinate the handover of awarded projects to the relevant teams. Marketing & Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Marketing to deliver local campaigns, workshops, scientific events, and product launch activities that address customer needs. Work closely with Sales, Service, and Shared Services to align priorities and provide a consistent customer experience. Contribute to initiatives across Danaher operating companies and the Diagnostics platform in Saudi Arabia. DBS & Continuous Improvement Apply Danaher Business System (DBS) tools to strengthen standard work, improve processes, and maintain execution discipline. Use Daily Management and KPI tracking to monitor progress, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement. What You Bring A bachelor’s degree in Histopathology, Biomedical Sciences, Medical Laboratory Sciences, Life Sciences , or a related discipline. An advanced degree is an advantage. A strong, hands-on histopathology background covering tissue processing, staining, immunohistochemistry (IHC), and laboratory workflows. 7–10 years of relevant experience in applications, product management, or commercial roles within diagnostics or life sciences. Proven experience leading and developing application or technical teams . Strong knowledge of the Saudi healthcare market , including Ministry of Health (MOH) and institutional customers, with experience in NUPCO tender processes . Experience supporting product launches, market development, and expansion projects. The ability to build credibility with pathologists and laboratory leaders and translate technical information into clear customer value. Strong communication, presentation, coaching, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to deliver results in a matrix organisation. Fluency in English . Arabic is a strong advantage. How You Work You take ownership, follow through on commitments, and put customers at the centre of your decisions. You combine strategic thinking with practical execution, develop the people around you, and work across teams with integrity, accountability, and a commitment to continuous improvement. About Danaher Leica Biosystems is part of Danaher , a global life sciences and diagnostics innovator. Together, we bring science, technology, and operational capabilities to customer challenges that matter to human health. At Danaher, we value the different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives of our associates, customers, and shareholders. We recognise both our similarities and our differences and the contribution they make to our workplace and the markets we serve. Learn more at Leica Biosystems and Danaher . Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit www.danaher.com .

job_title: HSE Coordinator - Rig (Oil & Gas) Saudi Arabia)
description:
We are seeking an experienced **HSE Coordinator** to support Health, Safety, and Environmental activities for Oil & Gas operations in the Eastern Province. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring HSE activities, ensuring compliance with Saudi Aramco and project HSE requirements, and promoting a strong safety culture across operational sites.

Candidates with experience in both **Rig/Drilling and Non-Rig Oil & Gas environments** are encouraged to apply.

### Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and monitor the implementation of HSE policies, procedures, and project safety requirements.
* Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco HSE standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Conduct regular HSE inspections, audits, and site safety assessments.
* Identify unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, and potential hazards and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor and support the implementation of Permit to Work (PTW), Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and risk assessment processes.
* Participate in incident and accident investigations, including root cause analysis and corrective action follow-up.
* Prepare and maintain HSE reports, inspection reports, incident reports, and safety performance records.
* Coordinate and conduct safety inductions, toolbox talks, HSE awareness sessions, and safety training programs.
* Organize and participate in emergency response drills and ensure personnel are familiar with emergency procedures.
* Monitor the proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and other HSE-critical equipment.
* Participate in safety meetings and communicate HSE alerts, lessons learned, and safety initiatives to employees.
* Follow up on observations, audit findings, and non-conformances to ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Promote a proactive safety culture and encourage reporting of unsafe acts and conditions.
* Coordinate with project management, supervisors, contractors, and client representatives on HSE-related matters.
* Monitor environmental compliance, waste management, spill prevention, and other environmental protection requirements.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5+ years of HSE experience** in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Energy, Construction, Drilling, or Industrial projects.
* Previous experience working on **Saudi Aramco projects is highly preferred.**
* Saudi Aramco RTS approval/experience will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Rig/Drilling operations or Non-Rig Oil & Gas operations will be considered.
* Strong knowledge of Saudi Aramco HSE requirements, standards, and procedures.
* Good understanding of PTW, JSA, Risk Assessment, HAZID, Incident Investigation, and Emergency Response.
* Experience conducting HSE inspections, audits, toolbox talks, safety meetings, and training programs.
* NEBOSH IGC certification is highly preferred.
* Additional certifications such as IOSH, OSHA, ISO 45001, First Aid, H2S, Confined Space, or Fire Safety will be advantageous.
* Strong reporting, documentation, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently in field and operational environments.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.

The Video Content Producer brings KAUST’s stories to life in post-production — shaping raw footage into polished, brand-aligned content that communicates the University’s research, people, and mission to audiences across digital and institutional channels. The role combines strong editorial judgement with technical expertise across editing, colour grading, and motion graphics.

Working from production briefs under the direction of the Multimedia and Brand Production Manager, the Video Content Producer manages video projects from creative concept through to final delivery, contributes actively to pre-production planning, and serves as the team’s primary owner of motion graphics and 2D animation. The role requires a strong editorial sensibility, precise technical craft, and the discipline to manage multiple projects simultaneously to tight deadlines.

The Video Content Producer is expected to engage proactively in the team’s creative planning pipeline, maintain rigorous DAM and workflow discipline, and bring genuine creative investment to every production. Occasional out-of-office hours working will be required, for which overtime will be paid.

### Key Responsibilities

**Pre-Production**

* Review and analyse production briefs and participate in briefing sessions with relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute to storyboards, editorial structures, mood boards, and creative references.
* Identify and retrieve suitable archival footage and licensed media assets.
* Coordinate with production teams regarding shoot requirements, technical specifications, and footage handover.

**Editing and Post-Production**

* Edit and produce video content including documentaries, interviews, promotional videos, research communications, and social media content.
* Apply transitions, motion graphics, visual effects, and animations.
* Produce 2D motion graphics and animated sequences.
* Perform professional colour correction and colour grading.
* Mix and master audio, including music, voice-over, dialogue, and ambient sound.
* Prepare final video projects in appropriate formats for web, social media, YouTube, LED screens, and other channels.
* Manage multiple editing projects while maintaining quality and meeting delivery deadlines.

**Project Management and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Manage assigned video projects from creative concept through final delivery.
* Maintain clear communication with stakeholders regarding project requirements and timelines.
* Provide creative guidance and constructive feedback on video requirements.
* Maintain project schedules and proactively identify delivery or resourcing risks.

**Asset Management and Workflow**

* Upload and organize production assets within defined timelines.
* Apply proper metadata, tags, and naming conventions.
* Maintain organized project files, footage, and finished assets within servers and DAM systems.
* Track production activities, tasks, edit notes, comments, and deliverables using Asana or equivalent project management tools.
* Maintain editing workstations and software and report technical or licensing issues when required.

**Creative Contribution**

* Participate in creative planning sessions and contribute editorial and motion graphics ideas.
* Stay updated with emerging trends, techniques, and tools in video editing and post-production.
* Actively contribute to the editorial quality and visual impact of final productions

**Requirements**

### Qualifications

* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Film-making, Media Production, or a related discipline.
* Additional training or certification in colour grading, motion graphics, or post-production workflows is desirable.

### Experience

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience as a Video Editor within a large organization or creative agency.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating editorial range and high-quality post-production work.
* Demonstrated experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.
* Proven experience in Adobe After Effects, including 2D animation and typographic sequences.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and working under tight deadlines.
* Experience in institutional, corporate, or higher education video production is desirable.
* Experience with 3D animation software such as Cinema 4D or Blender is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Avid Media Composer is desirable.
* Experience working alongside or directing camera operators during location productions is an advantage.

### Technical Skills

* Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects.
* Strong knowledge of colour science, colour grading workflows, and LUT management.
* Competence in audio mixing and sound design.
* Knowledge of video/audio formats, codecs, and multi-platform delivery specifications.
* Familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems and metadata standards.
* Experience using Asana or equivalent project management tools.
* High IT literacy across Windows and macOS environments.

### Additional Requirements

* A portfolio or showreel of previous video editing work is required.
* Ability to work outside regular office hours when production schedules require it.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail, creativity, communication, organization, and teamwork skills.

About us: -
At Crowne Plaza®, we want our guests to feel able to do their best, achieve their goals and be recognized for their success. We’re Making Business Travel Work by Bringing Humanity to Business Travel. We challenge the old world of business that’s overly formal, rigid and where guests feel like a room number not a person. We embrace the new world of business with caring and flexibility – through hotel colleagues who Dare to Connect!
Dare to Connect is how we describe the Service Style at Crowne Plaza hotels. It shows we’re thinking and acting differently. We’re connecting with guests – and each other – in a more personal way. We’re showing our personalities (and sharing a little of ourselves) and learning more about the other person… as a person, not as a room number or a co-worker. When we Dare to Connect, it means we:
Dare to Make the First Move… we are proactive and positive… we are the first to greet and say hello, and the first to take action and help our guests.
Adapt to the Moment… we might not be mind readers, but we can read our guest’s moods and needs and then change our pace, tone and take action so we can help a guest when they need it.
Relate to Business Needs… we know that Modern Business Travelers need to be productive, so we make sure we prioritize the right things that help our guests do what’s important.
Enable Quality Downtime… we know our guests want more from their trip than just business, so we make an effort to get to know them and give them recommendations that help them make the most out of their free time.

YOUR DAY TO DAY: -
To develop and set revenue strategies for the hotel, ensure business plans are created and implemented, monitor results from sales goals and targets and drive revenues by selling the facilities the hotel has to offer to day to day client contact. Lead the wider sales team to achieve measurable business outcomes and ensure direction is taken from the GM / Delegate.
Key Accountabilities:
In conjunction with the GM and Commercial Team create and implement a sales plan that drives measurable outcomes including ( but not Key Metrics Organisational Parameters

exclusively) the following metrics, Topline Revenues , GOP, TGOP, RGI, RevPar, ADR, M&E & F&B Revenues and average spends.

Set sales team goals in order to maximize profitability across the sales department.

Supports the General Manager to prepare the hotels annual budget and financial plans over 1/3/5 years

Produce monthly reports and forecasts in order to demonstrate current and potential market trends

Co-ordinate and Lead Sales and Marketing activates to increase revenue and market share

Engage with the IHG RFP program in order to maximize the hotel market share from the corporate segment.

Ensure the Sales team maintain and develop relationships with hotel key accounts and identify new potential accounts by setting up the appropriate sales activities.

Support the GM by ensuring the sales team are engaging a portfolio of key accounts while maintaining the relationship with the IHG KAD’s through regular contact and interaction.

To drive a sales culture across the entire hotel by ensuring the entire hotel team are proactively create and convert revenue opportunities in all areas and outlets of the hotel by planning and executing sales activities based on strategies and financial targets ( e.g. hotel revenue, room night goals) outlined in the hotel’s annual Integrated Business Plan (IBP).

Ensure all databases, client profiles and promotions are updated and accurate at all times ensuring GDPR compliance

With decision making around sales opportunities to benefit the total revenue of the hotel.

Key Collaboration Network:
Key Shared Accountabilities – Total Revenue and Key Financial performance metrics, Guest Lover, GOP
Key Interface – Marketing Team, Reservation Team, M&E team, Front Office Team, Finance Team

What WE NEED FROM YOU:-
Educational Attainment:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent International degree in Marketing, Business or Commerce

Multiple Language capabilities, local language preferred (Arabic)

Critical Expertise & Experience:
3-5 years of experience in hospitality or hotel sales and marketing with direct line management / supervisory experience over a sales team

Previous progressive experience in the following areas Sales, Channel Management, Distribution, Revenue Management, Hotel Management and Marketing

Experience of effective use of sale management and reporting platforms which can demonstrate delivery of results

Demonstrated experience working with multiple cultures and managing hotels/vendors/owners across different countries within hospitality or related industry

Established network of clients and business contacts

Experience in engaging and navigating a global sales organisation

Strong influencing/consensus building and decision making skills

Strong leadership, team building, interpersonal and communication skills

Colleague Heartbeat (Sales Department )

Develop 3 / 5 year strategic sales plans

Development and sustainment of LNR accounts

Implementing standard Operating Procedures (SOP)

Commercial - Sales & Revenue Audits

Hotel Winning metrics performance

Proactive account targeting activities

Sales talent mapping

RevPAR / RGI

GOP

Decision Rights

Complies with the IHG way of Sales principles
Sales reporting and administration
IRFP including but not exclusively; wish want walk grids and business cases and submissions
Reviews tentative / prospect and turned down business

Budgets and forecasts
Market and client intelligence

How do I deliver this?
We genuinely care about people and we show this through living out our promise of True Hospitality each and every day. It’s what connects every colleague in all IHG® hotels.
Each IHG® hotel brand delivers True Hospitality in their own way, and at the heart of it all are specific, core service skills.
True Attitude: being caring, wanting to make a positive difference, and building genuine connections with guests
True Confidence: having the knowledge and skills to perform your role, and giving guests the confidence that they can trust you, to help and support them during their stay

True Responsiveness: is about providing guests with what they need, and doing so in a timely and caring manner
There’s so much more to the job than we can capture here. It’s simply about creating great experiences, doing the right thing and understanding people.

**SECTION I: Job Summary**

The QC Inspector – Coating performs inspection and testing of surface preparation and protective coating/painting activities to verify compliance with drawings, specifications, and applicable standards.

**SECTION II: Job Analysis**

Duties & Responsibilities

·         Perform in-process and final inspections on surface preparation and coating/painting works.

·         Verify surface preparation (blasting profile, cleanliness) against specifications (e.g., SSPC/NACE standards).

·         Witness coating application, DFT/WFT checks, holiday testing, and adhesion tests per the ITP.

·         Verify environmental conditions (humidity, dew point, temperature) prior to coating application.

·         Verify materials and batch certificates against approved coating specifications.

·         Record inspection results and raise Non-Conformance Reports as required.

·         Coordinate hold points and inspections with client/third-party inspectors.

·         Maintain inspection records, checklists, and daily QC reports.

·         Verify calibration status of measuring and test equipment (gauges, holiday detectors) used on site.

·         Support punch-list generation and verification of closure for coating works.

·         Support preparation of quality documentation for coating handover dossiers.

**Requirements**

**SECTION III: Performance Indicators**

Evaluated Based on

·         **Inspection accuracy and completeness**

·         **Timely identification and reporting of non-conformances**

·         **First-time inspection pass rate on assigned work fronts**

·         **Adherence to inspection schedules/hold points**

·         **Quality of inspection documentation**

**SECTION IV: Required Skills & Abilities**

Core Competencies

* Attention to Detail
* Integrity
* Analytical Thinking
* Communication Skills
* Time Management

Technical Skills

·         Coating/Painting Inspection Techniques

·         Surface Preparation Standards (SSPC/NACE)

·         DFT/WFT, Holiday & Adhesion Testing

·         Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs)

·         Measuring & Testing Equipment Use

·         QC Documentation & Reporting

**SECTION V: Required Experience and Education**

Experience

·          5–8 years of experience as a QC Inspector on coating/painting application projects.

Education

·          Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Civil Engineering.

·          NACE/coating inspection certification (e.g., NACE Level II) preferred.
