Job Purpose
The Senior Design Delivery Director is an executive leadership role responsible for directing and governing the end-to-end design delivery function across Retal Urban Development Company's portfolio of residential, mixed-use, hospitality, commercial, and master-planned development projects. The role ensures the successful planning, coordination, management, and delivery of all design activities from project inception through construction completion.
The Senior Design Delivery Director leads multidisciplinary design teams, manages external consultants, establishes design governance frameworks, drives value optimization, ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, and aligns design outcomes with Retal's strategic, financial, operational, and market objectives. The position serves as the key interface between executive management, development, project delivery, consultants, and key stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered efficiently, cost-effectively, and to the highest standards of quality, innovation, sustainability, and customer value.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
1. Design Delivery Leadership
Lead and oversee the design delivery function across multiple large-scale developments and project portfolios.
Establish and implement design delivery strategies, standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
Ensure design programs support project schedules, commercial objectives, and development strategies.
2. Portfolio Management
Direct the design execution of multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and business goals.
Monitor overall portfolio performance, design progress, resource allocation, and risk exposure.
3. Design Governance & Quality Assurance
Establish design review and approval processes across all project stages.
Ensure consistency, quality, innovation, functionality, constructability, and customer-focused outcomes.
Chair executive design review committees and gateway approval processes.
4. Strategic Design Management
Guide project teams during concept design, schematic design, detailed design, tender documentation, and construction phases.
Ensure design solutions align with market demands, customer expectations, operational requirements, and investment objectives.
5. Consultant & Stakeholder Management
Lead the selection, appointment, and performance management of architects, engineers, urban designers, and specialist consultants.
Foster collaborative relationships with government authorities, utility providers, investors, strategic partners, and key stakeholders.
6. Budget & Commercial Oversight
Oversee design budgets and consultant contracts across the project portfolio.
Ensure effective cost control and optimization throughout the design lifecycle.
Monitor design-related expenditures and provide executive-level reporting.
7. Value Engineering & Optimization
Drive value engineering initiatives to achieve optimal balance between quality, functionality, cost, sustainability, and operational efficiency.
Identify innovative solutions that improve project feasibility and financial performance.
8. Design Risk Management
Identify, assess, and mitigate design-related risks affecting cost, schedule, quality, approvals, and constructability.
Ensure proactive resolution of design conflicts and project delivery challenges.
9. Regulatory & Code Compliance
Ensure full compliance with Saudi Building Code, municipal regulations, zoning requirements, planning guidelines, and relevant industry standards.
Maintain effective relationships with regulatory authorities to facilitate timely approvals.
10. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate closely with Development, Project Delivery, Construction, Commercial, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and Asset Management teams.
Ensure seamless coordination between design development and project execution activities.
11. Construction Design Support
Provide executive oversight of design support during construction.
Ensure timely resolution of design-related issues, technical queries, variations, and site challenges.
12. Sustainability & Innovation
Lead the integration of sustainability, smart technologies, ESG objectives, and innovative design practices across all developments.
Promote environmentally responsible and future-ready development solutions.
13. Organizational Leadership
Build, lead, mentor, and develop high-performing design delivery teams.
Establish talent development programs, succession planning initiatives, and performance management frameworks.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement.
14. Executive Reporting & Communication
Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations, strategic reports, and project updates to senior leadership, board members, investors, and stakeholders.
Communicate portfolio performance, key risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations.
15. Cultural & Market Alignment
Ensure all developments reflect Saudi Arabian cultural values, regulatory requirements, customer expectations, and market trends.
Support Retal's vision of delivering innovative and sustainable communities.

description:
We are looking for qualified and experienced horticulture professionals to join the **KAUST Beacon Development** team and support the development and maintenance of high-quality indoor and outdoor garden environments.

### Positions

* **Horticulturalist – Indoor Gardens** – 5+ years’ experience
* **Assistant Horticulturalist – Outdoor Gardens** – 3+ years’ experience

### Responsibilities

* Plan and carry out daily horticulture activities across indoor and outdoor garden environments.
* Plant, establish, maintain, prune, propagate, replace, and care for a wide range of plants.
* Maintain trees, shrubs, groundcovers, herbaceous plants, seasonal displays, and indoor plant collections.
* Monitor plant health and identify pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, water stress, and environmental issues.
* Implement and support Integrated Pest Management (IPM) strategies.
* Monitor and manage irrigation, watering, fertilisation, soil/media, and growing conditions.
* Maintain high horticultural, aesthetic, cleanliness, and presentation standards.
* Support seasonal planting and garden maintenance programmes.
* Assist with plant identification, labelling, inventory, collection records, and maintenance records.
* Monitor indoor environmental conditions including light, temperature, and humidity where applicable.
* Maintain and safely operate horticulture tools and equipment.
* Identify and report damaged, declining, hazardous, or poorly performing plants.
* Support routine and preventive horticulture maintenance activities.
* Work collaboratively with horticulturists, gardeners, botanists, landscape teams, irrigation personnel, contractors, and other garden operations teams.
* Maintain clean, organised, and safe horticulture work areas.
* Follow all applicable health, safety, environmental, biosecurity, and horticulture procedures.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Horticulturalist** – Indoor Gardens: Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
* **Assistant Horticulturalist** – Outdoor Gardens: Minimum 3+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong practical knowledge of horticulture, plant care, cultivation, and maintenance.
* Experience in indoor gardens, conservatories, glasshouses, botanic gardens, public gardens, nurseries, landscapes, or similar environments.
* Experience with planting, pruning, propagation, watering, fertilisation, mulching, and plant replacement.
* Knowledge of plant identification and plant-health management.
* Experience identifying and managing common pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental stresses.
* Knowledge or experience in Integrated Pest Management (IPM).
* Experience with irrigation and water-management practices.
* Knowledge of soil preparation, growing media, fertilisation, and plant nutrition.

* Ability to safely use and maintain horticulture tools and equipment.

The Indoor Gardens team is responsible for the care, maintenance, propagation, and presentation of indoor plant collections and horticultural displays, ensuring high standards of plant health, horticultural quality, sustainability, and visitor experience. The role involves practical and technical support in plant establishment, propagation, irrigation, nutrition, greenhouse operations, environmental monitoring, plant health, and Integrated Pest Management (IPM). The position will also support plant inventory and records, display maintenance, pest and disease management, and visitor-engagement activities, while working closely with the Horticulturalist, Botanic Garden Curator, and wider horticulture team.

* Maintain indoor plant collections, displays, and greenhouse/controlled growing environments.
* Perform watering, pruning, repotting, fertilisation, plant replacement, propagation, and general plant maintenance.
* Monitor plant health and identify pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental stress.
* Support and implement Integrated Pest Management (IPM) and appropriate plant-health treatments.
* Monitor temperature, humidity, light, ventilation, irrigation, growing media, and plant nutrition.
* Maintain plant inventories, labels, databases, and horticultural records.
* Support plant propagation using seeds, cuttings, division, and other methods.
* Maintain high horticultural, aesthetic, cleanliness, and visitor-experience standards.
* Support greenhouse operations, indoor display maintenance, and plant collection management.
* Work with horticulture teams, botanists, contractors, and other multidisciplinary teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in **Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, or a related discipline**.
* Relevant experience in **indoor horticulture, indoor garden management, greenhouse, conservatory, or controlled growing environments**.
* Practical experience in plant care, propagation, pruning, repotting, irrigation, fertilisation, and plant maintenance.
* Experience identifying **plant pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental stress**.
* Knowledge and practical experience with **Integrated Pest Management (IPM)**.
* Experience monitoring **temperature, humidity, light, irrigation, ventilation, and growing conditions**.
* Experience maintaining plant collections, horticultural displays, plant records, and inventories.
* Strong attention to detail, practical problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Experience in a **botanic garden, greenhouse, conservatory, nursery, public garden, or similar horticultural facility** is preferred.

**Purpose**

The Senior Process Controls Engineer works closely with Maintenance, Operations, Engineering and Technical Management to coordinate, organize and execute process controls activities for preventive and corrective maintenance. The role aims to reduce maintenance-related costs while improving plant reliability and availability in line with business needs across Air Separation Units (ASU), Steam Methane Reformers (HYCO), CO2 capture, utilities and associated ancillary equipment. The role may also support joint venture partners, equipment sales customers and new customers as required by BHIG.

**Nature & Scope**

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, the Senior Process Controls Engineer provides day-to-day technical support to maintain the safe, reliable and efficient operation of process control systems and low-voltage instrumentation and controls equipment. The role plans and executes preventive and corrective maintenance activities in coordination with Maintenance Management, Operations and Engineering and works closely with internal and external resources to ensure safe and reliable execution.

The facilities cover multiple technologies, including ASU, HYCO, CO2 production and H2 mobility. The incumbent routinely interfaces with Operations, Maintenance and Instrument Technicians to provide troubleshooting support, work instructions and technical guidance for process control systems. The position requires teamwork, clear communication, organization, change management, work-process optimization, planning, leadership, and hands-on technical capability across related disciplines.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Safety:**

• Maintain a safe work environment and demonstrate visible leadership in BHIG and industry safe-work processes to prevent injuries. Ensure appropriate documentation is maintained for safety-related activities.

• Provide technical support and safety leadership for Management of Change (MOC), Operational/Process Hazard Reviews (OPHR), Safety Integrity Level (SIL) assessments and other process-safety initiatives. Consult BHIG and shareholder process safety specialists as required.

• Support the implementation, audit and revalidation of Critical Safety Systems (CSS), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) and Safety Instrumented Functions (SIF), including the applicable lifecycle documentation and testing requirements.

**Technical:**

• Provide technical solutions and lead execution planning for SAP PM activities covering plant instrumentation, analyzers, gas chromatography and process control systems, including DCS, local PLCs and associated control loops.

• Maintain long-term instrumentation and controls plans covering calibration, spare-parts management, control logic, programming, graphics changes, operational changes, system migration and backup management.

• Perform SIL assessments and verification and support SIS and SIF lifecycle activities.

• Provide engineering support and prepare punch lists during plant construction and commissioning. Ensure timely closure of punch items, accurate document control and compliance with quality assurance requirements.

• Interface with Process Engineering to identify gaps and develop improved operating and control strategies to achieve productivity targets. Develop tracking programs and metrics for plant optimization, efficiency and controller on-stream performance.

• Interface with Advanced Controls resources to define DCS interface requirements and jointly design, implement and test the required interfaces.

• Support plant productivity and improvement projects, including instrument specification, control-system configuration, detailed cable and wiring design, and preparation of work packages for contractor bidding and installation.

• Maintain current engineering specifications and sizing calculations for procurement of instrumentation and controls equipment, including control valves, flowmeters, inline devices, transmitters and analyzers.

• Provide engineering input to develop and maintain instrumentation and controls standards, procedures, best practices, inspection contracts and contractor-selection guidelines.

• Lead and provide technical support for new installations, existing plant modifications, ongoing operations, continuous improvement and maintenance activities across BHIG facilities. Ensure compliance with legal requirements and BHIG safety and technical standards.

• Provide technical support for BHIG equipment-sales activities, existing plant modifications, operations, continuous improvement and maintenance services for customers in the Region through site visits, remote support or the Process Intelligence Center.

• Provide technical leadership for investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to identify and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

**Operations:**

• Provide process-controls engineering support to operate ASU, HYCO, CO2 and H2 mobility facilities safely and reliably while meeting customer requirements for product quality, supply flexibility and contractual compliance.

• Ensure BHIG standards and applicable shareholder best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality and customer service are met.

• Provide technical support to commissioning teams during commissioning, start-up and troubleshooting activities and participate in Operations training before plant commissioning.

• Assist Operations in maintaining accurate document control and monitoring quality assurance initiatives.

• Maintain alignment with Plant Managers, Site Leadership, and the Business Area on asset-management opportunities and commercial priorities.

• Provide technical support for turnarounds and major maintenance activities.

• Establish and maintain compliance with applicable company requirements, local regulations, technology standards and codes consistent with BHIG operational objectives.

• Participate in technical reviews, equipment design, installation, operation and optimization, including validation, Mechanical Integrity, Management of Change and procedure development and implementation.

**Repair & Maintenance:**

• Establish and maintain close working relationships with Process Engineering, Operations and Maintenance personnel to continuously monitor and evaluate plant performance and process-control systems and equipment.

• Develop and implement comprehensive maintenance plans for process-control systems and equipment and provide technical guidance and detailed instructions to schedule, execute and monitor plan compliance.

• Develop engineering solutions for repetitive failures and other conditions that adversely affect plant operations.

• Provide engineering support and participate in or lead incident investigations and RCA activities. Identify and implement sustainable corrective actions.

• Guide the Maintenance team in setting spare-parts inventory levels, managing quality and developing inventory strategies.

**Project Management / Budget:**

• Apply appropriate project-development and project-management practices, including scope, budget, schedule, execution strategy, risk planning and cost reporting, for projects and turnaround activities.

• Provide engineering support in developing the annual budget for process-control systems and equipment maintenance, repair and system upgrades.

**Professional:**

• Lead by example and promote teamwork through open communication, active listening, and timely issue resolution.

• Drive continuous improvement in safety performance, reliability, and cost of quality.

• Build and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

• Support, mentor and develop instrument technicians and less-experienced engineers.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

• Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Control, Electrical, Electronics or related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 10 years of relevant process automation experience in chemical, refinery or gas-plant maintenance, inspection or engineering.

• Demonstrated hands-on plant experience in troubleshooting, maintenance, commissioning and operation of instrumentation and process-control systems.

• Experience with Air Separation, HYCO, and gasification process systems is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

• Troubleshooting and maintenance-level knowledge of Siemens PCS 7 Distributed Control Systems, including specifications, configuration and programming using PCS 7, STEP 7 and WinCC. Experience with other control platforms is an advantage.

• Demonstrated ability to configure, calibrate, troubleshoot and repair process instrumentation for temperature, pressure, flow, voltage and other process variables.

• Working knowledge of industrial computer networks and demonstrated logical, systematic troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.

• Knowledge of SIL, SIS, SIF and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) principles and applications.

• Knowledge of applicable oil, gas and refining industry codes and standards, including API, ISA, NEC/IEC, NFPA and ASME. Knowledge of Saudi Aramco standards and working practices is preferred.

• Knowledge of process safety, occupational health and applicable local environmental requirements.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant engineering, maintenance and data-historian applications.

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**

• Strong commitment to employee involvement, teamwork, diversity, and inclusion.

• Ability to communicate effectively with management, Operations, Maintenance, customers and contractors.

• Proficiency in spoken and written English is required; Arabic language capability is an advantage.

• Demonstrated leadership, organizational, computer, interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills.

• Confident, self-motivated, results oriented and committed to continuous improvement.

• Formal training and experience in Six Sigma and continuous improvement tools is a plus.

Lucidya is a leading AI-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform in the MENA region, enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and serve their customers across digital channels at scale.

As we continue to scale our platform and move toward IPO-scale engineering, we are looking for a **Frontend Software Engineer** who is passionate about building high-quality user experiences, learning quickly, and using modern engineering practices — including AI — to deliver better software faster.

This role is ideal for an engineer with **0–2 years of professional experience** who has a solid foundation in frontend development and wants to grow in an environment where **ownership, speed, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement** matter.

We don't measure impact by how many lines of code you write. We care about your ability to understand problems, build maintainable solutions, collaborate effectively, and continuously improve the way you work.

Please note that this position is strictly open to Saudi nationals only. Applications from non-Saudi nationals will not be considered and will be disqualified from the recruitment process.

**Requirements**

**What You Will Work On**

### Modern Frontend Development

* Build and maintain production-grade web applications using **React, JavaScript, and TypeScript**.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable frontend components.
* Turn product requirements and designs into clean, intuitive, and responsive user experiences.
* Integrate frontend applications with **REST APIs and real-time communication services**.
* Work with **WebSockets / Socket.IO** to build real-time user experiences.
* Understand and work with event-driven flows connected to **RabbitMQ** and backend messaging systems.
* Handle real-time updates, reconnection scenarios, error states, and synchronization between live events and UI state.
* Manage server state efficiently using **React Query / TanStack Query**.
* Manage complex client-side state using **Redux / Redux Toolkit** when appropriate.
* Contribute to improving frontend architecture, performance, code organization, and maintainability.

### Quality & Testing

Quality is part of development — not something that happens after development.

* Write reliable unit and integration tests using **Jest**.
* Build and maintain end-to-end tests using **Playwright**.
* Test your work thoroughly before considering it complete.
* Participate actively in code reviews and learn from feedback.
* Identify regressions, edge cases, and potential production issues before they reach users.
* Debug issues systematically and focus on root causes rather than temporary workarounds.
* Write code that is easy for other engineers to understand, review, test, and maintain.

### AI-Enabled Engineering

We expect engineers to use AI as an **engineering accelerator**, not as a replacement for engineering judgment.

* Use AI coding tools effectively to research, prototype, implement, debug, test, and refactor solutions faster.
* Know how to provide AI tools with the right context, requirements, and constraints to generate useful results.
* Critically review and validate AI-generated code instead of accepting it blindly.
* Use AI to automate repetitive work and spend more time solving meaningful engineering problems.
* Continuously explore better AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity and engineering velocity.
* Maintain high standards for **quality, security, performance, and maintainability**, regardless of whether code was written manually or with AI assistance.

The goal isn't simply to write code faster. It's to **deliver better outcomes in less time without sacrificing quality**.

### Ownership & Collaboration

* Take ownership of your work from understanding the requirement through implementation, testing, review, and production.
* Communicate clearly when requirements are unclear or when you identify technical risks.
* Collaborate closely with frontend engineers, backend engineers, QA, product managers, and designers.
* Ask questions when necessary while developing the ability to investigate and unblock yourself.
* Give and receive constructive feedback during code reviews and technical discussions.
* Help teammates when needed and actively share what you learn.
* Take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.
* Treat the product as something you own — not simply a collection of assigned tickets.

### Stack

**Our frontend ecosystem includes:**

* **React**
* **JavaScript (ES6+)**
* **TypeScript**
* **React Query / TanStack Query**
* **Redux / Redux Toolkit**
* **Jest**
* **Playwright**
* **WebSockets / Socket.IO**
* **RabbitMQ**
* **REST APIs**
* **Git**
* **Modern AI-assisted development tools**

**Experience with every technology is not required, but you should have strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.**

### What We Are Looking For

* **Bachelor's degree in Computer Science** or a closely related field.
* **0–2 years of professional frontend development experience.**
* Strong understanding of **JavaScript fundamentals**.
* Hands-on experience building applications with **React**.
* Good understanding of **TypeScript** and type-safe development.
* Good understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, rendering, and component lifecycle.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data.
* Familiarity with **React Query / TanStack Query** and **Redux / Redux Toolkit**.
* Understanding of frontend testing and experience with tools such as **Jest** and **Playwright**.
* Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using **WebSockets / Socket.IO**.
* Basic understanding of **message queues and event-driven systems**, especially **RabbitMQ**.
* Understanding of common real-time challenges such as reconnection, duplicate events, stale data, race conditions, and keeping UI state synchronized.
* Solid understanding of **HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals**.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Ability to debug problems rather than only work around them.
* Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code.
* Practical experience using **AI tools to improve software engineering productivity**.
* Strong willingness to learn and continuously improve.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

### This Role Is a Strong Fit If You...

* Can take a feature from requirement to production instead of stopping when the code simply "works."
* Care about both **speed and quality** — you don't believe one has to come at the expense of the other.
* Use **AI to multiply your productivity** while still understanding and owning every solution you ship.
* Don't blindly copy AI-generated code — you question it, review it, test it, and improve it.
* Try to understand **why** something works, not only **how** to make it work.
* Investigate bugs and edge cases instead of immediately passing them to someone else.
* Treat testing as part of development rather than an optional final step.
* Care about code readability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Can receive code-review feedback and use it to improve.
* Communicate early when you are blocked.
* Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other engineers.
* Are curious about the product, not just the ticket assigned to you.
* Look for opportunities to improve existing code and engineering processes.
* Have a strong sense of ownership and don't need constant follow-up to get things done.
* Want to become a significantly stronger engineer over the next few years.

### What Success Looks Like

Within your first months at Lucidya, we expect you to:

* Understand the frontend codebase, architecture, and development workflow.
* Deliver production features with increasing independence.
* Write clean and maintainable code that requires fewer review iterations over time.
* Build appropriate automated tests for the features you develop.
* Work confidently with REST APIs and increasingly understand our real-time architecture.
* Debug frontend and integration issues effectively.
* Use AI tools to **noticeably improve your development speed and productivity while maintaining engineering quality**.
* Participate meaningfully in technical discussions and code reviews.
* Collaborate effectively with your squad and other engineering teams.
* Become someone your teammates can rely on to **own and finish work properly**.

**Benefits**

### Why Lucidya

* Work on a real enterprise platform operating at significant scale across the MENA region.
* Build products used by major organizations and large customer-service teams.
* Work on an **AI-native product** where AI is part of both the platform and the engineering workflow.
* Gain hands-on experience with **real-time systems, WebSockets, RabbitMQ, APIs, and complex frontend applications**.
* Learn from experienced engineers while having meaningful ownership early in your career.
* Work with modern frontend technologies and engineering practices.
* Solve real problems involving performance, real-time experiences, large datasets, and complex enterprise workflows.
* Join Lucidya during an important stage of growth as we continue building toward **IPO-scale engineering**.
* Real scale with billions of events and not just toy systems
* Direct impact at CTO and executive level

**We are looking for engineers who want more than their next job. We are looking for people who want to compound their skills, take ownership, use AI to amplify their capabilities, and become exceptional engineers.**

We are seeking an experienced **Plant Labelling Officer** to support the accurate identification, documentation, labelling, mapping, and interpretation of living plant collections within a Botanic Garden environment.

The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate plant labels, collection records, databases, mapping systems, and visitor-facing botanical information. The successful candidate will work closely with **botanists, horticulturists, curators, and other technical specialists** to ensure plant identities and collection information remain accurate, consistent, and up to date.

### Key Responsibilities

* Create, install, inspect, update, and maintain plant labels across indoor and outdoor collections.
* Ensure labels include accurate scientific names, common names, family information, geographic origin, accession details, and other relevant information.
* Verify botanical nomenclature and taxonomy using recognised botanical references.
* Conduct regular audits to identify missing, damaged, outdated, duplicated, or inaccurate labels.
* Coordinate the correction and replacement of plant labels.
* Work with botanists, horticulturists, curators, and other specialists to verify plant identification.
* Maintain consistency between physical labels, accession records, databases, maps, and collection-management systems.
* Manage and update plant-record databases and maintain accurate records of plant accessions, locations, provenance, movements, replacements, and losses.
* Support plant accessioning and deaccessioning activities.
* Maintain plant collection mapping systems and conduct field verification of plant locations.
* Support the integration of plant records with **GIS, digital mapping, and collection-management systems**.
* Develop and maintain botanical interpretation and visitor-facing information materials.
* Translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear and accessible content.
* Support digital plant-identification tools, QR-code systems, mobile applications, interactive maps, and digital collection platforms.
* Conduct quality-control reviews of physical and digital plant information.
* Support plant inventories and collection audits.
* Maintain appropriate data-quality, backup, and version-control practices.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in **Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, Plant Taxonomy**, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
* **Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience** in horticulture, botanical collections, plant identification, education, or technical capacity-building.
* Strong knowledge of **plant identification, taxonomy, nomenclature, and classification**, with the ability to identify plants using morphological characteristics, botanical references, and taxonomic keys.
* Proven experience in **plant labelling, living-collection documentation, accessioning, provenance, and collection management**.
* Experience managing **plant databases, electronic records, GIS, mapping systems, and digital collection-management platforms**.
* Strong research, information-verification, data-quality, and quality-control skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Experience developing and delivering **horticulture training programmes**, including practical, hands-on training.
* Experience developing **training materials, technical guides, manuals, presentations, and educational resources** related to horticulture.
* Experience assessing training needs, evaluating competency, and supporting internships, apprenticeships, vocational training, or work-based learning programmes.
* Experience conducting horticulture workshops, demonstrations, or community-engagement programmes.
* Ability to translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear, engaging, visitor-facing content.
* Experience working collaboratively with **botanists, horticulturists, curators, researchers, educational institutions, and other technical specialists**.
* Familiarity with **digital plant-identification tools, QR-code systems, mobile applications, and interactive mapping** is advantageous.
* Previous experience in a **botanic garden, public garden, horticulture institution, nursery, educational institution, or comparable environment** is preferred.
* Strong written communication, technical documentation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Professional training or educational delivery experience in **English and Arabic** is preferred.

description:
The Finance & RCM Specialist is responsible for overseeing financial, billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle activities. The role ensures accurate and timely invoice and claim validation, effective financial controls, budget adherence, and strong coordination with the healthcare operator, insurers, and internal Finance teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Management**

* Review and validate operator invoices and quotations for accuracy, completeness, and contractual compliance.
* Support annual budgeting, forecasting, expenditure monitoring, and cost control.
* Prepare monthly financial analysis, budget-versus-actual reports, and variance analysis.
* Identify financial risks, discrepancies, and opportunities for cost optimization.

**Insurance & Revenue Cycle Management**

* Oversee monthly insurance claim submissions and ensure accuracy and compliance with insurer requirements.
* Monitor claim rejections, denials, outstanding claims, and collection timelines.
* Coordinate with the operator and insurers to resolve claim discrepancies and improve collections.
* Lead regular claim reconciliation and follow-up activities.
* Identify opportunities to reduce revenue leakage and improve RCM performance.

**Reporting & Compliance**

* Prepare financial and insurance performance reports and monitor key KPIs.
* Provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with applicable policies, contracts, and regulations.
* Maintain accurate documentation and transparency across financial and claims processes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the key contact for financial and insurance matters with the healthcare operator and insurers.
* Collaborate with the Head of Health, Operations Manager, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders to achieve financial and operational objectives.

**Qualifications**

We are seeking an experienced **Plant Tissue Culture Technician** responsible for the laboratory-based propagation of rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, and high-value plant species using **tissue culture and micropropagation techniques**.

The role will support living plant collections, plant conservation programmes, and specialised in-vitro propagation activities. The successful candidate will establish and maintain sterile laboratory conditions, prepare culture media, initiate and maintain plant cultures, monitor plant development, and support the acclimatisation of tissue-cultured plants.

### Key Responsibilities

* Propagate rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, and high-value plant species using tissue culture and micropropagation techniques.
* Initiate, establish, multiply, root, and maintain **in-vitro plant cultures** according to species-specific protocols.
* Select and prepare suitable explant material for tissue culture initiation.
* Perform surface sterilisation and maintain strict aseptic techniques to minimise contamination.
* Prepare and modify plant tissue culture media, including nutrients, vitamins, plant growth regulators, carbohydrates, and gelling agents.
* Monitor cultures for growth, development, contamination, physiological abnormalities, and overall performance.
* Conduct routine subculturing and transfer plant material under sterile conditions.
* Maintain appropriate temperature, photoperiod, light intensity, and other environmental conditions for tissue cultures.
* Operate, clean, sterilise, and maintain laboratory equipment including **autoclaves, laminar-flow cabinets, growth chambers, balances, pH meters, and microscopes**.
* Monitor equipment performance and coordinate maintenance and calibration requirements.
* Implement laboratory cleaning, sterilisation, contamination-control, and waste-management procedures.
* Identify sources of microbial contamination and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Support the transfer and acclimatisation of tissue-cultured plants from **in-vitro to ex-vitro** conditions.
* Develop, refine, document, and standardise tissue culture protocols for priority plant species.
* Maintain detailed records covering explant sources, media formulations, culture dates, subcultures, treatments, contamination rates, multiplication rates, rooting success, and plant survival.
* Maintain laboratory inventories of culture media components, consumables, chemicals, glassware, and sterile materials.
* Support plant conservation and recovery programmes for endangered, threatened, rare, and difficult-to-propagate species.
* Assist with research and trials aimed at improving propagation success.
* Provide practical training and technical guidance to staff, interns, and students.
* Ensure laboratory activities comply with applicable health, safety, chemical handling, biological material, biosecurity, and laboratory operating requirements.

**Requirements**

* Degree in **Biology, Plant Biology, Botany, Biotechnology, Plant Sciences, Horticulture**, or a related field.
* Formal training in **plant tissue culture, micropropagation, plant biotechnology**, or related laboratory techniques is preferred.
* **Minimum 5+ years of relevant laboratory experience** involving plant tissue culture and micropropagation.
* Demonstrated practical experience in **culture initiation, multiplication, subculturing, rooting, and culture maintenance**.
* Experience propagating **rare, endangered, difficult-to-propagate, or high-value plant species** is highly desirable.
* Strong practical experience in **explant selection, preparation, surface sterilisation, and aseptic handling**.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and modifying plant tissue culture media and working with **plant growth regulators**.
* Extensive experience maintaining sterile laboratory conditions and controlling contamination.
* Hands-on experience operating **autoclaves, laminar-flow cabinets, growth chambers, pH meters, balances, microscopes**, and related laboratory equipment.
* Experience identifying and troubleshooting contamination, culture decline, abnormal growth, poor multiplication, and rooting problems.
* Experience monitoring environmental conditions for in-vitro cultures.
* Experience with **hardening and acclimatisation** of tissue-cultured plants to greenhouse or nursery environments.
* Experience developing, testing, refining, or documenting species-specific micropropagation protocols.
* Strong laboratory record-keeping, data-management, inventory-management, and technical documentation skills.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to perform laboratory procedures consistently and precisely.
* Previous experience in a **botanic garden, plant tissue culture laboratory, research institution, university, conservation facility, commercial micropropagation laboratory, or comparable plant-science environment** is preferred

The IBM CP4I OpenShift Operations/Administrator is a systems infrastructure specialist responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and maintaining our enterprise hybrid-cloud integration architecture. Sitting at the intersection of Cloud DevOps and Middleware Engineering, this role focuses on the end-to-end administration of IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I) running on Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) to guarantee high availability and continuous automated pipeline scaling.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* **Cluster & CP4I Deployment:** Plan, architect, install, and configure Red Hat OpenShift clusters across hybrid cloud environments, provisioning the core IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I) platform using Operator Lifecycle Managers (OLM).

* **Security & Identity Governance:** Secure cluster infrastructures by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), managing Red Hat OpenShift OAuth integrations, Keycloak/IAM identity layers, and SSL/TLS certificate configurations.
* **Compute, Storage & Lifecycle:** Architect container persistent storage layers using Software-Defined Storage engines and schedule seamless cluster upgrades, security patching, and node updates with a zero-downtime objective.
* **Performance Diagnostics & Triage:** Configure APM surveillance dashboards, automate multi-tenant provisioning using GitOps paradigms, and systematically troubleshoot complex cluster degradation events, persistent volume failures, and pod networking drops.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical system discipline.
* **Core Engineering Track Record:** Deep, practical engineering experience managing production-grade Red Hat OpenShift clusters and administering IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I) components.
* **Architecture & Pattern Competency:** Solid knowledge of Software-Defined Networking (SDN/OVN), Ingress/Route architectures, service meshes (Istio), network policies, and container security compliance scanning.
* **Security & Protocol Familiarity:** Strong technical comprehension of enterprise integration patterns, containerized message-queuing mechanics, and API lifecycle architectures.
* **Analytical Evaluation:** Exceptional analytical and systemic debugging capabilities, possessing a high technical attention to container density logs and compute sizing variables.

* **Core Development Environments:** Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP), OKD, Kubernetes, CoreOS, IBM CP4I, IBM MQ, API Connect, ACE, Event Streams, DataPower.
* **Programming Languages & UI Engines:** Linux CLI, Bash, Python scripting, OpenShift CLI (oc), kubectl.

* **Dependency & Repository Managers:** Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm Charts, Customize, OLM Operators, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Tekton, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenShift Logging, Sysdig.
* **Enterprise Project Management Suites:** Jira, Azure DevOps (ADO), or Microsoft TFS.

**JOB PURPOSE**

The Director of Enterprise Activation is the execution engine that stands QHC up as a functioning organization. Reporting to the CEO, the role owns the practical build of the corporate strategy, operating model, the mobilization of the startup, and the disciplined delivery of the  transition from a preliminary structure to the target organization design.

The role design and converts strategy and organization into activated capability, establishing the operating model, governance cadence, service-level framework with Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC) shared services, and the program management discipline required to launch a company startup at pace and with control.

Working across every function and the wider Qiddiya ecosystem, the Director of Enterprise Development ensures interdependencies are managed, readiness milestones are met, and the leadership team has the structures, decisions and reporting it needs to move from stabilize, to operationalize, to institutionalize.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1\. Corporate Strategy**

•    Build the corporate strategy and execution strategic priorities and long-term growth agenda.

•    Evaluate emerging healthcare trends and opportunities aligned with Qiddiya’s vision.

•    Develop strategic planning frameworks and performance measures supporting executive decision making.

**2\. Organizational Design Activation & Operating Model Build**

•    Translate the approved organization design into an activated operating model — defining roles, structures, decision rights, interfaces and ways of working across QHC functions.

•    Drive the activation of QHC’s core functions, defining setup requirements and activation plans and sequencing their transition toward the target operating model.

•    Establish the operating cadence and cross-functional interfaces that allow the organization to run and scale.

**3.  Startup Mobilization & Program Management**

•    Own the enterprise program management office for the startup build, maintaining the master mobilization plan, milestones, dependencies and critical path.

•    Drive execution follow-up and delivery momentum across workstreams, tracking priority initiatives and decisions to closure and escalating delays, blockers and cross-functional dependencies where required.

•    Prepare leadership decision-support materials and maintain a single, credible view of startup progress and readiness for the CEO / MD and Board.

**4.  Shared Services**

•    Define and coordinate the shared-services model through which QHC leverages QIC and wider Qiddiya ecosystem shared services (including finance, human capital, technology, …etc) during the startup phase.

•    Define QHC’s shared-service requirements, interfaces and ways of working, and coordinate with QIC on service arrangements, support requirements and transition activities.

•    Clarify which enabling and support capabilities are leveraged from the ecosystem, at what level, and where retained capabilities must sit.

**5.  Transition Roadmap & Milestone Delivery**

•    Own delivery of the phased transition roadmap for both the strategy and enterprise activation including the milestones that make each phase real.

•    Coordinate the stand-up of new pillars and the consolidation of enabling functions in line with the target structure, adjusting sequencing as constraints emerge.

•    Maintain a living transition dashboard evidencing progress against the target operating model.

**6.  Capability & Resource Mobilization**

•    Coordinate with Human Capital and function leads on workforce requirements and mobilization dependencies for Day-1 and subsequent activation waves.

•    Track function-level capability and resource requirements, priorities and gaps against the activation plan.

•    Coordinate the setup requirements and dependencies — including tools, workspace, policies and processes — required for functions to operate from Day-1.

**6.  Governance, Decision & Reporting Cadence**

•    Establish the enterprise delivery reporting cadence, progress dashboards and escalation mechanisms required to keep startup delivery aligned.

•    Coordinate the leadership delivery rhythm including progress reviews, prioritization and escalation, to support timely resolution of cross-functional delivery issues.

•    Ensure delivery risks, dependencies, actions and blockers are documented, visible and escalated where required.

**7.  Risk, Interdependency & Readiness Management**

•    Maintain the enterprise risk and interdependency register for the startup build, driving mitigation and readiness across functions.

•    Assess and report organizational readiness ahead of key milestones, flagging gaps in ownership, capability or infrastructure.

•    Coordinate contingency planning for critical Day-1 dependencies.

**8.  Stakeholder & Ecosystem Coordination**

•    Serve as the primary coordination point between QHC functions, QIC, and the wider Qiddiya ecosystem on activation and operating-model matters.

•    Align external partners and internal teams around a common activation plan and shared milestones.

•    Support the leadership team in stakeholder engagement, materials preparation and decision-making.

**Requirements**

**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**

A Master’s degree  in Business Administration, Engineering, Healthcare Management, Organization Design, or a related field is required.

10+ years of progressive experience in organizational activation, transformation, operating-model design, PMO leadership or large-scale program delivery, including experience standing up new organizations, functions or greenfield ventures.

Demonstrated experience mobilizing complex, multi-stakeholder programs to defined milestones, ideally within healthcare, sports, government / semi-government or large ecosystem-based environments. Experience operating within a shared-services or SLA-based model is a strong advantage.

Proven ability to translate organization design and strategy into activated capability, and to run executive governance and reporting cadences. Working knowledge of the Saudi operating environment and Vision 2030 context is preferred.

We are currently seeking a Lead Financial Auditor with substantial auditing experience to join our Internal Auditing Organization. This role does not have permanent direct reports, however the Lead Auditor on any audit will have a team working for them.

The Internal Auditing organization within Saudi Aramco is an independent and objective assurance and consulting activity designed to add value and improve the operations of Saudi Aramco. The Internal Auditing organization helps the organization to accomplish its objectives by bringing a systematic and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of the organization’s risk management, control, and governance processes. The Internal Auditing organization provides members of management and the Board of Directors with analyses, recommendations, and information concerning the activities reviewed.

Your primary role is to be the main point of contact for the client and responsible for the audit team.

Key Responsibilities

You will be required to perform the following:

• Review and analyze financial statements in order to identify areas which should be assessed as a part of an audit.

• Design, execute, document and report on audit testing of financial and reporting processes, balances, amounts and disclosures.

• Identify key business, financial and functional processes for identifying and assessing current and emerging risks.

• Plan, execute, and/or report internal audits to management.

• Establish the objective and scope of the audit engagement.

• Develop comprehensive risk-based audit programs.

• Responsible for the audit team and will be overseeing assistant auditors.

• Discuss concerns and issues with the audit client, draft field memorandums, and update client and Internal Auditing Management on progress of the audit.

• Prepare or assist in preparing audit reports.

• Deliver presentations to client’s management at the audit opening and closing meetings.

• Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to inexperienced or less experienced staff.

• Evaluate the performance and capabilities of the assisting staff auditors.

• Assurance and consulting activities on internal controls as requested.

• As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor's degree in accounting or finance or another related field; and preferably have an advanced degree relevant to accounting and finance.

• You will have a minimum of six (6) years of experience working either in external auditing and public accounting firms in the auditing/assurance practice or the financial reporting function of a publicly listed company, working with the adoption, application and presentation of International Financial Reporting Standards.

• You should hold a Certified Public Accountant or Chartered Accountant designation. Additional certifications such as Certified Internal Auditor would be a plus.

• You must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills in the English language and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.

• You should be flexible to travel within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and/or outside the Kingdom to conduct audit and consulting engagements.

Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
• Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts in Saudi Arabia, narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential  
• Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners  
• Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close  
• Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?"  
• Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development  
• Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end  
• Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer  
• Build local references and case studies in your market  
• Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises  
  
**What We're Looking For**  
  
• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into the Saudi Arabian or broader GCC market — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure  
• Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)  
• Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review

**Bonus Points For**

In this role, you will contribute to and support a wide range of traffic engineering, corridor assessment, and mobility-improvement activities across Riyadh, using field observations, traffic data, analytical tools, and engineering judgment to identify practical and innovative transportation solutions.
You will work with experienced traffic engineers, transportation planners, civil engineers, ITS specialists, and RCRC counterparts to assess how the road network is performing, investigate the causes of congestion and safety concerns, and develop implementable improvement concepts. This is a strong development role for an engineer who wants hands-on exposure to large-city traffic management and operational improvement.
What You’ll Be Doing:
+ Support traffic engineering and mobility assessments at intersections, corridors, highways, access points, public transport interfaces, and congestion hotspots across Riyadh.
+ Review traffic counts, turning-movement data, travel times, queue observations, speed data, crash information, detector data, video, and other field information to identify operational deficiencies.
+ Conduct field inspections and document existing traffic operations, geometric constraints, lane-use issues, pedestrian conditions, access conflicts, parking impacts, and other factors affecting network performance.
+ Develop and review practical traffic-management and geometric improvement concepts such as lane-use changes, turn-lane modifications, access management, signing and marking improvements, signal-timing changes, intersection channelization, and localized capacity improvements.
+ Support corridor assessments by identifying recurring bottlenecks, progression issues, queue spillback, operational conflicts, and opportunities for multimodal improvements.
+ Prepare clear technical sketches, exhibits, maps, photographs, calculations, tables, and concise engineering narratives that explain observed issues and recommended treatments.
+ Support senior engineers with Synchro, GIS, spreadsheet, or other analytical tasks used to test and compare transportation improvement options.
+ Support before-and-after evaluations and development of performance measures for implemented traffic improvements.
+ Coordinate with roadway, signal, ITS, public transport, parking, safety, and construction specialists to ensure recommendations account for wider network impacts.
+ Assist with preparation of assessment reports, corridor studies, presentations, technical memoranda, guidelines, and implementation recommendations.
+ Participate in site meetings, technical workshops, and coordination sessions with RCRC and other project stakeholders.
+ Maintain organized engineering records and ensure analysis inputs, assumptions, field observations, and recommendations are traceable.
+ Apply current transportation-engineering practices while looking for innovative, data-driven solutions appropriate to Riyadh’s operating environment.
+ Support implementation monitoring and field verification to determine whether completed improvements are functioning as intended.
+ Develop technical capability through mentoring, structured review, and exposure to traffic operations, transportation planning, ITS, and roadway-design disciplines.

+ Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Traffic Engineering, or a closely related field.
+ 6-8 years of professional experience in traffic engineering, transportation planning, mobility analysis, roadway operations, or related transportation work.
+ Working knowledge of traffic engineering principles including intersection operations, capacity, queues, lane utilization, traffic control, access management, and basic signal operations.
+ Experience reviewing traffic data and translating field observations into clear engineering findings and potential improvement concepts.
+ Ability and willingness to conduct field investigations in live urban traffic environments and document conditions accurately.
+ Familiarity with traffic-analysis software such as Synchro/SimTraffic, Vissim, HCS, or comparable tools is desirable; demonstrated analytical aptitude is required.
+ Working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or GIS tools for reviewing or preparing engineering exhibits is advantageous.
+ Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for analysis and technical reporting.

description:
Job Description

Job Overview
The Field Specialist III is responsible for independently executing and supervising field operations using advanced techniques, procedures, and criteria to deliver Weatherford products and services safely and effectively at the well site. The role serves as a primary technical interface with clients and is responsible for ensuring service quality, operational excellence, equipment readiness, and compliance with Weatherford and client standards.
The Field Specialist III is expected to perform complex downhole tool operations, troubleshoot technical issues, conduct engineering and operational checks, and provide technical guidance to junior field personnel. The role requires strong expertise in Wellbore Productivity and Downhole Tools, including wellbore cleaning, PBL operations, liner top testing, negative testing, and completion-related applications.
The position will specifically support operations involving negative test packer assemblies combined with WBCO (Wellbore Cleanout) tools for cement cleanout applications and pre-completion operations.
Responsibilities:
Plan and execute field operations, including tool inspection, function checks, measurements, BHA preparation, job execution, and post-job reporting.
Independently operate and run Wellbore Productivity and Downhole Tools in accordance with approved work instructions and operational procedures.
Prepare and review BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) designs based on well conditions, job objectives, and client requirements.
Execute and supervise wellbore cleaning and PBL operations, including preparation and deployment of WBCO assemblies.
Run negative test packer assemblies combined with WBCO tools for cement cleanout applications and pre-completion operations.
Perform liner top testing, packer setting, negative testing, cleanout, and related completion operations as required.
Support cement drill-out, casing cleanout, tubing/casing pickling, circulation, and displacement operations.
Conduct pre-job and post-job tool inspections and ensure all equipment is properly prepared, tested, and documented before deployment.
Oversee field jobs at client locations, ensuring operational excellence, technical quality, and HSE compliance.
Troubleshoot downhole tool and operational issues and provide appropriate technical solutions during field operations.
Monitor job parameters and operational data and recommend technical solutions or improvements when required.
Maintain accurate records of pipe tally, BHA/completion components, tool dimensions, critical fishing dimensions, and other job-critical information.
Complete all job-related documentation accurately and within required timelines, including client tickets, job logs, utilization sheets, WPTS entries, job reports, and invoicing documentation.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior Field Specialists and field personnel.
Maintain strong communication with clients, rig personnel, operations teams, and management throughout the job lifecycle.
Provide 24-hour on-call support as required to meet customer and operational requirements.
Ensure all equipment, facilities, and work areas are maintained in a safe, clean, and operational condition.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to improve service quality, efficiency, and equipment reliability.
Perform additional duties as assigned by the supervisor within the physical constraints of the role.

Skills:
Advanced hands-on knowledge of Wellbore Productivity and Downhole Tools.
Strong experience with WBCO (Wellbore Cleanout) tools and PBL operations.
Proven ability to run negative test packer assemblies combined with WBCO assemblies for cement cleanout and pre-completion applications.
Strong knowledge of liner top test tools, packer systems, cleanout assemblies, and multifunctional circulating tools.
Ability to prepare and review complex BHA designs and execute downhole tool operations.
Strong understanding of completion and wellbore preparation operations.
Ability to troubleshoot downhole tools and operational challenges independently.
Strong wellsite supervision and client-facing skills.
Excellent understanding of well control and safe operating practices.
Strong time management, planning, and organizational skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong documentation and post-job reporting capabilities.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and in challenging field environments.
Willingness and ability to provide on-call and extended field support.
Strong HSE awareness and commitment to operational excellence.

Qualifications:
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
8+ years of relevant oilfield experience, preferably in Wellbore Productivity, Downhole Tools, Completions, or Well Intervention.
Proven experience executing complex field operations involving downhole tools.
Demonstrated experience with wellbore cleaning, PBL, WBCO, cement cleanout, and pre-completion applications.
Experience running negative test packer and WBCO combined assemblies is strongly preferred.
Previous experience with major operators such as Saudi Aramco, BP, or other international oil companies is an advantage.
Valid IWCF Supervisor Level and/or IADC WellCAP certification is preferred.
Previous drilling, completion, or workover experience is highly desirable.
Must be willing to work onshore/offshore, travel as required, and support rotational or on-call field operations.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
As a participant in our EMEA Hotel Leadership Graduate Programme (Elevator), you’re not just accelerating your development into a future hotel leader – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:
Accelerate your future in hotel leadership through immersive experience: Embark on a dynamic 18-month development journey comprised of two 9-month placements in different countries within the EMEA region, designed to fast-track your path to a General Manager role in one of our hotels within 5–8 years of programme completion
Gain hands-on experience across departments: Rotate through Operations (including Food & Drink, Front Office, Housekeeping and Hotel Support Services), Human Resources, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial departments (including Groups, Conference and Events, Marketing, and Revenue)
Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through the completion of two major business projects, which will support you in your growth to becoming a General Manager
Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules, and business library while building knowledge through group modules and business-driven projects; Participate in tailored learning programmes and follow a flexible personal development plan designed to grow your technical and leadership capabilities
Grow with personalised guidance and mentoring: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching while working closely with a dedicated GM-level mentor, a peer buddy from a previous Elevator programme class, and a VP-level sponsor to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme
Click here to learn more about the Elevator Programme

What We’re Looking For
With our major global presence and ambitious growth plans, Hilton is developing a strong team of future Hotel General Managers. We are seeking curious, driven, and flexible individuals who embody the Hilton Values and are ready to grow their careers across borders.
Completion of a bachelor’s or master’s degree by the start of the programme (1st September 2027)
Fluency in English (spoken and written)
Eligibility to work within the EMEA region
Full mobility across the EMEA region and a willingness to relocate as required
Aspiration to become a future Hotel General Manager
Availability to begin full-time employment on 1st September 2027

Selection Process
Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 13th December 2026.
Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:
Online assessments
One-way video interview
Competency-based interview with a Hilton Hotel General Manager
Virtual Assessment Centre (February 2027)

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.
Due to the high number of applications, our screening process may take a little longer than usual. Every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, without the use of AI. To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final stages of selection will be issued after applications have closed. Thank you for your patience, we’ll be in touch as soon as there’s an update. Please keep an eye on your inbox and junk folder too, so you don’t miss any messages from us.
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.
Salary is determined by the placement location. For placements within the EU, starting salaries range from €21,500 to €40,000, with separate locally determined salaries applying in the Czech Republic, Poland and Sweden. The salary for each placement location is fixed and is not subject to individual negotiation.
