job_title: Product Specialist - Dermatological Beauty Division (Central Region)
description:
H ello, we’re L’Oréal, we're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.

A Day in the Life
As a Product Specialist, you will be a key driver in building and strengthening relationships with healthcare professionals in Riyadh, KSA. Reporting to the Regional Medical Visits Manager, you will use your scientific expertise to enhance the brand's image and drive recommendations within the medical community, making a tangible impact on patient well-being.

Drive Brand Advocacy & Recommendation: You will visit targeted doctors, presenting the scientific value of our products to increase prescriptions. You'll also represent the brand at key medical congresses and events. Execute Medical Strategy: You will implement the medical visit plan, utilizing all digital and physical promotional tools to deliver personalized and impactful messages to healthcare professionals. Analyze and Strategize for Growth: By analyzing your sector, competitor activity, and prescription data, you will identify new business opportunities and propose strategic action plans to improve results and ensure a strong return on investment. Ensure Operational Excellence: You will manage visit planning, reporting, and activity monitoring through our CRM systems (Veeva) while also ensuring optimal product availability in nearby clinics and pharmacies.

We Are Looking For
An ideal candidate for this role has a strong scientific mindset and a proactive, entrepreneurial approach to managing their territory. You are driven to build strong customer relationships and thrive in a collaborative, results-oriented environment. You possess:
A bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, Biology, or a related scientific field. Previous experience in a medical representative role is highly valued. Scientific & Medical Expertise: Deep understanding of dermatology and the ability to translate scientific information into compelling medical detailing. Entrepreneurial Spirit: A proactive approach to identifying and seizing new business opportunities within your sector. Customer Centricity: A focus on understanding and meeting the needs of healthcare professionals to build lasting partnerships. Collaboration & Influence: The ability to work effectively with internal teams and influence key external stakeholders. Negotiation & Persuasion: Strong skills in communicating value and achieving commitment from the medical community. A valid Saudi driving license is a must have for the job

What’s In It For You
A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!) Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated! A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference

Who We Are L’Oréal is present in 150 markets on five continents. For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to ‘Create beauty that moves the world’; it is now the industry world leader with €42 billion consolidated sales. Together, we solve complex challenges at scale, while making sure we stay committed to making the world a more inclusive and a better place for everyone & our planet.
The mission of L'Oréal Dermatological Beauty is to “Pioneer health and beauty to give the world life changing and sustainable dermatological solutions for all.” Our brands, including Vichy, La Roche Posay, CeraVe, and SkinCeuticals are trusted & recommended by dermatologists, general practitioners and pharmacists all over the world.
We’re committed to guaranteeing inclusive recruitment processes and to advocating for hiring and promoting each candidate in an ethical and equitable way. The Group strictly prohibits discrimination against any applicant for employment because of the individual’s visible and/or invisible disabilities, socio-economic and/or multicultural origins, health conditions, age, religion, or any other characteristics protected by law.

job_title: Power Systems SME – PSCAD / HV & EHV Studies
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Power Systems Subject Matter Expert (SME) – PSCAD / HV & EHV Studies to serve as a Technical Authority across our portfolio of energy, oil & gas, mining, industrial and infrastructure projects in Saudi Arabia.

The successful candidate will provide specialist technical leadership for complex High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) power system studies, with particular expertise in PSCAD-based switching transient and insulation coordination studies for systems operating at 69 kV and above.

The SME will act as a senior technical authority throughout the project lifecycle, supporting concept studies, FEED, detailed engineering, EPC/PMC execution, technical assurance and commissioning. In addition to advanced PSCAD studies, the role requires strong capability in ETAP-based power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, motor starting, relay/protection coordination and arc-flash studies.

* Act as the Technical Authority / SME for HV and EHV power system studies across major industrial and energy projects.

* Lead and technically assure PSCAD electromagnetic transient studies, particularly switching transient analysis and insulation coordination.

* Perform and review studies for electrical systems operating at 69 kV and above, including HV/EHV substations and associated power networks.

* Develop and validate PSCAD models for complex electrical networks, equipment and switching scenarios.

* Perform and technically review insulation coordination studies, including evaluation of transient and temporary overvoltages and equipment insulation requirements.

* Lead and review ETAP power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, motor starting, relay/protection coordination and arc-flash analysis.

* Review electrical system philosophies, design criteria, technical specifications, study reports and engineering deliverables.

* Provide independent technical assurance and resolve complex power-system engineering issues throughout Concept, FEED, detailed design and project execution.

* Support technical reviews, design reviews, client workshops and interdisciplinary engineering activities.

* Provide specialist technical input to proposals, tenders and business-development activities.

* Mentor and develop electrical and power-system engineers and promote consistent engineering standards and best practices.

* Maintain awareness of developments in power-system modelling, HV/EHV technology, grid integration and applicable international standards.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.

* Minimum 20 years of relevant power systems engineering experience, preferably within energy, oil & gas, petrochemical, mining, industrial or major infrastructure projects.

* Demonstrable expert-level experience using PSCAD for electromagnetic transient studies.

* Extensive experience in switching transient and insulation coordination studies for 69 kV and above HV/EHV systems.

* Strong practical experience with ETAP for load flow, short circuit, motor starting, relay/protection coordination and arc-flash studies.

* Strong understanding of HV/EHV substations, transformers, switchgear, transmission/distribution systems and industrial electrical networks.

* Strong knowledge of applicable IEC, IEEE and other relevant international electrical standards.

* Demonstrated experience providing technical assurance, independent design review and resolution of complex power-system engineering issues.

* Previous experience operating at Principal, SME, Technical Authority, Technical Fellow or equivalent senior specialist level is strongly preferred.

* Experience with major projects in Saudi Arabia and/or the GCC, particularly Saudi Aramco or other major industrial clients, would be advantageous.

* Strong client-facing, communication, mentoring and technical-leadership skills.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking for an exceptionally talented **BIM Manager** to join their team! The BIM Manager (also open to Assistant BIM Manager) is responsible for leading the end‑to‑end digital delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects across infrastructure, transit, healthcare, commercial and residential developments. This role defines, implements and enforces BIM processes and workflows in line with global standards, ensuring that Employer’s Information Requirements (EIR) are fully met and that coordinated, clash‑free federated models are delivered to support design coordination and reduce site issues.

  

The BIM Manager (or Assistant BIM Manager) will act as the central point of contact for all BIM and digital delivery matters, driving integration of BIM into project delivery and operations, and providing strategic input to bids, tenders and digital transformation initiatives.

  

## What you'll be doing:  

### Strategy, Governance & Standards

* Develop, implement and maintain BIM and digital delivery strategies aligned with company and client objectives.
* Define BIM processes, workflows and information management procedures in strict compliance with ISO 19650ISO\\ 19650ISO 19650, BS 1192BS\\ 1192BS 1192 and other applicable standards.
* Translate Employer’s Information Requirements (EIR) into clear BIM Execution Plans (BEP), Model Production and Delivery Tables (MPDT) and project‑specific protocols.
* Establish, document and enforce modelling standards, templates, naming conventions and data structures across disciplines and projects.
* Set up and manage project BIM environments, including file structures, model federation strategies and coordination procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and updating standards, guidelines and best practices.

### Project Delivery & Coordination

* Oversee digital delivery on large, complex programmes (e.g. rail systems, light rail transit, metro, roads and bridges, utilities, hospitals, commercial and residential developments).
* Lead the creation and management of coordinated, clash‑free federated BIM models for all phases: Concept, Preliminary, Detailed Design and IFC.
* Organise and run model coordination and clash detection sessions using tools such as Autodesk Navisworks Autodesk\\ Navisworks Autodesk Navisworks and other coordination platforms.
* Ensure all models and outputs are compliant with project BIM standards, client requirements and information delivery milestones.
* Interface closely with project managers, discipline leads and design teams to integrate BIM into design reviews, design assurance and technical submissions.
* Support design optimisation, constructability reviews and reduction of site issues through robust digital coordination.
* Provide BIM leadership during both delivery and operational phases, supporting asset information modelling and handover requirements.

### Stakeholder Management & Communication

* Act as primary point of contact for all BIM‑related queries, both internally and externally (clients, contractors, consultants and third parties).
* Represent the organisation in BIM/digital delivery meetings, workshops and reviews with clients and partners.
* Coordinate onshore and offshore BIM teams, ensuring consistent quality, aligned processes and efficient collaborative workflows across multiple locations.
* Collaborate with GIS specialists to support GIS–BIM integration, enabling geospatially coordinated models and data‑driven decision making.
* Support client engagement by explaining BIM strategies, information requirements, digital deliverables and value propositions.

### Bids, Tenders & Business Support

* Provide BIM and digital delivery input into bids and tenders, including methodology, resource planning, software requirements and fee estimates.
* Develop bid‑stage BIM strategies, delivery plans and high‑level model scopes that respond to tender documentation and EIRs.
* Support the business in communicating digital capability, case studies and lessons learned to enhance win rates and client confidence.

### Quality Assurance, Compliance & Risk Management

* Establish and maintain QA/QC processes for models and digital deliverables, including regular model audits and data checks.
* Implement model review/checking procedures to ensure compliance with BIM standards, client requirements and statutory regulations.
* Monitor and mitigate risks related to information management, data integrity, version control and model coordination.
* Ensure accurate and timely information exchanges via common data environments (CDEs) such as Autodesk Construction Cloud Autodesk\\ Construction\\ Cloud Autodesk Construction Cloud, Oracle Aconex Oracle\\ Aconex Oracle Aconex, ProjectWiseProjectWiseProjectWise and other platforms.

In this role you will lead the end-to-end procurement strategy and execution for regional transport links (e.g. inter-city rail, highways, bus corridors, logistics corridors and associated infrastructure).     * Professional services and multidisciplinary consultancy

* Drive supplier performance, including KPIs, relationship management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in procurement processes and tools.

* High level of integrity, ethics, and commitment to transparent, compliant procurement.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and decision-making skills.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Land Surveyor** to join our team! In this role you will get to work in the field performing various surveying activities in infrastructure and landscaping projects

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* The Land Surveyor plans, organizes, and directs work in surveying earth's surface to determine precise location and measurements of points, elevations, lines, areas, and contours for construction, mapmaking, land division, titles, or other purposes:
    
* Researches previous survey evidence, maps, deeds, physical evidence, and other records to obtain data needed for surveys. Develops new data from photo-gram metric records. Determines methods and procedures for establishing or reestablishing survey control.
    
* Locate in the field: In the field, locate rights-of-way, topographic features, property lines, corners and boundaries. Coordinate Region control surveys.
    
* Document management system: Search for, analyze, and arrange to obtain historical survey records and maps and develop methodologies to incorporate these records into a document management system.
    
* Permit for survey corner destruction: Approve and issue permits for the temporary removal or destruction of survey corners.
    
* Field survey maps: Draft, check, file and distribute maps prepared that depict the results of the field surveys.
    
* Coordinate critical projects: Coordinate unusually critical or complex projects, which usually involve the use of electronic measuring instruments and a large party.
    
* Compute & plan survey data: Participate in computation and platting of survey data.
    
* Survey contracts: Develop procedures and specifications for statewide survey contracts and agreements; administer and approve contract surveys.
    
* Approve plats & sites: Approve all right-of-way and electronic communication sites submitted to or created by the department for correct technical data and proper form.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* BSc. Surveying graduate or diploma in surveying
    
* Minimum of 5 to7 years of experience in land surveying and setting out for landscape and parks projects including streetscape and earthworks
    
* Knowledge of surveying procedures and instruments, engineering formulas.
    
* Knowledge of drafting, arithmetic, geometry, calculus and engineering formulas, CAD drawings and maps.
    
* Experience in the construction of roads, infrastructure and landscaping projects
    
* Requires a comprehensive knowledge of engineering and construction-related processes, as well as industry practices.
    
* Also requires excellent written and oral communication skills, a familiarity with CAD and other PC software packages typically associated with engineering and construction, and the proven ability for performing in a lead capacity on a project.
    
* Keeps accurate notes, records, and sketches to describe and certify work performed. Coordinates findings with work of engineering and architectural personnel, clients, and others concerned with project.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking for an exceptionally talented **Senior Manager: Procurement** to join their team!

In this role you will lead the end-to-end procurement strategy and execution for regional transport links (e.g. inter-city rail, highways, bus corridors, logistics corridors and associated infrastructure). The role is responsible for developing robust procurement plans, managing high-value tenders and contracts, and ensuring optimal value, transparency, and compliance across major transport programs.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Develop and implement procurement strategies for regional transport links, aligned with program objectives, funding mechanisms, and risk profile.
* Define category strategies for key packages, including:
    * Civil works and structures
    * Rail / road systems and equipment
    * Transport-related buildings, depots, and hubs
    * Professional services and multidisciplinary consultancy
* Establish procurement schedules, milestones, and resource plans for multiple concurrent projects.
* Lead market engagement, prequalification, and bidder shortlisting for large, complex transport contracts.
* Oversee preparation of tender documents, including:
    * Instructions to tenderers
    * Scope of work and technical requirements
    * Commercial conditions and pricing schedules
* Manage the full tendering process: clarifications, addenda, evaluation, negotiations, and recommendation for award.
* Ensure tender processes are fair, transparent, and compliant with internal policies and applicable regulations.
* Recommend appropriate contracting strategies (e.g. EPC, D&B, DBFM, PPP, framework agreements) tailored to regional transport projects.
* Collaborate with legal, finance, and technical teams to develop balanced, robust contract terms that allocate risk effectively.
* Lead commercial negotiations to secure best value outcomes while safeguarding client interests.
* Develop and maintain a qualified supplier base for regional transport infrastructure, including international and local contractors, designers, and systems suppliers.
* Monitor market conditions, capacity, and pricing trends to inform procurement timing and strategy.
* Drive supplier performance, including KPIs, relationship management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Implement procurement governance frameworks, policies, and procedures for all regional link projects.
* Ensure full compliance with relevant public procurement laws, funding agency requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Identify, assess, and manage procurement and commercial risks, integrating with program-wide risk registers.
* Prepare and deliver robust procurement reports and recommendations to executive committees and steering boards.
* Work closely with project directors, engineers, planners, and cost managers to align procurement with design development, construction sequencing, and budgets.
* Support change management processes, including procurement-related variations, claims, and contract amendments.
* Ensure procurement timelines support overall project delivery and key operational readiness dates.
* Act as the principal procurement interface for government entities, regulators, partners, and funding agencies on regional transport links.
* Present procurement strategies, tender outcomes, and contract recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder consultations and approvals, ensuring alignment with national or regional transport strategies.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of procurement specialists, category managers, and support staff.
* Build capability in strategic sourcing, complex evaluation, and negotiation for major transport programs.
* Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in procurement processes and tools.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring;

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Supply Chain Management, Business, or related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years’ experience in procurement within the transport or infrastructure sector.
* Proven track record leading procurement for large-scale transport projects, such as:
    * Inter-city or regional rail
    * Highways and expressways
    * BRT / bus networks or regional bus corridors
    * Freight and logistics corridors or multimodal links
* Extensive experience in end-to-end tendering, evaluation, and contract award for high-value, complex packages.
* Strong understanding of construction, rail/road systems, interfaces, and typical risk profiles in transport projects.
* Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Project Management, Infrastructure Management, Supply Chain).
* Professional certification (e.g. CIPS, ISM, RICS or similar).
* Experience with $PPP$ / concession models and working with IFIs or public sector clients.
* Regional experience in \[e.g. GCC / Middle East / Europe / Asia\] and familiarity with local procurement regulations and market.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
* Excellent knowledge of procurement methodologies, contract forms, and international best practices.
* Ability to manage multiple complex procurements in parallel within tight deadlines.
* Effective stakeholder management and influencing capabilities at senior levels.
* High level of integrity, ethics, and commitment to transparent, compliant procurement.
* Strong analytical, reporting, and decision-making skills.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring;**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Project Management, Infrastructure Management, Supply Chain).
* Professional certification (e.g. CIPS, ISM, RICS or similar).
* Experience with $PPP$ / concession models and working with IFIs or public sector clients.
* Regional experience in \[e.g. GCC / Middle East / Europe / Asia\] and familiarity with local procurement regulations and market.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Engineer – MEP** to join our team! The Senior MEP Engineer is responsible in the areas of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems, focusing primarily on HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) including developing polices, standards, inspection procedures, and evaluation tools for MEP matters involving judicial branch facilities. Coordinates for activities such as plumbing, Fire Protection and Electrical engineering as part of the project requirement and ensure compliance based on the standard and statutory requirements. **Experience in stadium or large public venue projects is strongly preferred due to their specialized and complex nature.**

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Lead the development of MEP systems for the projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards, codes, and client requirements.
* Manage MEP aspects of projects from conception to completion, including budgeting, scheduling, and coordinating with other disciplines and stakeholders.
* Review, validate, and approve HVAC system designs, load calculations, equipment selections, and technical submissions.
* Ensure MEP/HVAC design compliance with local codes (e.g., ASHRAE, SMACNA, NFPA, or local authority regulations).
* Provide technical guidance and expertise in MEP systems design, installation, and operation, resolving complex engineering challenges as they arise.
* Ensure the quality and integrity of MEP designs and installations through thorough reviews, inspections, and testing protocols.
* Lead and mentor a team of MEP engineers and designers, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high standards of performance.
* Collaborate with contractors, vendors, and suppliers to procure MEP equipment and materials, ensuring compliance with specifications and schedules.
* Identify potential risks and developing strategies to mitigate them, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding MEP systems, addressing their concerns, and providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, codes, and standards governing MEP systems design, installation, and operation.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in MEP engineering, implementing innovative solutions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project outcomes and efficiency.

  

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering
* Professional certificate in MMUP Engineer Registration (UPDA) is preferred.

* 10+ years of experience in MEP engineering, focusing on construction oversight.
* Experience in stadium or large public venue projects is strongly preferred
* Experience in PMC roles is preferred.
* Mastery of engineering software tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, and MEP modeling software for designing and analyzing MEP systems.

  

**What desired skills you'll bring:**

* Comprehensive understanding of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, including design principles, installation methods, and operational requirements.
* Mastery of engineering software tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, and MEP modeling software for designing and analyzing MEP systems.
* Familiarity with building codes, regulations, and standards governing MEP systems, ensuring compliance with local, national, and international requirements.
* Strong project management abilities to oversee MEP projects, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, and coordination with other disciplines and stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving skills to identify and resolve complex technical issues related to MEP systems, ensuring efficient and effective project delivery.
* ERP knowledge preferably SAP functional skills are a requirement to be successful in this role.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are seeking a seasoned a Vertical Links Lead to lead all activities related to Operations & Maintenance (O&M) for the PUA program, including long-term service contracts, operating agreements, maintenance frameworks, spares and consumables, and outsourced support services.

The role is responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies that secure reliable, cost-effective O&M delivery, while ensuring transparency, compliance, and alignment with PUA performance and safety objectives.

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Develop and own the O&M strategy for the PUA program, covering operations, maintenance, asset management, and support services.
* Define sourcing strategies and category plans for:
    
    * Operations service providers and operators
    * Preventive and corrective maintenance services
    * Long-term maintenance contracts and performance-based agreements
    * Spare parts, consumables, tools, and specialist equipment
    * Technical support, OEM services, and asset management systems
    
* Align O&M with lifecycle cost targets, reliability/availability requirements, and risk allocation strategy.
* Lead market sounding and industry engagement for O&M and related services to understand capability, capacity, and commercial models.
* Oversee preparation of all O&M-related documents, including:
    
    * RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, and ITTs
    * Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and performance metrics
    * Commercial conditions, payment mechanisms, and incentive/penalty regimes
    
* Manage the full tender cycle: issue, clarifications, addenda, technical and commercial evaluation, negotiations, and recommendation for award.
* Ensure robust, auditable evaluation processes, including total cost of ownership and qualitative service criteria.
* Recommend appropriate contracting models for O&M (e.g. O&M contracts, performance-based maintenance, availability-based contracts, framework agreements, PPP/operate components).
* Work with legal, finance, risk, and technical teams to develop balanced contract terms addressing:
    
    * Performance and service levels
    * Asset condition and lifecycle obligations
    * Interfaces with capital works and systems suppliers
    * Risk allocation, warranties, and liquidated damages
    
* Lead commercial negotiations focused on lifecycle value, risk mitigation, and alignment with PUA operational objectives.
* Build and maintain a qualified supplier base for O&M services, OEMs, and critical spare partners within the transport sector.
* Support definition of performance frameworks, KPIs, and reporting requirements for O&M contracts.
* Establish mechanisms for supplier performance reviews, improvement plans, and escalation processes.
* Promote long-term, collaborative relationships where appropriate, while preserving competition and value-for-money.
* Apply DMO and PUA governance frameworks to all O&M procurement activities.
* Ensure full compliance with public regulations, funding body rules, and internal audit requirements.
* Identify, assess, and manage commercial risks related to O&M contracts, feeding into the program-wide risk register.
* Prepare clear reports, evaluation summaries, business cases, and board papers for decision-making forums.
* Work closely with operations, maintenance, asset management, engineering, and finance teams to ensure O&M:
    
    * Reflects realistic technical and operational requirements
    * Supports asset lifecycle strategies and renewal plans
    * Aligns with budgets, tariffs, and business plans
    
* Support transition from construction to operations, including novation or integration of warranties, manuals, and spare parts into O&M arrangements.
* Ensure contract start dates, mobilisation periods, and lead times align with operational readiness and service commencement.
* Act as the primary O&M interface with:
    
    * Government agencies, regulators, and oversight bodies
    * Operators, maintenance providers, and key suppliers
    * Internal program leadership and DMO governance forums
    
* Present O&M strategies, tender outcomes, and contract recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Support consultations, approvals, and alignment with broader transport and asset management strategies.
* Lead and mentor a dedicated O&M team within the PUA program.
* Develop capabilities in service, performance-based contracting, and lifecycle commercial analysis.
* Promote best practice, standardization, and lessons learned across O&M processes, tools, and templates.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Quantity Surveying, or related discipline.
* Minimum 20 years’ experience within the transport sector (rail, metro, highways, public transport, or similar).
* Significant experience leading of O&M and long-term service contracts for major transport or infrastructure assets.
* Proven track record in complex tendering, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award for high-value service and maintenance agreements.
* Strong understanding of operations, maintenance practices, asset management, and lifecycle costing in transport systems.
* Regional experience in GCC / Middle East (ideally Saudi Arabia) and familiarity with local regulations and O&M market dynamics.
* Strong commercial acumen, with expertise in service and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Advanced negotiation and contract structuring skills.
* In-depth knowledge of methodologies, evaluation techniques, and contract forms for O&M.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills at executive level.
* High ethical standards, integrity, and commitment to transparent, auditable procurement.
* Strong analytical, risk-based decision-making, and documentation skills.

**Desired Skills;**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Asset Management, Project Management, Supply Chain, Infrastructure Management).
* Professional certification (e.g. CIPS, ISM, RICS, or equivalent).
* Experience with performance-based contracts, availability-based payments, or PPP / concession O&M structures.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking to appoint an experienced Procurement Lead to lead all procurement activities for the PUA–VST corridor within the DMO, covering the full lifecycle of major transport infrastructure and systems contracts.

The role is accountable for procurement strategy, planning, execution, governance, and supplier performance, ensuring value for money, transparency, and timely contract awards that enable successful delivery of the PUA–VST program.

## What You'll Be Doing

* Develop, own, and continuously refine the procurement strategy for PUA–VST within the DMO framework.
* Define sourcing strategies for key categories and work packages, including:
    * Civil and structural works for the corridor
    * Rail/road systems, signaling, telecoms, control systems, and rolling stock-related interfaces
    * Transport buildings, depots, stations, and hubs
    * Professional services (design, supervision, project management, specialist advisory)
* Align procurement plans with program objectives, funding constraints, risk appetite, and DMO governance.
* Prepare and maintain the PUA–VST procurement master schedule, ensuring alignment with design, approvals, and delivery milestones.
* Lead pre-market engagement, industry briefings, and prequalification processes for major PUA–VST contracts.
* Oversee development and quality assurance of all procurement documentation, including:
    * Expressions of Interest and RFQs
    * RFP / ITT documents and scopes of work
    * Commercial conditions, pricing schedules, and evaluation criteria
* Manage the full tender cycle: issuing documents, handling clarifications, managing addenda, coordinating technical and commercial evaluations, and finalizing recommendations for award.
* Ensure all procurement processes are fair, traceable, and compliant with DMO policies and applicable regulations.
* Recommend appropriate contracting and commercial models for PUA–VST packages (e.g. EPC, Design & Build, DBFM, PPP / concession, framework agreements).
* Work closely with legal, finance, risk, and technical teams within the DMO to develop balanced, robust contract terms and risk allocation.
* Lead commercial negotiations with bidders, reconciling technical, financial, and legal positions to secure optimal outcomes for the program.
* Develop and maintain a robust, competitive supplier base for PUA–VST, including local and international contractors, systems suppliers, and consultants.
* Monitor market intelligence: price trends, capacity, supply chain risks, and innovation opportunities in the transport sector.
* Establish supplier performance frameworks, KPIs, and review mechanisms; drive continuous improvement, collaboration, and problem resolution with key suppliers.
* Implement DMO procurement governance frameworks and controls on all PUA–VST procurement activities.
* Ensure compliance with relevant public procurement laws, funding agency requirements, audit standards, and internal DMO procedures.
* Identify and manage procurement and commercial risks, integrating them into the program risk register and developing mitigation strategies.
* Produce concise, evidence-based procurement reports, evaluation summaries, and board papers for executive and steering committees.
* Coordinate closely with program management, design, engineering, planning, cost management, and construction teams to align procurement with:
    * Design maturity and approvals
    * Budget and cost plans
    * Construction sequencing and operational readiness
* Support change management for PUA–VST contracts, including procurement-related variations, claims, re-tendering, and contract amendments.
* Ensure procurement lead times and award dates support the critical path and key DMO delivery milestones.
* Act as the principal procurement interface for PUA–VST within the DMO
* Present procurement strategies, tender outcomes, and recommended awards to senior leadership and decision-making forums.
* Support approvals, consultations, and alignment with national/regional transport strategies and DMO-wide priorities.
* Lead and mentor the PUA–VST procurement team, including category leads, buyers, and analysts.
* Build capability in strategic sourcing, complex evaluation, negotiation, and contract management for major transport projects.
* Promote standardization, best practice, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across DMO procurement processes, tools, and templates.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring;

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in procurement within the transport sector (rail, metro, highways, regional links, or multimodal networks).
* Demonstrable track record leading procurement on large-scale, multi-package transport programs or corridors.
* Extensive experience managing end-to-end procurement for high-value, complex infrastructure and systems contracts.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, rail/road systems, interfaces, and typical risk profiles in transport contracts.
* Regional experience in GCC / Middle East (Ideally Saudi Arabia) with knowledge of local procurement regulations and market dynamics.
* Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Project Management, Infrastructure Management, Supply Chain, Public Administration).
* Professional certification (e.g. CIPS, ISM, RICS, or equivalent).
* Experience with $PPP$ / concession structures and working with international financial institutions or public-sector clients.
* Strong commercial acumen and advanced negotiation capability.
* Deep knowledge of procurement methodologies, evaluation techniques, and standard forms of contract used in transport.
* Ability to manage multiple complex procurements concurrently in a program environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills at executive and board level.
* High ethical standards, integrity, and commitment to transparent, auditable procurement.
* Strong analytical, risk-based decision-making, and reporting skills, with attention to detail and documentation quality.

The Spa Receptionist at Life in Balance Spa, Miraval The Red Sea, is the first point of contact for guests seeking a transformative wellness experience. This role plays a crucial part in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the spa by providing exceptional customer service and maintaining a welcoming and calming environment. The Spa Receptionist will be knowledgeable about all spa treatments, retail products, and services offered throughout the resort, actively contributing to the guest experience. The Spa Receptionist will also support in generating and maximizing revenue through mindful upselling and cross-selling of retail products and services in alignment with guest needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Guest Reception & Support:

· Greet and welcome guests with warmth and professionalism, offering them information about available spa treatments, wellness programs, and fitness services at Miraval The Red Sea.

· Manage guest bookings and scheduling, ensuring appointments are accurately coordinated for spa treatments, fitness programs, and wellness services.

· Provide guests with detailed information about retail products used in treatments and offer recommendations based on their personal preferences.

· Ensure a seamless check-in and check-out process, managing payments and assisting with any guest inquiries.

· Foster a calm and welcoming atmosphere, ensuring guests feel relaxed and supported from the moment they arrive.

· Assist in tracking guest preferences, ensuring that their needs and experiences are consistently met.

Operational Support & Flexibility:

· Support the daily operations of Life in Balance Spa, ensuring that the reception area is well-organized and operates efficiently.

· Provide operational support in the Body Mindfulness Center, Aquatic Center, or Serenity Center as needed, ensuring that all wellness spaces align with Miraval’s commitment to mindful living and holistic wellness.

· Assist in maintaining inventory of retail products and spa supplies, ensuring product availability and cleanliness of the spa and wellness areas.

· Be flexible and adapt to guest flow and operational needs across all areas of the resort, supporting a seamless guest experience.

Cashiering, Reporting & Inventory Assistance

· Handle guest transactions including cash, card, and POS payments with accuracy and professionalism.

· Complete end-of-day reports, handovers, and daily financial summaries as per resort procedures.

· Assist with inventory checks and stock management of wellness and retail items at the reception area.

· Monitor and record retail sales, updating systems and communicating stock needs as required.

Revenue Generation & Upselling:

· Maximize revenue by actively and mindfully upselling and cross-selling retail products, spa services, fitness programs, and wellness offerings.

· Ensure that guests are aware of additional services such as personal training, fitness classes, spa upgrades, and offering them as part of a holistic wellness experience.

· Promote retail products used in treatments and recommend products based on guest preferences, needs, and wellness goals.

· Ensure that upselling and cross-selling are done in a thoughtful, guest-focused manner, ensuring that all suggestions align with the guests’ wellness objectives.

Guest Engagement & Emotional Connection:

· Build positive relationships with guests, ensuring that each interaction is attentive, welcoming, and personalized to their individual wellness journey.

· Provide emotional support by offering mindful, calming interactions, creating a sense of peace and ease for guests before and after their spa experiences.

· Ensure that guests are aware of all wellness programs available to them, including fitness classes, spa treatments, and any additional offerings that enhance their Miraval experience.

· Help guests feel comfortable and empowered, offering them the opportunity to connect with their wellness goals while on their journey at Miraval The Red Sea.

Team Collaboration & Support:

· Collaborate with other team members, including spa therapists, fitness instructors, and wellness professionals, to ensure all guests have a seamless and integrated experience across the resort.

· Communicate with the Head of Scheduling and the spa team regarding guest feedback, bookings, and operational needs to improve overall service delivery.

· Actively contribute to creating a supportive team environment, where all members feel empowered to contribute to the guest experience.

Administrative & Operational Excellence:

· Manage guest appointments, ensuring accurate scheduling and reducing errors.

· Assist with administrative duties such as guest record management, inventory tracking, and the preparation of reports related to bookings and sales.

· Maintain an organized and efficient reception area, ensuring the space is always clean and welcoming for guests.

· Ensure all spa treatments, wellness services, and retail products are accurately recorded in the system, ensuring smooth operational flow.

Minimum 1 year of experience in a spa receptionist or guest services role within a luxury wellness resort or hospitality setting.

· Knowledge of retail products, including skincare and wellness products, with the ability to explain their benefits and incorporate them into spa treatments and guest recommendations.

· Experience in booking systems and managing appointments efficiently.

· Proficiency in English (knowledge of Arabic is a plus).

· Strong customer service and communication skills, with a passion for wellness and mindfulness.

· Experience with upselling and cross-selling services and retail products in a luxury setting.

Skills & Abilities:

· Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to engage with guests and provide clear recommendations for treatments and retail products.

· Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and guest needs efficiently.

· Ability to adapt to operational needs, providing support in different wellness centers as required.

· Empathetic and responsive to guest needs, offering a mindful and supportive environment.

· Ability to work collaboratively with the spa team, fitness instructors, and wellness professionals.

· Proficiency with digital tools for scheduling, guest management, and communication.

· Ability to model mindfulness and integrate it into daily interactions with guests and staff.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Food & Beverage Waiter, you’re not just providing food and drink service – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
Delight our guests: Bring an upbeat and friendly attitude to all guest interactions and proactively look for ways to make their meal experience special
Master the menu: Learn the details of all menu items, promotions, and specials so you can help guests and answer their questions with confidence
Serve with efficiency and care: Take food and beverage orders, enter them into the point-of-sale system, and deliver completed orders promptly – attention to detail is key!
Manage the food service station: Make sure the food service station is always fully stocked, clean, and organized

description:
### **About the Project**

TSMG is looking for Quality control specialists to support an AI language project focused on improving speech recognition systems.

As a QC contributor, you will review completed language annotation tasks and ensure that AI-generated transcripts have been accurately converted into natural, readable display text according to the project guidelines. You will focus on identifying and correcting formatting, punctuation, capitalization, and text normalization issues.

### What You Will Do

* Review completed Display Transcription tasks for accuracy and consistency.
* Compare the Display Transcription against the original lexical transcript and project guidelines.
* Verify the correct use of:
    * punctuation;
    * capitalization;
    * numbers, dates, times, and currencies;
    * abbreviations and other text normalization rules.
    * Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
    * Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.
    * Use the reference audio when necessary to verify ambiguous cases.
    * Apply project-specific quality standards consistently.
    * Provide accurate feedback and flag recurring issues when required.
    * Complete assigned QC tasks within project deadlines and productivity targets.

### Requirements

* Excellent written skills in the target language.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good understanding of punctuation, capitalization, and written language conventions.
* Ability to identify inconsistencies and errors in formatted text.
* Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently.
* Basic computer skills and a reliable internet connection.
* Ability to work independently and meet quality and productivity targets.
* Previous experience in transcription, proofreading, quality control, annotation, or linguistic projects is a plus.
* Training and project guidelines will be provided before the project starts.

### What We Offer

* Opportunity to contribute to the development of AI and speech recognition technologies.
* Flexible project-based work.
* Clear guidelines and training before starting.
* The opportunity to gain experience in AI language data and quality control projects.

Job Description

As a Representative - Outside Sales, you will be responsible for developing new prospects and interacting with assigned customers to increase sales and margin of the company's products and/or services. Your primary focus will be face-to-face selling and account management activities to meet sales revenue. You will be expected to engage with all levels of the customers’ organizations including technical, operations, supply chain and executive management. Executes and expands assigned customer account plan(s) which is developed in conjunction with management.

Prospects potential customers, including cold calling and developing leads through referral channels.

Ensures customer satisfaction through ongoing communication and relationship management; resolves any issues that may arise post-sale.

Maintains communication with existing and previous customers, alerting them of new products, services, and enhancements that may be of interest.

Develops and grows product knowledge through Wesco and supplier training.

Develops strong relationships with suppliers, including performing regular joint sales calls.

Provides quotations directly or in conjunction with sales support team.

High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor’s Degree is preferred

Prior sales experience required, outside sales preferred

Two years of industry experience preferred

Ability to travel to current and potential clients and suppliers

Ability to work flexible schedule and occasional overnight travel

Excellent sales and negotiation skills

Ability to develop and deliver presentations

Strong interpersonal skills

Effective communicator both written and verbally

Ability to work in team environment

Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills

Knowledge of advertising and sales promotion techniques (Preferred)

Ability to travel 50% - 75% of the time

## Company Description

Assystem is an international company with one mission: accelerate the energy transition around the world.  
  
Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia & Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low-carbon energy.  
  
We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.  
  
Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.  
  
To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all

* Openings, penetrations, sleeves, and embedded items are properly coordinated.
* Structural floor-to-floor requirements are coordinated with architectural and MEP requirements.
* Slab depths and structural zones are compatible with building services.
* Shafts, risers, ceiling voids, and service zones are properly coordinated.
* Structural interfaces with façades and building envelopes are resolved.
* Structural interfaces with foundations and civil works are coordinated.
* Temporary and permanent works interfaces are appropriately addressed.
* Construction sequencing and structural stability requirements are considered.
* Architectural and engineering changes are assessed for structural impact.

**8\. BIM and Digital Engineering Coordination**

* Lead implementation of BIM requirements within the structural engineering discipline.
* Coordinate with BIM Managers and BIM Coordinators.
* Ensure structural models comply with project LOD/LOI requirements.
* Participate in multidisciplinary clash-detection reviews.
* Review model-based design issues affecting structural systems.
* Ensure alignment between BIM models, drawings, specifications, schedules, and structural design information.
* Promote effective use of BIM and digital engineering tools throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure structural information is developed in accordance with the project BIM Execution Plan.
* Coordinate analytical models with BIM models where applicable.
* Ensure structural model integrity and consistency across project deliverables.
* Support digital coordination, model reviews, and multidisciplinary design integration.

**9\. Technical Assurance and Quality**

* Perform technical reviews of structural designs and calculations.
* Ensure structural designs undergo appropriate checking and approval before issue.
* Conduct interdisciplinary structural design reviews.
* Participate in technical assurance and project gateway reviews.
* Identify structural design risks and ensure they are mitigated.
* Ensure technical comments are properly addressed before final submission.
* Review design compliance with project requirements and applicable codes.
* Review structural analysis methodologies and design assumptions.
* Ensure appropriate engineering factors, load cases, load combinations, and design criteria are applied.
* Review structural calculations prepared by the engineering team.
* Promote lessons learned and standardization across projects.
* Maintain compliance with Assystem's Quality Management System.
* Ensure consistency, safety, accuracy, and quality across all structural deliverables.
* Support independent design checking and peer review processes where required.

**10\. Client and Stakeholder Interface**

* Represent the structural engineering discipline during Client meetings.
* Present structural design concepts, solutions, and recommendations.
* Respond to Client technical and engineering comments.
* Coordinate with Client technical and engineering teams.
* Attend authority, contractor, consultant, and stakeholder meetings.
* Support the Project Manager in resolving structural and engineering-related stakeholder issues.
* Provide clear structural engineering recommendations where multiple solutions are available.
* Present structural design options and technical evaluations.
* Explain structural design assumptions, constraints, risks, and proposed solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with Clients and project stakeholders.

**11\. Tender and Construction Support**

When included within project scope:

* Respond to bidder technical queries.
* Review structural technical submissions.
* Assist with tender technical evaluations.
* Review contractor structural design proposals.
* Review structural material submissions.
* Review shop drawings.
* Review reinforcement drawings and structural fabrication drawings where applicable.
* Respond to RFIs.
* Support technical resolution of site structural issues.
* Participate in design-change reviews.
* Review proposed substitutions and value-engineering proposals.
* Review temporary works proposals where applicable.
* Review structural mock-ups and material samples where applicable.
* Participate in site inspections when required.
* Support structural testing, inspection, commissioning, and project handover activities where applicable.
* Review structural snagging and close-out requirements.
* Review as-built structural documentation where applicable.
* Provide technical support during construction and respond to structural non-conformances.

**12\. Value Engineering, Sustainability and Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to optimize structural design solutions.
* Evaluate alternative structural systems considering CAPEX, OPEX, functionality, constructability, durability, maintainability, and whole-life performance.
* Optimize structural member sizes and material quantities while maintaining required safety and performance.
* Evaluate alternative structural materials and systems.
* Promote efficient use of concrete, reinforcement, structural steel, and other construction materials.
* Support low-carbon and sustainability objectives.
* Consider embodied carbon and material efficiency in structural design decisions.
* Optimize structural grids, spans, floor systems, and foundation solutions.
* Evaluate materials based on structural performance, durability, availability, cost, and sustainability.
* Encourage appropriate use of advanced analysis, BIM, automation, and digital engineering tools.
* Support standardization of structural solutions across projects.
* Promote innovative structural engineering approaches while maintaining technical, safety, constructability, and commercial feasibility.

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

WHY THIS ROLE?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS.

We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout.

- Partner with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices.

- Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations

- Design and implement deployment strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards.

- Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related technical issues, providing timely solutions to minimize downtime.

- Travel to customer premises between 20-40%

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

- You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers

- You have experience deploying enterprise software in private/hybrid cloud environments

- You have proven experience administering large-scale production Kubernetes clusters and expertise with Helm

- Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Git for version control

- You have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), networking, and virtualization

- You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target

- You are fluent in Arabic and English

IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE…

- Familiarity with GPU node orchestration & scheduling

- You understand the intersection of GPU infrastructure, inference systems, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and performance optimization.

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

description: Benefits QUÉ OFRECEMOS • Incorporación a un grupo internacional que transporta a mil millones de personas al año en 11 países. • Participación directa en uno de los megaproyectos de infraestructura y movilidad más ambiciosos del mundo: Qiddiya City, Saudi Vision 2030. • Liderazgo de un equipo de 9-12 profesionales en un entorno de alto impacto y crecimiento. • Paquete retributivo competitivo, negociable en función de experiencia y trayectoria, que incluye housing allowance y transporte. • Desarrollo profesional en un entorno multicultural de alto impacto, con equipos de diversas nacionalidades. • Proyección de carrera internacional dentro del Grupo.

## ***About Us***

Backed by top regional and global VCs, **BRKZ is Saudi Arabia’s fastest-growing construction-tech startup**. Our web platform, mobile apps and WhatsApp channels give contractors instant access to 7,000+ building-material SKUs from 1,100+ vetted suppliers, with quotes in minutes and buy-now-pay-later financing built in. In just two years we have on-boarded 850+ contracting companies, supported giga-projects such as **NEOM** and **King Salman Park**, and scaled RFQs to $350 million while keeping positive unit economics.

You can read more about BRKZ's latest news on [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/davidprosser/2025/02/09/brkz-raises-8-million-to-build-on-saudi-construction-boom/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/09/saudis-brkz-closes-17m-series-a-for-its-construction-tech-platform/) & [Wamda](https://www.wamda.com/en/2025/02/brkz-closes-17-million-series-a-bolster-presence-saudi-arabia).

## **Role Overview**

As a  Financial Controller you will be **responsible and accountable for all accounting, audit, and financial reporting functions** at BRKZ. This is **not a traditional, high-level oversight or advisory position**. We are **looking for a builder, someone who will operate directly in the trenches**, **establish robust financial processes, strengthen internal controls, and actively develop our finance team** as the company continues to scale rapidly.

The ideal candidate has **strong knowledge of Saudi accounting, tax, zakat, VAT, audit, and regulatory requirements**, with experience in fast-paced companies. Startup experience is highly preferred, and experience in construction, contracting, building materials, or marketplace businesses is a strong plus.

## **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the full accounting function**, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, accruals, reconciliations, payroll accounting, and monthly closing.
* **Lead the month-end and year-end closing process**, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete financial statements.
* Prepare and review management reports, financial statements, and reporting packs for leadership, investors, banks, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* **Own the external audit process end to end**, including preparation of audit schedules, coordination with auditors, resolution of audit comments, and timely issuance of audited financial statements.
* **Ensure compliance with all applicable Saudi laws and requirements**, including tax, zakat, VAT, withholding tax, e-invoicing, accounting standards, and regulatory filings.
* **Strengthen internal controls** across finance, procurement, payments, collections, revenue recognition, inventory-related processes, and expense management.
* **Build scalable finance processes**, policies, approval workflows, and reporting structures suitable for a high-growth startup.
* Work closely with business, operations, credit, procurement, and commercial teams to ensure financial data is accurate and properly reflected in the accounts.
* Monitor receivables, payables, collections, supplier payments, working capital, and cash reporting.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis by providing reliable actuals and clear explanations of financial performance.
* **Identify gaps in systems, controls, and processes, then take ownership of fixing them directly**.
* **Build, manage, and develop the accounting and finance operations team** as the company scales.
* Support ERP, accounting system, and finance automation initiatives.

## **Requirements**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field**.
* Minimum **10 years of experience as Financial Controller**
* **Professional certification such as SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent** is preferred.
* **Strong knowledge of Saudi accounting, tax, zakat, VAT, audit, and compliance requirements**.
* Strong technical accounting skills and ability to prepare accurate financial statements.
* **Experience owning accounting, audit, and reporting functions end to end**.
* Prior experience in a **startup**, scale-up, marketplaces, fintech, construction, contracting, or building materials business is highly preferred.
* Experience in construction or a related sector is a strong plus.
* Previous Big 4 experience is a plus.
* **Strong Arabic and English communication skills** are required.
* **Strong command of Excel and accounting or ERP systems**.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* **High attention to detail, strong ownership, and strong execution mindset**.
* Comfortable working directly on the details, not only managing or reviewing others’ work.
* Strong leadership and team management skills

## ***What we offer:***

* Great opportunity to be part of a start-up with a lot of responsibility and independence early on and where you will have an impact on the entire business.
* The best idea wins; we are all ears when it comes to ways to do things better.
* Exciting stock options and Premium health insurance.
* Attractive compensation package.
* Product first mindset.

* * *

*Check our guide on **[How to prepare for your interviews with BRKZ 🚚🏗️](https://www.notion.so/How-to-prepare-for-your-interviews-with-BRKZ-1050a449029c80df85fbec82913780b1?pvs=4)***

*Pls note : Certain positions eventual grading might be subject to interview performance, this allows great talent to shine regardless of years of experience and keeps a fair process based on how big of an impact you deliver in the organization.*

### About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

## **About You and The Role**

As Regional Head — Middle East you will create and grow Zipline’s business and operating footprint across the region. You will build a portfolio of government, institutional and private-sector partnerships, identifying and testing high-potential applications for Zipline’s logistics platform across healthcare, retail, food, logistics, public services and other relevant sectors.

Some opportunities will be government-backed networks that strengthen access to essential goods, health systems, emergency response or economic opportunity. Others will be purely commercial partnerships with customers that can use Zipline to create faster, more reliable and more efficient logistics. Many may combine both. You will pursue these pathways in parallel, then concentrate Zipline’s resources behind the markets, use cases and partners that prove most compelling commercially, strategically and operationally.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one leadership role. Initially, you will personally define the region’s market entry strategy, establish the most important relationships, develop commercially sound network models and take complex opportunities through to launch. As markets mature, you will recruit and lead country teams, with growing responsibility for local operations, customer outcomes, business performance and expansion. You will be Zipline’s senior external representative across the region.

## **What You'll Do**

* **Build and prioritize a regional opportunity portfolio.** Develop parallel government, institutional and commercial pathways; form and test hypotheses around high-value use cases; and focus investment on the opportunities with the strongest revenue, strategic and operational potential.
* **Create government and institutional partnerships.** Build senior relationships with governments, health systems, public agencies, development partners and other institutions. Develop partnerships that enable Zipline networks to strengthen essential logistics, public services and economic opportunity.
* **Develop commercial partnerships.** Originate and grow relationships with private-sector customers and strategic partners across relevant sectors, including retail, healthcare, food, logistics and other high-value applications.
* **Shape viable network and business models.** Translate Zipline’s aircraft and platform capabilities into locally relevant propositions; assess customer demand, operating feasibility, economics and scale potential; and develop clear cases for investment.
* **Structure and close complex deals.** Lead negotiations across commercial terms, procurement, financing, contracts, launch commitments, governance and expansion pathways. Maintain momentum through long, multi-stakeholder decision processes.
* **Create the enabling environment for launch.** Work with governments, regulators, infrastructure partners and Zipline’s central teams to establish the policy, regulatory, operational and stakeholder conditions required for deployment.
* **Lead launch readiness and regional performance.** Maintain accountability from signed partnership through launch, early customer performance and expansion. Coordinate closely with global operations, engineering, product and commercial teams to ensure each network is viable, reliable and positioned to grow.
* **Build and lead country organizations.** Recruit, develop and lead in-country commercial, government-partnership and operational leaders as markets mature. Establish clear accountability, operating rhythms and performance standards across the regional portfolio.
* **Own regional business performance.** Build the regional plan, manage the pipeline and investment case, and increasingly own revenue, unit economics, customer outcomes and P&L performance as operations scale.
* **Represent Zipline externally.** Serve as Zipline’s senior regional representative with governments, customers, partners, investors, regulators and the wider community.

## **What You'll Bring**

* Exceptional business-development, strategic-partnership or commercial leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to originate, structure and close complex deals.
* Strong commercial judgment and curiosity. You can develop credible hypotheses about where Zipline’s platform will create value, test them rigorously and turn the strongest into durable businesses.
* The ability to engage credibly with senior government stakeholders and navigate public-sector decision-making, procurement, policy and institutional dynamics. Direct government-relations experience is valuable, but strong relationship instincts, judgment and executive presence are essential.
* Deep practical knowledge of key markets in the Middle East who matters, how decisions are made and how to build momentum across varied political, commercial and cultural environments.
* Experience managing long, ambiguous and sometimes difficult negotiation processes involving multiple stakeholders, competing interests and novel commercial or operating models.
* A hands-on, entrepreneurial approach. You are willing to open doors personally, solve problems directly and create momentum before there is a large local organization behind you.
* The leadership range to build and develop teams over time, including country-level leaders with responsibility for commercial execution, operations and customer success.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to work effectively with global product, engineering, operations, legal, regulatory, finance and commercial teams.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, equally comfortable with senior government officials, C-suite executives, frontline operating partners and internal technical teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the region.
* Ability to be based in the Middle East and eligibility to work there.

## **Job Summary**

The Cost Control Officer is responsible to monitor and manage project expenditures, ensuring adherence to budgets and identifying areas for cost-saving opportunities. They analyze financial data, track expenses, and implement strategies to optimize project profitability while maintaining quality standards. Additionally, they provide financial insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and mitigate financial risks.

## **Job Responsibilities 1**

Monitor project budgets and expenditures to ensure adherence to financial plans and identify any variances or discrepancies.

Track and analyze project expenses, including labor costs, material purchases, subcontractor fees, and overhead expenses, to maintain accurate financial records.

Conduct cost analysis and cost-benefit evaluations to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimize resource allocation, and improve project profitability.

Prepare financial forecasts and projections based on project timelines, resource requirements, and market trends to support long-term planning and decision-making.

Perform variance analysis to compare actual costs against budgeted costs, investigating any deviations and implementing corrective actions as needed to mitigate financial risks.

Generate regular reports and financial statements summarizing project costs, expenses, and budget performance for management review and decision-making purposes.

Develop and implement cost control procedures, policies, and best practices to enhance efficiency, streamline processes, and minimize wastage.

Assist in contract negotiations, review contract terms and conditions, and ensure compliance with contractual agreements to mitigate financial risks and optimize cost-effectiveness.

Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and subcontractors to negotiate pricing, terms, and payment schedules, ensuring cost competitiveness and adherence to budgetary constraints.

Provide financial advice and recommendations to project managers and stakeholders on cost-related matters, including budget planning, forecasting, and risk assessment, to support informed decision-making and project success.

Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies

12

The Revenue Solution Architect (RSA) serves as a technical expert within the Revenue organization, forging close partnerships with Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology and our Enterprise Data Organization. In this position, you will be responsible for translating customer objectives into well-scoped and implementable technical solution designs that align to established product capabilities and supported architectures. The role is execution-oriented; producing high quality technical discovery outputs, solution designs and technical validations that reduce delivery risk and improve deal velocity and progression.

**Revenue & Deal Enablement**

* Partner with Sales/Account teams to support customer engagement through technical qualification, requirements clarification, and solution shaping aligned to existing plays.
* Help improve deal velocity by preparing technical inputs that reduce ambiguity (assumptions, dependencies, sizing inputs, sequencing).

**Customer & Commercial Problem Solving**

* Support retention/expansion motions by identifying adoption blockers and aligning on remediation steps with Account and Revenue teams

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Technology partners to ensure proposed solutions are deployable and supportable within current capabilities and standards.
* Contribute structured feedback from customer/deal learnings into internal forums (pattern gaps, recurring requirements, common integration issues).
* Support Revenue teams with clear documentation and execution/follow up on open questions and solution design capability

**Revenue Acceleration and Enablement**

* Apply standard solution patterns to reduce rework and delivery risk; document reusable modules and lessons learned in knowledge repositories
* Support prototypes/POCs by following established methodology, validating feasibility, and documenting results and limitations
* Help standardize technical discovery and architecture documentation within the team by consistent use of approved formats.
* Contribute to playbooks, documentation and training for revenue-wide capability building

**Required Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years in pre-sales solution architecture, technical sales enablement, technology and/or GTM architecture
* Technical fluency in cloud platforms **(AWS, Azure, GCP)** , hyperscalers and modern orchestration approaches.
