* Ability to produce and review core technical artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration flows, NFRs (performance, availability, security) and implementation approach notes.
* Experience with communicating with mixed audiences (technical and commercial) and deliver concise written outputs that support deal progression.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed environment by coordinating inputs across Sales, Product and Technology to meet fast paced opportunity timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

The Cell Therapy Account Manager (CTAM) has primary responsibility for developing the relationship with Kite’s Authorized Treatment Centers (ATCs) in Saudi Arabia and serves as the ATC’s primary point of contact with Kite. In this role, the CTAM is responsible for driving appropriate utilization of Kite’s CAR T therapies within the account and ensuring the delivery of a seamless customer experience. Everyone at Kite is grounded by one common goal – curing cancer. We are at the forefront of immunotherapy and engineered T cell therapy. Our personalized approach is what sets us apart. We also are entering a pivotal time in our history with multiple planned launches and evolving competitive dynamics on a global scale. That means a fast moving, constantly changing environment and innovative culture, where we make discoveries every day – discoveries that include our own capabilities and our individual potential.

o   Identify and understand the needs of account stakeholders and collaborate with Kite cross-functional colleagues (e.g. Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Quality) to find or develop solutions

## **Job Description:**

**Details of the Division and Team:**

Financial and Regulatory Reporting is responsible for the timely and accurate delivery of complete and comprehensive financial and regulatory reporting and analysis, for their area, in line with applicable internal policies and external regulatory, statutory and control frameworks.

This position involves supporting the Head of Finance, KSA (in Riyadh) in providing full-service Finance support under the Regional Finance function to the two main businesses in KSA Corporate Banking and Wealth Management.

**What we will offer you:**

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

**You can expect:**

* Life Insurance
* Accidental Death Insurance
* Permanent Partial Disability Insurance
* Private Medical Insurance for you, your spouse and dependent children
* Flexible working arrangements
* 30 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
* DB contributions to Employee Workplace Savings "Gosi” plan (for Saudi nationals only)

**Your key responsibilities:**

Direct reporting line is to the Head of Finance, KSA. It is envisaged that the candidate will be the main registered finance contact point with the banking regulator , SAMA.

The candidate should be able to demonstrate solid banking and markets Finance experience and will require ‘hands-on’ experience of the following functional areas:

* Liaison and point of contact for the main banking regulator SAMA.
* The majority of communication and submission to the regulator are in Arabic.  Fluency in both spoken and written Arabic is required.
* Managing external/internal audits of the entity including resolving the issues arise during audit in a timely and efficient manner, coordinating with relevant parties as and when required.
* Managing regulatory and taxation returns for the entity including review of monthly, quarterly and annual tax returns.
* Validation, control over the month end close process, both revenues and costs bookings, liaising directly with front office and operational staff and management in Riyadh to ensure relevant bookings are complete and accurate.
* Facilitation of the month-end balance sheet substantiation (MRP) as secondary Finance owner
* Liaison with both line business management and infrastructure functions to ensure that appropriate internal controls are in place
* Assisting in the completion of New Product Approval cross-functional risk-assessment checklists for new product or business implementations

In addition, the role will require:

* Onshore KSA coverage for other core Finance roles, as directed by Head of Finance, KSA

The role requires the following competencies gained in an international or large domestic Banking or Securities working environment as follows:

* Strong product accounting knowledge for vanilla Markets and Banking products
* The ability to analyse and communicate ‘risks’ inherent in a given operational or product booking situation, as well as delivering appropriate solutions
* Application skills which demonstrate an aptitude for change and a ’hands-on’ approach
* Strong inter-personal communication skills to support relationship-building across multi-functional teams
* An ability to work on initiative

**Your skills and experience:**

* Preferably a recognised Accounting Qualification, with minimum 6 years experience the areas above
* Internal DB core Finance systems, interface and DB financial data standard knowledge (SAP, Janus, BCS, FIM)
* Strong MS Office skills

**How we’ll support you:**

* Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
* Training and development to help you excel in your career

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Purpose

The Finance Manager collaborates closely with the Finance and Client Facing organization, providing financial business support. This role involves overseeing financial planning, financial analysis, and reporting, managing financial risks, and financial modelling and reviewing of client deals and business cases. The role will support the delivery of the Budget, Forecast and Multi-Year Growth Plans driving efficiencies, and to support client deal structuring and approval process The Finance Manager will report to the KBO Head of Finance, to support in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Oman (KBO) overall business priorities.

  

Principle Responsibilities/Key Results Area:

Financial Management:

* Production of key business drivers (e.g. volumes, transactions, etc.) to be used in strategic planning, annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting
* Volume trend and product mix analysis (International vs. Domestic)
* Proactive identification of development areas in designated markets; financial support of market development strategy
* Support in pricing and interchange related discussion concerning the covered markets, to include the impacts of both pricing and interchanges on client profitability
* Management of ad hoc/monthly/quarterly/yearly analysis of Market and Client trends to be used by all supported departments and the GCM’s
* Provide support in the areas of revenue management and investment decision.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities to meet or exceed internal customers’ expectations.

  

Incentives and Contracts:

* Responsible for deal modelling for clients in the covered markets and ensure it meets business needs and internal governance and compliance requirements (includes preparing the deal approval documents)
* Review incentive deal proposals with geo/functional teams and provide feedback where appropriate to optimize risk-adjusted returns.  Provide recommendation to senior leadership team on their financial viability and execution risks.
* Detailed deal tracking for all executed deals in the covered markets, providing management with real time analysis on deals performance.
* Provides financial analysis for forecasting contra-revenues.  Review and provide challenge to sales teams to obtain realistic projections for existing deals and new deals.
* Deal reforecasting on a monthly/quarterly basis and budget process
* Collaborate with other internal stakeholders (Legal, Client Contract Management, Controlling, etc) to ensure that the GCC client incentive contracts are executed in an efficient manner, properly accounted and meets internal governance and compliance requirements.

  

Expense Management:

* Proactive management of cross-functional & geography expense planning. Financial leadership in forecast and budget process for the markets; Tracking and monthly performance, understanding of variances.
* Advisory and guidance to cost center managers so they are informed of their approved budgets & forecasts and their commitment to budget/forecast on a continuous basis.
* Participation in continuous improvement activities to exceed customer expectations and promote a professional finance organization.
* Implement strategies to prevent and resolve bad debts.

  

Compliance and Governance:

* Ensure deals and approval-to-spend requests are captured, recorded, summarized, and reported in compliance with policies and procedures.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency of information as well as organized documentation of all financial assumptions, results and data sources used.
* Provide guidance to business partners on their approved budgets and forecasts, and their commitment to budget/forecast on a continuous basis.

Professional:

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, engineering, accounting, mathematics, economics, or related quantitative field
* At least 5 years post qualification experience in finance
* Degree in Accounting or professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent) is preferred.

Technical:

* Demonstrated expertise in utilizing financial analysis and modeling in challenging and complex scenarios.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint).
* Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills; able to resolve tough business problems with well-structured analyses
* Proven expertise in modelling techniques and managing large data sets
* Attentive to detail, highly organized, and focused on quality of output.
* Fluent in written and spoken business English.

Business:

* Excellent stakeholder management skills
* Excellent business acumen

* Strong problem-solving skills and logical, analytical mind-set
* Ability to work effectively with a diverse team and produce time sensitive deliverables
* Must be proactive, can-do attitude
* Experience in leading process improvement projects would be advantageous
* Strong interpersonal skills will be required to address on-going needs of a complex, matrix reporting structure, and multinational organization

Overview:

The Acceptance Solutions team is part of the Value-Added Services (VAS) organization and is responsible for enabling and growing acceptance products and services across the CEMEA region.

This role will be responsible for leading Visa's acceptance localization strategy and execution across Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA. The role will drive the identification, prioritization, and delivery of localization requirements necessary to support domestic payment schemes, national payment infrastructure initiatives, local routing mandates, regulatory requirements, and market-specific acceptance needs.

The successful candidate will serve as the CEMEA subject matter expert for card-present acceptance localization and will work closely with regulators, national payment companies, financial institutions, acquirers, processors, merchants, and internal Visa stakeholders to ensure Visa's in-person acceptance capabilities support local market requirements and evolving payment ecosystem needs.

This role will partner extensively with Global Product teams, Core Processing and Network teams, Technology teams, Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, and Compliance organizations to assess market requirements, define product and processing enhancements, influence product roadmaps, and drive the delivery of localization initiatives across the acceptance ecosystem.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing regional localization strategies, conducting market and regulatory assessments, translating local requirements into actionable business and technical specifications, supporting client engagements, and ensuring successful deployment of localized acceptance capabilities across CEMEA markets.

This position would be ideal for a candidate with extensive experience in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance, payment processing, domestic payment schemes, regulatory programs, or in-person payments product management. The role is part of the hub team covering the CEMEA region and will report to the Acceptance Solutions Lead within the VAS organization.

  

Key Responsibilities:

* Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-person acceptance localization across CEMEA, covering merchant acquiring, acceptance infrastructure, card-present payments, domestic payment schemes, and local routing initiatives.
* Lead Visa's regional strategy for localization of in-person acceptance capabilities to address regulatory requirements, domestic payment scheme mandates, and national payment infrastructure initiatives.
* Analyze and translate regulatory, market, and domestic scheme requirements into clearly documented business, operational, and technical requirements.
* Partner with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, and government stakeholders to understand evolving payment ecosystem requirements and represent Visa's acceptance capabilities.
* Work closely with Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Regional Product teams to assess the impact of local payment requirements and define Visa's response strategy.
* Collaborate with Global Product, Technology, Acceptance Solutions, and Core Processing teams to build business cases, prioritize market requirements, and drive product roadmap enhancements.
* Partner with VisaNet, network processing, and core processing teams to evaluate technical implications of localization initiatives and identify scalable implementation approaches.
* Drive end-to-end execution of localization initiatives including requirements gathering, impact assessments, stakeholder alignment, business case development, delivery tracking, testing, certification support, and market readiness activities.
* Support domestic payment scheme enablement initiatives, including co-badging programs, local routing, domestic acceptance mandates, and national payment infrastructure projects.
* Assess acquiring, processing, and acceptance ecosystem readiness to support market-specific payment requirements.
* Engage with acquirers, processors, payment service providers (PSPs), payment facilitators, terminal vendors, merchants, fintechs, and ecosystem participants to understand implementation challenges and support deployment readiness.
* Identify product gaps and regional customization requirements and work with global teams to prioritize and deliver solutions addressing local market needs.
* Develop market assessments, strategy recommendations, and executive-level updates to support regional and global decision-making.
* Be responsible for annual planning activities for localization initiatives, including KPI setting, strategic priorities, delivery objectives, and cross-functional alignment.
* Monitor progress of localization programs and provide regular updates to senior leadership on market readiness, implementation status, risks, and dependencies.
* Represent Visa at industry forums, regulatory discussions, market working groups, and client engagements related to payment acceptance, domestic schemes, and localization initiatives.

Visa Marketing Services is the strategic marketing arm of Visa that partners with issuing financial institutions, fintechs, and co-brand partners to drive cardholder engagement, acquisition, and loyalty. We combine Visa's global expertise, proprietary data insights, and cutting-edge marketing technology to help our issuer clients build winning campaigns that deliver measurable business outcomes. As part of Visa Marketing Services, you will work directly with issuers across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) to design and execute marketing strategies that grow their card portfolios, increase spend and deepen customer relationships.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Marketing Manager to be a strategic partner to our internal teams and issuer clients across Saudi Arabia.

This is a unique opportunity for a builder who understands marketing systems, has deep expertise in digital marketing, and is passionate about empowering teams with AI and automation tools.

Your core mission will be to leverage Visa Marketing Services programs and the Visa platform to design, guide, and help build winning marketing strategies and campaigns for our issuer partners. You will revolutionize how our marketing team engages with banks, fintechs, and financial institution clients to drive cardholder acquisition, activation, and loyalty.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Issuer Partnership & Client Engagement**

* Serve as a strategic marketing technology advisor to issuer clients, understanding their business objectives and translating them into effective campaign strategies

* Collaborate with issuer marketing teams to implement best-in-class campaigns leveraging Visa's platforms, sponsorship assets, tools, and data assets
    

* Present marketing technology solutions, campaign performance insights, and strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders
    

* Build strong relationships with issuer partners, acting as a trusted advisor on marketing innovation and digital transformation   
    
    

**Digital Marketing & Martech Leadership**

* Lead the design and execution of multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across, paid media, social channels, and programmatic advertising

* Educate and upskill internal teams and issuer clients on AI capabilities and practical applications in marketing

Saudi Arabia's rapid digital transformation, driven by Vision 2030, creates an exciting environment where you can shape the future of marketing for leading financial institutions. You will have access to Visa's world-class resources, data assets, and global expertise while making a tangible impact on the Kingdom's payments ecosystem.

**SAP Specialist**

KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers and we all share one goal of improving the World and Beyond: responsibly, and safely. KBR is looking for SAP specialist.

**Responsibilities:**

* To coordinate and execute responsibilities relating to governing and establishing the Total reliability program Framework  throughout the remaining asset lifecycle in Refinery.
* To prepare framework and methodology for criticality assessment and Reliability improvement program of refinery assets.
* To lead and Perform Asset Criticality Analysis for all the refinery assets
* To collect all data for criticality assessment, Lead/conduct Asset Criticality assessment workshops, Compilation of workshop finding in suitable reports and populate the data in required format for uploading in SAP with supporting documents.
* Champion the implementation of various reliability methodologies for all asset types by establishing reliability programs to sustain operational excellence.
* Shall lead the team as the focal point of contact for reviews and technical matters related to reliability culture development in projects and operating facilities with guidance to safeguard the asset reliability throughout the asset lifecycle.
* Shall administer and perform the Asset Lifecycle management procedures such as Asset criticality ranking, SAP Taxonomy, Asset Operating Limits \[IOW\], Asset maintenance development procedures, and Master data developments in SAP, Bill of Materials BOM in SAP, active SAP-PMs Implementation and effectiveness.
* Shall initiate and conduct essential studies for facilities and operational asset improvements, while providing specialized technical service in relevant engineering disciplines, acts as a consultant on complex engineering problems, designs, and/or projects, coordinates with plant-wide teams.

* The candidate shall have site Reliability background and strong knowledge in Refinery Processes.

* Leadership and Team Management
* Knowledge of the Oil and Gas Industry.
* Experience in Asset Life cycle Management processes.
* Implementing predictive maintenance policies and increasing asset availability
* Communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a diversified and critical environment.
* Data analysis and report writing skills.
* Attention to details.
* Knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Power Point).
* Proficient in verbal and written English.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Contracts Manager** to join our team! In this role you will act as the **vital link between project delivery and financial viability, ensuring that one of the world's most ambitious infrastructure developments remains profitable, compliant, and on track. You will join a multidisciplinary "Delivery Partner" team, navigating complex Design-Build environments and managing high-value contract portfolios that define the future of the Kingdom.**

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Oversee all aspects of contract management including administering complex contracts (FIDIC, NEC, or bespoke), ensuring full adherence to contractual obligations and KSA law.
    
* Proactively identify contractual and financial risks early in the project lifecycle and develop robust strategies to protect both Parsons' and the Client's interests.
    
* Lead the assessment, negotiation, and resolution of significant variations, change orders, and potential disputes.
    
* Mentor and lead a team of Contract Managers fostering a culture of professional integrity and technical excellence.
    
* Provide strategic direction and leadership for all contract management activities focusing on successful outcomes, across the portfolio.
    
* Develop and implement commercial & contract management strategies to achieve project objectives, output deliverables in a timely manner, and maximize value.
    
* Assist in evaluation of Change Requests, including developing and managing change management documentation through to finalizing EI’s and VO’s.
    
* Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions, including managing claims, variations, and disputes.
    
* Provide expert advice on contract interpretation and risk mitigation strategies.
    
* Assist the development and management of project budgets, ensuring alignment with financial goals.
    
* Prepare detailed reports, forecasts, and cost analysis for senior management and stakeholders.
    
* Coordinate with procurement team and ensure the activities align with project requirements and organizational policies.
    
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with consultants, suppliers and contractors to ensure optimal performance.
    
* Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial risks throughout the project lifecycle.
    
* Develop contingency plans to address potential financial and contractual challenges.
    
* Foster a culture of collaboration and excellence.
    
* Provide training and guidance to team members to enhance their skills and performance.
    
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, contractors, and consultants, to ensure alignment on commercial matters.
    
* Represent the project in commercial discussions and negotiations with stakeholders.
    
* Ensure adherence to legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
    
* Prepare and present comprehensive reports to stakeholders and senior management.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, or Construction Law.
    
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in commercial and-or contracts management across multiple construction sectors.
    
* Extensive knowledge of cost & commercial management principles, procurement processes, and contract management principles.
    
* Proven track record of managing large-scale projects and delivering within budget and schedule.
    
* Familiarity with local regulations, industry standards, and best practices.
    
* Proficiency in project management software and financial tools.
    
* Exceptional communication and leadership skills.
    
* Ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships and resolve disputes effectively.
    

  
**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional certification (MRICS) is preferred.
    
* Experience in PMO projects is highly desirable.
    
* Strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    
* Leadership and team management expertise.
    
* Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
    
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Delivery Manager** to join our team!

We are seeking a highly experienced Delivery Manager to lead the successful delivery of a major airport airfield and infrastructure development area, including runways, taxiways, aprons, airfield pavements, utilities, drainage systems, and associated infrastructure works. This role requires exceptional leadership, project delivery, and stakeholder management experience gained from complex aviation and large-scale infrastructure programs.  
  
The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 20 years of experience in managing the delivery of major airport, airfield, transportation, or infrastructure projects, with proven capability in leading multidisciplinary teams, managing contractors, ensuring compliance with aviation requirements, and delivering complex projects safely, on time, and within budget.

# **What You'll Be Doing:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for the successful delivery of an assigned airport infrastructure area, including runways, taxiways, aprons, airfield systems, utilities, and supporting infrastructure.
* Develop and implement delivery strategies aligned with project objectives, contractual requirements, and client expectations.
* Lead multidisciplinary delivery teams covering engineering, construction, project controls, quality, HSE, commercial, and stakeholder management functions.
* Ensure successful execution of project activities from design development through construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Drive delivery performance and ensure achievement of key milestones and project objectives.
* Oversee the delivery of airfield works including runway and taxiway construction, pavement works, airside roads, markings, lighting interfaces, drainage, and associated systems.
* Ensure airfield works comply with aviation standards, operational requirements, and approved design specifications.
* Manage construction sequencing and delivery strategies considering airport operational constraints and safety requirements.
* Coordinate integration between airfield infrastructure, utilities, buildings, systems, and operational interfaces.
* Support successful completion of airfield testing, inspections, commissioning, and operational readiness activities.
* Provide leadership and direction to contractors, consultants, and delivery partners.
* Monitor contractor performance against approved programs, quality requirements, safety standards, and contractual obligations.
* Review construction methodologies, execution plans, recovery strategies, and resource plans.
* Ensure effective resolution of technical, commercial, and construction challenges impacting delivery.
* Drive accountability across contractors and project stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
* Work closely with planning, cost control, risk, and commercial teams to monitor project performance.
* Review project schedules, progress reports, cost forecasts, and delivery dashboards.
* Identify potential delays, risks, and constraints and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support development of recovery plans and improvement initiatives where required.
* Ensure effective integration between project controls and delivery activities.
* Lead coordination between design teams, contractors, consultants, and client representatives.
* Ensure design deliverables support construction requirements and project objectives.
* Review technical challenges, design changes, and interface issues affecting delivery.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces between civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, ICT, utilities, and aviation systems.
* Support value engineering initiatives and constructability improvements.
* Act as a key point of contact between project leadership, client representatives, contractors, authorities, and operational stakeholders.
* Manage complex interfaces between airfield works, infrastructure packages, airport operations, and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate progress meetings, executive reviews, technical workshops, and coordination sessions.
* Ensure timely resolution of stakeholder concerns and delivery constraints.
* Maintain strong relationships with aviation authorities and regulatory bodies.
* Ensure all delivered works comply with project specifications, quality standards, aviation regulations, and contractual requirements.
* Support implementation of quality assurance and quality control processes.
* Review inspection plans, testing procedures, non-conformance reports, and corrective actions.
* Promote a culture of quality excellence throughout project delivery activities.
* Ensure completion documentation and handover requirements are achieved.
* Provide leadership in maintaining the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental performance.
* Ensure all construction activities comply with airport safety requirements, HSE procedures, and operational restrictions.
* Support risk assessments, safety reviews, and constructability assessments.
* Promote safe delivery practices across contractors and project teams.
* Ensure environmental requirements and sustainability objectives are integrated into delivery activities.
* Support commercial teams in managing contractual obligations, variations, claims, and delivery risks.
* Review contractor performance and support resolution of contractual issues.
* Provide delivery input into change management and commercial decision-making processes.
* Ensure project execution remains aligned with approved budgets and contractual requirements.
* Provide regular delivery updates, performance reports, and executive-level presentations.
* Report progress, risks, opportunities, and key decisions to project leadership.
* Participate in governance meetings and strategic project reviews.
* Maintain effective project documentation and delivery records.
* Provide leadership, mentoring, and guidance to project team members.

# **What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related Engineering discipline.
* Master’s Degree in Engineering or Project Management is an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of experience in major infrastructure, airport, airfield, transportation, or EPC project delivery.
* Proven experience managing large-scale airport development programs involving runways, taxiways, pavements, utilities, and infrastructure systems.
* Extensive experience leading multidisciplinary project teams and managing contractors.
* Strong track record of delivering complex projects through design, construction, commissioning, and handover phases.
* Experience working with international clients, consultants, contractors, and government authorities.
* Strong knowledge of airport infrastructure delivery requirements and airfield construction practices.
* Excellent understanding of project delivery methodologies, construction management, and contract administration.
* Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities.
* Experience managing complex interfaces across multiple disciplines and contractors.
* Strong understanding of project controls, risk management, cost management, and schedule performance.
* Ability to manage high-pressure project environments and resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

# **What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional qualification such as Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or equivalent.
* Extensive experience delivering international airport and airfield development projects.
* Knowledge of ICAO, FAA, and international aviation infrastructure standards.
* Experience working under FIDIC, EPC, design-build, or similar international contract frameworks.
* Experience managing mega projects with significant stakeholder complexity.
* Strong experience in airport operational readiness, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Experience leading integrated project delivery teams across multiple work packages.
* Knowledge of BIM, digital engineering, and modern project delivery technologies.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are seeking a detail-oriented and organized **Contract Administrator - Saudi National** to support contract administration and commercial coordination on a major airfield / airport development project.

The role focuses on assisting with contract documentation, correspondence, change management support, and compliance with contractual procedures in accordance with project and client requirements. The ideal candidate will have 5 years of experience in contract administration or commercial support roles on construction or infrastructure projects.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Support the administration of contracts in accordance with contract terms, conditions, and project procedures.
* Assist in preparing contract correspondence, notices, and contractual records.
* Support the tracking of variations, change orders, and contract deliverables.
* Maintain contract documentation, logs, and registers in line with project requirements.
* Assist in preparing basic contractual reports, summaries, and status updates.
* Support coordination with commercial, procurement, and project teams on contractual matters.
* Assist in ensuring compliance with contract procedures, approvals, and documentation requirements.
* Support coordination with contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders on contract-related communications.
* Participate in contract reviews, meetings, and coordination sessions as required.
* Maintain records of contract correspondence, approvals, and submissions.
* Support document control related to contracts and commercial records.
* Assist in tracking key contract milestones and obligations.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Law, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of experience** in contract administration, commercial support, or similar roles on construction or infrastructure projects.
* Basic understanding of construction contracts and contract administration procedures.
* Good documentation, organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with contract registers, logs, and reporting tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to FIDIC or similar standard forms of contract.
* Experience on airport, airfield, or large infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with document control systems and commercial reporting processes.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking an authoritative and highly systematic **Deputy EDMS Manager** to establish, govern, and lead the overarching information management framework for a multi-billion-dollar program in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This role requires an expert to take absolute ownership of the life cycle of all engineering, commercial, and legal records across massive infrastructure packages, ensuring flawless compliance, data integrity, and strict access control across all project entities.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Framework & Governance Setup: Establish, update, and enforce program-wide document control policies, numbering taxonomies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Parsons teams, contractors, and subcontractors.
    
* EDMS Management & Supervision: Oversee the deployment, optimization, and daily administration of the Enterprise Document Management System (EDMS), ensuring metadata compliance and seamless system configuration.
    
* Team Leadership & Quality Assurance: Manage a multi-national team of document controllers, running regular quality audits to eliminate indexing errors, backlog delays, or missing revisions.
    
* Security & Access Control: Maintain absolute data confidentiality and security protocols in strict alignment with client requirements and Parsons data privacy standards, safeguarding sensitive or restricted project files.
    
* Reporting & Progress Tracking: Generate specialized document status metrics, turnaround-time analytics, and engineering submittal reports for Senior Project Directors to flag workflow bottlenecks.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience in document control and records management on world-class, mega-scale construction and infrastructure programs, with a proven track record in a leadership or managerial capacity.
    
* **Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.** Professional certifications in Information Governance or Records Management are a significant asset.
    
* Technical Expertise: Advanced, expert-level proficiency with major industry-standard EDMS platforms (such as Aconex, ProjectWise, or PMWeb). Deep understanding of engineering drawings, design stages, and contract closeout documentation workflows.
    

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* Direct experience managing complex information systems for Saudi Arabian giga-projects (such as NEOM, Trojena, Oxagon, or Red Sea Global) is heavily weighted.
    
* Communication & Precision: Exceptional organizational capability, meticulous attention to detail, and a flawless command of technical English. The role demands strong leadership to guide contractors and maintain rigid compliance under aggressive program timelines.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Contracts Manager** to join our team! In this role you will act as the **vital link between project delivery and financial viability, ensuring that one of the world's most ambitious infrastructure developments remains profitable, compliant, and on track. You will join a multidisciplinary "Delivery Partner" team, navigating complex Design-Build environments and managing high-value contract portfolios that define the future of the Kingdom.**

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Undertake all aspects of contract management including administering complex contracts (FIDIC, NEC, or bespoke), ensuring full adherence to contractual obligations and KSA law.
    
* Proactively identify contractual and financial risks early in the project lifecycle and develop robust strategies to protect both Parsons' and the Client's interests.
    
* Undertake assessment, negotiation, and resolution of significant variations, change orders, and potential disputes.
    
* Foster a culture of professional integrity and technical excellence.
    
* Provide direction for all contract management activities focusing on successful outcomes, across the portfolio.
    
* Implement commercial & contract management strategies to achieve project objectives, output deliverables in a timely manner, and maximize value.
    
* Assist in evaluation of Change Requests, including developing and managing change management documentation through to finalizing EI’s and VO’s.
    
* Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions, including managing claims, variations, and disputes.
    
* Provide advice on contract interpretation and risk mitigation strategies.
    
* Assist the development and management of project budgets, ensuring alignment with financial goals.
    
* Prepare detailed reports, forecasts, and cost analysis for senior management and stakeholders.
    
* Coordinate with procurement team and ensure the activities align with project requirements and organizational policies.
    
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with consultants, suppliers and contractors to ensure optimal performance.
    
* Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial risks throughout the project lifecycle.
    
* Develop contingency plans to address potential financial and contractual challenges.
    
* Foster a culture of collaboration and excellence.
    
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on commercial matters.
    
* Represent the project in commercial discussions and negotiations with stakeholders.
    
* Ensure adherence to legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
    
* Prepare and present comprehensive reports to stakeholders and senior management.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, or Construction Law.
    
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in commercial and-or contracts management across multiple construction sectors.
    
* Extensive knowledge of cost & commercial management principles, procurement processes, and contract management principles.
    
* Proven track record of managing large-scale contracts and delivering within budget and schedule.
    
* Familiarity with local regulations, industry standards, and best practices.
    
* Proficiency in project management software and financial tools.
    
* Exceptional communication and leadership skills.
    
* Ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships and resolve disputes effectively.
    

  
**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional certification (MRICS) is preferred.
    
* Experience in PMO projects is highly desirable.
    
* Strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    
* Leadership and team management expertise.
    
* Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
    
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities effectively.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Principal Quantity Surveyor** to join our team! In this role you will get to **l****ead and oversee all quantity surveying activities related to Architecture / Civil / Structural / MEP construction projects, with a well-rounded background in the construction of buildings including residential, educational, medical, and industrial facilities as well as infrastructure works such as roads, bridges, and underground utility supply systems ensuring accurate cost estimation, contract compliance, and financial control.**

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Responsible for managing quantity take-offs, cost analysis, and payment certifications to support project delivery within budget and schedule.
    
* Conduct detailed material quantity take-offs from design and shop drawings for all disciplines.
    
* Maintain and periodically update the schedule of quantities and unit prices to ensure budget adequacy and cost control.
    
* Prepare comprehensive cost estimates and quantity assessments for proposed variations and additional works.
    
* Lead negotiations with contractors regarding change orders.
    
* Review and validate contractor’s monthly progress invoices and final accounts to ensure accuracy and compliance.
    
* Perform site inspections to verify completed work against contract specifications and drawings.
    
* Assume Resident Construction Engineer duties when required, ensuring technical compliance and quality assurance.
    
* Provide expert advice on cost engineering, value engineering opportunities and contribute to continuous improvement of cost management practices.
    
* Coordinate with project controls and planning teams to ensure alignment between cost and schedule performance.
    
* Ensure compliance with relevant local regulations, codes, and international standards. Perform any other job-related duties as assigned.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related discipline.
    
* Minimum 10 years of post-graduate experience in Quantity Surveying, with a strong focus on buildings and infrastructure construction projects.
    
* Proven track record in managing medium and large-scale infrastructure or building projects.
    
* Proficiency in industry-standard software such as MS Office (Word/Excel/PowerPoint), AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
    
* Fluent in spoken and written English; ability to produce clear technical documentation and reports.
    
* Experience working in a multidisciplinary team environment and interfacing with engineering, procurement, and construction teams.
    
* Knowledge of FIDIC or other standard forms of contract is a must.
    

  
**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.
    
* Membership in a recognized professional body (e.g., RICS, AIQS) is preferred.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Design Engineering Manager (Water)** to join our team. In this role, you will act as the main point of contact within the design team for technical issues related to **water and irrigation networks**.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Design and plan **primary and secondary pressurized** networks.
    
* Act as the main point of contact within the design team for technical issues related to **water/irrigation networks**.
    
* Provide support for other engineering activities as required.
    
* **Compute** water demands and requirements.
    
* Develop efficient and cost-effective pressurized network designs that meet all requirements.
    
* Prepare site plans, design reports, specifications, and cost estimates.
    
* Review deliverables, including design reports, design submissions, and specifications.
    

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or a related field from an accredited University/Institute is required.
    
* Minimum **20** **years of experience** in the design of infrastructure mega projects, specifically **irrigation network design**.
    
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
    
* Experience advising clients on the best systems, materials, products, and sustainability approaches for irrigation systems.
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Strong computer/software skills in **WaterGEMS, LandF/x, Microsoft Word, Excel, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Rain Cad** *(please confirm exact product spellings as used by the company).*

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented **Irrigation Inspector (Saudi National)** to join our site-based construction supervision team on a major public realm development in Diriyah, which includes a series of iconic and neighborhood parks, open spaces, and over 55 kilometers of streetscape. The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well-being.  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Attend Inspection Requests (IRs) submitted by the contractor and take appropriate action promptly.
* Assist in reviewing submitted shop drawings against contract drawings and specifications, local codes and statutory requirements, and international best practices.
* Report any works carried out by contractors found to not be in accordance with approved drawings and specifications and report to stakeholders for appropriate action.
* Monitor the quality of executed works and the progress on site daily.
* Maintain records for daily activities on site including progress photos and ensure they are readily available for inspection as and when required.
* Prepare surveillance report(s) for deficiencies of work found at the site and nonconformance reports (NCR) if required in view of the development of events.
* Check and ensure effective coordination between discipline-related works and all other disciplines.
* Provide technical input and experiences to resolve any discipline-related issues on-site that may arise.
* Inspect construction works to ensure compliance with approved methods and contract requirements.
* Maintain records of inspections, work executed, etc.
* Assist in or measure work done when required.
* Observe site safety procedures.

  

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Must have a Degree in Agriculture Engineering with 7 plus years of related experience in direct landscape work.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a high-calibre, senior-level **Health, Safety & Environment Manager** to lead HS&E across a major rail infrastructure project. This is a key leadership role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of delivering HS&E excellence on large-scale, multi-million-dollar civil engineering or infrastructure projects. Reporting directly to the Project Director, you will lead the HS&E function and drive the implementation of a robust, proactive management strategy across every stage of the project. You will be strategic in approach, but equally comfortable being hands-on and visible across the project environment. With the credibility and gravitas to influence a complex matrix organization, you will build strong relationships with senior management, project teams, contractors and the client. You will champion a culture of continuous improvement and bring the project to life through a genuine commitment to our **Zero Harm philosophy**.

This is an exciting opportunity for a results-driven HS&E leader who is passionate about delivering one of the region’s most significant rail projects.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following:
    
* Supporting the Leadership Team, comprising of the Project Manager, Deputy Project Manager and Package Managers in driving and implementing the HS&E efforts on the project
    
* Implementing and monitoring initiatives to improve efficiency and effectiveness in the HSE services and delivery
    
* Planning and coordinating continuous improvement HSE actions for all phases of the project to share good practice, feedback experiences and drive best practice, typically through continuous improvement workshops, lessons learnt reviews
    
* Managing a team of HSE professionals
    
* Overseeing and reviewing the HSE requirements of the design-build (DB) contactors in matters such as such as contract compliance, RAMS and permits to work
    
* Auditing, monitoring and reporting project and DB contractor HSE performance
    
* Reviewing, implementing and maintaining the management systems for HSE, in line with regulatory standards
    
* Ensuring the project team follows the relevant legislation, engineering and construction codes and standards
    
* Leading, developing and updating the HSE policies, plans and procedure to comply as a minimum with the joint venture standards, local and international legal requirements
    
* Developing and implementing Emergency Preparedness Plan (EPP’s), Emergency Operating Procedure (EOP’s) and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP’s)
    
* Identifying hazards and assessing safety risk, developing strategies to ensure products, system and applications are safe and reliable
    
* Preparing HSE documents and processes such as Risk Assessment and Safe Systems of Work
    
* Investigating and ensuring action to eliminate the cause of potential non-conformities to prevent their occurrence
    
* Reporting all cases of non-conformity
    
* Identifying then eliminating the root cause and prevent recurrences
    
* Leading the investigation team of serious incident and accident reports
    
* Preparing and submitting reports and follow-up in preventative and corrective actions
    

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Minimum of 15 years experience on a heavy civils engineering project
    
* Experience leading a team of HS&E professionals
    
* NEBOSH, IOSH, IEMA, IRCA or equivalent
    
* Registered Lead Auditor
    
* Ability to deliver in a highly pressurized & fast paced environment
    
* Ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization
    
* Effective communication skills including the ability to make persuasive presentations to small and large audiences
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**

* Experience on metros, rail or related project
    
* Experience on tunneling projects
    
* Have obtained a suitable Environmental Management Qualification

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Deputy** **Practice Lead** to join our team! In this role you will get to be a key EMEA regional point of contact and support the discipline lead for the practice area considering both business development and project delivery. The position will be key in the development of execution strategies for new PMC proposals and will bring innovation to Parsons and the market in general. The position will support key clients in the region and make significant public impact as we grow our world class capabilities.

* Supports PMC pursuits across EMEA taking Technical Lead role as and when necessary.
* Participate in strategic pursuit reviews, (red/gold/green) and EPR’s as required.
* Act as SME for PMC pursuits in support of the sectors, helping to develop execution strategies and alternative delivery strategies to Parson’s pursuits and to the market in general.
* Support ongoing development of the Project Management Framework (PMF) for the consistent deployment and implementation of PMC and PMO projects in the EMEA region.
* Support development of overall PMC Practice and Guidance.
* Support PM Training and Development Program
* Support and administer the EMEA PM Community of Practice.
* Ability to stand in, on rare occasion, for Project Directors for short term assignments (at specific client request):
* Must be capable of managing a project or program min. value $200m-$500m.
* Provide input and support for every phase of large projects or programs to ensure on-schedule completion within budget and in accordance with contractual obligations.
* Prior experience must include significant project management or construction management assignments at the Principal Project Manager level.
* Relocation to the job site may be required for short-term support.
* Undertake/ support Strategic reviews of live projects and where necessary support Project recovery initiatives.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

Travel around Europe and the Middle East region is expected in support of project start-ups and permanent relocation within the region may be required upon a designated Program Director major program assignment. This is a high-profile technical leadership position.

**As Deputy PMC Practice Lead:**

Key responsibilities of the Deputy Practice Lead will be People, Process and Technology, as well as Project Delivery.

People:

* Act as a regional point of contact for that technical Practice for both BD and Sectors. Responsible for reputation management and leadership of the Practice Area.
* Be aware (number and capability) of the staff in region that align with the Practice – this includes support an employee matrix mapping.
* Support regional mobility of high potential staff in the Practice Area.
* Support the Sectors Leads in developing the strategy and the growth or contraction of that Practice in their Geography.
* Support all major PMC pursuit developments, red reviews and president reviews as required.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior ITS Engineer** to join our PMO team. In this role, you will provide program‑level technical leadership, oversight, and integration of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) across one of the largest and most complex urban road networks in the region.

The position requires a highly experienced ITS professional capable of reviewing designs, assessing contractor technical proposals, ensuring system integration, and aligning ITS deployments with Traffic Control Centers (TCC) and adjacent projects.

The **Senior ITS Engineer** will act as the PMO technical authority for ITS systems, overseeing planning, design development, contractor submissions, interfaces, and system integration across multiple road and corridor projects.

The role involves coordination with designers, contractors, authorities, system integrators, and operators to ensure that all ITS solutions are technically compliant, interoperable, future‑ready, and aligned with smart mobility objectives.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Provide program‑level oversight and governance for all ITS works across the Program.
* Review and manage ITS scope covering:
    * Signalized and unsignalized intersections
    * Variable Message Signs (VMS) and Dynamic Message Signs (DMS)
    * Overhead gantries and cantilever structures (OVHDs)
    * Automatic Incident Detection (AID) systems
    * Ramp metering systems
    * ANPR systems
    * ITS field devices (CCTV, detectors, sensors, cabinets)
    * Local Control and Support Centers (LCSC)
* Review and provide technical recommendations on contractor and system integrator technical proposals, shop drawings, material submissions, method statements, and system architectures.
* Ensure ITS systems are fully integrated with existing and future Traffic Control Centers (TCC) and coordinated across project‑to‑project interfaces.
* Oversee the design and implementation of optical fiber communication networks, including backbone, distribution, access networks, redundancy, and routing strategies.
* Review Functional System Design Documents (FSDDs), integration plans, testing and commissioning strategies, and operational readiness plans.
* Ensure compliance with applicable international ITS standards, local authority requirements, and RCRC specifications.
* Support interface management between ITS, traffic engineering, electrical, communications, civil, and structural disciplines.
* Provide technical input to BOQs, scope definitions, risk registers, and value engineering initiatives.
* Monitor and support FAT, SAT, system integration testing, and final commissioning of ITS systems.
* Prepare and review technical reports, design review comments, decision papers, and executive summaries for senior management and stakeholders.
* Liaise with RCRC, traffic authorities, operators, police, and other stakeholders to resolve technical and operational issues.
* Mentor junior ITS engineers and contribute to PMO capability building and **standardization**.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communications Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in ITS planning, design, integration, and delivery on large‑scale urban road or highway infrastructure projects.
* Extensive hands‑on experience with:
    * Urban ITS systems and architecture
    * Intersections, VMS/DMS, AID, ramp metering, ANPR, and field devices
    * ITS communications and fiber optic networks
* Proven experience reviewing contractor and vendor technical proposals and complex multi‑disciplinary designs.
* Strong understanding of ITS system integration, interoperability, cybersecurity, and data communications.
* Familiarity with relevant international standards and protocols (e.g., NTCIP, IP networking, ONVIF, SNMP).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coordination, leadership, and problem‑solving skills.

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Prior experience on mega road or smart city programs in the GCC, preferably Saudi Arabia.
* Experience with traffic management centers, smart mobility platforms, and city‑wide ITS integration.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity requirements for ITS and operational networks.
* Professional certifications (PMP, PE, CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent).
* Experience supporting operational readiness, O&M transition, and asset handover.

**Job Description:**

  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Controls & Change Management Manager** to join our team! In this role, you will work closely with the Project Controls Director and management, engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, contracts, finance, and client representatives to assess the impact of changes and support informed project decision-making.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

### Project Controls Management

* Establish and implement project controls procedures, systems, tools, and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain the project control baseline, including scope, schedule, cost, resources, and key performance indicators.
* Oversee the preparation and maintenance of the integrated master schedule.
* Ensure that project budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, and cash flows are accurately maintained.
* Monitor project performance against approved cost and schedule baselines.
* Review schedule updates, progress reports, cost reports, forecasts, and variance analyses.
* Ensure timely identification of trends, deviations, risks, and opportunities.
* Coordinate the preparation of monthly project performance reports and executive dashboards.
* Ensure consistent reporting across project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
* Lead the development of recovery plans for projects experiencing cost, schedule, or performance issues.
* Support earned value management, productivity analysis, resource planning, and performance measurement activities.
* Ensure project control data is accurate, complete, traceable, and suitable for management decision-making.

### Change Management

* Establish and administer the project change management and change control process.
* Manage the identification, registration, assessment, approval, implementation, and closeout of project changes.
* Maintain the project change register, trend register, potential change log, and associated records.
* Review change requests, change notices, variation orders, field instructions, design changes, claims, and contract amendments.
* Ensure that all proposed changes are assessed for their impact on:ScopeCostScheduleResourcesProcurementContractsEngineeringConstructionQualityRiskSafety and regulatory requirements
* Coordinate the preparation of cost estimates and schedule impact assessments for proposed changes.
* Review contractor and subcontractor change submissions for entitlement, accuracy, completeness, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure that changes are properly authorized before implementation.
* Lead change control meetings and provide recommendations to project leadership and clients.
* Ensure approved changes are incorporated into project budgets, forecasts, schedules, progress measurement systems, and contractual records.
* Monitor the status of pending, approved, rejected, implemented, and closed changes.
* Support the evaluation of claims, extensions of time, compensation events, and disputed changes.
* Identify trends and potential changes at an early stage to minimize cost and schedule impacts.
* Ensure that changes are fully documented and audit-ready.

### Team and Stakeholder Management

* Provide leadership, guidance, coaching, and performance management to the project controls and change management team.
* Define roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and performance expectations.
* Coordinate with project managers, engineering managers, construction managers, procurement, contracts, commercial, finance, and client representatives.
* Promote consistent project controls and change management practices across the organization.
* Facilitate workshops, review meetings, risk sessions, and change control boards.
* Communicate project performance, risks, trends, and change impacts clearly to senior management.
* Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions by providing reliable project controls information.
* Develop strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

### Governance and Continuous Improvement

* Ensure compliance with company policies, project procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable standards.
* Establish effective document control and audit trails for project controls and change management activities.
* Support internal, client, and external audits.
* Identify opportunities to improve project controls processes, reporting systems, data quality, and change management workflows.
* Implement lessons learned and best practices across projects.
* Support project closeout by ensuring that final costs, schedules, approved changes, claims, and contractual records are complete and accurate.

  
  

## Required Qualifications

  

* **Required Qualifications**
    * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
    * 20 years of experience in project controls, cost control, planning, contract administration, change management, or project management.
    * Experience in engineering, procurement, and construction projects, preferably in construction, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, or industrial sectors.
    * Understanding of project change control, cost management, schedule management, and contract administration principles.
    * Ability to interpret project drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, estimates, and technical documents.
    * Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
    * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
    * Experience in using project controls or document management systems.
    
* **Preferred Qualifications**
    * Professional certification such as PMP, AACE, PSP, CCP, MRICS, or equivalent.
    * Knowledge of earned value management principles.
    * Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Oracle Unifier, EcoSys, SAP, Procore, or similar project management systems.
    * Experience with contract forms such as FIDIC, NEC, EPC, EPCM, or design-build agreements.
    * Knowledge of cost forecasting, progress measurement, schedule analysis, and risk management.
    * Experience preparing time impact analyses and extension-of-time assessments.
    * Experience working with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and client organizations.
* **Technical Skills**
    * Change registers and change control workflows
    * Cost estimating and cost impact analysis
    * Schedule impact analysis
    * Trend and risk management
    * Budget and forecast control
    * Contract change administration
    * Variation orders and claims management
    * Progress measurement and earned value management
    * Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project
    * Excel-based reporting and data analysis
    * Document control and audit management
    * Project management information systems
    * Core Competencies
    * Strong attention to detail
    * Commercial and contractual awareness
    * Analytical and problem-solving ability
    * Effective stakeholder coordination
    * Clear written and verbal communication
    * Ability to identify potential project impacts early
    * Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
    * Sound judgment and decision-making
    * Integrity and confidentiality
    * Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary project environment
* **Key Performance Indicators: Performance may be measured by:**
    * Timeliness and accuracy of change evaluations
    * Completeness of the change register
    * Percentage of changes processed in accordance with project procedures
    * Accuracy of cost and schedule impact assessments
    * Timely incorporation of approved changes into project baselines
    * Reduction of unapproved or undocumented changes
    * Accuracy of change forecasts and trend reports
    * Timely resolution of pending change items
    * Quality of change documentation and audit compliance
    * Stakeholder satisfaction with the change control process

**Title:**

Senior Manager - Information Management

### Senior Manager - Information Management

  
  

### LOCATION

  

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

  

**project description**

The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets. KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.

  

**THE ROLE**

Reporting to the Programme Director, the Senior Manager - Information Management is responsible for establishing, leading and governing the programme-wide information management framework, ensuring the effective collection, control, integration, security and utilization of project information across all PMO functions.

The role will drive digital information management strategies, data governance, document management standards, information lifecycle processes and system integration across the programme to support efficient project delivery, regulatory compliance and informed decision-making.

The Senior Manager - Information Management will provide leadership in the implementation of information management best practices, digital transformation initiatives, enterprise data solutions and reporting systems while ensuring the integrity, accessibility and security of programme information assets

  

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Develop and implement the programme-wide Information Management Strategy aligned with PMO and client objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, policies and procedures for information management and data quality.
* Lead the development and management of information management systems, document management platforms and digital collaboration tools.
* Ensure effective integration and coordination between document control, project controls, scheduling, cost management, reporting and other PMIS platforms.
* Define and manage information lifecycle processes including creation, review, approval, storage, retrieval, retention and archiving.
* Oversee programme data governance and ensure consistency, accuracy and integrity of project information.
* Ensure compliance with information security requirements, cybersecurity standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support programme leadership with reliable reporting, dashboards, analytics and management information.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders, consultants, contractors and technology providers to ensure effective information management practices.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives related to information management and process optimization.
* Manage information management teams, document control specialists and technical support resources.
* Monitor information management performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Prepare executive reports, dashboards and recommendations for senior programme and client leadership.
* Promote a culture of data-driven decision-making and information excellence across the programme.

**EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in project controls, programme management or information management, including at least 5 years supporting digital transformation initiatives.
* Professional certification in one or more of the following:

\-        Microsoft Cloud Solutions

\-        Oracle Cloud Architect Professional

\-        Oracle Cloud Operations Associate

\-        Cisco Specialist - Enterprise Core

\-        International Cyber Security Institute (UK) Network Security Specialist

\-        Scrum Foundation Professional

\-        Equivalent relevant technical certifications

* Extensive experience implementing and managing information management frameworks on large-scale infrastructure, construction or programme management projects.
* Strong understanding of data governance, information architecture, records management and enterprise information systems.
* Experience with document management systems, common data environments (CDE), digital collaboration platforms and PMIS environments.
* Experience developing reporting solutions, dashboards and business intelligence tools including Power BI.
* Knowledge of information security standards, cyber resilience and data protection requirements.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams,  consultants and technology vendors.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to engage senior client representatives.
* Experienced user of Microsoft Office Suite and enterprise project management systems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

* Information Management Leadership
* Strategic Thinking
* Digital Transformation
* Data Governance
* Information Security Awareness
* Stakeholder Management
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Planning and Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Team Leadership
* Continuous Improvement
* Customer Focus

  

**KBR — Delivering Solutions, Changing the World.**

KBR brings together the best and brightest to deliver science, technology and engineering solutions that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most critical missions and objectives.

* **We Value Our People –** We create diverse, inclusive environments in which each person can feel safe, respected and valued, and where everyone has opportunities to grow and reach their full potential.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking an experienced, hands-on **Civil Engineer - Saudi National** to support the design validation, site execution, and quality assurance of large-scale infrastructure assets in **Tabuk, Saudi Arabia**. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing grading, earthworks, roads, and utilities, ensuring that heavy civil construction aligns perfectly with project master plans, strict design tolerances, and international engineering standards.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* **Site Supervision & Quality Control:** Oversee day-to-day heavy civil construction activities, including bulk earthworks, deep grading, road networks, and wet/dry utility installations, ensuring strict adherence to approved drawings and specifications.
    
* **Design Validation:** Review contractor shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements for structural and civil works, flagging constructability issues or design clashes early to avoid field delays.
    
* **Inspections & Sign-offs:** Conduct site inspections, witness compaction testing, and review concrete pouring preparations, authorizing structural and civil stage sign-offs alongside client representatives.
    
* **Progress & Variance Tracking:** Monitor contractor performance against the baseline schedule, verifying quantities of materials installed and reporting accurate field progress to the Resident Engineer.
    
* **Health, Safety & Environment (HSE):** Enforce rigid site safety and environmental guidelines, ensuring contractors maintain proper excavation safety, dust control, and logistical order in a demanding desert environment.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* **Experience:** Minimum of **7 years** of direct experience in civil engineering, with a solid background in mass earthworks, road networks, or large-scale site development.
    
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Engineering in any related field. .
    
* **Technical Expertise:** Comprehensive understanding of international civil engineering standards (e.g., ASTM, AASHTO, ACI codes). Proficiency in interpreting grading plans, utility profiles, and geotechnical reports.
    

## **What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* **Location/Adaptability:** Must be willing to relocate to and work full-time in the **Tabuk region**. Direct experience navigating the unique soil and logistical conditions of KSA giga-projects (such as NEOM, Trojena, or Red Sea Global) is heavily preferred.
    
* **Communication:** Strong technical English communication skills (written and verbal) are mandatory to interface effectively with contractors, surveyors, and project managers.

Parsons is looking for an amazing **Lifting Manager** with strong contractor experience as an Appointed Person (AP) to join our team! Manages and leads, all on-site field lifting operational activities from lifting plan preparation and method statements through to safe execution, works involve multiple contracts and programs.
