* Managing, leading, developing detailed plans and method statements, safe systems of work across all on-site construction activities in line with project objects, plans, specifications, and safety standards.
    
* Supervise lifting operators, riggers and signallers/banksmen ensure all pre-lift briefings are conducted and all crews involved understand lifting plans and their specific roles.
    
* Developing equipment inspection and selection processes and procedures, ensuring lifting plant/equipment, tools, and tackle have stringent inspection regimes and best practices, in place.
    
* Site coordination with site management and other trades to ensure lifting areas are clear, secured and safe.
    
* Coordinate with design teams, engineering, subcontractors, procurement, environment, safety, to ensure unnecessary lifting movements are ‘designed out’ through effective design principles for safe execution.
    
* Supervising multiple site teams and subcontractors, assigning work, monitoring progress, and making recommendations on lifting operations and any corrective actions.
    
* Leading site lifting inspections, safety audits, and quality checks to ensure compliance and resolve technical issues.
    
* Preparing detailed progress reports and presenting updates to senior management and clients.
    
* Promoting construction best practices, technical excellence, and client satisfaction across the project.
    
* Implementing and ensuring compliance with safety, QA/QC, and document control protocols.
    
* Representing Parsons in meetings with clients, authorities, and external stakeholders, with the ability to enhance and promote client relationships whilst remaining an ambassador for the company.
    
* Leading multi-disciplinary lifting assessments and lifting operation workshops to optimize project delivery.
    
* Ability to mentor and motivate construction team members/individuals through career guidance and or participation in company sponsored events/award initiatives
    
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

* Degree in Civil Engineer / NVQ Diploma level 7 or engineering related field
    
* Deep understanding of LOLER, PUWER and HASAWA; crane load charts, crane types, capabilities and limitations; rigging methods and structural stability
    
* Superior initiative, judgement, and ability required to assume the total leadership of a complete largescale program and /or multiple concurrent lifting operations across projects.
    
* Strong leadership in controlling and managing site lift operations, lifting teams, and subcontractors.
    
* Demonstrated experience working with PMCM and major contractors on complex, high-value projects.

* Excellent English, written and verbal communication skills with the ability to lead meetings and report effectively.
    
* Familiarity with industry standards, safety regulations, and quality assurance protocols.
    
* Experience in public meetings, regulatory coordination, or working with government clients.
    
* Candidate must be knowledgeable of current and future emerging technologies and how they can be effectively utilized on projects.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Road Network Engineer (ITS) – City Operations & Maintenance (Saudi National)** to join our team! In this role you will get to oversee the operational performance, safety, asset condition, and continuous traffic flow of a city-wide road network within a landmark giga-project. You will support Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic operations, road asset maintenance, event mobility, and smart-city integration to ensure highways, urban streets, and transit corridors operate safely and efficiently during daily operations and major events.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Oversee the day-to-day operational performance and condition of highways, urban roads, intersections, transit corridors, and associated road infrastructure.
    
* Monitor real-time traffic conditions using Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic management platforms, roadside sensors, CCTV, and traffic data feeds.
    
* Analyze traffic speeds, volumes, congestion levels, travel times, incidents, and network performance to identify operational issues.
    
* Monitor and optimize intelligent traffic signal operations and timing plans to improve traffic flow and reduce congestion.
    
* Coordinate with Traffic Management Centers (TMC), City Operations, Security, emergency services, and other stakeholders during incidents and network disruptions.
    
* Support rapid response to road accidents, vehicle breakdowns, obstructions, and other incidents affecting network availability.
    
* Develop and implement traffic management measures to maintain safe and efficient movement during planned and unplanned disruptions.
    
* Conduct regular technical inspections and condition assessments of roads, pavements, intersections, and associated infrastructure.
    
* Identify pavement defects including cracking, potholes, rutting, settlement, surface deterioration, and other asset condition issues.
    
* Develop and coordinate preventive and corrective road maintenance programs based on asset condition, operational priority, and lifecycle requirements.
    
* Support planning and delivery of pavement rehabilitation, resurfacing, road marking, and associated maintenance activities.
    
* Monitor the condition and maintenance of road barriers, guardrails, street lighting, stormwater drainage, road markings, signage, and associated roadside assets.
    
* Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize disruption to traffic and maintain safe access throughout the network.
    
* Monitor contractors performing road, ITS, and associated infrastructure maintenance and verify compliance with approved SLAs, KPIs, specifications, and safety requirements.
    
* Develop and review Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) plans for construction activities, maintenance works, concerts, sporting events, festivals, and other major events.
    
* Plan safe diversions, detours, temporary lane closures, traffic control arrangements, and alternative access routes.
    
* Coordinate event traffic strategies with parking, public transport, security, emergency response, venue operations, and mobility teams.
    
* Assess road network capacity against anticipated event demand and identify potential congestion points before major events.
    
* Coordinate road network operations with parking arrival and departure strategies to reduce queuing and congestion around major destinations.
    
* Analyze historical and real-time traffic telemetry to identify recurring congestion zones, network bottlenecks, and operational improvement opportunities.
    
* Support integration of roadside ITS devices, traffic signals, CCTV, Variable Message Signs (VMS), traffic detectors, and other smart mobility technologies.
    
* Coordinate integration of road and ITS systems with the central City Operations or Traffic Management platform.
    
* Support planning and operational readiness for connected, autonomous, and emerging mobility technologies where applicable.
    
* Develop and monitor network performance indicators covering traffic flow, congestion, incidents, asset condition, system availability, and maintenance performance.
    
* Maintain accurate road asset records, inspection findings, maintenance histories, incident logs, and operational data using GIS, CMMS, or asset management systems.
    
* Prepare technical reports, traffic assessments, dashboards, maintenance recommendations, and management presentations.
    
* Identify operational and asset-related risks and develop practical mitigation and improvement measures.
    
* Coordinate with Asset Management, Parking Operations, Public Transport, Facilities Management, ICT, Security, HSE, contractors, consultants, and technology vendors.
    
* Support emergency response, incident management, business continuity, and road network recovery activities.
    
* Promote road safety, asset reliability, smart mobility, and continuous improvement across City Operations.
    
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.
    

## What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Highway Engineering, Traffic Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
    
* Minimum **5+ years of experience** in road maintenance, highway engineering, traffic operations, ITS, transportation engineering, or related infrastructure operations.
    
* Minimum **2+ years of experience supporting giga-projects, major municipalities, smart cities, major destinations, or similarly complex urban environments.**
    
* Active membership/registration with the **Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE)**.
    
* Strong technical knowledge of road network operations, highway engineering, traffic management, and road asset maintenance.
    
* Strong understanding of **Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)** and their application to real-time traffic operations.
    
* Experience with:
    
* Traffic Management Systems
    
* Traffic signal control systems
    
* CCTV and incident detection
    
* Variable Message Signs (VMS)
    
* Traffic detectors and roadside sensors
    
* Traffic data and telemetry
    
* Smart traffic control technologies
    
* Strong understanding of traffic flow, road capacity, congestion management, intersection operations, and network performance.
    
* Experience developing or reviewing Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) plans, diversions, detours, and lane closure arrangements.
    
* Experience supporting major event traffic and transportation operations.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are recruiting for a highly experienced **Design Director** to join their team!

The **Design Director** is responsible for providing operational design leadership and assurance across city and district developments, representing the future operator, maintainer and asset owner throughout planning, design development, design reviews and asset delivery activities.  The role ensures operational requirements, maintainability considerations, logistical needs, support facilities and service delivery requirements are appropriately reflected within asset designs and associated development proposals.

Acting as the design authority for operability and maintainability, the Design Director provides independent review, challenge, assurance and recommendations across all assets that will require future operations, maintenance, management or service delivery. The position develops and maintains operational design requirements, coordinates stakeholder alignment, supports district and development teams, and manages specialist consultant activities relating to operational design assurance.

The role works closely with Development, Delivery, City Operations, Community Management, Asset Management, Utilities, Mobility, Security, Digital and other operational stakeholders to ensure assets are designed for safe, efficient and sustainable operation throughout their lifecycle. The position also coordinates operational aspects of asset handover activities with City Asset Management to facilitate a smooth transition from development into operations.

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Lead operational design reviews of city and district assets to assess operability, maintainability, functionality and long-term serviceability.
* Review asset designs throughout planning, concept, schematic, detailed design and pre-handover stages.
* Challenge design proposals to ensure assets can be safely, efficiently and sustainably operated and maintained.
* Assess asset layouts, operational functionality, maintenance strategies and service delivery requirements.
* Identify operational risks, maintenance constraints, accessibility challenges and service delivery issues that may impact future operations.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations to improve asset operability, maintainability and operational performance.

* Ensure operational facilities are appropriately located to maximize efficiency, accessibility and service performance.
* Review space planning requirements associated with operational support activities and future city growth.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to validate operational assumptions and facility utilization requirements.
* Identify opportunities to optimize operational infrastructure and support facilities.
* Ensure asset support facilities align with long-term operating models and maintenance requirements.
* Review and provide assurance on operational logistics requirements associated with city and district assets.

* Review emergency access provisions and operational resilience considerations.

* Support resolution of design issues through structured review, analysis and stakeholder engagement.

* Review consultant reports, technical studies, assessments and recommendations.
* Ensure consultant outputs align with operational objectives and requirements.

* Challenge recommendations to ensure practical, efficient and sustainable operational outcomes.

* Identify opportunities to improve asset performance, maintainability and operational efficiency through design optimization.
* Support capability development through guidance, coaching and stakeholder engagement.
* Promote evidence-based decision making through robust analysis and transparent reporting.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Facilities Management, Asset Management, Urban Planning, Building Sciences, Construction Management or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is desirable.
* Chartered, licensed or professionally accredited status with a recognized professional institution is preferred.
* Additional qualifications relating to facilities management, asset management, operational readiness or infrastructure planning are advantageous.

* Experience developing operational requirements, design standards and assurance processes.

* Experience coordinating development, operations, asset management and delivery stakeholders.
* Experience managing consultants, technical advisors and specialist studies.

* Operability and maintainability reviews.

* Facilities planning and operational infrastructure assessment.
* Operational logistics and accessibility planning.
* Asset handover coordination.
* Stakeholder engagement and cross-functional integration.
* Consultant management and technical assurance.
* Operational readiness planning.
* Whole-life asset performance considerations.

**Desirable Skills You'll Bring;**

* Operational design assurance.
* Facilities planning and operational readiness.
* Estate management and city operations.
* Asset management and lifecycle optimization.
* Infrastructure operations and service delivery planning.
* Master-planned developments and large-scale destinations.

You will support the integration of intelligent parking technologies, traffic operations, event mobility, asset maintenance, EV infrastructure, and data-driven optimization to ensure safe, efficient, and seamless parking operations across the development.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Support operational planning for peak periods, special events, emergency scenarios, and high-volume traffic conditions.

* Monitor multi-modal interfaces between parking facilities, pedestrian routes, public transport, shuttle services, ride-hailing, taxis, and other mobility services.
    
* Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for parking systems, automated equipment, car lifts, barriers, payment equipment, and associated mechanical systems.

* Prepare technical reports, operational assessments, recommendations, presentations, and management updates.

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Traffic Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

* Strong technical knowledge of smart parking and automated parking management systems.
    
* Experience with:
    
* Parking Guidance Systems (PGS)
    
* License Plate Recognition (LPR/ANPR)
    
* Automated barriers and access control
    
* Digital payment systems
    
* Parking sensors and occupancy monitoring
    
* Variable Message Signs and digital wayfinding
    
* EV charging infrastructure
    
* Strong understanding of traffic circulation, parking operations, ingress and egress management, queuing, and capacity management.
    
* Experience analyzing parking demand, occupancy, utilization, vehicle movements, and traffic performance data.
    
* Experience managing parking and traffic operations during high-demand periods and major events.
    
* Understanding of multi-modal mobility interfaces, including public transport, shuttle operations, taxis, ride-hailing, pedestrian movements, and other transport modes.
    
* Experience coordinating preventive and corrective maintenance of parking assets and associated systems.
    
* Knowledge of parking facility inspection, asset condition assessment, and lifecycle management principles.
    
* Familiarity with traffic simulation tools, GIS platforms, CMMS/asset management systems, and digital reporting tools.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational and asset performance data.
    
* Ability to identify operational risks and implement practical mitigation measures.
    
* Strong understanding of safety requirements associated with parking structures, traffic operations, pedestrians, and major events.
    
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    
* Strong stakeholder, contractor, and vendor coordination capabilities.
    
* Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure environments involving significant traffic and event demands.
    

## What Desired Skills You'll Bring

* Advanced knowledge of GIS-based mobility and asset management applications.
    
* Experience developing parking strategies for stadiums, entertainment venues, major events, or high-volume visitor destinations.

* Experience with EV charging network planning, operations, and asset management.

* Experience managing contractors and technology vendors against SLAs, KPIs, and asset performance requirements.
    
* Knowledge of preventive maintenance, asset lifecycle planning, reliability, and operational readiness principles.

* Experience working within Delivery Partner, PMC, client-side, or large program environments.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an experienced **ICT Lead** **\- Aviation, ATCT - Saudi National** to plan, coordinate, review, and technically support the ICT systems Passive and active networks for serving the ATCT and associated external areas, ensuring the systems are fit for operational use, integrated with other airport platforms, secure, resilient, maintainable, and compliant with project and authority requirements.

You will act as the focal technical engineer for all tower-related ICT systems during design, construction, testing and commissioning, handover, and early operations support. Ensuring the ATCT communication and data infrastructure is delivered to a mission-critical standard suitable for air navigation and airport operational environments. Supporting interdisciplinary coordination among ICT, ELV, electrical, mechanical, architectural, security, ATC systems, and airport operations stakeholders.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Review design documents, drawings, method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, interface matrices, and technical submissions related to ATCT ICT systems.
* Coordinate the delivery of structured cabling systems, fiber backbone, LAN/WAN connectivity, network rooms, cabinets/racks, switches/ servers configuration, network architecture, wireless services, timing/synchronization interfaces, IP telephony, operator work position data connectivity, and associated passive infrastructure.
* Monitor integration requirements between ICT systems and other airport/tower systems such as access control, CCTV, public address, voice communication systems, meteorological systems, BMS, fire alarm, UPS monitoring, and security platforms where applicable.
* Participate in technical reviews to ensure compliance with client standards, aviation authority criteria, cyber-security requirements, redundancy philosophy, maintainability needs, and operational constraints of a 24/7 critical facility.
* Review testing and commissioning procedures including FAT, SAT, pre-commissioning, integrated systems testing, cutover plans, failover testing, redundancy verification, and operational readiness demonstrations.
* Support site inspections and verify that installation quality, labeling, segregation, grounding/bonding, containment, equipment placement, and as-built records meet approved standards.
* Track design and construction risks, identify interface gaps, issue technical comments, and follow up corrective actions to closure.
* Contribute to the development and review of ICT O&M manuals, SOPs, asset registers, preventive maintenance requirements, spare parts lists, training plans, and handover dossiers.
* Coordinate with stakeholders including airport operator, ATC users, digital/cyber-security teams, consultants, contractors, and authority representatives.
* Prepare technical reports, progress updates, issue logs, and engineering recommendations for management decision-making.
* Structured cabling system (copper and fiber optic backbone/distribution).
* Local area network, switching infrastructure & configuration, network cabinets, patching, and network architecture, integration, cybersecurity and physical layer management.
* ATCT data connectivity for operational systems and operator positions.
* IP telephony / voice and data interfaces supporting tower operations.
* Wireless access services where approved for operational or administrative zones.
* Server room / telecom room fit-out interfaces, racks, UPS-fed ICT loads, environmental monitoring, and cable management.
* External ICT links serving guard post, security checkpoint, perimeter/fence interfaces, parking/ancillary facilities, and inter-building communications, as applicable within the project scope.
* Integration touchpoints with security, ELV, and digital airport platforms.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring;

* Bachelor’s degree in ICT Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics / Communications Engineering.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in ICT engineering, preferably within airports, air navigation facilities, transportation, mission-critical buildings, or other high-availability infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience in design review, site supervision, testing and commissioning, and handover of ICT systems.
* Good knowledge of structured cabling, fiber systems, IP-based networks, telecom rooms, redundancy concepts, and interface management.
* Airport, aviation, or critical-facility project experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience of active and passive network infrastructure, fiber optic systems, LAN/WAN architecture, rack layout, patching, and network resilience concepts, network architecture.
* Knowledge of ICT installation practices, containment coordination, grounding/bonding interfaces, room data layouts, and equipment accommodation requirements.
* Working knowledge of testing tools and practices for copper/fiber certification and network connectivity validation.
* Awareness of cyber-security coordination requirements for operational technology and airport systems environments.
* Ability to interpret project specifications, standards, interface control documents, risk registers, and testing protocols.

Parsons are looking for an incredibly talented **Director of Systems & Rolling Stock** to join their team.

As the Director of Systems & Rolling Stock, you will provide the technical vision, engineering leadership, and governance required to deliver a world-class, fully automated (GoA4) driverless rail system. Operating client-side within a highly dynamic, developer-led environment, you will bridge the gap between master planning, and core rail systems.

A critical part of your mandate is managing technical consultants, ensuring internal governance framework compliance, and managing alignment with interfacing developers.

* **Innovation & Future-Proofing:** Ensure the system leverages modern, reliable automated rail technologies optimized for the unique environmental conditions of Saudi Arabia.
* **Consultant Oversight:** Act as the primary client interface managing international engineering consultants, Project Management Officers (PMOs), and specialized shadow operators. Hold partners accountable to strict deliverables, quality, and timelines.
* **Internal Governance:** Establish and execute technical review gateways, safety assurance protocols (RAMS), and configuration control boards. Ensure all systems engineering processes comply with international standards and local regulations.
* **Risk & Value Engineering:** Identify technical risks early and implement mitigation strategies. Run rigorous value engineering exercises to optimize capital expenditure without compromising safety, capacity, or performance.
* **Stakeholder Integration:** Coordinate directly with internal and external real estate development teams to align the rail system's alignment, station footprints, and utility corridors with adjacent mixed-use developments.
* **Commercial Mindset:** Navigate a developer-led environment by understanding how delivery timelines, construction phasing, and rail boundaries impact the broader commercial master plan.
* **Conflict Resolution:** Resolve complex technical interface conflicts between transit systems and real estate assets, protecting the rail system’s operational performance while facilitating developer progress.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 20 years of experience in major rail infrastructure projects, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role operating client-side or within a major project management consultancy.
* **Technical Expertise:** Proven track record of delivering fully automated, driverless rail transit systems (GoA4 / CBTC). Deep technical understanding of rolling stock procurement, systems integration, and automated depot operations is essential.
* **Developer Environment:** Demonstrated experience working within developer-led, giga-project, or complex multi-stakeholder real estate environments.
* **Consultant Management:** Mastered the art of directing and evaluating Tier 1 international engineering and design consultants.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering. A Master’s degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., Chartered Engineer, PMP) is highly advantageous.
* **Regional Knowledge:** Experience navigating the regulatory landscape, environmental challenges, and supply chain dynamics of Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region is preferred.

* Review road design drawings, specifications, profiles, sections, details, and construction requirements.
    
* Coordinate road design interfaces with utilities, drainage, structures, pavements, lighting, landscaping, and other infrastructure works.
    
* Monitor roadwork activities against approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project requirements.
    
* Coordinate construction sequencing for earthworks, subgrade, capping, sub-base, base course, asphalt, kerbs, footpaths, and associated works.

* Monitor roadwork progress and coordinate with Planning teams to ensure activities remain aligned with the approved schedule.

* Coordinate resolution of RFIs, Technical Queries, design clarifications, and site issues related to roads.

* Coordinate road crossings, utility corridors, drainage crossings, and interfaces with existing infrastructure.
    
* Support review of contractor roadwork method statements and construction proposals.
    
* Coordinate with QA/QC teams to ensure required inspections and testing are completed.
    
* Monitor testing requirements for subgrade, fill, compaction, aggregate, asphalt, and pavement layers.
    
* Coordinate material approvals and ensure approved materials are available for construction.
    
* Support investigation and resolution of roadwork defects, settlement, soft spots, pavement failures, and other construction issues.

* Maintain roadwork interface registers, action trackers, and coordination records.
    
* Participate in technical coordination meetings, construction meetings, progress meetings, and site inspections.
    
* Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors to ensure work fronts are properly planned and managed.

* Coordinate interfaces between airport roads and airfield infrastructure including taxiways, aprons, gates, and operational areas.
    
* Ensure road construction activities consider airport operational constraints, access requirements, and phased construction.
    
* Coordinate roadworks with drainage, utilities, street lighting, traffic systems, signage, barriers, and security infrastructure.
    
* Support coordination of roads within restricted and operational airport environments.
    
* Coordinate temporary and permanent access arrangements required for construction activities.
    
* Support roadwork coordination for major infrastructure and external development packages.

* Earthworks & Grading
    
* Subgrade Preparation
    
* Capping Layers
    
* Sub-base & Base Course
    
* Asphalt Pavements
    
* Kerbs & Edging
    
* Footpaths & Hardstanding
    
* Road Drainage
    
* Road Crossings
    
* Road Markings
    
* Traffic Signs
    
* Road Furniture
    
* Street Lighting Interfaces
    
* Utility Crossings

* Good understanding of road construction methods, pavement systems, earthworks, drainage, and utilities.
    
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary roadwork interfaces.
    
* Ability to read and interpret road design drawings, profiles, cross-sections, specifications, and construction details.
    
* Experience with roadwork inspections, testing, and quality requirements.
    
* Good understanding of construction sequencing and project schedules.
    
* Experience working with Contractors, Consultants, Client representatives, and multidisciplinary teams.
    
* Knowledge of relevant road and pavement standards and specifications.
    
* Proficiency in MS Office and relevant engineering / project management systems.
    
* Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Commercial Manager** to join our team! In this role you will get to support the FIDIC Engineer in administering commercial and contractual matters in accordance with the applicable FIDIC Design and Build contracts.

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Contract and Commercial Administration
    * Support the FIDIC Engineer in the administration and management of infrastructure contracts in accordance with the applicable FIDIC Conditions of Contract.
    * Interpret and apply contractual requirements relating to measurement, valuation, payment, variations, extensions of time, claims, notices, and commercial correspondence.
    * Maintain a detailed understanding of contract obligations, entitlements, risks, and commercial procedures.
    * Review Contractor submissions and assess compliance with contractual and procedural requirements.
    * Prepare and maintain commercial records, registers, trackers, and supporting documentation.
    * Ensure that all commercial decisions and recommendations are properly documented, supported by evidence, and aligned with the Contract and Client requirements.
    * Provide guidance to project teams on contractual and commercial matters.
* ### Measurement and Valuation
    
    * Review and verify Contractor measurements, quantities, applications for payment, and supporting records.
    * Undertake independent measurement and valuation of completed works, materials on site, approved changes, provisional sums, and other contractual entitlements.
    * Assess the value of works executed against the approved scope, drawings, specifications, Bills of Quantities, and contract rates.
    * Ensure that valuation methodologies are consistently applied across the portfolio of contracts.
    * Identify discrepancies, omissions, duplicate claims, unsupported quantities, and potential overpayments.
    * Support the preparation of interim and final account assessments.
* ### Payment Certification
    
    * Review Contractor applications for interim payment and provide recommendations to the FIDIC Engineer.
    * Verify progress, quantities, approved variations, retention, advance payment recovery, liquidated damages, deductions, and other applicable adjustments.
    * Prepare payment assessment documentation and supporting commercial evaluations.
    * Assist with the timely issuance of payment certificates in accordance with the Contract.
    * Coordinate with Project Controls, Finance, and relevant technical disciplines to validate progress and payment information.
    * Monitor payment status and identify potential commercial and cash-flow risks.
* ### Change and Variation Management
    
    * Administer the change control process in accordance with contractual requirements and project procedures.
    * Review and evaluate Contractor notices, quotations, proposals, and claims relating to changes and variations.
    * Prepare independent cost estimates and assess the financial impact of proposed changes.
    * Evaluate changes based on scope, drawings, specifications, rates, resources, quantities, time implications, and applicable contractual provisions.
    * Maintain variation and change registers, including status, value, approval authority, and potential cost exposure.
    * Ensure that changes are properly instructed, evaluated, approved, recorded, and incorporated into the contract value.
    * Support the FIDIC Engineer in resolving commercial issues and negotiating fair and reasonable outcomes.
* ### Claims and Dispute Support
    
    * Assist with the review and assessment of Contractor claims, including claims relating to variations, delay, disruption, extensions of time, loss and expense, and other contractual entitlements.

* Experience in PMO or client-side roles on large-scale or megaprojects is preferred.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strong knowledge of Testing & Commissioning processes across multi-disciplinary infrastructure systems.
* Proven experience in handover management, close-out documentation, and stakeholder coordination.
* Ability to manage complex interfaces between utilities, ITS, and civil infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GIS/asset management systems and digital handover requirements.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities across a program environment.

**Job Description:**

The Senior Project Manager: Technical – Rail Systems is a senior, client‑facing role embedded within an integrated client–PMC office on a major transportation program with a heavy focus on rail (metro, heavy rail, light rail, high‑speed). This is a non‑operational position focused on managing and assuring the rail systems technical scope across the design and build lifecycle on behalf of the client, rather than operating or maintaining the railway.

Sitting within the Engineering & Safety function, the role provides technical leadership, design governance, systems integration oversight, and safety‑by‑design assurance for all rail systems packages. Typical systems include signalling and train control, telecoms, SCADA, platform systems, fare collection, security, and line‑wide systems. The position ensures that consultants, contractors, and integrators deliver safe, compliant, interoperable, and constructible solutions that meet employer’s requirements, rail standards, and regulatory expectations.

## Key Responsibilities

### 1\. Client Representation & Governance (Integrated Office)

* Act as the primary technical focal point for rail systems within the integrated client office.
* Represent the client in technical, design, integration, and risk meetings with consultants, contractors, systems integrators, independent reviewers, and authorities.
* Interpret, communicate, and safeguard employer’s requirements, system performance specifications, and technical standards for rail systems.
* Provide independent, objective advice and recommendations to client leadership on rail systems issues, risks, and impacts on scope, time, cost, and safety.

### 2\. Rail Systems Design Management & Technical Assurance

* Manage and oversee the rail systems design lifecycle (concept, preliminary, detailed design) for:
    
    * Signalling and train control
    * Telecoms (radio, CCTV, PABX, passenger information, data networks)
    * Control systems and SCADA
    * Platform systems (platform screen doors, edge doors, interface with signalling)
    * Automatic fare collection and ticketing systems
    * Security systems (access control, intrusion detection, public address)
    * Other line‑wide systems as applicable
    
* Review and challenge system design reports, drawings, architectures, software/hardware specifications, and interface control documents for compliance with:
    
    * Employer’s requirements and performance criteria
    * Local regulations and authority requirements
    * Relevant international and industry standards
    
* Chair or lead multi‑discipline rail systems design reviews and value engineering workshops to drive safe, robust, and cost‑effective solutions.
* Ensure requirements management and traceability for rail systems from capture through verification, validation, and close‑out.
* Oversee implementation of the technical assurance framework for rail systems, including formal design verification, independent safety assessments, and configuration control.

### 3\. Systems Integration & Interfaces

* Oversee, from a PMC perspective, the integration of rail systems with:
    
    * Track and rolling stock (train control, braking curves, speed profiles, headways)
    * Power supply and traction power systems
    * Stations and depots (room layouts, cable routes, equipment spaces, MEP interfaces)
    * Central control centres and back‑office systems
    
* Manage interface registers and interface control documents for rail systems; ensure early identification and resolution of cross‑system and cross‑contract issues.
* Support integrated system architecture development and ensure that all systems are compatible, scalable, and support operational concepts (normal, degraded, and emergency operations).
* Coordinate closely with civil, MEP, and architecture teams to ensure physical and environmental requirements for rail systems equipment are embedded in designs.

### 4\. Safety, RAMS & Regulatory Compliance (Non‑Operational)

* Embed safety by design principles across all rail systems and support demonstration of system safety and availability targets.
* Review and monitor rail systems RAMS documentation, including safety cases, hazard logs, risk assessments, FMEAs and FTA.
* Coordinate with the Engineering & Safety function, independent safety assessors and regulators/authorities on safety approval processes and evidence.
* Ensure that required safety approvals, certifications, and licenses for rail systems are planned, tracked, and obtained in line with project milestones.
* Support the definition and implementation of cybersecurity requirements and processes for safety‑critical and business‑critical rail systems.

### 5\. Design–Build Coordination & Construction Support

* Ensure rail systems designs are aligned with construction methodologies, phasing, and access constraints; identify constructability and installation risks early.
* Review contractors’ installation strategies, cable routing plans, equipment room layouts, and temporary works arrangements from a technical and safety standpoint.
* Support the client in evaluating and approving rail systems design changes, technical deviations, and value engineering proposals, including impact assessments on safety, performance, and interfaces.
* Provide senior technical input on RFIs, non‑conformance reports, and site technical queries related to rail systems.
* Oversee quality of as‑built documentation and verify alignment with approved designs and technical requirements.

### 6\. Testing, Commissioning & System Acceptance (Technical Oversight)

* Review testing and commissioning strategies, plans, and procedures for rail systems, including:
    
    * Factory acceptance tests
    * Site acceptance tests
    * Static and dynamic tests
    * Integration tests and trial running
    
* Monitor execution of testing and commissioning via reports and selective site attendance; assess readiness for key milestones (trial operations, safety certification).
* Evaluate test results, defects, and trends; ensure robust defect management and re‑testing strategies are implemented.
* Support the client in formal acceptance processes and performance demonstrations; confirm that rail systems meet functional, safety, and performance requirements before handover.
* Coordinate with Operations & Maintenance teams to ensure systems are operable, maintainable, and aligned with long‑term asset management strategies.

### 7\. Program, Cost & Technical Risk Management

* Monitor progress of rail systems design, procurement, installation, and commissioning activities against the integrated master program.
* Identify schedule‑critical dependencies such as power‑on dates, track access, and integration windows; propose mitigation and recovery plans where required.
* Support project controls and commercial teams with technical input for changes, claims, and variations related to rail systems.
* Maintain and update rail systems technical risk registers, including assessment of likelihood, impact, and mitigation strategies.
* Provide clear, concise technical, risk, and status reports for client governance and steering committees.

### 8\. Stakeholder, Authority & Third‑Party Coordination

* Coordinate with internal client stakeholders to ensure rail systems support operational concepts and customer service objectives.
* Interface with regulators, transport authorities, telecom and power providers, and other third parties involved in approvals, licenses, and interconnections.
* Support engagement with adjacent projects, developers, and other infrastructure owners where interdependencies exist

### 9\. Leadership, Team & Quality Management

* Lead and mentor a team of rail systems engineers and technical specialists within the integrated client–PMC environment.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical excellence, collaboration, and proactive risk management.
* Ensure robust QA/QC processes for rail systems design and construction deliverables, including systematic reviews, audits, and technical checkpoints.
* Capture, document, and disseminate lessons learned on rail systems design, integration, commissioning, and safety assurance across the program.

## Qualifications

### Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Control/Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in Railway Systems, Transportation Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Project Management is an advantage.
* Professional registration/chartership (CEng, PE, equivalent) is highly desirable.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

### Experience

* Typically 15\+ years’ experience in rail systems engineering on major rail/metro/light rail/high‑speed rail projects.
* Substantial experience in a PMC, client, or major consultancy role managing rail systems scope on design and build contracts.
* Proven track record in rail systems design management, systems integration, and technical assurance on complex, multi‑contract programs.
* Demonstrable experience with signalling/train control
* Experience working within integrated client/PMC teams and coordinating with multiple contractors, consultants, and OEMs is highly advantageous.

## Skills & Competencies

* Deep technical understanding of rail systems architectures, technologies, and standards.
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering, integration, and RAMS principles,
* Excellent project management, planning, and coordination skills in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a structured approach to technical and program risk management.
* Highly effective communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to non‑technical stakeholders.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and client‑service orientation.
* Proficiency with standard office and project tools; familiarity with requirements management tools, modelling/simulation tools, platforms, and document control systems is an advantage.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken); Arabic ideal.

Parsons is looking for an experienced lead to take on **The Engineer** role. In this position, you will act as The Engineer under the applicable FIDIC contract conditions and provide professional leadership across the Master Development Unit Projects portfolio.  You will be responsible for administering the contract fairly and effectively, ensuring that all works are delivered in accordance with the contractual, technical, quality, schedule, cost and performance requirements under the Delivery Partner agreement. * Administer FIDIC-based contracts, including the Red, Yellow and Silver Books, together with project-specific amendments and Particular Conditions.
* Provide impartial and timely contract administration throughout the design and construction lifecycle.
* Ensure the Employer’s and Contractor’s obligations are clearly defined, monitored and effectively managed.
* Review and issue contractual notices, instructions, determinations, certifications and other contract communications.
* Coordinate the review and approval of Contractor submissions, including design deliverables, construction methodologies, programmes, work plans and technical proposals.
* Monitor the Contractor’s performance against contractual, technical, quality, safety, environmental, schedule and cost requirements.
* Oversee the administration and evaluation of variations, extensions of time, acceleration proposals, delays, disruption, suspension and other changes.
* Assess and determine Contractor claims and Employer entitlements in accordance with the contract.
* Lead the preparation of contractual position papers, delay and disruption assessments, entitlement reviews and supporting recommendations.
* Review and certify interim payment applications, progress valuations, retention releases, advances, deductions and final accounts.
* Ensure that payment certifications are supported by accurate progress measurement, approved records and appropriate contractual substantiation.
* Implement controls to prevent overpayment, unsupported claims, unauthorized commitments and non-compliant changes.
* Coordinate with Project Controls, Commercial, Design, Construction, Quality and Document Control teams to align contractual, schedule, cost, risk and technical information.
* Monitor the status of design development, construction coordination, approvals, interfaces and project deliverables.
* Maintain effective records of instructions, notices, approvals, determinations, claims, variations, payments and other contractual matters.
* Oversee the contract risk register and ensure that emerging contractual, commercial, technical and delivery risks are identified and addressed.
* Support the resolution of disputes through negotiation, escalation, dispute avoidance and formal dispute resolution procedures where required.
* Participate in progress meetings, executive reviews, governance boards, steering committees and coordination workshops.
* Serve as the senior contractual and technical point of contact for the Client, Delivery Partner, Contractors, consultants and key stakeholders.
* Promote compliance with applicable laws, regulations, Client procedures, quality standards and professional codes of conduct.
* Lead, mentor and develop a multidisciplinary Engineer’s team, fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Support contract close-out, including completion certification, defects management, final account settlement, release of securities and archiving of project records.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Law or a related discipline.
* 15 years of progressive experience in the administration and delivery of major construction, infrastructure or mixed-use development projects.
* Extensive experience working as an Engineer, Project Manager, Resident Engineer, PMC representative, Delivery Partner representative or senior consultant.
* Strong experience administering FIDIC-based contracts in a Client, Engineer, PMC, Delivery Partner or consultancy environment.
* Deep knowledge of FIDIC contract forms, including the Red, Yellow and Silver Books, associated conditions of contract and bespoke amendments.
* Proven experience in contract administration, variations, claims, extensions of time, delay analysis, disruption, payment certification and final accounts.
* Demonstrated ability to make fair, reasoned and contractually compliant assessments and determinations.
* Strong understanding of design management, construction supervision, technical compliance, quality assurance and project delivery processes.
* Good knowledge of project controls, including programme, cost, risk, change and performance management.
* Experience reviewing and coordinating technical submissions, design deliverables, method statements, inspection records and project documentation.
* Strong negotiation, communication, report-writing and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing multidisciplinary project teams.
* High standards of integrity, impartiality, confidentiality and professional judgement.
* Proficiency in contract management systems, document control platforms, Microsoft Office and project reporting tools.
* Professional registration, chartership or relevant FIDIC training/certification is preferred.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Survey Manager** to join our team!

### **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Develop survey plans, control networks, and reporting frameworks aligned with client and project requirements.
    
* Ensure integration of survey data with design, construction, and operational workflows.

* Ensure survey deliverables meet aviation standards, contractual requirements, and stakeholder expectations.
    

* Ensure accurate processing, validation, and delivery of survey data to design, engineering, and construction teams.

* Conduct QA/QC audits of survey data and procedures.

* Introduce digital tools and automated processes to enhance survey accuracy, efficiency, and integration.
    
* Support BIM and digital twin initiatives with accurate geospatial data.
    

* Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary survey team, fostering technical excellence and collaboration.
    
* Conduct performance evaluations and support professional development, certifications, and training.
    
* Promote a culture of precision, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Expert-level proficiency with survey instruments, GNSS/GPS, total stations, LiDAR, UAVs, and GIS software.
    
* Solid understanding of airport construction sequencing, airfield design standards, and aviation safety requirements.
    
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
    
* Knowledge of surveying quality standards, calibration protocols, and data validation techniques.
    

### **What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Professional certifications: RICS, CPEng, or equivalent.
    
* Experience with BIM, 3D modeling, and digital surveying platforms.
    
* Knowledge of FIDIC or similar contract standards in construction projects.
    
* Ability to thrive in high-pressure, fast-paced, multi-stakeholder airport programs.

Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

  


Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

  


**Job Summary**

The Transformational Partnership Manager plays an important role within MGB International. This role will be a key member of the initial team that helps structure, launch, and execute MGB's recently developed Transformational Partnership strategy – executing deep, longitudinal (10+ year) partnerships with international partners to bring the best of MGB to transform local healthcare delivery systems across care delivery, education, and research. This strategy will further radiate MGB's mission globally and deliver sustained financial results for MGB and its international partners. The TP Manager is accountable across three core pillars: (1) Transformational Partnership Execution, (2) TP Product Development and (3) Team Leadership. This role sits at the critical intersection of MGB and client teams, organizing and leading day-to-day operations to ensure the Transformational Partnership runs smoothly. International travel and direct engagement with clients in culturally nuanced, complex environments are core expectations of this role.  
  
Essential Functions  
  
\-Independently structures complex, ambiguous problems into discrete workstreams, key questions, and analytical plans that guide team execution.  
  
\-Ensures analytical rigor across all workstreams, including defining key metrics, overseeing data collection, and validating outputs and assumptions.  
  
\-Leads end-to-end project management of a Transformational Partnership from scoping through implementation planning, including leading junior team members and upward management of leaders and SMEs (including structuring workstreams, timelines, approaches, and deliverables).  
  
\-Oversees the work of MGB and client Finance analysts responsible for establishing the financial baseline and expected impact of TP over time, which informs partnership deal structure and MGB economics.  
  
\-Leverages growing subject matter expertise to make meaningful contributions to client and internal stakeholder discussions; insights demonstrate strategic thinking and a keen understanding of more complex concepts.  
  
\-Serves as a key bridge supporting the onboarding of operational leaders and teams as TP shifts from the planning to the operations phase.  
  
\-Supports the TP Lead and team as needed with ad hoc analysis and strategic problem-solving to ensure MGB and partner goals and objectives are met when structuring Transformational Partnerships.  
  
\-Work closely with the TP Lead and broader MGBI leadership to establish a high-quality, repeatable process for sourcing, structuring, contracting, and executing international Transformational Partnerships, grounded in Transformation best practices.  
  
\-Assess resource needs for each TP opportunity and work with the TP Lead and MGBI leadership to ensure that resource availability and expertise align with those needs.  
  
\-Serve as the primary point of contact on the ground to gather client and MGB stakeholder feedback on MGB’s TP product offering and update the approach iteratively.  
  
\-Ensure disciplined adherence to institutional policies, procedures, and governance standards when deploying the TP product offering.  
  
\-Forms strong relationships with client partners to strengthen the MGB partner collaboration model and ensure smooth TP delivery.  
  
\-Leverages strong client/stakeholder management skills to anticipate, surface, and resolve potential areas of tension or misalignment (internal or external) during TP delivery.  
  
\-Illustrates developing leadership capabilities, modeling inclusive, accountable, and mission-driven leadership to cultivate a collaborative, high-performing team.

  


**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in related field of study required
* Master's Degree Related Field of Study preferred
* Equivalent experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree

  
**Experience**

* 3+ years of experience preferred at a top-tier management consulting firm strongly preferred
* 3+ years of experience preferred working within or with a health system / provider setting

  
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Familiarity with Transformation programs and previously worked as an Engagement Manager or Senior Associate on multi-year Transformation project(s).
* Deep experience leading a team or workstream for a Transformation program focused on delivering financial results in a value creation or turnaround scenario.
* Deep understanding of value drivers for hospital/health system Transformation programs and demonstrated track record deploying a playbook to realize this value.
* Demonstrated experience in core consulting skillsets, including structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, financial modeling, and executive-level communication.
* Proven ability to translate complex analysis into clear, concise, and compelling executive-ready materials and recommendations.
* Prior experience operating within a large, matrixed healthcare organization.
* Demonstrated ability to build consensus and drive results through influence rather than direct authority.
* Superior interpersonal and communication skills – written and verbal –with the ability to build rapport with stakeholders.

  

**Working Schedule Requirements:**

* Ability to travel internationally frequently, approximately 20% travel required.
* Based in Boston area and must be willing to travel to Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, and MGB main campus in Boston, as well as other international travel to client sites as needed.

  


**Additional Job Details (if applicable)**

  


**Remote Type**

Hybrid

  


**Work Location**

399 Revolution Drive

  


**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

  


**Employee Type**

Regular

  


**Work Shift**

Day (United States of America)

  
  


**Pay Range**

$200,000.00 - $275,000.00/Annual

  


**Grade**

91

  


At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857)-282-7642.

  


## **Mass General Brigham Competency Framework**

At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

Mass General Brigham is a passionate, welcoming community where minds meet caring hearts.

  
Come be a part of the world’s most powerful force in medicine, where every role is important in changing lives. Are you ready?

  

Our history includes New England hospitals founded over 200 years ago, some of the first and most prestigious hospitals in the world.

  
Built on the legacy of two leading academic medical centers, we’re more than a system—we’re leaders in the practice of medicine. Mass General Brigham is committed to serving the community.

  
We are dedicated to enhancing patient care, teaching and research, and taking a leadership role as an integrated health care system.

## **JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Working at Abbott**  
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**  
This position is based in our Jeddah location within Abbott Nutrition International (ANI).

**Divisional Information**  
Abbott Nutrition International (ANI)

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, Glucerna® and ZonePerfect® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

  

**Purpose of the Role**

The E-Commerce & Omni-Channel Development Lead is responsible for accelerating the growth of Abbott Nutrition's digital commerce business by developing and executing e-commerce and omni-channel strategies across key customers, marketplaces, pharmacy chains, quick commerce platforms, and direct-to-consumer touchpoints.

The role will drive sustainable growth of Abbott's Nutrition portfolio by enhancing digital shelf excellence, improving online shopper engagement, optimizing customer journeys, and creating seamless omni-channel experiences that support both healthcare professional recommendations and consumer purchasing behavior.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, and Digital teams, the role ensures Abbott Nutrition brands are effectively represented and activated across all digital channels while maintaining compliance with company and healthcare regulations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**E-Commerce Strategy & Growth**

* Develop and execute Abbott Nutrition's e-commerce and omni-channel growth strategy in line with business objectives.
* Deliver annual sales, market share, and profitability targets across digital channels.
* Identify growth opportunities across pure-play e-commerce, pharmacy e-commerce, marketplaces, quick commerce, and omni-retail customers.
* Build joint business plans with key e-commerce partners to accelerate category and brand growth.

  

**Omni-Channel Development**

* Lead the development of seamless consumer and shopper experiences across online and offline channels.
* Drive omni-channel initiatives that connect healthcare professional engagement, retail activation, pharmacy recommendations, and digital conversion.
* Partner with customer teams to develop integrated online-to-offline activation plans.
* Support implementation of innovative digital solutions that improve customer engagement and purchasing convenience.

  

**Digital Shelf Excellence**

* Ensure best-in-class product content across all digital platforms.
* Improve product discoverability through search optimization, category placement, content enhancement, and digital merchandising.
* Monitor digital shelf KPIs including:
    * Availability
    * Content compliance
    * Search rankings
    * Ratings & reviews
    * Share of search
* Establish governance and execution standards across all e-commerce partners.

  

**Shopper Marketing & Consumer Engagement**

* Collaborate with Marketing and Trade Marketing teams to develop digital-first activation plans.
* Drive online campaigns, media investments, and promotional activities to increase traffic and conversion.
* Support shopper journey optimization using first party and retailer data.
* Develop initiatives that increase consumer loyalty, retention, and repeat purchase rates.

  

**Analytics & Business Performance**

* Monitor and analyze business performance across digital channels.
* Develop dashboards and management reports tracking:
    * Sales
    * Market share
    * Traffic
    * Conversion
    * Basket size
    * ROI
* Leverage data and insights to identify growth opportunities and improve commercial effectiveness.

  

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Supply Chain & Distributers to ensure product availability and reduce out-of-stock occurrences.
* Work closely with Medical Affairs and Regulatory teams to ensure compliance of digital content and communications.
* Collaborate with Finance on forecasting, investment tracking, and profitability management.
* Support digital transformation initiatives across the commercial organization.

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Financial**

* E-commerce Net Sales Growth.
* Market Share Growth.
* Gross Profit Contribution.
* Revenue Delivery vs Plan.

  

**Commercial Excellence**

* Digital Shelf Compliance.
* Share of Search.
* Product Availability (OSA).
* Online Assortment Coverage.

  

**Consumer Metrics**

* Conversion Rate
* Average Order Value
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Customer Acquisition & Retention

  

**Execution Metrics**

* Joint Business Plan Delivery.
* Promotional ROI.
* Customer Satisfaction.
* Omni-Channel Program Adoption.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Pharmacy, Nutrition, Digital Commerce, or related field.
* MBA preferred.
* Additional certifications in E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, Analytics, or Commercial Excellence are advantageous.

  

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in FMCG, Healthcare, Nutrition, Consumer Health, or Retail industries.
* Minimum 3-5 years leading e-commerce and/or omni-channel commercial functions.
* Strong experience managing key online retailers, pharmacy chains, and marketplace platforms.
* Demonstrated success delivering profitable growth through digital commerce channels.
* Experience working in highly regulated healthcare or nutrition categories preferred.

  

**Critical Competencies**

**Commercial Leadership**

* Strategic Thinking.
* Revenue Growth Management.
* Joint Business Planning.

About the Role:

We are hiring a hands-on Head of Product to own product direction, roadmap, feature definition, acceptance, and customer enablement. You will work closely with the Head of Engineering to take customer problems through discovery, delivery, and adoption, using AI to help a small team achieve exceptional speed and quality. You will be expected to produce specifications and prototypes, test workflows, and assess product results directly.

What You Will Own:

Set product direction, priorities, and scope within agreed business goals and budget.

Translate customer needs into complete workflows, clear specifications, acceptance criteria, and measurable success outcomes.

Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, feature definition, product documentation, and acceptance work.

Own usability and product acceptance, including error and permission states, onboarding, guidance, and adoption.

Resolve scope and delivery trade-offs with Engineering and communicate progress through demonstrated customer outcomes.

Continuously evaluate the product, identify gaps, and turn customer feedback into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring

Proven experience taking commerce, SaaS, marketplace, or operational products from customer problems through to shipped and adopted workflows.

Operating procedures must be followed to ensure that there is continuity of standards across the KSA to support these primary job functions. In addition to these duties the salesman will also provide his supervisor with latest market information in order to develop any sales opportunities. The salesman will be required to attend training courses designed to improve levels of professionalism and customer service. The salesman is required to complete a daily debriefing with his supervisor PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES Responsibilities: Sell the full range of products to an agreed list of customers. The salesman is responsible for maintaining the sales vehicle in a clean and roadworthy condition and any defects or damage must be reported at the earliest opportunity to the supervisor.  Daily the salesman will agree his order requirements for the next selling period.  Maintaining individual customer stock levels to the agreed requirements in order to make sure that out of stock problems are kept to a minimum.  The salesman is responsible for the implementation of the agreed in store merchandising communicated by the supervisor. Where there is additional support from a company merchandiser the salesman will agree with the supervisor the arrangements planned in the outlets with the support.  Advise the supervisor of any relevant competitor activity taking place in the area served by the salesman. This will be part of the daily debriefing with the supervisor. Daily reconciliation of all cheques, cash & credit sales. Zero stock & cash shortages. Sales staff are to be neatly groomed and presentable at all times.  Maintain a high standard of driving and obey the driving regulations.  The following Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) will be used to measure a salesman’s performance. Qualifications EXPERIENCE / COMPETENCIES REQUIRED  Customer service skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic. Analytical skills.

**Overview:**

Mitel is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Channel Account Manager (CAM) to drive revenue growth and partner engagement across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). The CAM will be responsible for developing and managing key relationships with Mitel's value-added resellers (VARs), system integrators (SIs), and managed service providers (MSPs) in the region. The ideal candidate understands the local telecom and unified communications (UC) market, has strong channel expertise, and can support partners in navigating both Mitel’s on-premise solutions portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

* Channel Partner Engagement - Identify, Onboard and enable new Channel partner in alignment with Mitel's growth strategy in KSA
    
* Manage and Grow existing channel base and increase market penetration
    
* Sales Execution - Own the Channel sales Quote for allocated partners and meet or exceed revenue targets.
    
* Develop and execute joint business plans with partners
    
* Drive deal registratio, pipeline development and forecast accuracy
    
* Partner enablement - Ensure partners are trained and certified on Mitel Solutions.
    
* Support sales and technical enablement events, workshops, local roadshows
    
* Market Intelligence - Stay informed on competitive activities, market dynamics and customer demans specific to KSA
    
* Understand and navigate local regulatory environments
    
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders at partner organizations and end customers
    
* Co-Ordinate executive alignment with Mitel Leadership and strategic partners.
    
* Collaborate with marketing teams and partners to run co-branded campaigns tailored to Saudi market needs.
    
* Leverage digital platforms, industry events and local exhibitions to drive awareness.
    

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or IT (MBA preferred).
    
* 5–8 years of experience in channel sales or partner account management in the UC, telecom, networking, or IT sector.
    
* Deep understanding of channel dynamics in KSA and Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries.
    
* Proven track record of building and scaling channel ecosystems in a competitive market.
    
* Strong understanding of unified communications, cloud voice, collaboration, and contact center solutions.
    
* Knowledge of public sector, education, oil & gas, and enterprise verticals in KSA is highly desirable.
    
* Fluent in English and Arabic.

As a Seller Acquisition Specialist Intern, you will help identify, engage, acquire and onboard targeted Saudi sellers, while supporting them through the journey from first contact to becoming active on Trendyol. You will also help manage a pool of high-potential SMEs, supporting their growth, selection and marketplace performance.

From seller experience to new market launches, we turn insights into action—fast. Our cross-functional teams shape the future of commerce with bold ideas, real-time impact, and a deep sense of ownership. In a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we grow together — as individuals and as a team.

- Customisable FlexBenefits budget: Adjust your daily meal allowance, choose your health insurance package (and extend it to your spouse or children), and pick from additional benefits like fuel support or Trendyol shopping credits.
- Well-being support: Access to location-based in-house doctors, as well as psychologist and dietitian support, and HPV vaccination provision.
- Personalised training allowance and learning opportunities: Use your annual budget for any training or conference of your choice, explore our Learning Management System (LMS) anytime, and join in-person learning sessions offered throughout the year.

- A diverse, international team: Collaborate with global peers across our offices in Berlin, Amsterdam, Dubai, and beyond, in a startup-spirited and collaborative environment.

With strong pride for our pioneering role in the history of the Korean plant industry in the past 50 years, we successfully performed numerous projects around the world and grew into a globally competitive engineering company. Join us and be part of a dynamic team where ideas are valued, and collective success drives our future.

## Job Description

**JOB SUMMARY:**

Assisting Field Control Manager on Subcontract administration with management, administration and review of Subcontract Agreements or its amendments

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Handle contract changes by negotiating with subcontract person- Handle comprehensive cost, delay, variation claims- Participate in review and negotiation of subcontractor claims under supervision and guidance by Contract Administrator
* Review progress invoices from subcontractor.
* Maintain files of subcontract document
* Organize history of all claim, change order and back charge under subcontracts.
* Verify subcontractor requests for release of hold back and final payments.
* Report any potential claim related with delay or disruption through correspondence such as daily report or incoming letters, etc.
* Respond to claims issued by subcontractors through official letters.
* Prepare claim details and issue notification of claim to subcontractors or owner.
* Attend weekly construction meeting with subcontractors to get update on site issues and advise construction team to avoid exposure to liabilities.
* Review proposals submitted by subcontractors for new or additional work.
* Prepare subcontract approval paperwork (subcontract RRC, GRRC and Tender Board paperwork) where required in support of ITT’s and awards.
* Ensure that where appropriate the sub-contract terms drafted ensure full back to back coverage with client contracts.
* Prepare and issue to the selected contractors approved contracts and deal with subsequent contract amendments and Call offs and purchase orders.
* Maintain and log all subcontract change authorizations and amendments where appropriate liaise with legal, tax, insurance and compliance to obtain their input into subcontracts.
* Such other works of incidental and related as Subcontract Engineer.

## Qualifications

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related major.

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum 5 to 10 years’ experience
* Experience In cost control, project based field control experience ideally gained within the Oil and Gas industry or Petrochemical industry
* Experience in drafting / working with contracts for all tiers of suppliers in differing commercial and contractual arrangements
* Experience working within an active and lively operational team
* Oil and gas experience in tendering, awarding, managing and negotiating subcontracts

**KNOWLEDGE:**

* Competent with document control
* Working to advanced knowledge of Word, Excel, etc.

***TECHNICAL SKILLS / COMPETENCIES:***

* Subcontract
* Method Statement
* Review of Construction Schedule
