**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Document Controller - Saudi National to join our team! In this role you will get to support the effective management, control, distribution, tracking, and archiving of project documentation across a major project environment. You will work closely with multidisciplinary project teams to ensure documents are accurate, traceable, properly controlled, and processed in accordance with Parsons, client, and project document control requirements.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Manage the receipt, registration, distribution, tracking, retrieval, and archiving of project documents and correspondence.
* Maintain accurate document registers, logs, trackers, and electronic filing systems throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure all project documents are correctly identified, numbered, coded, classified, version-controlled, and filed in accordance with approved procedures.
* Process incoming and outgoing correspondence, technical submittals, drawings, reports, RFIs, transmittals, specifications, and other project documentation.
* Review document submissions for completeness and compliance with established document control requirements prior to processing.
* Distribute documents to appropriate project team members, reviewers, contractors, consultants, and client representatives in a timely manner.
* Monitor document workflows and follow up on overdue reviews, approvals, comments, responses, and outstanding actions.
* Maintain effective revision control and ensure superseded or obsolete documents are clearly identified, withdrawn where required, and appropriately archived.
* Prepare, process, and issue document transmittals and formal document packages.
* Upload, retrieve, update, and manage documentation within the project **Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) / Common Data Environment (CDE)**.
* Maintain accurate metadata and document attributes within the EDMS/CDE to support effective search, retrieval, reporting, and traceability.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Design, Construction, Commercial, Planning, Project Controls, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and other project teams regarding documentation requirements.
* Ensure documentation complies with approved Parsons procedures, client requirements, project protocols, and established document workflows.
* Identify missing, incomplete, duplicated, incorrectly coded, or incorrectly submitted documents and coordinate corrective action with responsible parties.
* Support document control requirements associated with design reviews, technical approvals, construction activities, inspections, and project meetings.
* Maintain complete and auditable records of document submissions, reviews, approvals, revisions, and distributions.
* Support preparation of document control reports, dashboards, status summaries, overdue reports, and document registers.
* Assist project teams in retrieving records and documentation required for internal and external audits.
* Support project handover and closeout activities by ensuring required documentation is complete, correctly indexed, and properly archived.
* Assist in compiling final project records, as-built documentation, handover packages, and closeout documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality, security, and integrity of sensitive project and client information.
* Support implementation and continuous improvement of project document control processes and procedures.
* Provide guidance to project personnel regarding document numbering, workflows, revision control, and EDMS/CDE requirements.
* Perform other document control responsibilities as assigned by the Document Control Lead or Project Management.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in **Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, Records Management**, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Minimum **2+ years of relevant document control experience**, preferably within engineering, construction, infrastructure, transportation, airport, or other major project environments.
* Experience working with **Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS)** and/or **Common Data Environment (CDE)** platforms.
* Good understanding of document control principles, procedures, and project information management practices.
* Experience managing:
* Document numbering and coding
* Revision and version control
* Document registers and logs
* Transmittals
* Technical submittals
* Drawings and specifications
* RFIs and correspondence
* Review and approval workflows
* Project records and archives
* Ability to maintain accurate and traceable project documentation throughout the document lifecycle.
* Experience monitoring document workflows and following up on outstanding reviews, approvals, and responses.
* Good understanding of engineering and construction documentation and multidisciplinary project workflows.
* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Office**, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and records management skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when processing large volumes of project documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines within a fast-paced project environment.
* Strong communication, coordination, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Good command of written and spoken English.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately manage sensitive project information.  
    

## What Desired Skills You'll Bring

* Experience working on **major infrastructure, airport, transportation, buildings, or large-scale construction projects**.
* Previous experience within a **PMC, Delivery Partner, engineering consultancy, contractor, or client-side project environment**.
* Hands-on experience with document management and collaboration platforms such as: **Oracle Aconex**, **Asite**, **Procore**, **Microsoft SharePoint**, **Autodesk Construction, Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360** and Other comparable EDMS/CDE platforms
* Familiarity with client and consultant document control procedures and approval workflows.
* Experience controlling engineering drawings, technical submittals, RFIs, specifications, correspondence, reports, and construction records.
* Familiarity with document control requirements associated with design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and handover activities.
* Experience supporting document audits, project closeout, as-built documentation, and final handover packages.
* Familiarity with **ISO 19650 information management principles** is advantageous.
* Experience preparing document control KPIs, dashboards, reports, and overdue-document trackers.
* Ability to identify opportunities to improve document workflows, filing structures, and information traceability.
* Strong teamwork and customer-service mindset when supporting multidisciplinary project teams.
* Arabic language capability is an advantage for KSA-based assignments.

**Senior Chiller Technician**

  

**About Carrier**

Carrier is the leading global provider of healthy, safe and sustainable building and cold chain solutions with a world-class, diverse workforce across HVAC, refrigeration, fire and security. We make modern life possible by delivering safer, smarter and more sustainable solutions that make a difference to people and our planet while helping shape the future of our industry.

Join Carrier and be part of a team that delivers innovative solutions, exceptional service and lasting value to our customers.

  

**About This Role**

As a **Senior Chiller Technician** at Carrier, you will play a key role in the installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of commercial and industrial chiller systems and associated HVAC equipment.

You will use your technical expertise to diagnose complex mechanical, electrical and control-system issues, perform preventive and corrective maintenance, and ensure that chiller systems operate safely, reliably and efficiently.

Working both independently and as part of a team, you will interact directly with customers and internal stakeholders, providing professional technical service and helping maintain Carrier's high standards for safety, quality and customer satisfaction.

This role is well suited to an experienced HVAC professional with strong chiller knowledge who is passionate about technical excellence and looking to take their expertise to the next level.

  

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Perform inspection, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of commercial and industrial chiller systems and associated HVAC equipment.
* Diagnose mechanical, electrical, refrigeration and control-system faults and determine appropriate corrective actions.
* Carry out scheduled maintenance activities to maintain equipment reliability, efficiency and performance.
* Service and maintain chillers, chilled-water systems, pumps, cooling towers and associated HVAC equipment.
* Inspect operating pressures, temperatures, refrigerant circuits, chilled-water systems and other critical operating parameters using appropriate test instruments.
* Identify refrigerant leaks and perform refrigerant recovery, evacuation, charging and related service activities in accordance with applicable regulations and procedures.
* Inspect, test and maintain compressors, motors, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, condenser and evaporator systems, controls and safety devices.
* Troubleshoot electrical circuits, electronic controls, sensors, starters, variable-frequency drives and other control components associated with chiller systems.
* Diagnose and adjust HVAC control systems and support the operation of building automation and control systems where applicable.
* Perform system start-up, shutdown, commissioning, testing and performance checks as required.
* Analyze equipment operating conditions and recommend corrective actions to improve system reliability and energy efficiency.
* Replace or repair defective components and ensure equipment is returned to safe and reliable operating condition.
* Maintain accurate service reports, maintenance records, equipment readings and documentation in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
* Provide technical guidance and support to junior technicians and other field personnel when required.
* Communicate effectively with customers, site representatives, supervisors and other stakeholders regarding equipment condition, service requirements and recommended solutions.
* Identify potential risks and hazards associated with work activities and take appropriate measures to mitigate them.
* Follow all Carrier safety policies, procedures and applicable local regulations.
* Maintain and use required personal protective equipment (PPE), tools and company-issued equipment.
* Participate in on-call or emergency service rotations as required by the business.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Technical diploma, vocational qualification or certification in HVAC, refrigeration, mechanical or electrical engineering is preferred.
* **5–7 years of relevant HVAC/chiller experience** required.
* Strong hands-on experience with commercial or industrial chiller systems.
* Experience with troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, refrigeration and control-system faults.
* Valid driver's license where required by the role and local regulations.
* Relevant refrigerant handling certification/license, where required by local regulations.
* Relevant electrical/HVAC certification or license, where required by local regulations.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize service activities and make sound technical decisions in the field.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and provide technical support to less-experienced technicians.
* Ability to lift, push and pull equipment and materials as required for the role.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including overtime, emergency call-outs or on-call rotations where required.

  

**Knowledge and Technical Skills**

Strong knowledge of:

* Commercial and industrial HVAC and refrigeration systems.
* Air-cooled and/or water-cooled chiller systems.
* Chilled-water and condenser-water systems.
* Chiller compressors, evaporators, condensers, expansion devices, pumps and associated components.
* Refrigeration principles, refrigerant circuits and refrigerant recovery procedures.
* Electrical circuits, motors, starters, contactors, relays and variable-frequency drives.
* Electronic controls, sensors, safety devices and HVAC control systems.
* Building automation and management systems.
* Preventive and corrective maintenance practices.
* HVAC diagnostic tools, electrical test instruments and refrigeration service equipment.
* HVAC safety procedures, refrigerant handling requirements and applicable regulatory standards.
* Safe handling and use of chemicals, refrigerants and Safety Data Sheets (SDS).
* Technical documentation, service reports and maintenance records.

  

**Safety and Compliance**

At Carrier, safety is a fundamental part of how we work. The Senior Chiller Technician is expected to:

* Comply with all Carrier safety policies, procedures and environmental requirements.
* Follow applicable local, national and industry regulations.
* Identify and mitigate potential workplace hazards before and during service activities.
* Use appropriate PPE and safety equipment at all times.
* Maintain required technical certifications and licenses.
* Follow proper refrigerant recovery, handling, storage and disposal procedures.
* Maintain a clean and safe work environment.
* Participate in required safety training and company compliance programs.

**Our Commitment to You**

At Carrier, our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a workplace that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, fosters collaboration, and drives innovation to serve our customers better.

We are guided by our values of Respect, Integrity, Inclusion, Innovation, and Excellence, and we are excited for you to join us and make a difference.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Structural Steel inspector** **- Saudi National** to join our team!

The Structural Steel Inspector will be responsible for inspecting and monitoring all structural steel fabrication, erection, installation, welding, bolting, and associated activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), and client requirements.

The role will work closely with the Quality team, Structural Engineers, Construction teams, contractors, fabrication facilities, third-party inspectors, and consultants to ensure that structural steel works meet the required quality, safety, dimensional, and technical standards from fabrication through final installation and handover.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Inspect structural steel fabrication and erection activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, ITPs, and method statements.
* Review and verify approved shop drawings, fabrication drawings, material specifications, and erection drawings.
* Conduct inspections at fabrication yards and project sites as required.
* Verify structural steel materials against approved material submittals and specifications.
* Review Material Test Certificates (MTCs), Mill Certificates, Certificates of Conformity, and other material documentation.
* Verify steel grades, sizes, thicknesses, dimensions, heat numbers, and material traceability.
* Inspect steel fabrication activities including cutting, drilling, forming, fit-up, assembly, and preparation.
* Inspect welding activities and verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and applicable requirements.
* Verify welder qualifications and ensure welding is performed by approved and qualified personnel.
* Monitor pre-welding preparations, joint fit-up, alignment, preheating, welding parameters, and post-weld requirements.
* Coordinate and witness Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) including UT, MT, PT, RT, and visual inspection as applicable.
* Review NDT reports and verify that results meet specified acceptance criteria.
* Inspect bolted connections, including bolt type, grade, size, installation, tightening, and torque/tension requirements.
* Verify installation of high-strength structural bolts and associated connection components.
* Conduct dimensional inspections of fabricated and erected steel structures.
* Verify structural steel alignment, level, plumbness, tolerances, elevations, and connection geometry.
* Inspect surface preparation, blasting, cleaning, and coating application.
* Verify paint/coating systems, DFT requirements, environmental conditions, and coating inspection records.
* Inspect fireproofing / fire protection systems applied to structural steel where applicable.
* Verify anchor bolts, base plates, embedded items, and steel-to-concrete interfaces.
* Monitor erection activities and ensure temporary stability and approved erection procedures are maintained.
* Review lifting and erection activities from a quality and technical inspection perspective.
* Coordinate with Structural Engineers regarding technical issues, deviations, and field modifications.
* Raise and monitor Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Site Inspection Requests (SIRs), and Quality Observations where required.
* Verify implementation and closure of corrective actions related to structural steel works.
* Prepare inspection reports, checklists, photographs, and quality records.
* Maintain accurate inspection and material traceability documentation.
* Witness and document required hold points, witness points, and inspection activities in accordance with approved ITPs.
* Review contractor quality documentation and ensure required records are complete and traceable.
* Participate in fabrication inspections, pre-shipment inspections, site inspections, and final acceptance inspections.
* Verify structural steel works against applicable AISC, AWS, ASTM, ASME, BS, EN, ISO, and project-specific requirements, as applicable.
* Support quality audits and provide objective evidence of inspection and compliance.
* Monitor punch-list items and verify satisfactory completion before final acceptance.
* Support preparation of as-built records, inspection dossiers, welding documentation, NDT records, coating reports, and final handover documentation.
* Coordinate with commissioning and handover teams where structural steel works interface with mechanical, electrical, architectural, or specialist systems.
* Identify potential quality issues at an early stage and provide recommendations to prevent rework.
* Promote quality awareness and compliance among contractors and fabrication teams.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in structural steel inspection, fabrication, erection, or construction quality control.
* Proven experience on major airport, infrastructure, industrial, commercial, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of structural steel fabrication, welding, bolting, erection, coating, and inspection requirements.
* Experience working with structural steel fabricators, contractors, consultants, and third-party inspection agencies.
* Good understanding of drawings, specifications, ITPs, welding documentation, and inspection procedures.

* AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) is highly preferred.
* CSWIP Welding Inspector certification is an advantage.
* NDT qualifications such as UT, MT, PT, or RT are advantageous.
* NACE / AMPP Coating Inspector certification is an advantage.
* ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Quality certification is preferred.
* Relevant professional engineering certification is an advantage.

description:

**Job Description:**

Parsons are recruiting for an exceptionally talented **Service Charges & Revenue Director: Estate Management, City Assets Management** to join their team.

The Service Charges & Revenue Director will take ownership of the city-wide service charge framework, service charge model, charging methodologies, cost recovery governance, revenue opportunity evaluation and associated assurance activities across the Estate Management function. The role is accountable for coordinating operational, financial and asset-management inputs required to support service charge governance and commercial sustainability, whilst providing recommendations for leadership review and approval.  Minimum 20 years experience.

**Job Description**

The Service Charges & Revenue Director is responsible for establishing, owning and maintaining the city-wide service charge framework, governance model, charging methodologies and revenue optimization strategy across the city operating model.

The role provides coordination and assurance across Estate Management, City Operations, Asset Management, Finance, districts, operators and delivery teams to ensure that operational costs, common area services and shared infrastructure are appropriately understood, fairly allocated and recoverable where applicable. The Director acts as the custodian of the city-wide service charge model, leading cost allocation governance and city-wide revenue opportunity assessment to support long-term operational sustainability, financial resilience and value optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain the city-wide service charge framework, governance structure, policies, methodologies and operating principles across applicable assets, facilities, services and districts.
* Develop and maintain service charge allocation principles, recharge methodologies, cost categorization structures and governance requirements.
* Ensure service charge arrangements are transparent, equitable, auditable and aligned with approved operational and commercial objectives.
* Lead annual service charge review processes, including governance controls, methodology updates and assurance requirements.
* Prepare policy recommendations on service charge methodologies and governance arrangements for leadership review and approval.
* Ensure service charge approaches remain aligned with operating models, asset ownership structures, operational responsibilities and district requirements.
* Promote consistency in charging practices and cost recovery principles across the wider operating model.
* Provide leadership reporting on service charge governance effectiveness, risks, issues and improvement opportunities.
* Own and maintain the city-wide service charge model and its supporting governance arrangements.
* Coordinate inputs from Asset Management, City Operations, Finance, districts, operators and external advisors to ensure model integrity, consistency and reliability.
* Review and challenge charging assumptions, allocation methodologies, cost drivers and model outputs to support robust decision making.
* Ensure common area services, shared infrastructure, public realm assets and city-wide services are accurately reflected within service charge calculations.
* Maintain transparent assumptions, supporting evidence and governance records for all significant model decisions.
* Monitor model effectiveness and ensure assumptions evolve in line with city growth, asset commissioning and operational maturity.
* Develop management information, dashboards and reporting outputs to support leadership review and decision making.
* Support periodic reviews of service charge affordability, allocation fairness and cost recovery effectiveness.
* Lead the identification and evaluation of revenue-generating opportunities associated with assets, infrastructure, facilities, services and common areas.
* Assess emerging opportunities that support operational sustainability and maximize value from owned or managed assets.
* Coordinate commercial evaluations of potential revenue streams, recovery mechanisms and value-generation initiatives.
* Develop business case inputs, financial assessments and strategic recommendations for leadership consideration.
* Ensure revenue opportunities are evaluated against operational requirements, customer experience expectations and long-term strategic objectives.
* Maintain visibility of revenue-generating initiatives across districts, operators and asset portfolios.
* Monitor market developments and emerging trends that may create future revenue opportunities.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations regarding revenue generation, value optimization and cost recovery enhancement.
* Coordinate operating expenditure inputs with City Operations, operators, Finance and Asset Management stakeholders.
* Ensure service charge assumptions appropriately reflect approved service levels, operational requirements and operating delivery models.
* Work closely with lifecycle planning and integration stakeholders to incorporate lifecycle forecasts, renewal obligations and long-term asset funding requirements into service charge considerations.
* Ensure lifecycle cost impacts and renewal pressures are visible during service charge reviews and cost recovery assessments.
* Coordinate discussions regarding maintenance obligations, service standards, lifecycle exposure and cost allocation assumptions.
* Challenge cost assumptions where opportunities exist to improve efficiency, affordability or value for money.
* Support integrated planning through clear visibility of operational expenditure, lifecycle obligations and recovery opportunities.
* Promote alignment between operational sustainability objectives and cost recovery strategies.
* Maintain a consolidated view of operational costs, service charge assumptions, recovery methodologies and cost allocation structures.
* Review cost recovery performance and identify variances, risks, affordability issues, recovery gaps and potential revenue leakage.
* Coordinate assurance activities relating to service charge calculations, allocation methodologies and recovery assumptions.
* Provide recommendations to improve transparency, accountability and effectiveness of cost recovery arrangements.
* Support leadership reporting on cost recovery performance, service charge outcomes and operational affordability pressures.
* Monitor trends, exceptions and performance indicators to identify emerging risks and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure service charge arrangements remain sustainable and support long-term operational and financial objectives.
* Develop governance reporting and performance dashboards covering cost recovery effectiveness and financial resilience.
* Build strong working relationships with districts, operators, City Operations, Asset Management, Finance and governance stakeholders.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement activities associated with service charges, revenue generation and cost recovery initiatives.
* Facilitate discussions on operating assumptions, service levels, allocation methodologies, charging structures and recovery mechanisms.
* Ensure district and operator requirements are captured, reviewed and appropriately reflected within service charge governance arrangements.
* Support resolution of service charge and cost allocation issues through structured engagement, analysis and recommendations.
* Promote transparency and understanding of charging methodologies and governance requirements across stakeholders.
* Support senior leadership engagement on financially significant recovery, charging and revenue matters.
* Facilitate cross-functional reviews of emerging operational, commercial and cost recovery challenges.
* Define scopes, deliverables, acceptance criteria and performance requirements for consultants supporting service charge and revenue initiatives.
* Manage consultant activities, outputs, recommendations and reporting requirements.
* Review benchmarking studies, financial assessments, charge methodologies, governance recommendations and commercial evaluations.
* Ensure consultant outputs are evidence-based, practical and aligned with Estate Management objectives.
* Coordinate independent reviews and specialist assessments as required to support decision making.
* Escalate significant findings, risks, opportunities and recommendations to senior management where appropriate.
* Translate consultant recommendations into practical governance improvements and decision-support outputs.
* Promote effective knowledge transfer and capability development through external specialist engagements.
* Promote continual improvement of service charge governance, cost recovery methodologies and revenue opportunity assessment processes.
* Coordinate benchmarking exercises through specialist consultants to compare service charge practices, cost recovery arrangements and revenue opportunities against relevant market comparators.
* Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, operational trends and emerging practices that may impact service charge or revenue strategies.
* Develop dashboards, management reports and executive briefings covering service charge performance, revenue opportunities and recovery effectiveness.
* Review governance effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, transparency and value creation.
* Support the development of Estate Management capability through guidance, workshops, governance routines and stakeholder engagement.
* Maintain lessons learned and continuous improvement processes for service charge and revenue management activities.
* Promote evidence-based decision making through high-quality reporting and performance analysis.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, Asset Management, Business Administration, Commercial Management or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.
* Professional certification or membership in finance, service charge management, commercial management, asset management, real estate or business management is desirable.
* Minimum 20 years of progressive experience in service charges, commercial management, cost recovery, financial planning, real estate operations, asset management, infrastructure operations or related disciplines, including senior leadership experience.
* Proven experience developing, managing or governing service charge models and cost allocation methodologies within complex multi-stakeholder environments.
* Experience evaluating revenue opportunities, commercial initiatives, cost recovery strategies and financial sustainability programs.
* Experience coordinating operational, asset management and finance stakeholders to develop evidence-based commercial recommendations.
* Experience managing consultants, specialist advisors and commercial studies.
* Experience supporting executive-level decision making through financial modelling, governance reporting and commercial analysis.
* Experience within large-scale destinations, cities, infrastructure programs, mixed-use developments, public realm environments or giga-projects is strongly preferred.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring;**

* Background in service charge governance, estate management, property management, commercial management, infrastructure finance, revenue optimization or operational finance.
* Practical exposure to city operations, asset management, operational readiness, lifecycle planning and cost recovery environments.
* Experience working across finance, operations, asset management and governance functions to support sustainable operating models and commercial outcomes.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Service charge governance, allocation methodologies and cost recovery frameworks.
* Financial analysis, business case development and commercial evaluation.
* Revenue opportunity identification, assessment and value optimization.
* Operating expenditure analysis and multi-stakeholder coordination.
* Lifecycle cost integration and long-term operational sustainability considerations.
* Benchmarking, assurance reviews, performance reporting and governance controls.
* Consultant management, commercial oversight and executive-level reporting.
* Cross-functional stakeholder engagement and complex decision support.

* es and community management.

description:

**Job Description:**

  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **DLP & Snagging Engineer (Saudi National)** to join our team!

The DLP & Snagging Engineer is responsible for the technical identification, coordination, tracking and close-out of defects, snags and Defects Liability Period (DLP) obligations across assigned assets. The role provides engineering-focused support for DLP and snagging activities, working closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, service providers and internal stakeholders, and ensuring that defects are recorded, assessed, prioritized, rectified, evidenced and closed in line with contractual obligations, handover requirements, operational standards and client expectations.

  

This position supports asset handover, operational readiness and the transition into steady-state operations by ensuring that defects do not compromise safety, statutory compliance, maintainability, service continuity or user/guest experience.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Deliver day-to-day DLP and snagging engineering support across assigned assets, ensuring defects, incomplete works and operational readiness issues are clearly identified, technically assessed, logged, prioritised and progressed towards closure.
* Conduct and participate in inspections, joint walkthroughs, snagging reviews, defect verification visits and close-out validation with project teams, consultants, contractors, service providers and internal operations stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate defect and snag registers, ensuring each item has clear ownership, engineering description, priority, target date, status, supporting evidence, escalation route and formal close-out record.
* Monitor DLP obligations and contractor performance from a technical perspective, including rectification progress, recurring defects, response times, quality of repair, warranty issues and outstanding liabilities, escalating concerns to the DLP & Snagging Manager as required.
* Support asset handover and operational readiness by technically reviewing handover documentation, O&M manuals, asset registers, warranties, test records, training records, permits, compliance documentation and defect close-out evidence prior to acceptance into operations.
* Use CAFM/CMMS systems, snagging platforms, dashboards and reporting tools to control defect data, track progress, maintain evidence and provide accurate status and performance reporting.
* Assess defects and snags from an operational and engineering risk perspective, ensuring safety, statutory compliance, asset reliability, accessibility, maintainability, service continuity and user/guest experience impacts are understood and addressed.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders including hard services, soft services, roads, landscaping, utilities, mobility, public realm, security, events, FM service partners and project delivery teams to resolve cross-functional defects and interface issues.
* Contribute to governance reviews, readiness meetings, risk reporting, contractor performance discussions, commercial challenge, CAPEX/OPEX clarification and lessons learned relating to defects, warranty and handover quality.
* Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members and site-based resources, promoting disciplined close-out, accurate reporting, evidence-based decision making and continuous improvement in DLP and snagging management.

  

**What required skills you'll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Building Services, Civil), Facilities Management, Construction Management, Asset Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
* **Minimum 4 years’ experience** in construction completion, asset handover, DLP management, snagging, facilities management, operations readiness or O&M, including responsibility for technical assessment and resolution of defects.
* Demonstrable experience coordinating contractors, consultants or service providers through defect identification, technical rectification, evidence capture, close-out governance, warranty management and SLA/KPI reporting.
* Desirable experience within master-planned cities or communities, mixed-use developments, entertainment destinations, infrastructure assets, public realm environments, giga-projects or large-scale developments within Saudi Arabia, the GCC or similar markets.
* DLP governance support, snagging management, technical defect identification, root cause analysis, rectification coordination and close-out control.
* Asset handover, operational readiness, completion inspections, technical acceptance criteria and transition into steady-state operations.
* Strong understanding of hard services (MEP, building systems), soft services interfaces, public realm, infrastructure, utilities, roads, landscaping and building service interactions.
* Contractor governance support, warranty management, SLA/KPI monitoring, inspections, audits, compliance reviews and performance reporting.
* Proficiency in CAFM/CMMS systems, snagging platforms, dashboards, work order control, asset data quality, evidence management and recurring defect analysis.
* Knowledge of health, safety and statutory compliance, permit-to-work processes, operational risk assessment and public access risk management.
* Effective stakeholder coordination, escalation management, meeting participation, reporting discipline and cross-functional issue resolution.
* Commercial awareness, basic contract interpretation, liability tracking, cost impact understanding, lessons learned and contribution to continuous improvement.
* Relevant professional or technical qualification in project handover, facilities management, asset management, quality management, health and safety, defects management or contract administration is desirable.

The role will ensure that materials proposed and used by contractors comply with approved project specifications, applicable standards, design requirements, and client requirements.

The Materials Engineer position will coordinate closely with Materials Engineering, Quality, Construction, Procurement Engineering, Testing Laboratories, Independent Inspection Agencies, Consultants, Contractors, and Materials Suppliers, Manufacturers, Cement Concrete Batching Plants and Asphalt Plants to ensure the timely review, approval, inspection, testing, storage, handling, and traceability of construction materials throughout the project lifecycle.

The Materials Engineer dedicated to overseeing and managing all material-related workflows and compliance processes. To ensure seamless coordination between within Materials Management Team and all departments.

The Renewals Sales Specialist is responsible for renewing, up-selling, and closing license contracts for assigned accounts. Handling the entire renewals process for accounts, understand customer requirements, guide them through the renewal cycle, negotiate and issue proposals, forecast renewal opportunities, track purchase orders, and close renewals on time. description:
# ******Job Description Summary******

Serve as the site's primary authority for digital systems across materials management, manufacturing operations, quality, and maintenance. This role drives system adoption, process compliance, workforce capability, and master data quality while ensuring alignment with global standards. Acting as the site's Local Process Digital Authority, this role bridges factory operations and enterprise digital standards, partnering closely with DPE Global Process Digital Authorities, the Master Data Governance team, and site leadership to ensure digital solutions enable operational excellence locally.

# **Job Description**

**What will you do:**

**Digital Operations Leadership**

* Serve as the site's Local Process Digital Authority for digital systems and processes across materials management, manufacturing operations, quality, and maintenance.
* Lead local deployment, stabilization, and continuous improvement activities related to ERP, MES and other digital manufacturing systems and initiatives.
* Partner with site leadership to drive adoption of standardized business processes and digital solutions.
* Represent site operational requirements, risks, and opportunities within enterprise transformation programs, ensuring the site's voice is heard when global standards are defined or updated.

**Digital Systems & Process Governance**

* During deployment, serve as the site's primary resource for data conversion activities: validate legacy data against new system requirements, make practical decisions on data cleansing scope and prioritization, and own the classification and enrichment decisions needed to load accurate, usable data into the new system before go-live.
* Validate that global process designs, system configurations, and localization requirements support site operational needs across materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance systems while maintaining compliance with enterprise standards.
* Partner with Global Process Digital Authorities and the Master Data Governance team to ensure process consistency, data integrity, and operational readiness throughout deployment and beyond.
* Support system testing, user acceptance activities, deployment readiness reviews, and go-live preparation. Maintain site governance tools, including process documentation and decision-support guides.

**Capability Development & Operational Support**

* Own the site digital systems capability strategy once systems are live, ensuring employees have the knowledge and skills required to operate effectively within standardized digital processes across materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance.
* Lead the development and execution of role-based training programs for materials, manufacturing, quality, and maintenance teams, maintaining training curricula aligned with global standards.
* Serve as the primary functional escalation point for digital systems and user-support issues across all covered domains, distinguishing between a local training gap, a process gap, and a standard that needs updating, and routing each to the right resolution path.
* Monitor operational performance indicators related to system utilization, process compliance, and master data quality.

**Continuous Improvement & Cross-Site Collaboration**

* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve data quality, and increase user productivity without introducing unauthorized local process variations.
* Participate in the DPE LPDA network and collaborate with peers across manufacturing sites to share best practices, lessons learned, and standardization opportunities.

**What will you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain, materials management, or production operations within an industrial environment.
* Demonstrated experience with SAP, Oracle, or equivalent ERP platforms supporting manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems and other digital systems supporting quality or maintenance operations in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting user adoption, training, or business process transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, inventory management, production execution, and master data governance.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in Arabic.

**What will make you stand out :**

* Experience supporting ERP, MES, quality, maintenance, or other digital manufacturing system deployments in a key user, super user, or deployment role, including data conversion and cutover activities.
* Knowledge of master data governance, data migration, and ERP transformation methodologies.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement experience.
* Experience working within global manufacturing organizations and matrixed team structures.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change and drive sustainable process adoption.

# ******Additional Information******

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking to appoint an experienced **Interface Manager** to support its growing team!

**Interface Manager**: Design & Interface is a integrated team-client-facing role for a PMC, responsible for managing and assuring the end‑to‑end design and interface coordination process across multiple disciplines and packages (civil, stations, systems, MEP, rolling stock, etc.). Strong MEP, Water Transmission background,  The role has a strong focus on engineering governance, interface management, and safety assurance, Will be responsible for all interfaces - hard/soft, discussions, design workshops, and technical interface

Acting on behalf of the client, the position ensures that all designers, contractors, and systems integrators deliver coordinated, safe, and compliant designs and constructed works that meet employer’s requirements, statutory obligations, and project objectives for scope, time, cost, and quality.

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Serve as the primary PMC focal point for design coordination and interface management across the program.
    
* Represent the client in high‑level design, coordination, and interface meetings with consultants, contractors, systems integrators, authorities, and third parties.
    
* Ensure that employer’s requirements, technical standards, and safety obligations are clearly communicated, understood, and implemented by all delivery partners.
    
* Provide independent, objective advice and recommendations to the client leadership on engineering, safety, interface, and program matters.
    
* Lead and manage the overall multi‑discipline design process (concept, preliminary, detailed, and IFC) across architectural, civil/structural, MEP, water transmission and other disciplines.
    
* Review and comment on key design submissions, technical reports, drawings, models, calculations, and specifications to ensure compliance with: and constructability reviews, ensuring that design decisions are robust, buildable, and safe.
    
* Oversee requirements management and traceability, ensuring that all technical and safety requirements are properly captured, allocated, and verified.
    
* Monitor and enforce adherence to the project’s technical assurance and design governance processes.
    
* Establish and manage the project‑wide interface management framework, including processes, tools, and responsibilities.
    
* Identify, classify, and maintain a register of all key interfaces (civil–systems, stations–MEP, systems–rolling stock, depots, third‑party utilities, etc.).
    
* Chair interface coordination meetings and interface control working groups, driving resolution of interface issues and avoiding late changes.
    
* Review and monitor interface control documents, interface matrices, and interface agreements prepared by designers and contractors.
    
* Ensure that interface assumptions and decisions are documented, communicated, and implemented consistently across contracts.
    
* Escalate critical interface risks and conflicts to the client with options and recommendations.
    
* Oversee, from a PMC perspective, the integration of engineering and safety requirements throughout the design and build phases.
    
* Review and monitor RAMS documentation, safety cases, hazard logs, and risk assessments prepared by contractors and consultants.
    
* Ensure that design solutions incorporate safety by design, including construction safety, operational safety, and maintainability considerations.
    
* Coordinate with independent safety assessors (ISA), regulators, and third‑party reviewers, consolidating findings and actions for the client.
    
* Verify that all required safety approvals, certifications, and authority clearances are planned, tracked, and obtained in line with project milestones.
    
* Manage alignment between design deliverables and construction methodology/sequencing, ensuring early identification of constructability issues.
    
* Support the client in assessing and approving design changes, technical deviations, and value engineering proposals, including impact on safety, schedule, cost, and interfaces.
    
* Ensure consistent application of configuration management across design and construction phases, including version control and change tracking.
    
* Coordinate closure of design‑related non‑conformances, technical queries, and RFIs, working with designers and contractors to achieve timely solutions.
    
* Monitor design and interface activities against the integrated master program and key milestones; identify and manage critical path items.
    
* Maintain and regularly update design and interface risk registers, identifying mitigation measures and contingency plans.
    
* Provide clear, concise reports, dashboards, and presentations for the client, covering design progress, interface status, safety issues, and key risks.
    
* Support project controls teams in assessing schedule and cost impacts of design/interface issues and changes.
    
* Coordinate with internal client stakeholders to ensure that design outcomes meet future operational and business needs.
    
* Interface with local authorities, utility providers, and other third parties to support approvals, NOCs, permits, and technical agreements.
    
* Facilitate cross‑discipline alignment among multiple design consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure integrated, consistent solutions.
    
* Lead and mentor a team of design managers, interface engineers, and safety/assurance specialists within the PMC.
    
* Promote a culture of quality, safety, collaboration, and proactive risk management across all design and interface activities.
    
* Ensure robust QA/QC processes are applied to design deliverables and interface documentation.
    
* Capture, document, and disseminate lessons learned in design, interface management, and safety assurance across the program.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, or related discipline).
    
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Project Management, or related field is an advantage.
    
* Professional engineering registration/chartership CEng, PE) is highly desirable.
    
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2) and/or systems engineering/safety certifications are advantageous.
    
* **Approximately 15 years’ experience in major infrastructure, or complex multi‑discipline projects, with strong emphasis on design management and interface coordination.**
    
* Significant experience in a PMC, client, or international consultancy role managing design and build contracts.
    
* Proven track record leading multi‑discipline design teams and managing interfaces between civil, MEP, systems, and third‑party stakeholders.
    
* Demonstrable experience in engineering assurance, safety by design, and RAMS safety case processes.
    
* Experience working on large programs with multiple contractors and packages, ideally including rail/metro or similarly complex environments.
    
* Strong technical understanding of multi‑discipline design processes and interfaces across civil, structural, MEP, and systems.
    
* Solid knowledge of systems engineering principles, interface management, and safety RAMS methodologies.
    
* Excellent project management, planning, and coordination skills in a complex, multi‑stakeholder environment.
    
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management.
    

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring;**

* Highly effective communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues to non‑technical stakeholders.
    
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and client‑service orientation.
    
* Proficiency with standard project management and collaboration tools; familiarity with requirements management systems, BIM/CDE platforms, and document control systems is an advantage.
    
* Fluency in English (written and spoken); Arabic ideal.

Job Summary
The Cluster Receiving Clerk is responsible for receiving, inspecting, recording, and distributing goods delivered to the cluster of hotels. The position ensures that all deliveries are received accurately and in accordance with approved purchase orders, specifications, quality standards, and hotel requirements.
The Receiving Clerk works closely with the Purchasing, Finance, Cost Control, Stores, Kitchen, Housekeeping, Engineering, and other operational departments to ensure an efficient and well-controlled receiving process across the cluster.
Key Responsibilities
1. Receiving Deliveries
Receive all goods delivered to the hotels in accordance with approved Purchase Orders (POs).
Verify delivered items against purchase orders, delivery notes, invoices, and approved specifications.
Check quantities, descriptions, sizes, brands, and other relevant details before accepting deliveries.
Inspect the quality, condition, freshness, expiry dates, and packaging of delivered goods.
Ensure food, beverage, housekeeping, engineering, and general supplies meet the required hotel standards.
Reject or report damaged, expired, incorrect, or unauthorized items in accordance with hotel procedures.
Ensure all deliveries are received through the designated receiving area.
2. Documentation and System Entries
Prepare Receiving Records / Goods Received Notes (GRNs) accurately and on time.
Enter received goods into the hotel purchasing/inventory system.
Match purchase orders, delivery notes, and received quantities.
Ensure all receiving documents are properly signed, stamped, and filed.
Report discrepancies between purchase orders and actual deliveries to the relevant departments.
Maintain accurate and complete receiving records for audit and financial control purposes.
3. Quality and Quantity Control
Verify weights, measurements, and quantities where applicable.
Check food products for freshness, temperature, expiry dates, packaging, and quality.
Ensure chilled, frozen, and perishable items are received and handled according to food safety requirements.
Monitor delivery temperatures for temperature-sensitive products when required.
Coordinate with the relevant department when products do not meet specifications.
Ensure rejected goods are clearly identified and returned to suppliers.
4. Coordination with Hotel Departments
Coordinate with Purchasing regarding expected deliveries and outstanding purchase orders.
Coordinate with Stores and Cost Control to ensure received items are properly recorded and stored.
Work closely with Finance/AP regarding receiving documentation and invoice discrepancies.
Communicate with Kitchen, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments regarding special deliveries or urgent requirements.
Ensure departments are informed of shortages, substitutions, damaged goods, or other delivery issues.
5. Cluster Operations
Support receiving operations for all hotels within the cluster, as assigned.
Coordinate deliveries according to each property's requirements and receiving schedules.
Ensure consistent receiving procedures and controls are followed across the cluster.
Assist with inter-hotel transfers and documentation when required.
Maintain proper records of goods received for each hotel/property.
6. Inventory and Store Support
Ensure received items are transferred promptly to the appropriate stores or requesting departments.
Follow proper storage and handling procedures, including FIFO/FEFO principles where applicable.
Assist with stock counts and physical inventory checks when required.
Report any discrepancies, shortages, overages, or unusual inventory movements.
Assist the Storekeeper and Cost Control team in maintaining accurate inventory records.
7. Supplier Management
Verify supplier deliveries against approved purchase orders and agreed specifications.
Maintain professional communication with suppliers and delivery personnel.
Report repeated delivery issues, quality problems, shortages, or unauthorized substitutions to the Purchasing team.
Ensure suppliers follow hotel delivery procedures, hygiene standards, and designated delivery times.
8. Food Safety and Hygiene
Follow hotel food safety, HACCP, hygiene, and sanitation procedures.
Ensure food and beverage deliveries are inspected according to established standards.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the receiving area.
Ensure appropriate personal hygiene and protective equipment requirements are followed.
Immediately report any food safety or hygiene concerns to the responsible manager.
9. Financial and Internal Controls
Ensure no goods are accepted without proper authorization or supporting documentation, except where approved by management.
Maintain accurate receiving records to support invoice processing and payment.
Identify and report discrepancies between Purchase Orders, Goods Received Notes, and supplier invoices.
Support internal and external audits by providing accurate receiving documentation.
Follow hotel policies and procedures related to purchasing, receiving, inventory, and financial controls.
10. General Responsibilities
Maintain confidentiality of hotel and supplier information.
Follow all hotel policies, procedures, and operational standards.
Maintain a professional relationship with colleagues, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
Participate in training and development programs as required.
Assist with other duties related to receiving, stores, purchasing, and inventory as assigned by management.
Ensure all work is completed accurately, efficiently, and within established deadlines.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Accuracy of receiving records and system entries.
Compliance with Purchase Order procedures.
Accuracy of quantities received.
Number and value of receiving discrepancies.
Compliance with food safety and quality standards.
Timeliness of receiving and documentation.
Proper handling of rejected and damaged goods.
Accuracy of inventory and receiving records.
Compliance with hotel and cluster policies and internal controls.
Qualifications and Experience
High school diploma or equivalent; diploma/certificate in hospitality, accounting, purchasing, or supply chain is an advantage.
Previous experience in hotel receiving, stores, purchasing, inventory, or a similar hospitality position is preferred.
Experience with hotel purchasing/inventory systems is an advantage.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Good numerical and documentation skills.
Knowledge of food safety and HACCP procedures is an advantage.
Skills and Competencies
Attention to detail and accuracy.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced hotel environment.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to identify discrepancies and resolve receiving issues.
Good understanding of inventory and receiving procedures.
Ability to work effectively with multiple hotel departments.
Professional and ethical approach to handling goods and documentation.
Ability to work independently and as part of a cluster team.
Working Conditions
The position requires regular movement between the receiving area, stores, and hotel operational areas.
The employee may be required to handle or inspect food, beverage, housekeeping, engineering, and general supplies.
The position may involve working in chilled or refrigerated areas when receiving perishable products.
Flexibility to work according to hotel operational requirements, including weekends and public holidays when required.

Location: Abha, Saudi Arabia

Help healthcare professionals deliver better hearing outcomes

Cochlear develops implantable hearing solutions that help people experience a world of sound. We are looking for a Clinical Technical Specialist to provide expert support to surgeons, audiologists and other healthcare professionals across the South Region of Saudi Arabia.

* Facilitate workshops, hands-on sessions and clinical education programmes.
* Support the introduction and effective use of new products and software.
* Build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, clinical champions and other stakeholders.
* Contribute clinical expertise to account planning, tenders, reimbursement discussions and market-development opportunities.
* Represent Cochlear at relevant professional meetings, conferences and educational events.
* Maintain accurate activity and case-support records.
* Work in accordance with Cochlear’s quality and safety procedures, relevant ethical standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

  

This is a highly mobile field position involving extensive travel across the South Region, including overnight travel and possible travel elsewhere in Saudi Arabia.

  

**What you will bring**

  

You will have:

* A degree in audiology, biomedical engineering, healthcare sciences or another relevant field, with audiology highly preferred.
* Two to three years of relevant experience in clinical audiology or a clinical, technical or customer-facing healthcare environment.
* Experience supporting surgical procedures or working in surgical environments.
* Strong presentation, training and communication skills.
* Professional fluency in Arabic and English.
* The ability to build credible, lasting relationships with healthcare professionals.
* The confidence to work independently and manage changing priorities across a field-based territory.
* A valid driving licence, or the ability to obtain the locally required licence.
* The willingness and flexibility to travel extensively.

  

Audiologists must hold a current Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) audiology licence.

  

**Experience that would be advantageous**

It would be helpful if you have experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking a highly experienced **Senior Civil Engineer** - Saudi National to join our growing team in Tabuk. In this role, you will provide senior-level technical expertise, oversight, and design coordination for massive infrastructure and site development projects. You will be responsible for leading civil engineering design reviews, managing infrastructure master planning elements, and ensuring that construction activities strictly align with project specifications, international codes, and safety standards.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead and oversee civil engineering design elements, including site grading, drainage systems, roadways, earthworks, and wet utility networks.

* **Experience:** Minimum of 10 years of progressive civil engineering experience, with significant exposure to large-scale infrastructure mega-projects, land development..
    
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced proficiency in civil engineering design software, including Civil 3D, AutoCAD, and various hydraulic modeling tools. Deep understanding of international standards (AASHTO, ASTM) and the Saudi Building Code (SBC).

* **Attributes:** Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to deliver results within tight schedules on high-profile developments in Tabuk.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Cost Manager** to join our team! In this role you will get to support project cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, change management, and financial reporting throughout the project lifecycle. You will play a key role in ensuring accurate cost monitoring, analysis, and reporting to support effective project delivery, financial performance, and informed decision-making across major infrastructure and construction projects.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Support the development and maintenance of project budgets, cost plans, cost estimates, and cost control baselines.
    
* Monitor project costs, commitments, expenditures, accruals, forecasts, and approved budgets throughout the project lifecycle.
    
* Track budget utilization and identify potential cost variances, trends, and financial risks.
    
* Assist in preparing cost estimates, cash flow forecasts, expenditure plans, and project funding requirements.
    
* Maintain alignment between project scope, Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), schedules, and cost data.
    
* Prepare periodic cost reports, dashboards, financial summaries, and project performance reports.
    
* Perform cost variance analysis and identify cost trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended corrective actions.
    
* Support the preparation of Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC) forecasts.
    
* Assist in developing project performance metrics and executive management reports.
    
* Maintain accurate cost records, supporting documentation, and reporting databases.
    
* Support the evaluation of design changes, variations, scope modifications, and change requests.
    
* Review contractor quotations and variation submissions from a cost engineering perspective.
    
* Maintain change registers, variation logs, and cost tracking records.
    
* Assist in preparing cost impact assessments, commercial evaluations, and management recommendations.
    
* Coordinate with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, and Project Controls teams to ensure consistent project cost reporting.
    
* Support Earned Value Management (EVM) analysis and cost performance measurement.
    
* Maintain alignment between project schedules, progress reporting, forecasts, and cost reports.
    
* Participate in project reviews, progress meetings, cost workshops, and commercial discussions.
    
* Assist in identifying project cost risks and support the development of mitigation strategies.
    
* Support contingency monitoring, risk-based forecasting, and scenario analysis activities.
    
* Contribute to value engineering and cost optimization initiatives to improve project performance.
    
* Monitor project cash flow requirements and expenditure trends.
    
* Maintain project cost records, approvals, forecasts, supporting documentation, and commercial records.
    
* Support project audits, financial reviews, governance activities, and compliance requirements.
    
* Assist with final account preparation, project closeout reporting, and financial reconciliation.
    
* Contribute to lessons learned, cost benchmarking, and continuous improvement initiatives.
    
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Cost Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
    
* Minimum **25 years** work experience, which entails in Cost Engineering, Project Controls, Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, or related disciplines.
    
* Experience supporting large-scale construction, infrastructure, industrial, or capital projects.
    
* Experience monitoring project costs, commitments, expenditures, and forecasts.
    
* Knowledge of project budgeting, cost planning, and financial reporting principles.
    
* Experience supporting cost variance analysis and project performance reporting.
    

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and project controls methodologies.
    
* Experience maintaining cost records, change registers, and commercial documentation.
    
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
    
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
    
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
    
* Experience using project controls and cost management software is preferred.
    
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams and stakeholders.

Join CAE Middle East as a Senior Flight Simulator Engineer and help establish the technical operations supporting **Riyadh Air’s new training centre in Saudi** **Arabia**.

This role offers exposure to a wide range of modern simulators, systems, and equipment, providing opportunities for learning, development, and progression within the technical function.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Support the Flight Simulator Training Devices and Other Training Devices: Attend maintenance calls, device setup, conversions, demos, assist during Simulator Flight Tests, support snag clearance activities, etc…
* Independently perform the Preventive Maintenance Tasks (PMTs), Daily Readiness (DR), Recurrent QTG runs, Aircraft Database (ADB) updates, & IOS Lesson Plan (LP) updates on the training devices & associated systems. Ensure that all tasks are carried out according to the standards. Ensure that deficiencies associated with these tasks are followed up, actioned, and closed in a timely manner.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve training device issues, including AOGs and NAA raised issues. Perform hardware refurbishment, and modifications. Identify recurring issues and work to pursue permanent solutions. Monitor SimHub/Simissues for updates & use the Computerized Maintenance Management System to record, track, review, update, & monitor deficiencies and other maintenance activities. Produce reports for TCOPS Management to monitor performance and identify trends.
* May be assigned to the role of Shift Lead, Team Lead, Device Caretaker or Task Caretaker. Manage all aspects of the assigned role autonomously. Create, improve, or update procedures & guidelines for new, routine, and non-routine tasks.
* Work with the FSTD Technical Specialists on issues that require testing, troubleshooting. Take on special projects based on the needs of the Training Center Operation.
* Mentor & provide On-the-Job Training (OJT) to more junior colleagues. Provide support for work on more complex tasks & during corrective maintenance tasks. Pursue knowledge and skills to strive to become a technical expert in one or more FSTD system. (i.e. Visual, Motion, Flt Controls, QTGs, etc…)
* Comply with local & global CAE Environmental Health & Safety standards, instructions, and safe working procedures. Exercise duty of care for own H&S, and that of others who may be affected by his/her work.
* Prioritize, plan, & coordinate most maintenance tasks, regularly review and update all issues for planning purposes, generate reports for review during technical meetings, ensure that the training devices are ready for NAA recurrent evaluations, make sure that all maintenance records are up-to-date.
* Ensure that all training devices achieve the CAE, Departmental, and Service Level Agreement KPIs. Ensure that all projects and DRs are worked on, addressed, and brought to closure in a timely manner.  Make sure that authority and customer business critical issues are cleared within specified targets.
* Participate in weekly technical meetings, NAA evaluations, internal/external audits, & SLA review meetings with CAE upper management and/or the customer. Act as Deputy Manager or Group Leader Technical Operations in his/her absence.  Work with CAE Customer Service to follow-up on business-critical issues.
* Assist and actively participate in the yearly performance evaluation of the team and individuals.  Assist the Manager or Group Leader Technical Operations in the generation of the employee development plan. Mentor and share knowledge with fellow engineers and technicians in order to develop their skillsets. Develop technical workshops and provide on the job training to FSTD Support Staff.

* Technical College Diploma or Degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical/Aerospace Field and at least 7 years of related work experience.

* Excellent knowledge of the English Language, both spoken and written.
* Highly engaged and motivated individual.
* Highly customer oriented and must be able to deal tactfully in sensitive situations.
* Excellent workmanship and strong contributor within a team environment.
* Demonstrate initiative and the ability to work under minimal supervision.
* Able to work flexible shifts and adapt to changing work schedules and shift patterns.

* Knowledge of Analog and Digital principles and theory.

* Able to mentor and provide On the Job Training to more junior colleagues.
* Must be skilled in the use of test equipment, and software diagnostics tools.
* Good understanding and comprehension of Aircraft Systems, Avionics, Motion, and Visual Systems.
* Good computer skills with knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, etc…)
* Basic knowledge of computer mainframe/architecture, networking, operating systems (Windows NT/XP, UNIX, Linux, AIX), and software languages (C, C++, FORTRAN).
* Strong knowledge of local & International (EASA, FAA, etc) regulations pertaining to Flight Simulation Training Devices.

**What CAE Offers**

The Quality Manager will be responsible for overseeing and maintaining quality across both site execution and project documentation within the program.

The role will provide quality oversight across all ongoing projects and Task Orders, ensuring that works, materials, inspections, testing, and project records comply with approved drawings, specifications, contractual requirements, applicable standards, and Client requirements.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Site Quality**

• Lead and monitor quality activities across all ongoing site works.

• Conduct regular site inspections and quality surveillance to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, material approvals, and inspection requirements.

• Monitor the performance of contractors and supervision teams in relation to workmanship and quality requirements.

• Identify defective, incomplete, or non-compliant works and ensure appropriate NCRs, observations, and corrective actions are raised and properly closed.

• Monitor recurring quality issues, identify root causes, and ensure preventive actions are implemented.

  

**Documentation Quality**

• Monitor the quality, accuracy, and completeness of project and technical documentation.

• Conduct periodic reviews of WIRs, MIRs, NCRs, RFIs, material submittals, method statements, inspection records, test reports, and other quality-related documentation.

• Ensure WIRs and inspection records accurately reflect the actual works executed on site, including quantities, locations, inspection status, and supporting records.

• Ensure approvals are supported by the required technical evidence and are not processed only for administrative closure.

• Ensure that current approved drawings, specifications, and material submittals are being used on site.

  

**Quality Audits & Monitoring**

• Establish and maintain practical quality procedures, checklists, and monitoring requirements across the program.

• Conduct periodic quality audits covering both site activities and project documentation.

• Monitor contractors’ QA/QC implementation and compliance with project requirements.

• Maintain and monitor NCRs, quality observations, audit findings, and corrective actions.

• Identify recurring or systemic quality issues and escalate them for management attention.

Reporting & Coordination

• Report regularly to the Program Director on site quality, documentation status, NCRs, recurring deficiencies, risks, and required corrective actions.

• Immediately escalate significant quality issues that may affect delivery, cost, schedule, functionality, handover, or Client acceptance.

• Maintain quality KPIs and provide clear visibility of quality performance across the program.

  

**Qualifications & Experience:**

  

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or a relevant technical discipline.

• Minimum 10–12 years of relevant construction and project quality experience, preferably within consultancy, PMCM, or site supervision environments.

• Strong practical experience in QA/QC for multidisciplinary construction, refurbishment, fit-out, MEP, and operational projects.

• Good understanding of quality management principles and project quality procedures.

• Strong knowledge of WIRs, MIRs, NCRs, RFIs, method statements, material approvals, inspection and testing requirements, snagging, and project close-out.

• Experience reviewing and auditing both physical site works and project documentation.

• Strong reporting, coordination, and communication skills.

• Ability to identify and challenge non-compliance and drive corrective actions through to closure.

• Quality-related certification or auditing experience would be an advantage but is not mandatory.

On-site –Riyadh, SAU

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Controls Senior Manager / Lead** to join our team!

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Responsible for developing, managing and/or executing all phases of the project controls effort (planning/scheduling, cost analysis, and document control management).

* Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken.

* Requires basic engineering knowledge in infrastructure related field.
* Proficient PC skills including a proficiency in various Project Controls Software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Proven ability to perform in a supervisory capacity, as well as thorough knowledge of industry practices is required.
