**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Pavement Lead Engineer** to lead the pavement engineering design review, technical coordination, construction support, and quality assurance activities for a major Airport, Infrastructure, and Airfield Development Project. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the design, evaluation, and delivery of airfield pavements including runways, taxiways, aircraft parking stands, cargo aprons, service roads, and associated pavement infrastructure.

The Pavement Lead Engineer will provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring pavement systems are designed and constructed in accordance with airport operational requirements, ICAO and FAA standards, project specifications, and international best practices. The role requires extensive experience in airport pavement design, rehabilitation, construction supervision, materials evaluation, and multidisciplinary coordination within complex aviation environments.

## **What You'll Be Doing:**

* Lead and manage pavement engineering activities associated with airport airfield infrastructure and landside developments.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to pavement engineers, designers, consultants, and contractors.
* Establish pavement engineering priorities, technical review processes, and quality requirements.
* Ensure pavement engineering deliverables align with project objectives, contractual requirements, and operational needs.

* Lead the review and assessment of pavement designs for runways, taxiways, aprons, aircraft stands, and airport service roads.
* Review pavement design calculations, technical reports, material specifications, drawings, and engineering submissions.
* Evaluate flexible, rigid, and composite pavement solutions considering aircraft loading, operational requirements, and lifecycle performance.
* Review pavement thickness design, structural capacity, durability, and maintenance considerations.
* Ensure compliance with ICAO Annex 14, FAA Advisory Circulars, and applicable international pavement standards.

* Review pavement material specifications including asphalt mixtures, concrete pavement, aggregates, subgrade improvement, and stabilization techniques.
* Assess laboratory test results, material approvals, and quality control documentation.
* Review pavement performance requirements considering aircraft movements, environmental conditions, and operational demands.
* Support development of sustainable pavement solutions and optimization of material usage.
* Coordinate pavement engineering requirements for:
    * Runways and runway shoulders.
    * Taxiways and rapid exit taxiways.
    * Cargo aprons and aircraft parking stands.
    * Maintenance areas and airfield operational facilities.

* Ensure pavement interfaces are properly coordinated with airfield lighting, drainage systems, utilities, and aircraft operational requirements.
* Support phased construction planning to maintain airport operational continuity.
* Provide pavement engineering support during construction, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.

* Review contractor submissions including shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, and technical queries.
* Monitor pavement construction activities including earthworks, subgrade preparation, asphalt works, concrete paving, and testing activities.
* Conduct site inspections to verify compliance with approved designs, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Support resolution of pavement-related technical issues during construction.

* Ensure pavement works comply with project specifications, quality standards, and airport operational requirements.
* Review pavement testing results including compaction, density, concrete strength, asphalt performance, and material testing.
* Participate in quality audits, inspections, and technical reviews.
* Monitor contractor compliance with approved construction procedures and quality control plans.
* Support implementation of corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Coordinate with the Client, airport authorities, consultants, contractors, designers, and regulatory agencies regarding pavement engineering matters.
* Support technical approvals, design reviews, and authority submissions.
* Participate in pavement workshops, technical meetings, and coordination sessions.
* Provide technical advice to support timely decision-making.

* Prepare and review pavement engineering reports, technical assessments, design review comments, and recommendations.
* Maintain records of pavement design approvals, technical decisions, testing results, and construction observations.
* Provide regular updates to Project Management regarding pavement progress, risks, and technical challenges.
* Support preparation of asset handover documentation and pavement maintenance records.

* Promote a strong safety culture throughout pavement engineering activities.
* Ensure pavement designs and construction activities incorporate Safety-in-Design principles.
* Support compliance with airport HSE requirements, environmental regulations, and sustainability objectives.
* Participate in risk assessments, constructability reviews, and operational safety evaluations.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in **Civil Engineering** or related Engineering discipline.
* Master's Degree in Pavement Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering is an advantage.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in pavement engineering design, review, and construction supervision.
* Proven experience on major airport, airfield, transportation, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Extensive experience with airport pavement systems including runways, taxiways, aprons, aircraft stands, and associated infrastructure.
* Experience in pavement design evaluation, construction monitoring, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, contractors, consultants, and airport stakeholders.

* Strong knowledge of airport pavement design principles and construction methodologies.
* Detailed understanding of flexible, rigid, and composite pavement systems.
* Knowledge of aircraft loading analysis, pavement classification systems, and pavement performance evaluation.
* Familiarity with pavement design software such as FAARFIELD, COMFAA, Pavement ME Design, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ICAO Annex 14, FAA AC 150/5320 series, ACI, ASTM, and international pavement standards.
* Experience with BIM coordination and digital engineering processes.
* Strong analytical, technical review, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities within a complex airport project environment.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent professional registration.
* International airport pavement design and delivery experience.
* Experience with major airport expansion, greenfield airport development, or airfield rehabilitation projects.
* Knowledge of aircraft pavement evaluation methods and pavement management systems.
* Experience working under FIDIC or similar international contract frameworks.
* Experience supporting Design-Build, EPC, PMC, or Delivery Partner project delivery models.
* Familiarity with sustainable pavement solutions, recycled materials, and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and airport authority coordination experience.

## Company Description

Roland Berger, founded in 1967, is the only leading consultancy with German heritage and European origin. By joining Roland Berger, you choose an employer who has supported diversity of cultures, mentalities, and perspectives since its founding. We believe that great ideas and new perspectives are inspired by diverse teams from a variety of backgrounds. That's why we want you to be authentic, be yourself. Be the Original You.

## Job Description

Roland Berger Middle East is seeking a proactive and driven **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to join our Riyadh office. This role will support the firm's growth by managing the full recruitment lifecycle across consulting and management functions, while playing a key role in talent sourcing, market mapping, and candidate engagement.

The successful candidate will partner closely with hiring managers and leadership teams to identify, attract, assess, and hire top talent across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East region. The role combines strategic sourcing with end-to-end recruitment ownership, from talent identification and screening through offer management and onboarding coordination.

A strong interest in recruitment technology, talent analytics, employer branding, and AI-enabled recruitment tools will be highly valued.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing and screening through interviews, offer rollout, and onboarding coordination.
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand current and future hiring requirements across consulting and management functions.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies to identify high-caliber talent through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, direct outreach, and other talent channels.
* Conduct market mapping and talent research to identify target talent pools and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates.
* Screen and assess candidate qualifications, experience, and cultural fit through interviews and evaluation processes.
* Coordinate interview processes and work closely with interviewers to ensure an efficient and positive candidate experience.
* Support offer preparation, compensation discussions, approval processes, and offer rollouts.
* Build and maintain relationships with passive candidates for future hiring opportunities.
* Drive Saudization hiring initiatives and support the attraction of high-potential Saudi talent.
* Partner with universities, student organizations, and professional associations to support campus recruitment and employer branding initiatives.
* Manage recruitment activities through the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and ensure data accuracy.
* Prepare recruitment reports, hiring analytics, pipeline insights, and market intelligence for leadership.
* Leverage AI-powered recruitment tools and data-driven insights to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and overall recruitment efficiency.
* Support employer branding initiatives, recruitment events, networking activities, and talent attraction campaigns.

## Qualifications

**Experience Required**

* Saudi National.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end recruitment processes across multiple functions and seniority levels.
* Experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, talent databases, professional networks, and direct search methodologies.
* Experience within consulting, professional services, executive search, or other fast-paced environments is preferred.
* Previous exposure to campus recruitment and graduate hiring programs is advantageous.
* Strong understanding of recruitment best practices, assessment methodologies, and candidate management.

**Skills and Attributes**

* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent communication, interviewing, and influencing capabilities.
* Proactive and self-driven with strong organizational skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate recruitment data into meaningful insights.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
* Collaborative team player with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Passion for identifying and attracting top talent.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS); SmartRecruiters experience is preferred.
* Advanced LinkedIn Recruiter and candidate sourcing capabilities.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience creating recruitment dashboards, reports, and talent pipeline trackers.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled recruitment tools, talent intelligence platforms, and recruitment automation solutions is a strong advantage.
* Knowledge of recruitment analytics, sourcing metrics, and workforce planning principles is a plus.

12

The Revenue Solution Architect (RSA) serves as a technical expert within the Revenue organization, forging close partnerships with Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology and our Enterprise Data Organization. In this position, you will be responsible for translating customer objectives into well-scoped and implementable technical solution designs that align to established product capabilities and supported architectures. The role is execution-oriented; producing high quality technical discovery outputs, solution designs and technical validations that reduce delivery risk and improve deal velocity and progression.

Primary Focus

* Execute solution architecture for opportunities and customer engagement by mapping customer objectives to approved product capabilities, standard integration patterns, and delivery approaches.
* Produce clear, repeatable architecture artifacts (diagrams, integration flows, assumptions, risks, NFRs) that improve alignment and speed decisions during the sales cycle.

Support solution-led customer conversations by shifting discussions from features to workflows/outcomes using existing technical GTM narratives and playbooks.  


**Revenue & Deal Enablement**

* Partner with Sales/Account teams to support customer engagement through technical qualification, requirements clarification, and solution shaping aligned to existing plays.
* Help improve deal velocity by preparing technical inputs that reduce ambiguity (assumptions, dependencies, sizing inputs, sequencing).
* Support deal execution by participating in customer technical meetings and responding to technical questions

**Customer & Commercial Problem Solving**

* Build working knowledge of customer workflows and map them to solution capabilities to support measurable outcomes.
* Assist in resolving technical objections by providing evidence-based responses grounded in platform capability, reference patterns, and prior implementations (where available).

* Support retention/expansion motions by identifying adoption blockers and aligning on remediation steps with Account and Revenue teams

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Technology partners to ensure proposed solutions are deployable and supportable within current capabilities and standards.
* Contribute structured feedback from customer/deal learnings into internal forums (pattern gaps, recurring requirements, common integration issues).
* Support Revenue teams with clear documentation and execution/follow up on open questions and solution design capability

**Revenue Acceleration and Enablement**

* Apply standard solution patterns to reduce rework and delivery risk; document reusable modules and lessons learned in knowledge repositories
* Support prototypes/POCs by following established methodology, validating feasibility, and documenting results and limitations
* Help standardize technical discovery and architecture documentation within the team by consistent use of approved formats.
* Contribute to playbooks, documentation and training for revenue-wide capability building

**Required Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years in pre-sales solution architecture, technical sales enablement, technology and/or GTM architecture
* Technical fluency in cloud platforms **(AWS, Azure, GCP)** , hyperscalers and modern orchestration approaches.
* Working fluency in **AI/automation** concepts, including agentic frameworks and orchestration tools, with the ability to translate capabilities into deployable client solutions.
* Ability to produce and review core technical artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration flows, NFRs (performance, availability, security) and implementation approach notes.
* Experience with communicating with mixed audiences (technical and commercial) and deliver concise written outputs that support deal progression.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed environment by coordinating inputs across Sales, Product and Technology to meet fast paced opportunity timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking a highly specialized and experienced **GIS Manager - Saudi National** to join our critical team on the prestigious Qiddiya Project in Riyadh.

The GIS Manager leads complex production planning and delivery of geographic information system (GIS) services for large programs and projects. This role oversees sector‑wide GIS production, staffing coordination and technical guidance, using GIS principles, techniques and analyses to drive team productivity and ensure high‑quality geospatial deliverables.

The GIS Manager functions as the primary technical authority on GIS matters, defining data models, workflows and standards, and ensuring that spatial data is accurate, validated and fit for reliable analysis and decision‑making.  


## What you'll be doing:

* Oversee management of sector‑wide GIS initiatives, GIS production, functionalities, troubleshooting, practices and procedures.
* Provide expert guidance and assume responsibility for the quality of GIS deliverables developed for the program/project.
* Perform in a lead capacity for geospatial model delivery, management and integration with other digital models.
* Determine methods and solutions for complex GIS mapping challenges and select the most efficient plan for implementation.
* Participate in budget and cost forecasting analysis in support of the management team.
* Support preparation of competitive technical and commercial proposals, including GIS scope, approach and resource estimates.
* Communicate project objectives, plans and status to the project team and management, ensuring alignment on GIS activities and deliverables.
* Assist in developing initial level‑of‑effort estimates required to cover all GIS work within the proposed scope, with minimal supervision.
* Continuously monitor, evaluate and improve GIS delivery, identifying opportunities for automation, optimization and innovation.
* Provide leadership in defining data types, relationships, constraints and indexes to enable efficient querying and spatial analysis.
* Monitor team assignments and productivity; support management in organizing staffing/resource assignments for GIS tasks.
* Train and develop team members, including:
* Developing training plans and supervising training needs assessments
* Creating detailed training manuals and GIS tutorial videos
* Providing advanced technical support and coaching in the use of GIS systems, software and databases
* Manage spatial accuracy of data representations to ensure reliable spatial analysis.
* Advance and confirm data completeness and validation for robust spatial analysis and decision‑making.
* Serve as subject matter expert and primary contact for client(s) and agencies on all technical GIS matters.
* Generate detailed reports on GIS delivery, including key performance indicators (KPIs) and progress metrics.
* Oversee development of model builders and customized tools to streamline geospatial tasks and workflows.
* Oversee implementation and optimization of database design and administration processes for spatial data.
* Manage databases to maintain accuracy, consistency and integrity of geospatial data.
* Oversee management and tracking of task assignments, data management activities, preparation of data model structures and data transformation processes.
* Oversee definition and enforcement of topology rules to maintain data integrity and spatial accuracy.
* Maintain a risk‑averse approach while reviewing geospatial outputs and proposing mitigation solutions for identified risks.
* Collaborate with project teams for effective integration of GIS models with engineering, BIM and other digital models.
* Perform in an advisory capacity to senior management on GIS‑related work matters, including strategy, technology adoption and resourcing.
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

**What required skills you'll bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Geomatics, Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent work experience).
* 10 years of related work experience in GIS, spatial data management or geospatial analysis, including significant experience on large programs/projects.
* Expert knowledge of commonly used core GIS, Computer‑Aided Design (CAD) and Building Information Management (BIM) software/database packages and workflows.
* Expert knowledge of complex GIS production for large programs and projects, including multi‑site and multi‑disciplinary environments.
* Ability to apply concepts to assignments including:
* Developing and managing workflows and processes
* Troubleshooting and providing innovative solutions
* Conducting capacity and capability assessments for GIS task teams
* Staying current with emerging GIS technologies and setting GIS priorities
* Advanced skill in programming and scripting languages for GIS and automation tasks (e.g. Python, JavaScript).
* Ability to perform in a managerial capacity for database delivery, with effective leadership and organizational skills.
* Effective leadership skills; capable of directing, guiding and supervising production staff in geospatial work.
* Proficiency in building information modelling software and understanding of GIS–BIM data integration principles.
* Ability to lead and direct staff on GIS systems, software/technologies, database use and best practices.
* Ability to generate detailed reports on GIS delivery for projects/programs, including KPI reporting and tracking.
* Expert proficiency in various hardware and software used in GIS, CAD and BIM, and ability to manage hardware and software deployments in coordination with IT and responsible parties.
* Ability to confirm that security settings and dedicated server sites for GIS data are effectively managed.
* Expert understanding of Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) standard practices and procedures; capable of guiding staff on quality implementation.
* Strong understanding of desktop, web and mobile GIS applications, and associated workbenches/tools.
* Ability to stay engaged with current technology and industry trends as they apply to GIS practices and standards.
* Ability to communicate modelling, survey and GIS technical and non‑technical subjects clearly with management, engineering and production staff.

Position: Document Controller
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Department: Projects / Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

About CSI Global

CSI Global is a leading engineering and technical services company specializing in Testing, Adjusting & Balancing (TAB), Testing & Commissioning (Cx), Independent Commissioning Authority (ICA), MEP diagnostics, and engineering services across the GCC and international markets.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Document Controller to support our project and engineering teams by ensuring the accurate control, tracking, filing, distribution, and retrieval of project documentation.

Position Overview

The Document Controller will be responsible for maintaining an efficient document management system for project-related technical and administrative documents. The role involves coordinating with project managers, engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients to ensure documents are properly reviewed, approved, distributed, and archived in accordance with project requirements and company procedures.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain project documentation, including technical, engineering, commercial, and administrative documents.

• Receive, register, classify, distribute, and track incoming and outgoing documents.

• Maintain accurate document registers, logs, transmittals, and revision records.

• Ensure all documents are properly numbered, named, formatted, and filed according to company and project procedures.

• Control document revisions and ensure the latest approved versions are available to relevant project teams.

• Coordinate the submission and retrieval of documents between CSI, clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders.

• Prepare and issue document transmittals for drawings, reports, technical submissions, method statements, inspection documents, and other project deliverables.

• Track document review and approval status and follow up on pending submissions.

• Maintain electronic and hard-copy filing systems and ensure documents are easily accessible when required.

• Support project teams in preparing documentation for inspections, testing, commissioning, and project handover.

• Maintain records of RFIs, submittals, technical reports, drawings, approvals, correspondence, meeting minutes, and other project records.

• Ensure obsolete or superseded documents are appropriately identified and archived.

• Assist in preparing project documentation for final handover and close-out.

• Ensure document control activities comply with CSI procedures, client requirements, and project-specific document control standards.

• Coordinate with project teams to identify missing, incomplete, or overdue documentation.

• Generate periodic document control reports and provide updates to project management.

• Maintain confidentiality and integrity of sensitive project information.

• Perform other document control and administrative duties as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications

• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, or a related field .

• 3+ years of experience as a Document Controller, preferably within MEP, construction, engineering, testing & commissioning, or infrastructure projects .

• Good understanding of document control processes and project documentation.

• Experience working with document registers, transmittals, revision control, and document tracking systems.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word .

• Experience with document management systems or platforms such as SharePoint, Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore, or similar systems is an advantage.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple documents, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced project environment.

Preferred Skills

• Knowledge of MEP and Testing & Commissioning documentation .

• Familiarity with engineering drawings, technical reports, inspection records, and commissioning documentation.

• Experience working with consultants, contractors, and clients.

• Strong follow-up and coordination skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary project team.

• Knowledge of document numbering and project filing standards.

Key Competencies

• Document Management

• Attention to Detail

• Organization & Time Management

• Communication & Coordination

• Data Accuracy

• Follow-Up & Reporting

• Microsoft Office Skills

• Confidentiality & Information Management

• Teamwork and Collaboration

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work with a growing international engineering and technical services organization.

• Exposure to major MEP, infrastructure, testing, and commissioning projects.

• Professional and collaborative working environment.

• Opportunities for career development and growth.

## Overview

The Senior Structural Design Manager will lead the structural design development and delivery of large-scale hospitality and mixed-use developments across KSA. This role is responsible for managing all structural engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring technical excellence, design efficiency, constructability, compliance with local and international standards, and seamless integration with architectural, MEP, and other project disciplines.

The successful candidate will oversee structural consultants, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure that innovative, safe, and cost-effective structural solutions support the project's vision, quality standards, schedule, and budget objectives.

## Your Role

* Lead the structural design vision and engineering strategy from concept through detailed design, tender, and construction stages.

### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya closes the loop with proprietary NLU technology built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations. This enables marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

As we continue scaling globally, the reliability, performance, and resilience of our infrastructure become mission-critical to everything we do.

**Why this role matters**

At Lucidya, our platform processes massive volumes of real-time customer data. Any downtime, latency, or instability directly impacts our customers’ ability to make decisions and serve their own users.

This role exists to make sure that doesn’t happen.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll sit at the heart of our platform’s stability, owning the reliability of our cloud infrastructure and ensuring it scales seamlessly as we grow. You won’t just react to issues; you’ll anticipate them, design systems that prevent them, and build automation that removes them entirely.

If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, eliminating inefficiencies, and building systems that “just work” - this is where you’ll thrive.

### What You’ll Do

You’ll be responsible for outcomes, not just tasks. Here’s what success looks like in this role:

**You’ll make reliability the default**

* You’ll design and maintain infrastructure that is highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable
* You’ll proactively identify and eliminate single points of failure before they become incidents

* You’ll ensure our production systems remain stable, even under increasing scale and load

**You’ll own and optimize our cloud environments**

* You’ll manage and continuously improve workloads across AWS, GCP, or Azure
* You’ll use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to standardize and scale infrastructure
* You’ll optimize resource usage to balance performance and cost

**You’ll run and improve Kubernetes in production**

* You’ll operate and scale Kubernetes clusters (EKS, GKE, etc.) with confidence
* You’ll troubleshoot issues quickly and ensure smooth deployments and upgrades
* You’ll ensure our containerized workloads perform reliably at scale

**You’ll build strong observability and respond to incidents**

* You’ll implement and refine monitoring systems using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK
* You’ll define alerting that is meaningful, not noisy
* You’ll respond to incidents, lead root cause analysis, and ensure we learn from every failure

**You’ll automate everything that shouldn’t be manual**

* You’ll write scripts and build tooling to eliminate repetitive operational work
* You’ll continuously improve infrastructure efficiency through automation
* You’ll promote a culture where manual work is a temporary state, not the norm

**You’ll collaborate to improve the entire system**

* You’ll work closely with DevOps and engineering teams to solve performance bottlenecks
* You’ll contribute to CI/CD improvements and deployment reliability
* You’ll help shape reliability best practices across the organization

### What success looks like (First 90 Days)

**First 30 days:**

* You’ve built a strong understanding of our infrastructure, systems, and workflows
* You’re contributing to day-to-day operations with support from the team
* You’ve started identifying areas for improvement in automation and reliability

**By 90 days:**

* You’re independently managing infrastructure tasks and troubleshooting issues
* You’re actively contributing to reliability and scalability improvements
* You’ve taken ownership of parts of our infrastructure and are improving them

**Requirements**

### Who You Are

**This is what will make you successful in this role:**

* You’ve spent ~3 years working in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, and you’ve seen what breaks at scale
* You’re comfortable working in cloud environments like AWS, GCP, or Azure—and you understand how distributed systems behave
* You’ve worked hands-on with Kubernetes in production and know how to troubleshoot it when things go wrong
* You don’t just fix issues - you ask why they happened and make sure they don’t happen again

**Technically, you likely:**

* Use Terraform (or similar IaC tools) to manage infrastructure
* Work confidently with Docker and Kubernetes
* Write scripts in Python, Bash, or similar to automate workflows
* Understand CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket, etc.)
* Have a solid grasp of networking, load balancing, and high-availability design

**When it comes to monitoring:**

* You’ve implemented tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK
* You know the difference between useful alerts and noise
* You focus on signals that actually drive action

**What sets you apart:**

* You take ownership - you don’t wait to be told something is broken
* You’re calm under pressure and methodical during incidents
* You simplify complexity instead of adding to it
* You communicate clearly, even when explaining deeply technical issues
* You care about building systems that make other engineers more effective

**Nice to Have (but not required)**

* Experience with RabbitMQ or Redis in production
* Familiarity with Ansible or AWX
* Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid environments
* Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP) or Linux certifications
* Background from ITI (Information Technology Institute)

Our client is an established Saudi Aramco onshore EPC contractor headquartered in the Eastern Province, with a long delivery record on the Onshore Maintain Potential Program (OMPP), cross-country pipelines, flowlines and well tie-in packages across the Northern and Southern Areas. * Fluent in Arabic and English.

job_title: Solutions Architect - Remote - Octopus by RTG
description:
We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical shape of complex, multi-service platform solutions from vision through to delivery.

This role sits between business intent and engineering execution. You will translate requirements into a coherent architecture, make and defend the decisions that constrain how the system is built, and stay engaged through implementation to ensure what ships matches what was designed. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect — comfortable in a client workshop in the morning and in a design review with engineers in the afternoon — who thinks in trade-offs rather than absolutes.

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for assigned platforms and workstreams, across application, data, integration, security and deployment concerns.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into architectural decisions, and make the trade-offs explicit.
* Produce and maintain formal architecture deliverables: architecture vision, high-level design, integration designs, and decision records.
* Define service boundaries, API contracts, data ownership and event models across a distributed system.
* Design integration with external and third-party systems, and define the adapter and anti-corruption patterns that keep the core insulated from them.
* Define the non-functional posture — scalability, availability, performance, resilience, observability — and ensure the design actually meets it.
* Embed security and compliance requirements into the architecture rather than bolting them on, working closely with security and risk stakeholders.
* Lead design reviews, guide engineering leads, and govern that implementation stays true to the agreed architecture.
* Evaluate technologies and vendors, and produce clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Identify and articulate architectural risks, assumptions, dependencies and open decisions, and drive them to closure.
* Support estimation, technical scoping and delivery planning alongside product and delivery leadership.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years in an architecture role on large, multi-service systems
* A background of building software yourself, with enough current depth to review code and design credibly.
* Strong command of distributed system design: microservices, service boundaries, API design and versioning, and event-driven architecture.
* Deep experience with a major backend ecosystem — Java and Spring Boot, or an equivalent enterprise platform.
* Strong data architecture skills: relational modelling, persistence strategy, transactional integrity and consistency trade-offs across services.
* Solid grasp of security architecture — identity and access management, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, authorization models, encryption and secrets management.
* Experience designing for cloud-native or containerized deployment (Kubernetes or OpenShift) and CI/CD delivery.
* Proven ability to produce clear architecture documentation and diagrams that engineers can actually build from.
* Excellent stakeholder communication — able to hold a technical position under challenge and explain it in plain language to a non-technical audience.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills..

job_title: Executive Director - Health and Safety Workers Welfare - 50010079CM5
description:
Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC), a PIF-backed giga project, is central to Saudi Vision 2030’s goal of building a vibrant society, thriving economy, and ambitious nation. By harnessing the power of Play, QIC brings entertainment, sports, and culture to the forefront in Qiddiya City—a futuristic destination featuring world-class attractions, sports complexes, cultural landmarks, and residential areas.

To lead the delivery Health, Safety, and Worker Welfare (HSWW) across Qiddiya's active construction portfolio, ensuring the effective implementation of HSWW standards, driving construction safety compliance and assurance, and overseeing incident response and worker welfare practices.

**Requirements**

Construction Safety Oversight and Risk Management

·        Ensure health and safety requirements established during the pre-construction phase, including Safety in Design outputs and contractor pre-qualification conditions, are actively integrated into construction execution activities across all active delivery programs, directing site teams and contractors to address identified risks before and during construction, in alignment with enterprise HSWW standards.

·        Oversee health and safety risk assessments for construction execution activities across all active programs, directing the assessment of site-specific hazards, construction methodologies, and project risk profiles to ensure appropriate controls are in place before high-risk activities initiate.

·        Lead the execution of delivery-phase safety audits and inspections in alignment with the enterprise assurance framework, directing selective audits based on contractor and vendor risk profiles and the safety sensitivity of the assets being delivered, to identify non-conformances and escalate findings to relevant stakeholders.

·        Ensure compliance with applicable national and international safety standards, worker welfare standards, and KSA labour laws across all delivery activities, directing regular compliance audits in alignment with the enterprise standardized audit approach and ensuring corrective action is taken where deviations are identified.

Site Inspection, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and Corrective Action Management

·        Lead the delivery HSWW inspection program across all active construction sites, directing regular inspections of workplace conditions, risk mitigation measure effectiveness, and adherence to safe work practices, to verify that enterprise HSWW standards are consistently applied across all contractors and delivery partners.

·        Oversee the PPE program across all active delivery programs, including the management of PPE procurement, distribution, compliance monitoring, and record-keeping, to ensure the construction workforce is protected across all site activities at all times.

·        Monitor corrective actions arising from site inspections, audits, incidents, safety simulations, and worker welfare grievances, ensuring all identified actions are assigned, progressed, and closed out within required timeframes to prevent recurrence and demonstrate continuous safety improvement.

Incident Investigation and Crisis Response

·        Lead the investigation of health and safety incidents involving on-site workers, by adhering to the enterprise incident investigation hierarchy, directing root cause analysis, incident classification, escalation measures, and the development of lessons learned for site-level incidents.

·        Oversee the implementation of corrective and preventive actions arising from incident investigations, ensuring findings are communicated to relevant stakeholders, and that lessons are escalated relevant stakeholders for organization-wide dissemination.

·        Lead site-based crisis communication and coordinate regulatory reporting in the event of serious incidents, ensuring that internal leadership, government authorities, and relevant regulatory bodies are informed accurately and in a timely manner in compliance with applicable reporting obligations.

·        Ensure the provision of emergency medical response capability for construction-related incidents across all active delivery programs, liaising with relevant stakeholders on medical services coverage and escalating any gaps in emergency response readiness to ensure workforce protection.

Delivery Safety Performance Monitoring and Occupational Health

·        Validate delivery HSWW key performance indicators, maintain performance dashboards, and consolidate safety data across all active construction programs, feeding accurate and timely performance information into the enterprise centralized reporting framework in order to support safety decision-making.

·        Define and maintain occupational health standards and guidelines applicable to Qiddiya's active delivery programs, ensuring health monitoring, exposure surveillance, and occupational health compliance requirements are embedded within contractor obligations and consistently applied across all active construction sites.

·        Liaise with relevant stakeholders to ensure delivery safety performance data, incident trends, corrective action status, and compliance outcomes are accurately reported and fed into the HSWW Project Control Group and leadership reporting cycles on a regular basis.

Skills and experience required:

·       Demonstrates fluency in written and verbal English, with proficiency in Arabic preferred.

·       Interprets complex information and analysis to guide functional strategy, inform decision-making, and address ambiguity within the scope of the function.

·       Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders, facilitating cross-functional collaboration and ensuring alignment on priorities and initiatives.

·       Leads teams to deliver high-quality work, promoting accountability, performance management, and continuous improvement.

·       Applies advanced knowledge of national and international construction safety standards, KSA labour laws, and occupational health frameworks applicable to active construction programs.

·       Demonstrates deep technical expertise in construction delivery safety management, encompassing site safety oversight, risk assessment, audit and inspection, PPE governance, and incident investigation.

·       Demonstrates strong incident governance and crisis management capabilities, ensuring significant safety events are appropriately responded to, investigated, and addressed to protect people, maintain compliance, and strengthen organizational resilience.

·       A minimum of 18 years of experience in health, safety, and worker welfare in large-scale international construction delivery projects, or related fields is required, including relevant years in a leadership role.

·       Demonstrated experience leading construction delivery safety functions within complex and diverse construction environments, including on-site safety oversight and risk assessment, compliance audit and inspection, PPE management, incident investigation and root cause analysis, corrective action management, crisis communication, occupational health standards application, and safety performance.

·       Professional certifications or memberships with recognized health, safety, construction, or occupational health institutes (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, CMIOSH, CIOB) are preferred.

·       Preferred: Master’s degree in Health and Safety, Engineering, Occupational Health, or a related field.

·       Required: Bachelor’s degree in Health and Safety, Engineering, or a related field

**Benefits**

Attractive benefits package

description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Senior Manager of Digital Health & Technology leads the definition, prioritisation and delivery readiness of QHC’s healthcare digital, data and technology requirements. The role translates clinical, operational and corporate priorities into clear technology requirements, delivery roadmaps, information flows and reporting needs, while coordinating with QIC / QTech on solution design, architecture alignment, implementation planning and service readiness.

In a healthcare startup, technology is a critical enabler of clinical operations, reporting, integration and patient experience. The role supports prioritization of the systems required across Sports Medicine, Citywide Healthcare and IHN, and tracks technology dependencies, delivery risks and readiness requirements.  Specifically, within Sport Medicine / Performance , technology is core infrastructure rather than a support afterthought: electronic health records, clinical and athlete-monitoring platforms, analytics and cybersecurity must be specified, procured, deployed and integrated to enable safe clinical delivery and evidence-based performance health. 

The role works closely with clinical, operations, finance and enabling teams to translate business and clinical needs into healthcare technology and data requirements, coordinating with function owners and QTech to ensure solutions are aligned with healthcare requirements and that data is usable for decision-making. The role also supports technology quality assurance, readiness and compliance with relevant healthcare-specific technology and data requirements.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1.  Digital Health Strategy & Technology Requirements**

•    Implement approved QHC Digital Blueprint and define QHC's health technology requirements and digital roadmap across clinical, operational and enabling domains, aligned with the organization's startup priorities and target operating model.

•    Translate clinical and business needs into technology specifications, architecture principles and a prioritized delivery plan.

•    Advise leadership on build-versus-leverage decisions across the QIC / QTech and partner ecosystem.

•    Coordinate with QTech and relevant function owners on interoperability and integration requirements across clinical, operational and administrative systems.

**3.  Data Management, Analytics & Business Intelligence**

•    Define QHC’s healthcare data requirements, information flows, data ownership and reporting needs across functions.

•    Define and coordinate analytics and reporting requirements that support data-driven clinical, operational and leadership decision-making.

•    Track data availability, quality, ownership and reporting gaps, coordinating with function owners to ensure healthcare data is usable for decision-making.

•    Support reporting and data needs across the organization as capability matures.

**4.  QTech / QIC SLA & Vendor Service Delivery**

•    Define, establish and manage service-level agreements with QIC / QTech and technology partners, ensuring strong, accountable service delivery to QHC.

•    Monitor vendor and partner performance against SLAs and drive remediation where service falls short.

•    Act as the primary QHC coordination point with QTech and relevant technology stakeholders on healthcare-specific technology requirements and delivery priorities.

**5.  Cybersecurity, Data Privacy & Governance**

•    In coordination with QIC, embed cybersecurity, data privacy and information-governance controls across all platforms and data flows from the outset.

•    In coordination with QIC, ensure compliance with Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulations and applicable international standards.

•    In coordination with QIC, establish access controls, audit trails and incident-response readiness for health and personal data.

**6.  Deployment, Integration & Readiness**

•    Oversee deployment and integration readiness for all technology, ensuring systems are tested, secure and operational ahead of go-live milestones.

•    Coordinate healthcare-specific testing and readiness activities with QTech and relevant clinical and operational teams.

•    Track technology readiness against the enterprise activation roadmap.

**7.  Innovation & Digital Enablement**

•    Identify and introduce digital health innovations — telehealth, remote athlete monitoring, wearables and AI-assisted tools — aligned with partner best practice.

•    Pilot and scale digital solutions that enhance clinical quality, athlete outcomes and operational efficiency.

**Requirements**

**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master's degree and recognized certifications (e.g. health informatics, cybersecurity, TOGAF, ITIL, or vendor platform certifications

8+ years of progressive experience in digital health, healthcare IT, health informatics or technology delivery, including experience defining healthcare technology requirements, supporting EHR and healthcare platform delivery, and coordinating technology readiness in new or transforming organizations.

Demonstrated experience managing technology vendors and SLAs, data management and analytics, and cybersecurity / data-privacy controls within a healthcare environment. Experience within accredited healthcare institutions (JCI, CBAHI) is an advantage.

Working knowledge of Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulatory frameworks, and of interoperability and integration across clinical and administrative systems.

The Senior Manager, Leadership Development owns the leadership curriculum end to end  from identifying what leaders need, to designing the programs that build it, to standing in the room and delivering it personally. This is a design-and-delivery role, not a design-only role: the Senior Manager is expected to facilitate sessions and coach business leaders directly, not simply commission others to do it.

The role also owns training needs analysis (TNA) for the leadership pillar, working directly with business leaders to identify capability gaps rather than relying on a separate analytics function. Depending on the department's operating model it may also directly line manage a small number of reports.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Leadership framework & curriculum design**

•    Design and evolve the leadership development framework and curriculum spanning frontline supervisors through senior leaders.

•    Translate business priorities and future skills needs into concrete program design decisions, in partnership with the Director.

•    Build and run interventions using methodologies proven to drive behavioral change, including digital, blended, and experiential formats.

•    Scan industry shifts, technology, and emerging leadership practices to keep the curriculum current and competitive.

**Training needs analysis**

•    Own training needs analysis (TNA) for the leadership pillar  identifying leadership gaps and future capability requirements directly with business leaders.

•    Prioritize which capability gaps get addressed first based on business impact and urgency.

•    Feed TNA findings back into the leadership framework and curriculum roadmap.

**Personal training delivery & coaching**

•    Personally deliver leadership training sessions across levels  stay hands-on in delivery, not only design.

•    Personally coach business leaders as part of the department's coaching culture.

•    Structure and scale the internal coaching culture, including coach selection criteria and coaching standards.

•    Select and manage external facilitators, content providers, and assessment tools when specialist delivery is required.

**Capability building**

•    Build leadership development capability within HR Business Partners and Line Managers so expertise scales beyond the central team.

•    Design train-the-trainer approaches so select content can be co-delivered by capable Line Managers.

**Requirements**

•    8-10+ years in leadership, management, or executive development, with experience designing and personally delivering enterprise-wide interventions in large, complex organizations.

•    Prior experience owning training needs analysis or capability gap assessments is strongly preferred.

**Educational qualifications**

•    Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

•    Master's degree or relevant advanced HR certification (CIPD, ATD, SHRM) preferred.

**Skills & competencies**

•    Strong facilitation and instructional design skills; comfortable presenting to and influencing senior audiences directly.

**Title:**

Principal Structural Design Engineer - Offshore

## Position Overview

The Senior Offshore Structural Engineer is responsible for leading the design, analysis, and integrity assessment of offshore structures

including jackets, topsides, subsea structures, and floating systems. The role involves ensuring compliance with Saudi Aramco Standards, international codes, supervising junior engineers, and supporting engineering activities through all project phases including FEED, detailed design, installation, and decommissioning.

## Key Responsibilities

• Lead structural design and advanced engineering analysis for offshore platforms and subsea systems.

• Perform global and local analyses including in-place, loadout, lifting, fatigue, strength, buckling, and earthquake analysis.

• Review and approve structural calculations, drawings, and project documentation.

• Ensure engineering deliverables meet technical requirements, manhour budgets, and schedules.

• Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including piping, instrumentation, mechanical, electrical, architectural, pipelines, and geotechnical engineers.

• Provide technical support during fabrication, installation, and offshore construction activities.

•Develop and implement structural integrity management strategies for brownfield assets.

• Review Saudi Aramco standards and design codes (API RP 2A/2SIM, ISO 19900 series, DNV-GL standards) and ensure compliance.

• Mentor junior engineers and review their work.

• Perform single disciple checks on drawings and documents.

• Perform inter disciple checks on drawings and documents.

## Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in civil/Structural Engineering.

• 10+ years of offshore structural engineering experience.

• Strong knowledge of Saudi Aramco standards and offshore structural design codes (API, DNV, ISO).

• Proficiency in structural analysis tools (SACS and Staad.Pro).

• Experience in FEED, detailed engineering, and brownfield modifications.

• Understanding of offshore construction and installation methods.

• Strong communication, leadership, and technical report-writing skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments.

## Certifications Preferred

• Chartered Engineer / Professional Engineer (CEng/PE) preferred.

**Job Purpose**

The QHSSE Manager is responsible for overseeing all Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental & Security related aspects, within the complex/attractions. Including, conducting audits, delivering training, incident management & investigations, security personnel, managing access controls, conducting risk assessments, and coordinating with local authorities to maintain a secure and compliant environment for employees, guests, and assets. This role ensures that all QHSSE protocols and procedures are adhered to, and that any potential threats or incidents are managed effectively. The QHSSE Manager also supports compliance with QHSSE standards and contributes to a safe environment across the complex or attraction.

**Managerial Accountabilities:**

**Strategy and Planning**

* Implement the SEVEN QHSSE standards across the complex and attraction, aligning with the overall business objectives and QHSSE standards.
* Plan and coordinate security resource allocation, budgeting, and staffing to ensure effective coverage and operational efficiency.
* Set performance goals for the QHSSE team and monitor progress to achieve department objectives.

**Stakeholder Relations**

* Act as the primary point of contact for QHSSE related matters with internal and external stakeholders, including local authorities and emergency services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies and industry partners to enhance security collaboration and information sharing.

**Governance and Compliance**

* Implement and monitor the SEVEN QHSSE policies and standards
* Monitor compliance with security policies and procedures, conducting audits and assessments to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.

**Budget Management**

* Oversee the budgeting process for Complex/Attraction QHSSE operations, ensuring effective utilization of resources and alignment with financial targets.
* Monitor and control QHSSE related expenses, seeking opportunities to optimize costs and improve operational efficiency.
* Optimize resource allocation, including labor, inventory, and equipment, to maximize efficiency and minimize costs.

**People Management**

* Lead employee performance management processes within the Complex QHSSE department, ensuring continuous improvement and development.
* Direct performance evaluation processes and validate results to ensure appropriate and fair evaluation of security personnel.
* Promote a culture of safety, integrity, and service excellence within the QHSSE team.

**Functional Accountabilities:**

**Security Operations Management**

* Lead and supervise security personnel, ensuring that all staff are trained, equipped, and capable of carrying out their duties effectively.
* Manage the performance of the appointed security third party within the attractions/complex
* Develop and implement security policies, procedures, and emergency response plans to protect employees, guests, and assets.
* Monitor access control systems, surveillance, and other security measures to prevent unauthorized access and mitigate security risks.

**Risk Assessment and Incident Management**

* Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential QHSSE threats, vulnerabilities, and areas for improvement within the complex or attraction.
* Manage incidents and emergencies, coordinating with local authorities and internal teams to ensure a swift and effective response.
* Prepare and maintain detailed incident reports, documenting all QHSSE breaches, investigations, and resolutions.
* Develop incident management reports for management submission

**Compliance and Coordination**

* Ensure compliance with local regulations, QHSSE standards, and internal policies to maintain a safe and secure environment.
* Liaise with local law enforcement, emergency services, and regulatory authorities to build strong partnerships and support effective incident management.
* Manage audits and inspections, ensuring that all measures meet established standards and are operating effectively.

**Team Development and Training**

* Develop and implement training programs for SEVEN employees, including security employees and attractions operation teams, focusing on skills development, emergency response, and compliance with QHSSE protocols.
* Ensure that security staff are familiar with the layout of the complex or attraction and can assist guests and employees as needed.
* Coordinate regular emergency drills within the complex, identify opportunities for improvement and provide reports

**Asset Protection and Loss Prevention**

* Implement loss prevention strategies to protect company assets, inventory, and equipment from theft, vandalism, or misuse.
* Monitor and review security systems and processes to identify potential vulnerabilities and implement corrective actions.
* Support the Facility Management team in managing physical security systems such as CCTV, alarms, and access controls.

**Guest Experience**

* Contribute to a positive guest experience by ensuring a safe and secure environment for all guests, employees, and stakeholders.
* Address guest inquiries or concerns related to safety & security with professionalism and efficiency, providing assistance as needed.
* Support the guest services team in managing crowd control, event security, and emergency response to maintain a safe and welcoming atmosphere.

**Requirements**

**Knowledge:**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Health & Safety Management or Security Management, QHSE, or a related field is preferred.
* Professional training in security operations and incident management

**Professional Certifications**

* Health & Safety Professional (OSHA/IOSH)
* Certification in Security Management (e.g., CPP, PSP) is preferred.
* First Aid and Emergency Response Certification
* Risk Management

**Required Experience:**

* Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in QHSE/security management, with at least 3 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in managing QHSE/security operations for large complexes, attractions, or entertainment venues is highly desirable.
* Experience in ISO audit program, in particular, IS0 9001 or ISO 45001

**Title:**

Sr. Materials and Corrosion Engineer (Offshore)

KBR, Inc. is currently seeking a Materials and Corrosion Engineer to join the Offshore team in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. This role is central to ensuring the integrity and longevity of assets through specialized expertise in materials selection, corrosion prevention, and assessment. The position requires a strong technical foundation to guide decision-making and ensure compliance with Aramco and industry standards. Key responsibilities include:

* Lead Brownfield and Greenfield Offshore Projects, acting as a technical focal point for all aspects of materials engineering as well as managing project bids, execution, resources and deliverables
* Development of Corrosion Management Programs; Material Selection Reports, Material Selection Diagrams, Coating Selection Diagrams, and Corrosion Loop Diagrams.
* Carry out corrosion assessments on pipelines, piping, and equipment, with a preference for software experience with ECE-5.
* Non-metallic Material Studies; development of non-metallic material assessments and material selection of appropriate non-metallic material
* Provide technical support for disciplines and project-related tasks and workshops, including OSI, RBI and Corrosion Inspection Manuals for operating assets and new projects, development and resolution of Technical Queries, review and approval of materials substitutions and resolution of site fabrication issues
* Lead engineering assessments based on applicable codes such as API 579, BS DNV RP F101, ASME B31.3/4/8, ISO 15156, ISO 21457
* Review Technical Bid Evaluations (TBEs) and Non-Material Requirements (NMRs), primarily related to the materials scope.
* Review integrity assessment reports, which may include ILI reports, Fitness for Purpose (FFP) / Recommendations for Repair Reports (RRR), ILI raw data, and Direct Assessment reports as primary input.
* Assist in the training and development of junior team members.
* Liaise with the global offices for support where needed.
* Sites Visits outside offices as & when required.

Minimum 15+ years of experience, offshore engineering  and a degree in engineering is mandatory. Candidates with the below experience are encouraged to apply:

* Aramco Standards and Best Practices, NACE requirements, Material Selection, Corrosion Modelling, Damage Mechanisms, Corrosion Control and Cathodic Protection
* Water Injection, HPHT and sour gas field experience
* APCS coating systems and internal FBE coatings
* Chemical treatment, inhibitor selection and oilfield production chemicals
* Material grades, alloy selection, heat treatment and weld engineering
* Strong Experience working on pre-FEED, FEED, Detailed design, EPC and PMC roles

**Title:**

**Overall Summary**

  

A Principal Mechanical Engineer with extensive experience in the design, specification, and technical leadership of power generation equipment and associated auxiliary systems for thermal power plants. Proven expertise in the execution of FEED, detailed engineering, procurement support, and technical assurance activities for medium to large-scale power generation projects (700 MW and above).

Responsible for leading and mentoring a team of engineers and designers, ensuring the delivery of safe, reliable, cost-effective, and technically compliant engineering solutions in accordance with project requirements, industry standards, and company procedures. Provides technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, including equipment selection, bid evaluation, vendor document review, design optimization, and stakeholder engagement.

A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in power generation engineering, with demonstrated capability in managing engineering deliverables, coordinating multidisciplinary interfaces, and ensuring the quality, integrity, and timely execution of projects.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

The duties and responsibilities will be as follows but may not be limited to

* Lead, supervise, and mentor a team of mechanical engineers and designers.
* Develop engineering execution plans, deliverable registers, manpower plans, and schedules.
* Ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, standards, specifications, and company procedures.
* Review and approve equipment data sheets, technical specifications, calculations, and engineering deliverables.
* Lead technical bid evaluations and provide procurement support for mechanical equipment and packages.
* Review, coordinate, and approve vendor drawings and documentation.
* Coordinate mechanical engineering activities with other engineering disciplines and project stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership and engineering guidance to project teams, clients, and vendors.
* Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, constructability reviews, and value engineering studies.
* Drive initiatives related to safety, reliability, maintainability, sustainability, and cost optimization.
* Monitor engineering progress and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
* Manage technical risks and resolve complex engineering issues.
* Support client meetings, audits, and technical presentations.
* Ensure quality assurance requirements are implemented and maintained throughout project execution.
* Be accountable for the technical integrity, completeness, quality, and schedule performance of all assigned mechanical engineering work and personnel.

**Qualifications & Years of Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from an accredited university.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in power generation projects, involving FEED, detailed engineering and procurement support is required.

At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable.

Catalog is the layer underneath everything. Storefronts, search, recommendations, landing pages, and every channel a merchant sells through all read from the same product data. When it is good, every surface above it gets better at once. When it is thin or wrong, nothing built on top can fix it.

Two things make this exciting:.

First, Salla does not build the catalog. Merchants do, and often not even the merchant: a freelancer, operations staff, an outsourced agency. Every surface we build inherits what those hands produce. So the question is not how to clean the data. It is how you change what someone produces when they do not work for you and mostly want to finish and move on.

Second, no two categories need the same product record. What a fashion merchant needs is not what a pharmacy, a grocer, or a gold merchant needs. The easy answer is to build each category separately, and it does not scale.

You will drive impact across five areas

* The Catalog Engine and Category Setup (one engine, built once, with what each category needs from a product record expressed as configuration rather than code, so supporting one more category is fast and repeatable)
* Product Data Input (creation, bulk import, editing, and everything that happens at the moment someone types or uploads)
* Structure and Meaning (taxonomy, attributes, variants, identifiers, normalization, and duplicates)
* AI Enrichment (extracting and generating product data from what merchants already have, with a clear position on confidence, review, and correction)
* Downstream Fitness (how this data actually performs where it is consumed: search results, storefronts, recommendations, and external channel feeds)

### Responsibilities:

* Own the catalog strategy end to end: sequence it into quarters, defend it in the room, and hold it accountable to the numbers it promised.
* Own the roadmap for how product data gets created and improved on Salla, prioritized on whether the data works downstream rather than on how many fields are filled.
* Design for the people who actually do the work, including the ones who do not own the store, and make the good path the fastest path rather than a longer one enforced by rules.
* Keep a new category, a configuration change rather than an engineering project, and be able to show the difference in effort between the first one and the next.
* Put AI to work where it earns trust: decide what we generate outright, what we suggest for approval, and what we never touch, with a stated confidence policy and a loop that learns from every correction a merchant makes.
* Define what catalog quality means at Salla and instrument it honestly, tied to the surfaces that consume the data rather than to completeness for its own sake.
* Own how product data performs in external selling channels, where the requirements are strict and the rejections are visible.
* Decide how much structure we impose and where merchants stay free, then defend that line against pressure from both directions.
* Lead 2 to 3 product managers: give them real ownership, coach their framing and craft, run a reliable cadence, and raise the quality bar of what the group ships.
* Work as one system with the teams that depend on this data: search and discovery, storefronts, vendors, marketplace, and data.

**Requirements**

* Six or more years in product management, including work on a self-serve platform where users created their own content or data and you were accountable for the quality of what they produced.
* A number you owned and moved on that data: completeness that meant something, accuracy, time to publish, adoption of a data tool, or the performance of that data somewhere downstream.
* Evidence that you changed what users produced at the moment they produced it, rather than cleaning it up afterwards in a pipeline. We will ask which one it was.
* Platform judgment: you have built something once and made it serve many cases through configuration, and you can explain where you drew the line between what was shared and what was specific, and what that choice cost you.
* AI in production for structured data: extraction, classification, generation, or matching. You can talk concretely about confidence thresholds, error rates, what you let through automatically, and what you did when it was wrong at scale.
* Literacy in how product data is actually structured: taxonomies, attribute schemas, variants, identifiers, matching and deduplication, and the strict requirements external selling channels impose.
* You have coached product managers, formally or not, and you are ready to lead a small team without stepping away from the craft yourself.
* You own outcomes rather than roadmaps, you move quickly through ambiguity, and you build clarity where others see noise. You stay close to the details and you cannot guard your own area, because this data belongs to everyone downstream.
* Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required. Merchant context in this region is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia and work on-site.

The ultimate objective is to continuously develop and enhance employees’ knowledge, skills, and competencies required to achieve the strategic business objectives of the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Strategy & Governance*

* Contribute to the development and execution of the department’s short to mid-term strategic plans to ensure alignment with strategic priorities and corporate goals.
* Assist in the development of annual business plans for assigned areas of responsibility to support the achievement of financial and strategic objectives.
* Monitor, control, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the department to track performance and recommend corrective actions.

*Operational*

* Benchmark available training courses and best market practices to develop a comprehensive, state-of-the-art training catalogue.
* Coordinate with the supervising Training Coordinator to design in-house training courses and materials based on critical factors such as course objectives, methodology, and agenda.
* Develop and communicate regular reports on training performance, effectiveness, and quality to measure the ROI and efficiency of training programs.

* Identify opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase overall productivity and operational efficiency.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources Management, or an equivalent discipline from a recognized and accredited university.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 11 years of proven experience in Training & Development, Training, or a related field, out of which at least 5 years must be in a managerial or leadership position.

The Assistant Horticulturist – Outdoor Gardens supports the day-to-day maintenance, care, and presentation of outdoor gardens, landscapes, and living plant collections. Working under the direction of the Horticulturist – Outdoor Gardens, the role provides practical support in planting, pruning, plant health, irrigation, pest management, and general garden maintenance.

The position also supports plant identification, collection records, Integrated Pest Management (IPM), and the safe use and routine maintenance of horticultural tools and equipment. The role contributes to maintaining safe, healthy, attractive, and high-quality outdoor garden environments.

* Support planting, pruning, watering, weeding, mulching, fertilisation, deadheading, staking, and general garden maintenance.
* Assist with the establishment, replacement, and maintenance of trees, shrubs, groundcovers, herbaceous plants, and seasonal displays.
* Monitor plant health and identify signs of pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, water stress, and other environmental issues.
* Support the implementation of Integrated Pest Management (IPM), including monitoring, preventative measures, and appropriate control activities.
* Assist with soil preparation, amendments, mulching, fertilisation, and other plant-health activities.
* Support irrigation and watering activities and report signs of over- or under-watering.
* Assist with plant identification, labelling, inventory, and accurate maintenance of plant collection records and databases.
* Maintain high horticultural, aesthetic, and presentation standards across outdoor garden areas.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, or a related discipline.
* Additional training or certification in horticulture, plant identification, IPM, irrigation, or related areas is advantageous.

Experience

* Minimum **3 years of relevant professional experience** in outdoor horticulture, garden management, or landscape maintenance.
* Practical experience in planting, pruning, plant establishment, irrigation, soil preparation, fertilisation, mulching, and general plant care.
* Experience maintaining a range of trees, shrubs, groundcovers, herbaceous plants, and seasonal displays.
* Experience identifying common plants, pests, diseases, and environmental or plant-health issues.
* Experience supporting IPM programmes and routine plant-health monitoring.
* Experience with plant labelling, inventory, collection records, and basic horticultural databases is desirable.
* Practical experience using and maintaining common horticultural tools and equipment.
* Previous experience in a botanic garden, public garden, arboretum, nursery, major landscape, or comparable horticultural environment is preferred.

Core Competencies

* Practical horticultural and plant-care skills
* Plant identification and basic plant-health assessment
* Understanding of Integrated Pest Management principles
* Safe use and care of horticultural tools and equipment
* Attention to detail and horticultural presentation standards
* Accurate record-keeping and organisational skills
