job_title: Director of Sports Medicine Development and Activation - 50013027
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Director of Sports Medicine Development and Activation provides strategic leadership for the development of QHC’s sports medicine portfolio. The role shapes the service model and operating concept across clinical care, rehabilitation, athlete health, performance, research and innovation, ensuring that the programme reflects QHC’s mandate, clinical standards and long-term strategic ambitions.

The role leads the coordinated development of the sports medicine programme from concept through implementation. This includes service and facility design, technical and operational input to strategic partnerships and scopes of work, procurement requirements, workforce planning and hiring, technology and equipment requirements, governance, budgets and the key approvals required to establish integrated, athlete-centred and sustainable services.

Working across executive, clinical and corporate leadership, the Director establishes priorities, integrates multidisciplinary workstreams and provides assurance on programme scope, quality, resources, risks, dependencies and delivery. The role represents sports medicine in internal and external forums, guides executive decision-making and ensures that partners, teams and enabling functions remain aligned with the approved sports medicine strategy and service objectives.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1.  Sports Medicine Strategy, Service Model and Programme Development**

•    Lead the development of QHC’s sports medicine strategy and translate it into an integrated portfolio of clinical, rehabilitation, athlete-health, performance, research and innovation services, with clear priorities, intended outcomes, investment requirements and delivery sequencing.

•    Define and maintain the sports medicine service model and operating concept, including portfolio scope, target populations, service pathways, delivery channels, capacity assumptions, clinical and corporate interfaces, governance principles, decision rights and accountability arrangements.

•    Own the development and ongoing refinement of the sports medicine programme, converting strategy into approved service specifications, business and investment priorities, implementation plans, measurable objectives and executive decisions, while ensuring alignment with QHC’s mandate, clinical standards and long-term organisational ambitions.

**2.  Clinical, Rehabilitation and Performance Service Development**

•    Lead the development of an integrated clinical, rehabilitation, athlete-health and performance service portfolio, defining service scope, target populations, referral criteria, multidisciplinary pathways, standards of care, delivery requirements and intended athlete and patient outcomes.

•    Provide strategic oversight of multidisciplinary service and pathway design, bringing together sports medicine, orthopaedics, rehabilitation, performance science, imaging, diagnostics, nutrition, psychology and other specialist disciplines to deliver coordinated, evidence-based and athlete-centred care.

•    Establish the clinical and performance standards, outcome measures and governance requirements for prevention, assessment, treatment, rehabilitation, recovery, performance optimisation and return-to-sport, ensuring alignment with QHC clinical governance and recognised international best practice.

**3.  Corporate Programme Planning and Delivery**

•    Establish the governance structure for the sports medicine programme, defining workstreams, accountable owners, decision rights, approval routes, milestones and reporting requirements across clinical, operational and enabling functions.

•    Own the integrated programme plan and executive dashboard, coordinating scope, budgets, resources, schedules, dependencies, procurement, workforce, partnerships, technology, facilities and implementation priorities to maintain alignment and delivery against approved objectives.

•    Provide executive assurance on programme progress, financial and resource requirements, risks, issues, changes and delivery performance; prepare decision papers and present clear recommendations, options and corrective actions to support timely corporate and executive decisions.

**4.  Partnership Integration and Service Requirements**

•    Define the clinical, operational, facility, workforce, technology and mobilisation requirements that sports medicine partners must address, and provide subject-matter input to the designated Sports Medicine Partnerships lead during partner assessment, selection and appointment.

•    Develop and validate the sports medicine technical and service requirements for scopes of work, requests for proposal, evaluation criteria, service levels, deliverables, acceptance measures, knowledge-transfer expectations and mobilisation plans, in coordination with the Partnerships, Commercial and Procurement functions.

•    Coordinate the operational integration of appointed partners into the sports medicine programme, ensuring that service interfaces, responsibilities, resources, data requirements, reporting, escalation routes and implementation dependencies are clearly defined. Identify delivery gaps and provide recommendations to the accountable partnership lead and programme governance forums.

**5.  Facility, Workforce, Technology and Service Enablement**

•    Own the sports medicine design file from concept through detailed design and operational sign-off, ensuring that clinical briefs, functional programmes, room data sheets, equipment layouts, athlete and patient flows, infection-control requirements, accessibility, safety, privacy, technology integration and future-capacity needs are accurately reflected. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, assess operational impacts, manage change requests and maintain clear records of decisions, approvals, risks and outstanding actions.

•    Define and coordinate the clinical, rehabilitation, performance, digital and equipment requirements needed to enable the approved service model, including technical specifications, interoperability, data and reporting needs, procurement priorities, validation, maintenance, user training and operational acceptance.

•    Own the sports medicine workforce planning and mobilisation requirements, including organisational structure, staffing numbers, role profiles, recruitment priorities, selection support, credentialing, privileging, licensing, onboarding, training, competency assurance, roster design and leadership coverage. Work with Human Resources and clinical leaders to track deployment and mitigate critical workforce or capability gaps.

**6.  Implementation, Mobilisation and Service Activation**

•    Direct the phased implementation and mobilisation of the sports medicine programme, translating approved designs and service plans into coordinated activation schedules, workstream deliverables, resource plans, acceptance criteria and transition requirements across clinical, operational and enabling functions.

•    Establish service-activation criteria and oversee multidisciplinary assurance activities, including document reviews, walkthroughs, simulations, workforce and system checks, partner readiness and regulatory confirmation. Provide evidence-based recommendations on phased activation, remediation or deferral based on safety, quality, capability and delivery risk.

•    Lead service activation and early operational stabilisation, coordinating issue resolution, escalation, executive reporting and corrective actions across QHC teams and appointed partners. Monitor initial performance against agreed safety, quality, workforce and service thresholds and transition stable services into business-as-usual governance.

**Requirements**

**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**

Advanced degree in Sports Medicine, Physiotherapy, Sports Science, Rehabilitation, Healthcare Management, or a related healthcare, clinical or performance discipline is preferred. Relevant clinical or sports-performance qualifications are advantageous; a Master's degree is an advantage.

12+ years of progressive experience in sports medicine, performance health, rehabilitation or healthcare operations, including significant leadership responsibility for complex service development, multidisciplinary programme delivery, mobilisation or transformation. Demonstrated experience establishing or developing sports medicine services, centres of excellence or high-performance programmes is required.

Demonstrated experience in service-model design, capability definition, operating requirements and multidisciplinary sports-medicine environments. Experience within internationally recognized sports-medicine or academic medical centres, and within partnership or joint-venture models, is highly desirable.

Strong knowledge of international sports-medicine best practice, athlete-health pathways and performance science, with an understanding of the Saudi healthcare and sports context and Vision 2030 ambitions.

نبذة عن الفريق  
يُمثل فريق مبيعات Zoom قوة دافعة لنجاح الشركة. ويركز الفريق على تقديم حلول اتصالات متطورة للعملاء في جميع القطاعات، ويتفاعل بحماس مع العملاء حول العالم. ومن خلال الشراكات الاستراتيجية والنهج الذي يضع العميل في صميم اهتمامه، يلعب الفريق دورًا محوريًا في توسيع نطاق حضور Zoom العالمي، وضمان استفادة الشركات من الإمكانات الكاملة للتعاون الافتراضي.

  

ما نبحث عنه

* امتلاك خبرة من 5 إلى 7 سنوات في إدارة الشراكات في مجال الاتصالات الموحدة / الحوسبة السحابية / الهاتف.
* القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات لبرامج الشركاء وتمكين المبيعات
* خبرة في التعامل مع موزعي البرامج كخدمة (SaaS) في المملكة العربية السعودية، مع اشتراط إتقان اللغة العربية تحدثاً وكتابة.
* امتلاك فهم عميق لنظام الشركاء البيئي
* امتلاك مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة للتعاون بفعالية مع الشركاء وأصحاب المصلحة الداخليين.
* الكفاءة في تحليل بيانات المبيعات واتجاهات السوق لتحديد فرص النمو مع شركاء القنوات
* التعاون مع التحالفات التي تدفع نظام Zoom البيئي، مثل Poly و Dten و NEAT و Oracle و Ribbon و Jabra و Verint.

Our client is investing in the effectiveness of its sanctions screening capability - and needs a hands-on FircoSoft

specialist to tune it. Working within the institution's financial crime compliance function in Riyadh - with candidates

welcomed from anywhere in the world, and relocation and mobilisation fully supported - you will assess, calibrate and

optimise the FircoSoft screening environment across customer and payment screening: filter rules, matching

algorithms, thresholds, list management and workflow configuration.

Arabic fluency is central to the role, not incidental to it. Screening effectiveness in the Saudi market depends on how

the filter handles Arabic names - transliteration variants, romanisation schemes, name particles, honorifics and

orthographic differences between Arabic-script and Latin-script records. You will bring both the platform expertise to

tune the engine and the linguistic judgement to know when a match rule is generating noise and when it is masking

risk.

**Requirements**

Assess the current FircoSoft configuration - matching algorithms, rules, thresholds, good-guy/exception lists, and

screening scope across customer and transaction/payment screening.

• Tune filter parameters and matching logic to reduce false positives without compromising sanctions risk coverage,

with documented pre- and post-tuning analysis.

• Optimise Arabic name-matching performance: transliteration handling, romanisation variants, name particles and

script-conversion behaviour across watchlists and customer data.

• Review list management - sanctions list ingestion, versioning and update mechanisms (UN, OFAC, EU, UK and

local/SAMA-directed lists) - and the governance around exceptions and whitelisting.

• Conduct above-the-line/below-the-line style effectiveness testing of screening outcomes; document methodology,

results and recommendations to withstand model validation and regulatory challenge.

• Support alert workflow and operating model improvements - alert quality, hibernation/suppression logic, escalation

paths and investigator feedback loops.

• Coordinate with Compliance, Screening Operations, Technology and the vendor; present findings and

recommendations to senior stakeholders in Arabic and English as required.

Essential

• Hands-on FircoSoft tuning experience - filter configuration, matching algorithms, rules and threshold calibration (not

oversight of a team that did it).

• Professional fluency in Arabic and English, with practical experience of Arabic name-screening challenges:

transliteration, romanisation variants and script matching.

• Strong sanctions compliance knowledge - UN, OFAC, EU and UK regimes and screening obligations, and the

governance expectations around filter effectiveness.

• Experience of screening effectiveness testing and documentation to a standard that withstands model validation,

audit and regulatory review.

• Banking or financial institution experience, with the stakeholder skills to work across Compliance, Operations,

Technology and the vendor.

Preferred

• Saudi or wider GCC experience, and familiarity with SAMA supervisory expectations for sanctions screening.

• Exposure to ISO 20022 / SWIFT MT-MX message screening and payment-flow screening architecture.

• Experience with complementary screening or monitoring platforms and data analysis tools (SQL or similar).

• ACAMS, ICA or equivalent certification.

The QHSSE Manager is responsible for overseeing all Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental & Security related aspects, within the complex/attractions. Including, conducting audits, delivering training, incident management & investigations, security personnel, managing access controls, conducting risk assessments, and coordinating with local authorities to maintain a secure and compliant environment for employees, guests, and assets. The QHSSE Manager also supports compliance with QHSSE standards and contributes to a safe environment across the complex or attraction.

**Managerial Accountabilities:**

**Strategy and Planning**

* Implement the SEVEN QHSSE standards across the complex and attraction, aligning with the overall business objectives and QHSSE standards.

* Set performance goals for the QHSSE team and monitor progress to achieve department objectives.

**Stakeholder Relations**

job_title: Senior E&I Engineer (OMPP / Pipelines) Saudi Nationals
description:
Our client is an established Saudi Aramco onshore EPC contractor headquartered in the Eastern Province, delivering Onshore Maintain Potential Program (OMPP) packages, cross-country pipelines, well tie-ins and upstream facilities across the Northern and Southern Areas. The company self-performs electrical and instrumentation construction on its pipeline and wellsite projects, from overhead power lines to RTU and SCADA integration.

The Senior E&I Engineer runs the electrical and instrumentation construction on an OMPP / pipeline package: overhead power lines to new wells, cathodic protection of wellhead casings and pipelines, fiber optic and communication networks, RTU and SCADA installation, wellhead instrumentation and the energisation, loop testing and pre-commissioning that bring the package to mechanical completion. The role is the E&I in-charge on site, directing the E&I supervisors, technicians and subcontractors, and is accountable to the Construction Manager and the Saudi Aramco PMT for the discipline.

**Key Responsiblites:**

**Discipline execution**

* Own the E&I construction plan for the package, from IFC review and material take-off through installation, testing, energisation and pre-commissioning.
* Direct installation and testing of overhead power lines (13.8 kV and 34.5 kV), switch racks, transformers, switchgear and grounding systems at wellsites, remote headers and valve stations.
* Lead cathodic protection works for wellhead casings and pipelines, including deep anode beds, surface beds, rectifiers, junction boxes, test stations and CP commissioning.
* Manage fiber optic and telecommunication cable installation, splicing and testing along pipeline corridors and to wellsites.
* Oversee installation and configuration of RTUs, UPS systems, fire and gas detection (LEL / H2S) and SCADA integration with the client's central processing facilities.
* Direct wellhead and I-Field instrumentation installation (PT, TT, FT, MOV, MCV, PDHMS, MPFM, corrosion monitoring) and shutdown system testing.
* Run loop checks, instrument calibration, energisation packages, SAT and pre-commissioning to Saudi Aramco procedures.

**Client and standards**

* Act as the E&I interface with the Saudi Aramco PMT, inspection and operations representatives.
* Ensure all E&I work complies with Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES-P, SAES-J, SAES-X), SAEP procedures and Schedule Q.
* Prepare and close inspection packages, RFIs, technical queries, NCRs and redline / as-built drawings for the discipline.
* Drive E&I mechanical completion dossiers, loop folders, punch-list closure and turnover.

**Safety, quality and cost**

* Hold the discipline to the client's HSE plan and Aramco electrical safety requirements, including lock-out / tag-out, energisation permits and work on or near live systems.
* Coordinate with QA/QC so that cable testing, CP surveys, loop test records and calibration certificates are current and audit-ready.
* Control E&I material, manpower and subcontractor cost against budget, and raise material requisitions in line with Aramco approved vendor lists.
* Identify E&I scope changes early and support change notices with technical substantiation.

**People**

* Lead E&I supervisors, foremen, technicians and specialist subcontractors on site.
* Coach junior E&I engineers and help build a bench that reflects the client's Saudisation commitments.

**Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation and Control, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Saudi Council of Engineers registration required.
* **Experience:** Oil and gas E&I construction on Saudi Aramco onshore projects, including at least one full package as the E&I engineer in charge of the site scope (Senior E&I Engineer, Lead E&I Engineer, E&I In-Charge, E&I Superintendent or E&I Manager).
* **Core capability:** Hands-on construction delivery of E&I scope on Saudi Aramco OMPP, cross-country pipeline or upstream wellsite packages, with demonstrated experience in at least two of: overhead power lines, cathodic protection, fiber optic networks, RTU / SCADA installation.
* **Technical knowledge:** Aramco SAES electrical and instrumentation standards, Schedule Q, energisation and loop testing procedures, wellhead instrumentation and I-Field systems.
* **Certification:** Saudi Aramco approval as E&I Engineer, E&I Supervisor or Lead Engineer preferred.
* **Company environment:** Background at an Aramco-approved EPC contractor delivering OMPP, MGS, Jafurah or upstream pipeline work. Design-office, consultancy and building MEP backgrounds will not be considered; the role is site construction, not engineering design.
* **Nationality and residency:** This position is reserved for Saudi nationals in line with the Kingdom's Saudization (Nitaqat) requirements.
* **Location:** Based in the Eastern Province, or willing to relocate to Dammam / Al Khobar and work from project sites.

Lead site construction supervision and coordination for EPC works, ensuring that construction activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, EPC Contract requirements, project procedures and applicable codes and standards.

Drive EPC Contractor performance by monitoring daily site activities, manpower, equipment deployment, material availability, work fronts and adherence to the approved construction schedule.
Coordinate with the Client and EPC Contractor to ensure that the WSP scope of works is completed smoothly, with timely technical inputs, site responses, inspections, reporting and issue escalation.
Monitor construction interfaces between civil, mechanical, electrical, I&C, commissioning and HSE teams, and drive closure of interface issues that may affect schedule, quality or safety.
Review construction method statements, ITPs, work permits, risk assessments, lifting plans, temporary works and construction procedures, and coordinate comments with relevant discipline specialists.
Participate in site progress meetings, construction coordination meetings, Client meetings, EPC meetings and project review meetings, and ensure that key actions are recorded, assigned and followed up to closure.
Prepare and circulate minutes of meetings, action trackers, site observation reports and construction follow-up notes for meetings and site inspections attended.
Coordinate with discipline engineers for resolution of RFIs/TQs, design clarifications, field changes, site instructions, inspection comments and technical constraints raised during construction.
Support construction planning, sequencing and readiness reviews, including review of look-ahead schedules, critical path activities, work front availability and construction constraints.
Monitor site quality and HSE compliance in coordination with dedicated QA/QC and HSE teams, and ensure that construction observations, NCRs, punch items and corrective actions are properly tracked and closed.
Coordinate site communications with the Client and EPC Contractor, and support timely escalation of risks, delays, manpower shortfalls, material constraints and unresolved technical or contractual matters.
Support mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning readiness, punch list closure and handover activities by ensuring construction completion status is properly verified and documented.
Maintain construction action logs, issue registers, RFI/TQ trackers, site instruction logs, NCR/punch list trackers and other follow-up tools required to drive timely closure.
Provide inputs to construction progress reports, including physical progress, critical activities, constraints, delay events, recovery measures, manpower trends and key decisions required.
Support review of EPC Contractor invoices, progress claims and milestone submissions by confirming construction progress, site records and supporting evidence as required.
Ensure construction documentation and handover records are complete, traceable and aligned with project requirements, including redlines, as-built inputs, completion dossiers and final closeout records.

Must have minimum Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering discipline from an internationally recognized University. Minimum 15 years’ relevant experience, including substantial site construction management experience on CCGT, cogeneration, thermal power or large industrial EPC projects, with at least 5 years in a Construction Manager/Site Construction Manager or equivalent leadership role.
Professional registration/certification is preferred. Strong capability in site reporting, construction documentation, progress tracking, action management, MS Office, document control systems and relevant project controls tools is required.
Experience in construction supervision of CCGT/cogeneration projects involving GT, ST, HRSG, generators, BOP systems, substations, cooling systems and major civil/structural works.
Experience supporting mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning readiness, punch list closeout and handover dossier preparation.
Prior experience in KSA or GCC power project sites and familiarity with regional Client, EPC Contractor and permitting requirements is an advantage.

As an DevOps Engineer for the Thales CDI/MCS products On-Demand Connectivity (ODC) and eUICC IoT Manager(eIM), you will apply software engineering skills to build, maintain, support and optimize mission-critical, cloud-native systems and applications. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring our ODC &eIM solutions are reliable, scalable, and performant.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure & Automation:** Design, develop, and automate infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles. Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab.
* **Cloud Operations:** Install, configure, and manage Kubernetes-based solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* **System Reliability:** Take ownership of production systems with a "you build it, you run it" mindset. Manage real-time system monitoring, observability, and incident response to meet strict SLA commitments.
* **Integration & Support:** Act as a technical bridge between development, validation, and customers. The team will be working on 24/7 onsite shifts to provide operational support and participate in high impact Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews.
* **Documentation:** Prepare technical documentation, customer acceptance plans, and operational readiness reviews to drive continuous process improvement.
* **Team Collaboration:** Contribute to team growth through knowledge sharing, technical training, and continuous process improvement.

**Job Skills & Qualifications**

* **Education**: Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* **Experience**: 4+ years in systems administration, solutions delivery, or integration engineering. Experience with support & operations of highly critical productions systems and Understanding of ITSM processes (incident, Change, Problem, SLA's...) required.
* **Cloud & Orchestration**: Advance experience in public cloud (preferably GCP)**, Kubernetes**, and container orchestration along with **GitLab, CI/ID, Vaults.**
* **Automation & Scripting**: Autonomous in **Bash, Python,** or **Perl**. Experience with **Terraform**, **Helm**.
* **Advanced Linux** experience (minimum 3 years).
* Strong understanding of networking (**IPv4, Subnetting, TCP/IP, packet routing**).
* Deep knowledge of **HTTP(S), SOAP, and REST APIs**.
* Strong proficiency in **Apache, SSL/TLS/mTLS**.
* **Databases**: Hands-on experience in **Cassandra** and **MySQL**.
* **Telecom Domain (Preferred)**: Experience with eSIM technologies (e.g., **SGP22/32**) and telecommunications infrastructure.
* **Development:** A background in Java is highly preferred.

**Behavior Competencies**

* **Mindset:** Customer-oriented, self-starter, analytical, and an excellent team player.
* **Communication:** Strong communicator capable of managing conflicts in a fast-paced environment.
* **Adaptability:** Quick learner, flexible with hours, and ready to participate onsite in 24/7 team support to ensure system resilience.

The Cybersecurity / Security Architect is responsible for defining and governing enterprise security architecture to ensure that security, privacy, resilience, and regulatory requirements are embedded into business, application, data, technology, cloud, and solution architectures. The role develops security principles, reference architectures, standards, controls, and target-state designs while providing architecture assurance for strategic initiatives and technology solutions.

**Requirements**

· Develop and maintain enterprise security architecture in alignment with business strategy, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity strategy, and regulatory requirements.

· Assess the current-state security architecture across applications, data, infrastructure, cloud, networks, identity, and integration environments.

· Define target-state security architecture and security transformation roadmaps.

· Develop security architecture principles, standards, patterns, reference architectures, and design guardrails.

· Embed security-by-design and privacy-by-design requirements across enterprise and solution architecture activities.

· Define Zero Trust architecture principles and implementation patterns across identity, devices, networks, applications, data, and workloads.

· Collaborate with enterprise architects, solution architects, cloud architects, application teams, infrastructure teams, data teams, and cybersecurity operations.

· Participate in architecture governance, security design reviews, and Architecture Review Boards.

Required Experience

· Strong experience with identity, network, application, cloud, infrastructure, and data security architecture.

Preferred Frameworks, Standards & Methods

description:
Our client is a growing luxury interior design and construction company based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, bringing distinctive spaces to life for corporate and private clients. From initial concept and design to project management, construction, and final delivery, the company manages the complete project journey, translating each client’s vision into thoughtfully designed, expertly executed interiors.

### Job Summary

As an Events & Exhibitions Project Manager in Riyadh, this role serves as the strategic and operational cornerstone responsible for launching, establishing, and scaling our Events & Exhibitions department. Reporting directly to executive leadership, you will drive business growth by navigating tender platforms, expanding high-value client networks across Saudi Arabia, and overseeing projects from initial pricing and BOQ preparation to on-site execution and financial closure. By managing cross-functional teams, supplier networks, and key client relationships, your leadership directly impacts company revenue and solidifies our footprint within the Kingdom's rapidly growing events sector.

**Requirements**

* Business Growth & Tenders: Monitor tender platforms (Etimad/Manafesat), prepare winning technical/financial proposals, and expand our Saudi client network.
* Pricing & Cost Control: Prepare detailed BOQs, manage budgets, negotiate with suppliers, and safeguard profit margins.
* End-to-End Execution: Oversee project schedules, site setup, permits, subcontractors, installation, and final handover.
* Department Builder: Recruit and mentor team members, establish workflows, and hit annual revenue targets.

### Skills & Competencies

* Sales and business development experience: A background in identifying prospects, building client relationships, and converting leads into business. B2B experience is preferred, particularly selling products or services to companies and navigating purchasing decisions involving multiple stakeholders.

* Communication and opportunity generation: The ability to approach potential clients confidently, understand their needs, present relevant solutions, and negotiate effectively. This includes creating new business opportunities through outreach, networking, referrals, and consistent follow-up.

* Knowledge of the Saudi market: Familiarity with Saudi Arabia’s construction, events, and luxury projects sectors, including key players, client expectations, and procurement practices. An understanding of how to identify upcoming projects and connect with relevant decisionmakers would be valuable.

### Educational & Professional Requirements

* Events and exhibitions project management experience: A minimum of 5 years of direct experience managing events and exhibitions projects within Saudi Arabia is mandatory. This includes coordinating project planning, budgets, suppliers, execution, and delivery while managing client expectations and deadlines.
* Established network in Saudi Arabia: Strong existing relationships with government entities and large corporate clients in KSA, with the ability to engage key stakeholders, identify project opportunities, and build long-term partnerships.
* Commercial and technical expertise: Proven experience pricing Bills of Quantities (BOQs), preparing and managing bids, and interpreting technical drawings. You should be able to translate project requirements into accurate cost estimates and well-structured proposals that reflect the required scope.
* Arabic and English fluency: The ability to communicate confidently in both languages, verbally and in writing, including delivering presentations, discussing project requirements, negotiating with stakeholders, and preparing professional correspondence.
* Relevant academic qualification: A bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Design, or an equivalent discipline, providing a foundation for managing the technical, commercial, or creative aspects of project delivery.
* Preferred certification and procurement experience: **CEM, CMP, CSEP, PEMC / CAME or Event Management Diploma**

**Benefits**

* Competitive basic salary + attractive percentage of project profits.
* Housing and transportation allowances.
* Medical insurance for employee & family + annual flight tickets.
* Full operational authority to build your team and shape department strategy.

## Description:

# **Regional Controller – MENA | Saudi Nationals Only**

**Company:** Marsh  
**Location:** Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia  
**Business line supported:** Consulting – Oliver Wyman and Mercer  
**Reporting to:** KSA Controller / Regional Finance Leadership

**Important eligibility requirement**

This position is open exclusively to Saudi nationals. **Applicants must hold Saudi Arabian citizenship** and be eligible to work in Riyadh. Applications from non-Saudi nationals cannot be considered for this vacancy.

**About Marsh**

Marsh is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in more than 130 countries. With approximately 85,000 colleagues worldwide and annual revenue exceeding $23 billion, Marsh operates through four market-leading businesses:

* **Marsh** – Commercial insurance broking and risk management
    
* **Guy Carpenter** – Reinsurance broking and strategic advisory
    
* **Mercer** – Health, wealth and career consulting
    
* **Oliver Wyman** – Management consulting and strategy advisory
    

Together, these businesses help organizations navigate an increasingly dynamic and complex environment.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Regional Controller – MENA to join our finance leadership team in Riyadh. This role is central to the controllership function supporting our consulting businesses, Oliver Wyman and Mercer, across the MENA region.

Oliver Wyman has expanded significantly in the region through acquisitions, organic growth and entry into new country markets. Mercer is similarly scaling through acquisitions and a broader regional presence. This creates a high-impact opportunity for a senior finance professional to shape and strengthen the financial control framework across a rapidly growing portfolio.

You will act as a key finance partner to senior leadership, working closely with partners, business heads and regional stakeholders to ensure financial integrity, regulatory compliance and commercial insight across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country operation.

Based in Riyadh, the role will provide close partnership to KSA leadership while supporting continued expansion across the Gulf and wider MENA region.

**Key responsibilities**

**Financial controllership and reporting**

* Lead the regional controllership function for Oliver Wyman and Mercer across MENA.
    
* Manage monthly close, financial consolidation and group reporting in line with global timelines and standards.
    
* Oversee statutory reporting, budgeting and forecasting across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
    
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness and integrity of financial reporting across the regional portfolio.
    

**Revenue recognition**

* Lead revenue recognition for consulting and project-based engagements, including work-in-progress management, percentage-of-completion accounting and IFRS 15 compliance.
    
* Ensure consistent and accurate revenue reporting across Oliver Wyman and Mercer.
    
* Partner with commercial and operational stakeholders to address complex engagement-accounting matters.
    

**Tax compliance and advisory**

* Oversee regional tax compliance, with particular focus on applicable Saudi corporate income tax and Zakat requirements.
    
* Ensure compliance with VAT requirements in KSA and across the GCC.
    
* Monitor corporate tax developments and local filing requirements across MENA.
    
* Support transfer-pricing requirements and coordinate with group tax specialists.
    
* Liaise with ZATCA and other local tax authorities as required.
    

**Governance, controls and compliance**

* Maintain and strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks appropriate for a large global organization.
    
* Ensure compliance with local regulations, IFRS and group policies.
    
* Oversee local statutory and payroll compliance in KSA.
    
* Support compliance with Saudi labor requirements and applicable Saudization and localization programs.
    
* Identify financial and operational risks and ensure that appropriate mitigating controls are implemented.
    

**Stakeholder engagement**

* Act as a trusted finance partner to senior leaders, partners and business heads at Oliver Wyman and Mercer.
    
* Communicate financial performance, risks and opportunities clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
    
* Translate complex financial information into practical and commercially relevant recommendations.
    
* Build effective relationships across local, regional and global finance teams.
    

**Business growth and expansion**

* Support acquisitions, integrations and new-country setups as the consulting businesses continue to expand.
    
* Help build the financial infrastructure required to support regional growth.
    
* Support KSA market expansion, regional-headquarters requirements and local entity setup.
    
* Ensure that new businesses and entities are integrated into appropriate reporting, governance and control frameworks.
    

**What we are looking for**

**Mandatory eligibility and qualifications**

* **Saudi national – this vacancy is open exclusively to citizens of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.**
    
* Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CIMA, CPA, CA or an equivalent recognized designation.
    
* Approximately 10–16 years of progressive finance experience, with a strong focus on financial controllership.
    
* Ability to work from Riyadh and partner closely with KSA-based leadership.
    

**Experience and expertise**

* Proven controllership experience within a large multinational and matrixed organization.
    
* Strong revenue-recognition expertise, ideally gained in consulting, professional services or another project-based business.
    
* Practical knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 15.
    
* Strong understanding of work-in-progress, percentage-of-completion accounting and project profitability.
    
* Middle East tax knowledge, particularly Saudi VAT, corporate income tax and Zakat requirements, as well as GCC VAT regimes.
    
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple countries and legal entities.
    
* Strong understanding of statutory reporting, financial consolidation, budgeting and forecasting.
    
* Demonstrated ability to engage with and influence senior stakeholders, including partners and business leaders.
    

**Personal attributes**

* Commercially minded, with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insight.
    
* Credible and confident communicator who can build trust with senior leadership.
    
* Proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
    
* Collaborative, with a track record of working effectively across functions, countries and reporting lines.
    
* Comfortable balancing technical controllership requirements with broader commercial priorities.
    

**Nice to have**

* Previous experience in management consulting or professional services.
    
* Big Four experience in an advisory, accounting-consulting or finance-transformation capacity, rather than exclusively external audit.
    
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, HFM/Hyperion or comparable ERP and consolidation systems.
    
* Multi-entity finance experience across MENA.
    
* Previous professional experience in Saudi Arabia.
    
* Experience supporting acquisitions, finance integrations, regional-headquarters structures or new-country setups.
    
* Familiarity with KSA payroll, labor requirements and Saudization or localization programs.
    

**What we offer**

* A senior finance role at the heart of one of the world’s largest and most respected professional-services organizations.
    
* Exposure to two of Marsh’s highest-growth businesses in the region: Oliver Wyman and Mercer.
    
* The opportunity to shape regional financial operations during a period of significant expansion.
    
* Close partnership with senior business and finance leaders across KSA and MENA.
    
* A collaborative, high-caliber and internationally connected working environment.
    
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
    
* Long-term career development within a global organization.
    

**Application information**

**Please apply only if you are a Saudi national and meet the mandatory eligibility requirements stated above. Nationality and right-to-work eligibility will be verified as part of the recruitment process.**

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

description:
## How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

The Basin & Key Account Manager for KSA West Coast combines full basin commercial ownership with dedicated strategic management of one or more major key accounts. The role carries the same end-to-end basin responsibilities as the Basin Manager while providing deeper executive engagement, long-term account planning and complex contract leadership for strategically critical customers.  
  
The core objective is to maximize basin profitability, protect revenue and cash performance, secure long-term customer retention and develop sustainable growth. The manager serves as the definitive commercial lead for the Western basin and the focal point for major key accounts, coordinating Operations, Finance, Legal, Technical and Business Development while maintaining strict safety, compliance and governance standards.

**The key responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

****1\. Strategic Key Account Management & Retention****

* Commercial & Basin Ownership: Act as the primary commercial point of contact and end-to-end commercial owner for the full KSA West Coast basin portfolio, managing day-to-day performance across profitability, contractual obligations, retention, and service quality.
    
* Strategic Account Planning & Value Creation: Develop and execute 3-to-5-year Strategic Account Plans covering retention, growth, competitive threats, and joint value creation roadmaps (efficiency, reliability, optimization, expansion, and decarbonization), while aligning local strategies with Cluster/Group account frameworks.
    
* Executive Governance & Stakeholder Alignment: Build and maintain multi-level stakeholder matrices across customer and internal functions (Operations, Procurement, Finance, Technical, Legal, Executive Management), leading Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and steering committees supported by internal executive sponsorship.
    
* Contract Lifecycle Management & Administration: Lead full contract lifecycle administration, including complex negotiations, amendments, renewals, extensions, and commercial settlements, ensuring timely action ahead of contractual milestones and protecting the company’s long-term position.
    
* Contract Compliance & Risk Management: Maintain complete oversight of customer and company obligations, formal contractual notices, payment terms, indexation, volume commitments, and proactive mitigation plans for competitive, contractual, or operational risks.
    

****2\. Commercial Strategy, P&L & Working Capital Management****

* Basin Commercial Strategy: Formulate and execute the localized West Coast commercial strategy reflecting customer priorities, market conditions, competitive dynamics and long-term asset positioning.
    
* Commercial P&L & Financial Ownership: Own and actively manage revenue, margin/OI, pricing, volume performance and commercial cost drivers,  while preparing annual budgets, rolling volume/revenue forecasts, and monthly actual-versus-forecast variance analyses.
    
* Pricing Mechanisms & Revenue Assurance: Implement approved pricing strategies, contractual indexation, and minimum volume/Take-or-Pay mechanisms to safeguard profitability, prevent revenue leakage, and ensure audit readiness.
    
* Invoice Validation & Billing Accuracy: Validate monthly billing inputs (fixed/variable charges, indexation, penalties, and adjustments) and coordinate with Finance to ensure accurate, timely invoice issuance and prompt resolution of billing disputes.
    
* Working Capital, Account Receivable & Credit Risk Management: Maintain commercial ownership of accounts receivable, monitor Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and overdue aging, lead collection escalations, and partner with Credit Management to evaluate and mitigate payment exposures.
    

****3\. Business Development, Growth, Operational Execution & Commercial Governance****

* Growth & Expansion Support: Partner with Business Development and Technical teams to evaluate expansion projects, greenfield opportunities, and decarbonization initiatives, preparing business cases and commercial validation packages for Cluster/Group approval
    
* Operational & Crisis Interface: Serve as the commercial lead during supply disruptions, major turnarounds, or operational events, driving commercial risk mitigation and managing claims or disputes to protect customer relationships while enforcing contractual discipline.
    
* Customer Voice & Operational Feedback: Champion customer requirements internally across Operations, Supply Chain, and Technical teams to translate feedback into service reliability improvements and seamless onboarding of newly commissioned projects.
    
* Governance, Compliance & Safety: Ensure strict adherence to corporate governance, anti-bribery regulations, internal delegation of authority, and safety (EHS) standards, while maintaining accurate CRM records, contract documentation, and reporting to the Commercial Director.
    

## \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

## Are you a MATCH?

****Qualifications & Experience:****

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related technical/commercial field. An MBA or Master’s degree is desirable.
    
* Experience: Minimum of 8–12 years of progressive experience in B2B commercial management, strategic account management, and complex industrial sales.
    
* Industry Background: Proven background in industrial gases, petrochemicals, energy, refining, or heavy industrial manufacturing sectors.
    
* Track Record: Demonstrated success in long-term supply agreements, complex negotiations, profitability management, customer retention, and cross-functional commercial leadership.
    

****Skills & Competencies:****

* ****Technical & Commercial Skills:****
    
    * Advanced financial acumen covering commercial P&L, margin analysis, revenue assurance, receivables, Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), forecasting, and pricing/indexation mechanisms.
        
    * Strong grasp of commercial law principles, contract drafting, contractual risk, claims, and long-term supply agreement mechanics.
        
    * Proficiency in CRM, ERP, reporting and analytics tools for data-driven commercial management.
        
    * Deep understanding of regional B2B industrial markets, customer operating models and the commercial impact of operational events.
        
    * Strong command of Strategic Account Planning, executive stakeholder mapping and multi-level account governance.
        
* ****Core & Behavioral Competencies:****
    
    * Strategic Negotiation & Influence: Ability to steer high-stakes negotiations, manage conflicts and achieve sustainable win-win outcomes with senior stakeholders.
        
    * Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to lead by influence across Operations, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Technical and Business Development without direct reporting lines.
        
    * Customer-Centricity: Strong focus on customer value, service reliability, responsiveness and long-term retention.
        
    * Commercial Discipline: High attention to contractual obligations, billing accuracy, collections, financial exposure, governance and execution follow-through.
        
    * Resilience & Decisiveness: Capable of making sound commercial decisions under pressure, particularly during supply constraints, disputes or operational disruptions.
        
* ****Languages:** Fluent Arabic and English required; French is desirable.**

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

## Overview

The HSE Manager will be responsible for leading, implementing, and continuously improving all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) functions across Projects. The role will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight to ensure that all bridge and infrastructure construction activities are executed in compliance with project requirements, client standards, Saudi Arabian regulations, and international best practices.

* Develop, implement, and manage the Project HSE Management Plan aligned with project objectives and client requirements.
* Establish project-wide HSE policies, procedures, standards, and performance objectives.
* Lead and promote a proactive safety culture focused on prevention, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Provide strategic HSE leadership to project management, construction teams, and contractors.
* Drive achievement of "Zero Harm" and incident-free project delivery goals.

* Lead hazard identification and risk assessment processes across all project activities.

AtkinsRealis is looking for an experienced **Risk Engineer** (ideally Saudi National), who will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, technical, safety, and business risks across projects and assets.

The role involves providing accurate site measurements, setting out works, verifying construction alignment and levels, conducting as-built surveys, and supporting project teams to ensure all works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.

* Verify coordinates, levels, dimensions, and structural positioning before and during construction activities.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Field Structural Engineer will be responsible for monitoring and supervising structural construction activities to ensure compliance with approved designs, project specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable codes and standards. The role will support the successful delivery of large-scale building and hospitality developments by ensuring structural integrity, construction quality, safety, and adherence to project schedules.

## Your role

**Construction Supervision**

* Inspect structural works including foundations, retaining structures, concrete works, steel structures, and building frameworks.
* Verify that construction activities are executed in accordance with approved construction methodologies and quality requirements.
* Monitor site activities to ensure workmanship meets project specifications and industry standards.
* Witness inspections and testing activities related to structural materials and completed works.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of structural construction issues.

**Technical Review and Coordination**

* Review structural shop drawings, material submissions, and contractor technical proposals for compliance with design intent.
* Coordinate with architects, MEP engineers, quantity surveyors, and construction teams to address design and construction interfaces.
* Evaluate requests for information, technical queries, and proposed design modifications related to structural works.
* Support review and assessment of value engineering proposals affecting structural systems.
* Provide technical recommendations and solutions to site-related structural challenges.

**Quality Assurance and Compliance**

* Ensure structural construction activities comply with project quality plans, specifications, and approved procedures.
* Verify the quality of construction materials through review of test reports and inspection records.
* Monitor implementation of inspection and test plans for structural works.
* Identify non-conformities and ensure corrective actions are implemented and properly closed out.
* Support quality audits and compliance reviews related to structural construction activities.

**Site Inspection and Monitoring**

* Conduct regular site inspections to assess construction progress, workmanship quality, and compliance with approved designs.
* Monitor contractor adherence to approved work sequences and construction methodologies.
* Verify installation and execution of structural elements prior to concrete pours and subsequent construction activities.
* Ensure site records accurately reflect completed structural works and inspection outcomes.
* Assist in monitoring construction schedules and reporting progress against project milestones.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Liaise with Client representatives, contractors, consultants, and project management teams on structural engineering matters.
* Participate in construction progress meetings and technical coordination meetings.
* Support the resolution of structural issues raised by contractors and project stakeholders.
* Coordinate inspections with quality, HSE, and testing teams to ensure compliance requirements are achieved.
* Maintain effective communication with all project participants regarding structural works progress and performance.

**Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on structural construction progress and compliance activities.
* Maintain records of inspections, testing results, site observations, and technical reviews.
* Review contractor reports and verify accuracy of structural work progress and quality data.
* Document non-conformance reports, corrective actions, and technical recommendations.
* Ensure all structural engineering records are properly maintained and available for project audits and reviews.

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering with a specialization in Structural Engineering or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Structural Engineering is preferred.
* Professional Engineering registration or equivalent professional accreditation is desirable.
* Membership in a recognized engineering institution is preferred.
* Additional certifications related to structural design, construction supervision, or project management are advantageous.

* Minimum 8-12 years of professional experience in structural engineering and construction supervision.
* Minimum 5 years of experience on site supervision consultancy projects involving major building developments.
* Proven experience in large-scale buildings, convention centers, hotels, resorts, and mixed-use developments.
* Strong experience in reinforced concrete, structural steel, foundations, and building structural systems.
* Previous GCC experience, particularly within Saudi Arabia, is highly desirable.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of structural engineering principles, construction methodologies, and building systems.
* Thorough understanding of international structural design codes, construction standards, and quality requirements.
* Experience in reviewing shop drawings, material submittals, structural calculations, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of structural inspection procedures, testing requirements, and construction quality control practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and engineering software relevant to structural engineering.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* High attention to detail and commitment to engineering excellence.

Account Manager (Sales Specialist) | Arabic Speaking
About Fresha
Fresha is the leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry, giving businesses everything they need to run smarter, grow faster and build stronger client relationships.
In May 2026, Fresha secured an $80M growth investment from KKR at a valuation of $1B , officially reaching unicorn status and bringing total funding raised to $285M. Already profitable, Fresha is using this investment to accelerate global expansion and drive the next generation of AI and product innovation.
Today, Fresha operates at global scale, with offices across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. Our platform is trusted by 130,000+ beauty and wellness businesses across 120 countries , with more than 1.5 billion appointments booked to date.
Our mission is simple: help beauty and wellness businesses grow by giving them the technology they need to attract clients, manage their operations and run their business in one place.
We’re continuing to scale rapidly across markets, teams and products, making this an exciting time to join us.
Role Overview
Account Manager | Arabic Speaking | Office-based (5 days/week)
We’re looking for an ambitious Account Manager to join our growing commercial team, focused on driving product adoption, payments conversion and revenue growth across a portfolio of Fresha partners.
Reporting to the Account Manager Team Lead, you’ll build strong relationships with existing partners and act as a trusted advisor, helping them understand and adopt the products that can have the biggest impact on their businesses.
A key focus of the role will be introducing and converting partners onto Fresha’s payments solution , while also helping optimise their presence on the Fresha marketplace to maximise visibility and conversion.
This is a commercial, consultative role where you’ll combine relationship management, data analysis and sales skills to identify opportunities and deliver measurable commercial outcomes. You’ll work closely with Sales, Onboarding and Product teams to ensure a strong partner experience and feed valuable insights back into the wider business.
You’ll be joining a fast-paced environment where autonomy, performance and continuous improvement are highly valued. We’re looking for someone who is commercially motivated, analytical and proactive, with the confidence to influence partners and drive change.
Fluency in Arabic and English is mandatory for this role.
To foster a collaborative environment centred on in-person interaction and teamwork, this role is 5 days/week in our office.
Video submissions will be prioritised to help speed up the interview process. In your video, please briefly introduce yourself, tell us what motivates you, why Fresha interests you and why you believe you would be a great fit for the role.
What You’ll Do

• Payments & Product Adoption: Proactively educate partners on Fresha’s products, with a particular focus on converting businesses onto Fresha’s payments solution and increasing product adoption.

• Commercial Growth: Own commercial targets across your portfolio, using account insights and performance data to identify opportunities for revenue growth, upselling and cross-selling.

• Marketplace Optimisation: Help partners optimise their listing content and availability to improve their competitiveness on the Fresha marketplace and maximise booking conversions.

• Partner Relationships: Build strong, long-term relationships with your portfolio, acting as a trusted advisor and helping partners select and adopt the products most relevant to their needs.

• Consultative Selling: Use discovery and consultative sales techniques to understand partner needs, recommend relevant solutions and confidently influence purchasing decisions.

• Collaboration & Feedback: Work closely with Sales, Onboarding and Product teams to support the partner journey, ensure smooth handovers and share valuable feedback that can improve Fresha’s products and partner experience.

What We’re Looking For

• Commercial Experience: Demonstrable experience in a partner-facing, account management or sales role where you have been responsible for delivering commercial outcomes.

• Sales & Growth: Previous experience in outbound sales, upselling, cross-selling or another revenue-generating environment, with a proven ability to work towards targets.

• Analytical Mindset: Comfortable using data, reporting and account insights to identify opportunities and improve commercial performance.

coordination, and flawless execution of social, corporate, cultural, wellness, and high-profile   
private events within the resort. This role transforms spaces into extraordinary experiences,   
ensuring every event reflects the theatrical elegance, creativity, and elevated service   
synonymous with the Faena brand.

events from initial handover through execution, working closely with clients, Sales, Culinary,   
Operations, Wellness, and Executive teams to deliver bespoke occasions ranging from   
intimate celebrations to exclusive buyouts and destination gatherings.

event destinations in the Kingdom and beyond.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage all confirmed events from contract handover to post-event follow-up, ensuring seamless execution at every stage.

* Plan and coordinate weddings, private celebrations, executive retreats, brand launches, wellness events, incentive groups, cultural programming, and luxury gatherings.
* Conduct site inspections, planning meetings, tastings, rehearsals, and operational briefings.

## Job Description

**Department:** Finance  
**Section:** Credit / Accounts Receivable  
**Position:** Credit Supervisor  
**Reports To:** Director of Finance  
**Hotel:** Mövenpick Hotel and Residence Hajar Tower Makkah  


**Job Purpose**

The **Credit Supervisor** supports the effective management of the hotel’s **Credit and Accounts Receivable function**, ensuring accurate billing, timely collection of outstanding balances, proper credit control, and compliance with hotel policies and internal financial controls.

The role works closely with Finance and operational departments to protect the hotel’s financial interests while maintaining professional relationships with corporate clients, travel agencies, government accounts, groups, guests, and other business partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Credit Control & Accounts Receivable**

* Supervise the day-to-day activities of the **Credit and Accounts Receivable** function.
* Ensure all credit accounts are properly approved and supported by valid documentation in accordance with hotel credit policies.
* Review new credit applications and ensure required documents, approvals, credit limits, and payment terms are complete.
* Monitor credit limits and payment terms and highlight accounts requiring management attention.
* Review the **Accounts Receivable Aging Report** regularly and follow up on outstanding balances.
* Maintain systematic collection follow-up with companies, travel agents, government entities, groups, and other debtors.
* Escalate significantly overdue or high-risk accounts to the Credit Manager and Director of Finance.
* Support the hotel in controlling **Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)** and minimizing bad-debt exposure.

## Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance. **SOCPA certification** or membership is preferred.

Previous experience in Credit, Accounts Receivable, or Hotel Finance is required. Previous experience in a supervisory capacity within an international hotel environment is an advantage.

Strong knowledge of credit control, accounts receivable, and financial procedures.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting systems.

Experience with Opera PMS or similar hotel systems is an advantage.

Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Good command of English and Arabic.

SOCPA certification or membership is preferred

Job Purpose:

Receive, store, pick, and issue spare parts and accessories in the CEER parts warehouse, maintaining accurate stock records and a safe, organized storage environment to support timely parts availability for aftersales operations.

Key Functional Responsibilities:

Receiving & Put-away:
• Receive incoming parts shipments, verify quantities and condition against purchase orders/delivery notes, and report discrepancies or damage to the Parts Operations Asst. Manager.
• Bin and store parts in designated warehouse locations following CEER Warehouse & storage SOPs.
• Label and tag stock items using standard identification methods to ensure traceability.

• Investigate and report stock discrepancies to the Parts Operations Asst. Manager.
• Flag slow-moving, excess, or obsolete stock items for review.

• Operate material handling equipment (pallet jacks, forklifts where certified) safely and in line with HSE procedures.
• Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and adherence to 5S/housekeeping standards.
• Support periodic warehouse audits and compliance checks.
System & Documentation:
• Record all stock movements (receipts, issues, transfers, adjustme

nts) in SAP/WMS accurately and on time.
• Maintain documentation for goods receipt notes, delivery notes, and stock adjustment forms.

Job Requirement:

Education: High school diploma or vocational/technical certificate; a diploma in Logistics or Supply Chain is preferred.

Experience:

• 2-4 years of experience in warehouse operations, stock keeping, or parts logistics.

• Experience within an automotive Dealer/OEM parts environment is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with WMS/ERP systems (SAP is a plus) and material handling equipment.

Job Purpose:

To design, deliver, and evaluate technical training programs for CEER Motors’ dealer and service network, ensuring technicians are fully competent in the diagnosis, repair, and maintenance of CEER electric vehicles. The role supports network readiness, high-voltage safety compliance, and consistent technical capability across all CEER service centres.

Key Functional Responsibilities:

• Prepare, conduct, and evaluate technical training programs relating to CEER EV systems, high‑voltage safety, diagnostics, and repair procedures.

• Deliver instructor-led, hands-on, and digital training sessions across technical training workshops, EV labs, service centres, and classrooms.

• Develop and update training curricula, technical content, training manuals, presentations, and assessments in line with CEER standards.

• Conduct written and practical assessments to measure technician competency and readiness.

• Maintain training materials, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with product updates and engineering releases.

• Support the preparation of the annual and quarterly training plan to meet departmental and network requirements.

• Track trainee performance, attendance, and certification status; maintain accurate training records.

• Provide feedback on technician skill gaps and recommend training interventions to the After-Sales Training Manager.

• Support new model introductions by developing and delivering product launch technical content.

• Ensure all training activities comply with EV and high-voltage safety protocols.

• Assist in piloting and validating new training tools, equipment, and teaching methodologies.

Key Managerial Accountabilities:

• Contribute to achieving departmental objectives by delivering accurate, high-quality training and meeting assigned targets.

• Support the implementation of policies, procedures, and controls covering all assigned training activities.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in training processes, materials, tools, and trainee performance.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness of all reports, submissions, assessments, and documentation within the training function.

• Maintain the confidentiality of CEER internal information, training data, and proprietary technical content.

• Ensure adherence to Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) standards, especially EV and high‑voltage safety practices.

Job Requirement:

Education : Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electro‑Mechanical, or Automotive Engineering. EV/High‑Voltage Certification preferred.

Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of automotive technical experience, including diagnostics and repair. Prior experience in technical training is preferred.

Description
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth.
The Amazon University Talent Acquisition Team is looking for ambitious students to join us as Operations Intern, working in one of our core businesses, Amazon Operations.
About this internship
Our internships are educational opportunities intended to allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of Associates. As an Operations and Logistics Interns, you will learn how our managers effectively engage their teams to realize their full potential, ensure their performance in order to fulfill our customers’ expectations, and encourage a safe and productive environment within our large and complex Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers and Delivery Stations.
Your internship will put you at the heart of our Operations where you will be part of the journey of one of our many customer's orders.
Key job responsibilities
You will put your analytical skills to the test and roll up your sleeves to complete actions that will contribute to improving the functionality and level of service that Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers and Delivery Stations provide to our customers.
This will include:
- Diving deep into data, mapping processes and problems
- Offering and testing potential solutions and implementing the best one(s)
- Interacting with highly efficient managers, technology development teams, and front-line associates, thinking broadly about solutions to the most complex business and operational challenges faced by one of the world’s fastest growing operations network
Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027.
You should be available for 3 to 6 months, full time (40h/week) in Riyadh. This role is field based.
A day in the life
As an intern, you will be matched to a mentor.
In addition to learning about an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional
development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship.
No matter the location of your internship,
we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.
About the team
If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.
- Competitive pay
- Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
- Networking opportunities with fellow interns
- Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
- Mentorship and career development
If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies
Internship length is 3 to 6 months, full-time.
Basic Qualifications
- Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree with a graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English
- Available to commence an internship between January and December 2027. Yes, our start dates are flexible! You should then be available for 3-6 months, full time (40h/week).
Preferred Qualifications
- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
