## Company Description

Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

## Job Description

The Performance Senior Manager will be responsible for driving the overall business performance of HungerStation Market by providing management with the insights, analysis, and recommendations required to make better strategic and operational decisions.

The role will work closely with senior management and functions including Commercial, Operations, Finance, Logistics, Product, Marketing, and BI to monitor performance, identify opportunities, challenge plans, and translate insights into actions.

**Key Accountability Areas**

**Business Performance & Executive Reporting**

* Own HungerStation Market performance reporting across financial, commercial, customer, and operational metrics.
* Monitor performance, identify key drivers and gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
* Lead weekly and monthly business reviews, executive updates, and performance deep dives.
* Support senior management with ad hoc analysis on critical business topics.

**Forecasting, Planning & Financial Management**

* Lead business forecasting and support annual and strategic planning.
* Drive OKR setting, tracking, and performance management.
* Support P&L management and identify key revenue, cost, investment, and profitability drivers.
* Build and challenge business cases and investment plans, including store expansion.

**Business Analytics & Performance Deep Dives**

* Lead deep dives across store, customer, commercial, operational, and logistics performance.
* Analyze customer acquisition, frequency, retention, churn, and lifetime value.
* Evaluate campaign, promotion, pricing, and investment performance.
* Build analytical frameworks and models to improve business decision-making.

**Commercial Performance**

* Support optimization of pricing and commercial mechanics, including fees, minimum order values, margins, and promotions.
* Evaluate customer investment and trial strategies based on incremental impact and ROI.
* Monitor competitive activity and translate market developments into business actions.

**Strategy & Business Development**

* Support medium- and long-term strategy across store expansion, assortment growth, and new business opportunities.
* Develop frameworks for pricing, assortment, customer lifetime value, and budget optimization.
* Identify opportunities to improve demand planning, availability, and business performance through analytics and automation.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a key business partner across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Logistics, Product, Marketing, and BI.
* Translate business priorities into clear analytical, product, and operational requirements.
* Drive alignment across local and Delivery Hero stakeholders and ensure initiatives progress against plan.

## Qualifications

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 7–10 years of relevant experience in performance management, strategy, management consulting, corporate finance, FP&A, business analytics, e-commerce, or technology.
* Strong experience in business performance management, strategic planning, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to work with senior stakeholders and translate complex analysis into clear recommendations.
* Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, marketplaces, retail, or technology is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or another relevant field.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Ability to move between high-level strategy and detailed analytical work.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive ambiguous, cross-functional topics.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides.
* Strong SQL skills is a strong plus; experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Looker are highly preferred.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

## Company Description

Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

## Job Description

As a Data Analyst II at HungerStation, you will support the product development lifecycle by analyzing data, understanding user needs, and providing actionable insights that help optimize product performance.

You will work closely with Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams to turn data into meaningful insights and support data-driven decision-making.

In this role, you will:

* Analyze product and business data to understand growth drivers and identify opportunities for improvement.
    
* Develop analyses, reports, and interactive dashboards to support business teams and stakeholders.
    
* Use quantitative analysis to uncover insights and help Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers understand what to build and why.
    
* Work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources, including BigQuery, Redshift, and PostgreSQL.
    
* Use SQL (BigQuery) and Python or R to extract, process, and analyze large datasets.
    
* Design and analyze A/B tests by defining hypotheses, setting up experiments, and evaluating results using statistical methods.
    
* Own data projects from data collection through to operationalization.
    
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar visualization platforms.
    
* Contribute to continuous improvement of data and analytical processes.
    

## Qualifications

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics or a related field.
    
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a relevant field.
    
* Strong SQL skills, with experience using BigQuery.
    
* Python or R experience is required.
    
* Basic knowledge of statistics and experience applying statistical methods to data.
    
* Experience working with large datasets and data from multiple sources.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    
* Experience creating dashboards and reports using tools such as **Looker** Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar.
    
* Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for business and product stakeholders.
    
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams.

job_title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (relocation to Germany)
description:
We are looking for a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team with eventual relocation to Germany. EPAM is renowned for delivering cutting-edge technological solutions to transform businesses worldwide.
We are building AI-native solutions for our clients - products where LLM and its harness are the core of the value. This is a builder's role: you and your team are responsible for building agentic systems, writing the production code, and standing up the evals and observability. You will work closely with SMEs and end-users to understand where the real value lies, and you design the feedback loops.
The deadline for submission is 01.12.2026.

Responsibilities
• Design, build and ship end-to-end AI-native systems including agents, workflows, RAG and integration harnesses
• Write production-grade Python code for integrations, APIs, data access and deployment
• Work directly with subject matter experts and end-users through interviews, user acceptance testing and workflow observations
• Engage early in projects to shape use cases and check technical feasibility
• Build evaluation pipelines and use them to prove system utility
• Design for failure in the agent loop by implementing retries, model fallbacks, cost limits and human-in-the-loop actions
• Capture domain expertise and repeatable workflows to ensure success across engagements. Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges in collaboration with the broader team
• Ensure adherence to engineering excellence standards including test-driven development and continuous integration practices

Requirements
• 7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of building production AI and LLM applications
• Expert-level Python skills and solid software engineering fundamentals
• Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and major LLM providers
• Strong RAG and retrieval skills including vector databases, embeddings, hybrid search and context management
• Production deployment experience on major cloud platforms like AWS, Azure or GCP with containerization and CI/CD
• Proven experience evaluating generative AI quality using custom evaluation frameworks and observability tools
• Proven capability to work closely with clients, lead discovery conversations and explain technical trade-offs to diverse audiences
• Strong agent-design judgment and sound engineering judgment under ambiguity to balance speed, quality and scope
• C1 level English language proficiency
• An academic degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

Nice to have
• Experience designing experiments, A/B testing and iterating on AI products against real user behavior
• Strong background in NLP, Data Science or applied machine learning with experience moving models into production
• Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), Agent Skills and emerging agent standards
• Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Databricks Genie or Microsoft Foundry
• Exposure to AI governance, security and compliance including guardrails and prompt-injection prevention

About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
12
The Revenue Solution Architect (RSA) serves as a technical expert within the Revenue organization, forging close partnerships with Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology and our Enterprise Data Organization. In this position, you will be responsible for translating customer objectives into well-scoped and implementable technical solution designs that align to established product capabilities and supported architectures. The role is execution-oriented; producing high quality technical discovery outputs, solution designs and technical validations that reduce delivery risk and improve deal velocity and progression.
Primary Focus
+ Execute solution architecture for opportunities and customer engagement by mapping customer objectives to approved product capabilities, standard integration patterns, and delivery approaches.
+ Produce clear, repeatable architecture artifacts (diagrams, integration flows, assumptions, risks, NFRs) that improve alignment and speed decisions during the sales cycle.
Support solution-led customer conversations by shifting discussions from features to workflows/outcomes using existing technical GTM narratives and playbooks.
Revenue & Deal Enablement
+ Partner with Sales/Account teams to support customer engagement through technical qualification, requirements clarification, and solution shaping aligned to existing plays.
+ Help improve deal velocity by preparing technical inputs that reduce ambiguity (assumptions, dependencies, sizing inputs, sequencing).
+ Support deal execution by participating in customer technical meetings and responding to technical questions
Customer & Commercial Problem Solving
+ Build working knowledge of customer workflows and map them to solution capabilities to support measurable outcomes.
+ Assist in resolving technical objections by providing evidence-based responses grounded in platform capability, reference patterns, and prior implementations (where available).
+ Support retention/expansion motions by identifying adoption blockers and aligning on remediation steps with Account and Revenue teams
Cross-Functional Collaboration
+ Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Technology partners to ensure proposed solutions are deployable and supportable within current capabilities and standards.
+ Contribute structured feedback from customer/deal learnings into internal forums (pattern gaps, recurring requirements, common integration issues).
+ Support Revenue teams with clear documentation and execution/follow up on open questions and solution design capability
Revenue Acceleration and Enablement
+ Apply standard solution patterns to reduce rework and delivery risk; document reusable modules and lessons learned in knowledge repositories
+ Support prototypes/POCs by following established methodology, validating feasibility, and documenting results and limitations
+ Help standardize technical discovery and architecture documentation within the team by consistent use of approved formats.
+ Contribute to playbooks, documentation and training for revenue-wide capability building
Required Experience & Expertise
+ 5+ years in pre-sales solution architecture, technical sales enablement, technology and/or GTM architecture
+ Technical fluency in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) , hyperscalers and modern orchestration approaches.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

AtkinsRealis are looking for a Design Manager (DM) for PMC Development (RIBA Stage 1-4).

The PMC Design Manager shall be project based in KSA, assigned to support and assist the PMC Senior Project Managers to oversee the Client appointed Lead Design Consultants (LDC) on various development projects (RIBA Stages 1 – 4), in accordance with the PMC Development Framework scope of services. The role requires active and direct involvement, approach to work that is structured, systematic, efficient and disciplined having excellent communication and reporting skills.

## Your role

* Tender for LDC / Consultancy Services: Produce scope of works services for tender documentation considering the Clients existing Framework Agreements with various Consultants and the Project Brief to be developed by the appointed LDC.
    
* Oversight of Design and Approval Phase: DM shall oversee the Client appointed LDC activities and coordinate the designs for various stages and elements of each Project to align with the project objectives (brief), monitor the status of design progress & LDC deliverables, Client approvals and statutory approvals/permits.
    
* Design Review: PMC Services exclude all technical review obligations (no PI cover for technical reviews), technical reviews shall be undertaken by the LDA appointed separately by the Client. DM shall manage, document, co-ordinate, stage design reviews and audit the designs for compliance with the design briefs, risk and value analyses, and production of deliverables in accordance with the design brief, Quality Management Plan and HSE Plans and in accordance with procedures agreed with Client. Manage the Stakeholder design review and reporting process. Compile the Stage Gateway report at the end of each RIBA Stage.
    
* Change Management: DM shall review design documents to ensure that they are in general accordance with the versions of those documents previously approved by Client and do not contain unauthorized changes that may impact on each Projects’ time and cost. Any changes instructed by the Client shall be administered by the Client appointed Cost Consultant, register of design changes to maintained and agreed between Client and LDC. DM shall evaluate the necessity and feasibility of all potential design changes and compile / review the impact of design changes in terms of time, cost, and quality, and make a recommendation for Client’s consideration.
    
* Cost Management / Cost Estimate Review: LDC obligations include Cost Management to design to approved budget. DM shall assist PMC to ensure that the LDC Cost Manager assist, cooperate, meet and review with Client, PMC, Cost consultant and other parties to participate in any cost estimates, value engineering studies or constructability studies, so as to aid in construction direction, analysis and overall economies in the Works.
    
* Design Coordination: DM shall assist PMC to manage the design processes in accordance with procedures agreed with Client. PMC shall control the planning and scheduling of the design processes and forecast the dates by which design deliverables shall be required. DM shall review and monitor design progress and any independent checking and inform Client on the issues, so the approvals are facilitated, and the overall process is expedited.
    
* Value Management & Value Engineering: DM shall oversee the LDC obligation to comply with the Value Management requirements and where instructed, to implement the Value Engineering exercise in collaboration with the Client’s Cost Consultant.
    
* Design Workshops & Progress Meetings: DM shall coordinate with the client and LDC to establish routine design workshops and progress meetings. Minutes of Meetings shall be produced in accordance with PMC obligations.
    
* Completeness of Scope of Work for RFP Bidding: DM shall assist PMC to ensure that Scope of work for RFP are 100% complete before bidding. PMC shall ensure that LDC prepare, from the approved Project Brief, the Drawings, Specifications, finish schedules, product/equipment descriptions and other construction information (i.e., the “Contract Documents”) to form a robust scope of work.
    
* Design Reports: DM shall ensure that the LDC issue a Design Progress Report monthly. This report shall include the activities of all Sub-consultants of the Consultant, irrespective of any contractual relationship between them. Where no Lead Design Consultant has been appointed by Client, the PMC shall be responsible for writing the Design Progress Report.
    
* Design Risk Assessment: Collaborate with the LDC to identify, list, monitor and eliminate all design risks through the various design stages.
    

## About you

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in architecture or engineering, or a related field qualification is required. PMP in project management is advantageous.
    
* Experience (Client Criteria): Design Manager (Hospitality / Education & Schools / Culture / Arts / Museums / Mixed) at pre-contract stage, 7+ years’ experience including 3-years PgMC/PMC Managerial experience on similar projects.
    
* Industry Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of various Asset types (Mixed-Use), including its regulations, best practices, and emerging trends.
    
* Software: Proficiency in design coordination tools and platforms (e.g., BIM, Revit, AutoCAD).
    
* Project Management Expertise: Proficiency in project management methodologies, tools, and techniques, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects.
    
* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, and present project updates and proposals effectively.
    
* Time Management: Exceptional time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and unforeseen challenges, ensuring successful project completion.
    
* Safety Focus: A deep commitment to maintaining project safety standards and prioritizing safety in all aspects of the project.
    
* AtkinsRéalis Values: AtkinsRéalis require all staff to uphold the company values relating to safety, integrity, collaboration, innovation and excellence.
    

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
    
* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
    
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
    
* Generous annual leave balance.
    
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
    
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
    
* Company gratuity scheme.
    
* Discretionary bonus program.
    
* Annual flight contribution.
    
* Relocation assistance.
    
* Transportation & housing allowances (available for remote work locations).
    
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
    

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Your responsibilities will encompass inspecting electrical systems, equipment, and installations to verify their adherence to established guidelines and specifications. This role demands a meticulous approach, strong technical knowledge, and a commitment to upholding safety protocols in all electrical operations.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Inspector specializing in Structural assessments to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in civil engineering, with a focus on structures. The Inspector will be responsible for conducting thorough inspections, evaluating structural integrity, and providing detailed reports on the condition of project and related infrastructure. The role requires a keen eye for detail, excellent analytical skills, and a deep understanding of structural engineering principles.

## Your role

**Structural & Road Infrastructure Inspection**

* Conduct routine and specialized inspections of road and highway structures, including:
* Bridges and flyovers.
* Underpasses and tunnels.
* Retaining walls and abutments.
* Culverts, drainage structures, and road-side installations.
* Verify that construction works comply with approved IFC drawings, technical specifications, and method statements.

**Quality Control & Compliance**

* Perform visual inspections, dimensional checks, and non-destructive testing (NDT) as required for concrete and steel structures.
* Monitor concrete works including formwork, reinforcement, concreting, post-tensioning, and curing activities.
* Ensure compliance with AASHTO, ASCE, FHWA, ASTM, and local authority (UAE) standards.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Record inspection data, site observations, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and corrective actions.
* Prepare detailed inspection and progress reports highlighting:
* Structural condition.
* Construction quality issues.
* Safety concerns and recommendations.

**Coordination & Technical Support**

* Coordinate daily inspection activities with contractors, consultants, and project management teams.
* Assist Project Engineers in reviewing shop drawings, material submittals, and work inspection requests (WIRs).
* Provide technical guidance to junior inspectors and site staff on best practices in road structure construction.

**Stakeholder & Site Interface**

* Attend site meetings with clients, contractors, and regulatory authorities as required.
* Support audits, quality reviews, and inspections conducted by authorities or third parties.
* Ensure inspection activities are aligned with project schedules and safety requirements.

## About you

**Education & Certification**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering (Structural specialization preferred).
* Master’s Degree is an advantage.
* Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent certification preferred.

**Experience**

* 7+ years of proven experience in structural inspection, preferably on:
* Road and highway projects.
* Bridges and major infrastructure works.
* Demonstrated experience working in consultant supervision roles is highly desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of:
* Structural engineering principles and materials.
* Road and highway construction methods.
* Quality assurance and inspection procedures.
* Proficient in inspection tools, testing equipment, and reporting software.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Senior Material Engineer is responsible for managing and controlling the quality, testing, and approval of construction materials used in civil engineering projects. The role ensures that all materials meet project specifications, industry standards, and contractual requirements while providing expert support to construction and QA/QC teams to achieve high-quality and durable project outcomes.

## Your role

* Review, evaluate, and approve construction materials, mix designs, and material submittals.
    
* Supervise laboratory and field testing of soil, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, bitumen, and related materials.
    
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, drawings, and applicable standards (ASTM, BS, IRC, MORTH, AASHTO, etc.).
    
* Monitor and implement material quality control and quality assurance (QA/QC) processes.
    
* Analyze test results, identify non-conformities, and recommend corrective actions.
    
* Provide technical guidance to site teams on material-related issues and performance.
    
* Oversee calibration, operation, and maintenance of laboratory and testing equipment.
    
* Prepare and review material approval logs, test reports, and quality documentation.
    
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, QA/QC, and construction teams on material matters.
    
* Supervise and mentor material engineers, inspectors, and laboratory personnel.
    
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental requirements related to materials testing.
    

## About you

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related discipline. **UPDA Grade A Registration required.**
    
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in construction material engineering.
    
* Strong knowledge of concrete technology, asphalt, soil mechanics, and pavement materials.
    
* Proven experience in field and laboratory material testing and inspections.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Commercial / Contract Administrator will be responsible for managing contractual, commercial, and cost-related matters for the Projects. The role will support the effective administration of contracts, change management, payment certification, claims management, and commercial reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

## Your role

**Contract Administration**

* Administer construction contracts in accordance with project requirements and contractual obligations.
* Monitor contractor compliance with contract conditions, specifications, and project deliverables.
* Interpret contract clauses and provide contractual guidance to project teams.
* Review contractual correspondence and prepare formal responses on commercial and contractual matters.
* Maintain comprehensive contract records, registers, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure all contract administration activities comply with client requirements and project governance procedures.

**Commercial Management**

* Monitor project costs and commercial performance against approved budgets.
* Assist in the preparation and review of cost forecasts, financial reports, and commercial assessments.
* Support project leadership in identifying and mitigating commercial risks.
* Track commitments, expenditures, and cost trends throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare commercial reports for management and client review.

**Change Management & Variations**

* Manage variation orders, contract amendments, and change requests.
* Review contractor submissions for variations and assess entitlement, cost impact, and schedule implications.
* Prepare commercial evaluations and recommendations for approval.
* Monitor change management processes to ensure timely resolution of commercial issues.
* Maintain variation logs and change control records.

**Claims Management**

* Assess contractual entitlement and supporting documentation.
* Support preparation of contractual responses, determinations, and recommendations.
* Assist in the resolution of commercial disputes and claims negotiations.
* Coordinate with planning, engineering, and commercial teams to substantiate project positions.
* Payment Certification
* Review contractor interim payment applications and supporting documentation.
* Verify quantities, progress achievements, and contract milestones.
* Coordinate with engineering and construction teams to validate completed works.
* Prepare payment recommendations and certifications in accordance with contract provisions.
* Monitor payment status and ensure compliance with project procedures.

**Measurement & Quantity Verification**

* Review measured quantities associated with bridge and infrastructure works.
* Support quantity reconciliation and cost verification activities.

**Procurement & Subcontract Administration**

* Support procurement activities and contract award recommendations.
* Assist in preparation and review of tender documentation, BOQs, commercial schedules, and contract conditions.
* Evaluate commercial aspects of contractor and supplier bids.
* Administer subcontracts and monitor compliance with agreed commercial terms.
* Assist with supplier and subcontractor performance reviews.

**Risk Management**

* Identify and assess contractual and commercial risks.
* Develop mitigation strategies to protect project interests.
* Maintain commercial risk registers and issue logs.
* Monitor risk exposure associated with scope changes, delays, and contractor performance.
* Provide recommendations to project management regarding commercial risk management.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate records of contractual correspondence and approvals.
* Support audits and commercial compliance reviews.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Construction Law, Commercial Management, or Project Management is desirable.
* Professional membership with RICS, CIArb, ICE, AACE, or equivalent professional institutions is preferred.

* Minimum 8-12 years of experience in commercial management, quantity surveying, or contract administration.
* Minimum 5 years of experience on major bridge, highway, or transportation infrastructure projects.

* Experience working with consultants, PMCs, government clients, or major contractors is preferred.

* Strong commercial and contractual acumen.
* Excellent analytical and negotiation skills.

* Strong knowledge of claims and dispute resolution processes.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

We are seeking a qualified Traffic Inspector to support traffic management activities across active road construction sites in Riyadh. The role involves inspecting traffic arrangements, ensuring proper implementation of approved traffic management plans, monitoring on site traffic flow, and coordinating with contractors and authorities to maintain safety and compliance.

## Your role

* Inspect and verify traffic diversion setups on site as per approved Traffic Management Plans (TMPs).
* Monitor live traffic conditions and recommend corrective actions to ensure smooth flow and safety.
* Ensure proper installation and maintenance of signage, barriers, cones, delineators, and lighting.
* Conduct site assessments to identify risks and provide solutions for safe vehicle and pedestrian movement.
* Coordinate with contractors, site engineers, and government authorities on diversion arrangements.
* Ensure compliance with local traffic regulations and safety standards.
* Report non‑conformities and follow up on rectifications.
* Prepare daily site inspection reports and maintain accurate documentation.

## About you

* Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation, or related field.
* Minimum 10 years of hands‑on site experience in traffic inspection or traffic diversions in road construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of traffic control devices, road safety procedures, and diversion execution.
* Experience working with live traffic environments and fast‑paced construction sites.
* Ability to interpret and enforce Traffic Management Plans.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Familiarity with Saudi traffic regulations and standards.

# ******Job Description Summary******

GE Vernova is hiring Early Career Sales Specialist Trainee accountable for the Gas Insulated Substations (GIS) order intake, margin and cash for KSA within Middle East and Africa (MEA) Region.  
  
 This is an entry-level position designed for a high-potential engineering graduate to join our Gas Insulated Substations (GIS) Sales team. As a Sales Specialist Trainee, you will support the regional sales team in driving growth across transmission and industry segments. You will be mentored to develop your commercial strategy, customer relationship skills, and technical expertise, with the goal of eventually managing your own portfolio of opportunities.  
  
Duration: 12- months

# **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Opportunity Support: Assist in early-stage project detection and monitor the FEED (Front End Engineering Design) stage of potential projects.
* Tendering Assistance: Support the senior sales team in preparing quotations, organizing tender documentation, and tracking progress.
* Commercial Documentation: Help build value propositions and assist in the compilation of product qualification/homologation documents and techno-commercial offers under the guidance of the Product Line (PL) tendering team.
* Customer Engagement: Accompany senior team members to customer meetings to learn the art of customer intimacy, relationship building, and contract clarification.
* Market Research: Conduct basic market assessment tasks and competitor analysis to help the team define Commercial Action Plans.
* Internal Collaboration: Assist in the hand-over process between Sales and Project Execution teams to ensure seamless project transition.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Electromechanical, Mechatronics, Power Systems, or Communication Engineering from an accredited university or college or a related field.
* Fresh graduates with up to 2 years of experience.
* High proficiency in English, Arabic native language is mandatory.
* Ability to travel when necessary within KSA and MEA region.
* The legal right to work in KSA without company sponsorship or time restriction.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong academic record with a demonstrated interest in the Energy/Power sector.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical skills, self-motivated, and a high degree of curiosity.
* Ability to work effectively in a multi-cultural, matrix organization
* Strong presentation skills, self-discipline and proactive mindset.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

# ******Additional Information******

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

  

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our singular mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it.

If we want our energy future to be different…we must be different.

Our mission is embedded in our name. We retain our treasured legacy, “GE,” in our name as an enduring and hard-earned badge of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” / “verde” signal Earth’s verdant and lush ecosystems. “Nova,” from the Latin “novus,” nods to a new, innovative era of lower carbon energy that GE Vernova will help deliver.

# ******Job Description Summary******

 Assisting with complex rig moves, preparing, and executing lift plans, and providing on-site supervision for the crane operator team to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant heavy-lift operations.

# **Job Description**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead and supervise the crane operator team during all lifting activities, ensure clear communication and adherence to safe load control.
* Perform designed lifting plans to ensure both rigging gear and loads are protected, perform correct hand signaling and maintain constant communication.
* Identify load weights and calculate required sling sizes, sling angle stresses, and center of gravity (COG). Utilize bridge and crane load charts and unit conversion charts (Metric/Imperial) for all lift arrangements.
* Conduct detailed pre-lift inspections of all rigging equipment to ensure zero defects and compliance with OEM guidelines; inspect, assemble, and dismantle rigging setups.
* Ensure all operations strictly follow GE Vernova standards, report hazards immediately, and maintain accurate documentation of all activities.
* Act as a team player, providing leadership on the shop floor to maintain a culture of safety.

**Qualifications/Requirements**:

* High school diploma or higher.
* Ability to read/write instructions in English, and effectively present information to the rigger team.

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Rigger 1 in an industrial setting.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the housekeeping department, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, sanitation, and aesthetic upkeep throughout the hotel. This role involves strategic planning, staff management, and maintaining a seamless operation to enhance guest satisfaction, cultivating a culture of excellence, inspiring the team to strive for perfection, and taking pride in their work. Lead housekeeping operations: Direct all aspects of Housekeeping operations, including system management, budgeting, forecasting, inventory control, and policy implementation
Ensure high quality standards: Oversee and uphold cleanliness, service, and product quality standards in guest rooms, public spaces, restrooms, offices, and meeting areas
Collaborate on improvement projects: Partner with Property Operations and other departments on rehabilitation and capital improvement projects to enhance facilities
Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs
Uphold regulatory compliance: Ensure adherence to health and safety standards, particularly as related to proper usage of chemicals and cleaning supplies

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Extensive experience in housekeeping management, preferably in a 5-star hotel.
Strong leadership and organizational skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
Knowledge of cleaning techniques, equipment, and chemicals.
Proficiency in budgeting and financial management.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands, and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

SAIC is seeking Systems Engineers to support the U.S. Navy's Foreign Military Sales (FMS) C4I modernization program for the Royal Saudi Naval Forces (RSNF) on-site in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and Jubail, Saudi Arabia in direct support of the Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR) program office. The Systems Engineers will lead requirements analysis, technical site surveys, system verification, and analysis of alternatives (AoA) for the integration of C4I and Commercial Off The Shelf (COTS) capabilities into RSNF platforms and shore facilities. The selected candidate will interact routinely with U.S. Government and Saudi senior military and government officials and will produce technical documentation suitable for foreign disclosure release.
+ Perform end-to-end systems engineering for C4I capabilities (GCCS, NAVMACS, HF/UHF/VHF radios and antennas, Tactical Data Links Link-11/16/22, CENTRIXS, Network Communications, SATCOM, ADSI, VBSS) deployed to RSNF afloat and ashore.
+ Conduct technical site surveys at RSNF facilities in Riyadh, Jubail, and Jeddah; capture as-built configurations and translate operational needs into engineering requirements.
+ Plan and execute System Operation Verification Tests (SOVTs); develop test procedures, witness installations, document discrepancies, and drive resolution.
+ Research and conduct Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) for COTS products (radars, GPS, AIS, Radio Direction Finding, EO cameras, GMDSS, APS, Emergency Radio, FOTN, CCTV, Video Display, VTC) and provide trade studies with recommendations.
+ Support Systems Engineering and Technical Reviews (SETR) including SRR, PDR, CDR, and TRR events; prepare and present engineering artifacts.
+ Author and sanitize technical documentation for foreign disclosure review; coordinate disclosure determinations with the U.S. Government Foreign Disclosure Office.
+ Interface with U.S. Government (NAVWAR program managers, GS-15 civilians, O-6 field grade officers) and senior RSNF military and government officials.
+ Contribute engineering inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and brief schedule status to program leadership in MS Project and MS PowerPoint.
+ Identify, document, and mitigate technical risks; escalate cost, schedule, or performance impacts to the Program Manager.
+ Comply with all OCONUS work, security, and country-clearance requirements; maintain valid U.S. passport and Kingdom of Saudi Arabia work documentation.
Qualifications
Required Education:
+ Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field from an accredited college or university and five (5) years’ experience.
Required Clearance:
+ Must possess an active Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.
Required Skills:
+ Five or more (5+) years of experience supporting C4I systems (e.g., GCCS, NAVMACS, Tactical Data Links, Radios/Antennas, SATCOM, ADSI, or similar systems).
+ Three or more (3+) years of experience with COTS equipment (e.g., radars, GPS, EO cameras, GMDSS, APS, FOTN, CCTV, or VTC systems).
+ Experience working OCONUS in security cooperation efforts, engaging with U.S. Government or foreign senior military/government officials.
+ Expertise with foreign disclosure, technical documentation sanitization, site surveys, SOVTs, or AoAs of COTS products.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills related to C4I systems and network communications.
Desired Skills or Required Certifications:
+ Three or more (3+) years of experience with NAVWAR prime mission products and supporting Systems Engineering and Technical Reviews (SETR).

+ Proficiency in developing and presenting Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) using tools like MS Project and MS PowerPoint (or similar).
+ Master's degree in an Engineering field from an accredited institution.

description:
**Location:** [**Jubail Saudi Arabia**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fzPG3q1TysGiKNtG9)  
  

**Position Summary:**

Position requires a skilled MH-60/H-60 Avionics Technician AT with the ability to perform Planned Maintenance Interval Inspections (PMI), Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level maintenance on **H-60** helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of aircraft radio’s, radar, navigation equipment, and other rapid communication devices. Extensive knowledge in wire, and connector repair is required. Position is in Jubail Saudi Arabia.

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter Avionics work to include but not limited to:
* Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, and wire and connector replacements on the MH-60R aircraft and related systems.
* Have a knowledge of electronic theory.
* Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on electrical and utilities systems.
* Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair.
* Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP.
* Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training.

  

**Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:**

* 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to: installation, tests, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, alignments, modification, performing final test calibrations, and solving maintenance problems in highly complex navigation identification, radar electronic devices, navigational radar, electronic countermeasure systems, global positioning system (GPS), and armament systems.
* Must be able to solve complicated problems encountered by pilots while in flight. Often these problems cannot be duplicated on the ground.
* Have a thorough understanding of flight characteristics and their effects on electronic systems. Systems includes search/ navigational radar, communication, navigation, electronic countermeasures, data computing, recording equipment, weapons computer, and inertial measurement systems.
* Be able to use test equipment such as voltmeters, signal generators, sweep/ pulse generators, dual trace oscilloscopes, deviation meters, sweep carts, precision power, and frequency measuring devices. Also, must use various test sets that detect discrepancies that often do not appear during bench rework in work centers.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic diagrams, and technical directives
* Work with miniaturized solid-state circuits and devices. Able to use a full range of hand tools common to the trade. Must have a thorough knowledge of digital/ analog computers, algebra, and trigonometry.
* Must be able to pass a background check, and drug test.

  

**Preferences**:

* **Navy Aviation Avionics - AT MH-60R HSM HSC**
* **Airborne Low-Frequency Sonar (ALFS):** AN/AQS-22
* **Sonobuoy Processing System**
* **Multi-Mode Radar:** AN/APS-153(V)
* **Open-Architecture Mission Computer**

  

**Clearance Requirement:**

* **Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret Clearance.** Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing. **US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.**

* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
* Must be able to walk, and stand on level, inclined surfaces for certain periods throughout the day. Also be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
* Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
* Distinguish color and judge three-dimensional depth.

  

**Other Responsibilities:**

  

Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.

**Who Are We**

  
HALA is a leading fintech player in the MENAP region that aims to redefine financial services and build the future bank of SMEs. HALA aims at empowering SMEs to start, run, and grow their businesses by providing them with cutting-edge financial and technological tools.

  
HALA currently holds multiple entities in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt (including HALA Payments and HALA Logistics) and offers solutions that enable merchants to digitize their payments as well as manage their sales and operations.

  
Founded in 2017, HALA is currently licensed by the Saudi Arabian Central Bank.

Objective:  
  
We are seeking a senior auditor to join our Internal Audit team and perform risk-based financial, accounting, and finance-related audits across HALA. The senior auditor will be responsible for planning and executing audits covering financial reporting, accounting processes, financial controls, treasury, revenue assurance, reconciliations, financial instruments, and other finance-related activities. The role involves evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls, assessing compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and accounting standards, identifying financial and operational risks, and providing practical recommendations to strengthen financial governance, reporting accuracy, operational effectiveness, and risk management. The position will also contribute to the execution of the approved Internal Audit Plan, development of audit methodology, supervision of audit resources, and delivery of high-quality audit reports and insights to senior management and the Audit Committee.

Responsibilities:

\-Perform audit planning activities, including risk assessments, audit scoping, identification of key financial risks and controls, development of audit programs, and preparation of testing procedures

\-Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of financial controls, identify control deficiencies, assess their financial and operational impact, and provide practical recommendations to strengthen the control environment.

\-Assess the accuracy, completeness, validity, and integrity of financial records, transactions, account balances, management reports, and financial statements.

\-Review financial reporting processes and compliance with applicable accounting standards, including IFRS as adopted in Saudi Arabia, relevant SOCPA requirements, and other applicable local accounting standards.

\-Conduct audits of key finance processes, including financial close and reporting, journal entries, revenue recognition, expenditure management, fixed assets, provisions, accruals, intercompany transactions, and financial reconciliations.

\-Review treasury operations, cash management, bank reconciliations, payment processes, liquidity management, and controls over financial assets and liabilities.

\-Evaluate controls over revenue streams, merchant settlements, transaction processing, refunds, chargebacks, commissions, and other financial activities relevant to HALA’s FinTech operations.

\-Assess compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and recognized accounting and control frameworks, including SAMA requirements, Companies Law, SOCPA, IFRS, and other relevant regulatory requirements.

\-Review financial controls over technology-enabled processes, financial applications, interfaces, and data flows, in coordination with IT Audit and relevant technology stakeholders.

\-Conduct interviews, walkthroughs, and process reviews with Finance, Treasury, Accounting, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to understand processes and associated controls.

\-Perform substantive and control-based audit testing, including analytical reviews, sample testing, reconciliation reviews, journal entry testing, and validation of supporting documentation.

\-Identify potential financial misstatements, control weaknesses, process inefficiencies, fraud risks, and regulatory compliance gaps, and assess their implications for the organization.

\-Prepare clear, concise, and evidence-based audit reports, working papers, and executive presentations communicating audit findings, risk implications, root causes, and actionable recommendations.

\-Present audit findings and recommendations to senior management and facilitate discussions to obtain agreement on corrective action plans, responsible owners, and target completion dates.

\-Monitor and validate the implementation of agreed management actions through periodic follow-up reviews and provide independent assurance over the effectiveness of remediation activities, including validation of regulatory observations where required.

\-Build and maintain effective working relationships with Finance, Treasury, Accounting, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, and external stakeholders while preserving audit independence and objectivity.

\-Support the execution of the approved Internal Audit Plan and contribute to the preparation of risk assessments, audit planning, Audit Committee reporting, and periodic updates on audit activities.

\-Stay abreast of emerging financial risks, changes in accounting standards, regulatory requirements, FinTech developments, and evolving internal audit and risk management practices.

\-Review audit working papers, ensure quality and timely delivery of engagements, and contribute to knowledge sharing and professional development within the Internal Audit Department.

Requirements:

\-Master / bachelor’s degree

\-Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in audit & assurance

\-Strong understanding of auditing principles and practices

\-Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

\-Ability to work independently and as part of a team

\-Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities and meet deadlines

\-Knowledge of internal controls and risk management frameworks

\-Strong understanding of financial accounting, auditing principles, internal controls, risk management, and financial reporting practices.

\-Professional certification such as CIA, CPA, ACCA, CA or other relevant accounting/audit qualification is preferred.

\-Experience in a similar industry or field is a plus

**What We Offer You**  
**We believe you will love working at HALA!**

* We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in remote, in-office, and hybrid work setups.
* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 7 countries and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
* You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.

**If you think you have what it takes to join a remarkable team #apply\_now**

## About the Company

Riyadh Air (RXI), based in the heart of Saudi Arabia's capital, is the new innovative national airline redefining the future of air travel. With a vision to position Saudi Arabia as a global aviation and trade center, Riyadh Air aims to revolutionize the industry. This modern, digitally-driven airline will connect the kingdom to over 100 destinations worldwide.

## About the Role

Are you ready to elevate your career? We are seeking passionate and collaborative pilots to join our flight deck team. Our crew members are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safety and professionalism.This position is based in Riyadh and offers a full-time and lifestyle rostering option upon meeting defined criteria and subject to availability. Featuring a mixture of international and domestic flights from our Riyadh hub, you will be part of our ambitious journey without limits, where you can unleash your full potential and make your mark in aviation history. With us, the opportunities for growth and advancement are boundless.

## About You

To qualify for this role, you should have a minimum of 6,000 hours of total flying time on multi-crew, multi-engine aircraft, including at least 2,000 hours of recent command experience on widebody aircraft. Please note that only time spent in the operating seat of turbojet aircraft will be considered.You must also hold a valid ICAO ATPL, an unrestricted class one medical certificate, and an ICAO English level 5 or higher certification. Additionally, candidates should have logged a minimum of 150 hours in command within the last 12 months prior to joining the Riyadh Air team.Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. JOB OVERVIEW
The Kids Club/Youth Club Assistant Manager supports the management and daily operation of the hotel’s Kids Club, Youth Club, and recreational activities, ensuring engaging, safe, and memorable experiences for children, teenagers, and families.
The role assists in leading the Recreation team, developing creative activity programs, maintaining the highest standards of safety and supervision, and delivering personalized experiences aligned with the standards of luxury hospitality.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Assist in managing the daily operations of the Kids Club, Youth Club, and assigned recreation facilities and activities.
Supervise, guide, and support Kids Club, Youth Club, and Recreation team members during daily operations.
Plan, coordinate, and implement engaging recreational, educational, creative, cultural, and entertainment programs for different age groups.
Ensure activities are age-appropriate, inclusive, safe, and delivered according to established standards.
Create memorable and personalized experiences for children, teenagers, and families.
Monitor the supervision of children and teenagers and ensure established safeguarding and safety procedures are followed at all times.
Ensure registration, sign-in, sign-out, and authorized collection procedures are properly followed.
Maintain appropriate team-to-child supervision levels during all activities.
Conduct regular inspections of Kids Club, Youth Club, recreation areas, equipment, toys, and activity spaces.
Ensure all facilities and equipment are clean, safe, organized, and maintained to the highest standards.
Identify and report safety hazards, damaged equipment, maintenance requirements, or operational concerns.
Assist in preparing weekly and seasonal recreation calendars and special activity programs.
Support the organization of family activities, themed events, celebrations, and special recreational experiences.
Engage professionally with parents and guardians and provide clear information regarding activities, schedules, and safety procedures.
Handle guest requests, feedback, and concerns professionally and escalate matters when required.
Assist with team scheduling, task allocation, training, coaching, and performance monitoring.
Conduct team briefings and ensure operational information and guest requirements are communicated effectively.
Monitor recreational supplies, equipment, games, and materials and coordinate replenishment requirements.
Maintain accurate records, attendance information, incident reports, and operational documentation.
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, child safeguarding requirements, health and safety procedures, and applicable regulations.
Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Spa, Security, and other departments to support seamless family experiences.
Support Recreation management with departmental planning, reporting, budgeting, and operational requirements.
Perform other duties as assigned by Recreation management.

Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Recreation, Sports Management, Child Development, Education, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in Kids Club, Youth Club, Recreation, Family Experience, or a similar hospitality environment.
Previous supervisory or team leadership experience is preferred.
Luxury hotel, resort, or family-focused hospitality experience is highly desirable.
Good knowledge of recreational programming and age-appropriate activities for children and teenagers.
Strong understanding of child safeguarding, supervision, health, and safety requirements.
First Aid and CPR certification is preferred.
Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holidays, and shifts, according to hotel operations.

SKILL
Strong leadership and team supervision skills.
Excellent guest service and interpersonal skills.
Strong understanding of child safety and safeguarding practices.
Creative activity planning and programming skills.
Ability to engage effectively with children, teenagers, and families.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Good organizational and planning abilities.
Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Strong attention to safety and detail.
Ability to handle guest feedback and operational situations professionally.
Good time management and prioritization abilities.
Teamwork and cross-departmental coordination skills.
Positive, energetic, and professional approach.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.

* Move between decorating and baking sections based on production volume and operational requirements.
* Ensure cakes are completed accurately and to the required quality and presentation standards.
* Maintain consistent decorating and baking techniques across different orders.
* Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace safety standards at all times.

* Basic to solid baking experience, including mixing, portioning, and baking.
* Comfortable moving between decorating and baking tasks based on production requirements.
* Consistent and reliable technique with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment.
* Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
* Reliable, flexible, and willing to support different areas of production when needed.
* Good teamwork and communication skills.
* Ability to follow standardized recipes, processes, and quality guidelines consistently.
* Passion for baking, cake decorating, and creating high-quality products.

We are looking for a Cost Estimator / Estimation Engineer to join the team of a fast-growing advertisement agency specializing in signages, branding, events, exhibitions, fabrication, and interior fit-out.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing accurate and detailed project cost estimates by reviewing drawings, BOQs, specifications, and project requirements. You will work closely with the Sales, Design, Production, Procurement, and Project Teams to ensure projects are accurately priced and commercially viable.

This is a hands-on estimation role suited to someone with experience in costing, quantity take-offs, materials, fabrication, and project pricing, particularly within the events, exhibitions, signage, advertising, or fit-out industries.

### Responsibilities

* Review project drawings, BOQs, specifications, scope of work, and client requirements.
* Prepare detailed costings sheets for exhibitions, events, booths, branding, signage, fabrication, fit-out, and related projects.
* Prepare and verify Bills of Quantities (BOQs) based on drawings and project requirements.
* Calculate quantities for materials, fabrication, installation, transportation, manpower, equipment, and subcontracted works.
* Obtain, review, and compare quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, fabricators, and service providers.
* Prepare detailed cost breakdowns covering materials, labor, equipment, transportation, installation, and subcontracting.
* Apply appropriate markup, overhead, profit margin, contingency, and other commercial allowances based on company requirements.
* Prepare final pricing and quotation sheets for submission to the Sales or Commercial Team.
* Coordinate with Sales, Design, Production, Procurement, and Project Teams to clarify requirements and ensure accurate costing.
* Identify potential cost implications, missing information, and technical or commercial requirements during the estimation process.
* Maintain accurate and organized costing records and estimation

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing, quantity surveying, exhibitions, fit-out, signage, advertising, or fabrication.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas and costing spreadsheets.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, BOQs, layouts, and specifications.
* Good understanding of materials and works including MDF, plywood, acrylic, aluminum, PVC, digital printing, lighting, electrical works, carpentry, and metal fabrication.

* Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.

We are looking for a skilled and independent Quality Control Supervisor to join the production team of a fast-growing company operating across multiple markets. You will play a critical role in maintaining the highest standards of quality, food safety, and compliance across the facility, with the authority to take immediate action when food-safety standards are at risk.

In this role, you will work closely with the operations and kitchen leadership teams to build and maintain a strong QHSE culture across the facility. You will own food-safety monitoring, audits, HACCP requirements, incident investigations, training, and regulatory compliance, while acting as the independent voice for quality and food safety in day-to-day operational decisions.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and maintain QHSE policies, procedures, and programs in line with applicable local, national, and international standards.
* Own and independently conduct Critical Control Point (CCP) monitoring across the facility.
* Support CCP monitoring during facility commissioning and ensure food-safety controls are established from the start.
* Conduct regular QHSE audits, inspections, and risk assessments to identify hazards, non-compliance, and areas for improvement.
* Recommend and implement corrective and preventive actions to address identified risks and issues.
* Have the authority to halt or hold production when food-safety standards are at risk and make the final call on resuming production.
* Lead food-safety and quality incident investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure incidents are documented, reported, and escalated appropriately, including to regulatory bodies where required.
* Develop and maintain the facility’s HACCP plan and continuously update it as products, equipment, processes, or production volumes change.
* Own the facility’s internal, supplier, third-party, and regulatory audit and certification calendar.
* Ensure the facility remains prepared for inspections and external audits at all times.
* Conduct QHSE audits of suppliers and contractors and ensure external partners meet required standards.
* Deliver QHSE and food-safety training to kitchen and production teams.
* Monitor QHSE performance metrics and report trends, risks, and findings to management.
* Stay up to date with relevant regulations, certifications, food-safety standards, and industry best practices.
* Recommend improvements to policies, processes, and controls to continuously strengthen QHSE performance.
* Work closely with operations and kitchen leadership to embed food safety and quality into daily production.
* Act as the independent QHSE voice in operational, facility, and expansion-related decisions.

**Requirements**

* Saudi national.
* 5-6 years of experience in QHSE, food safety, quality assurance, or a similar role.
* HACCP certified.
* Proven experience independently managing CCP monitoring and food-safety controls.
* Experience supporting or establishing QHSE processes within a new or commissioning facility is preferred.
* Previous experience working in a bakery, food production, or similar manufacturing environment is preferred.
* Strong understanding of HACCP, food-safety standards, QHSE systems, audits, and risk assessments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to conduct thorough incident investigations.
* Confident in making independent decisions and taking ownership of food-safety issues under production pressure.
* Comfortable exercising authority to hold or release production when required.
* Strong understanding of local food-safety regulations and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to influence operational teams.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple audits, certifications, investigations, and compliance requirements.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing production environment.

Description:
+ Position requires a skilled H-60 powerplant/engine mechanic with ability to perform Planned Maintenance Interval Inspections (PMI), Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level maintenance on MH-60 helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of hydraulic components, flight controls, pumps, landing gear, tires, hydraulic, pneumatic, and pressurized systems.
Essential Responsibilities:
+ Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter maintenance to include but not limited to:
+ Performing maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, hydraulic, pneumatic, and related systems.
+ Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on hydraulic components and related systems.
+ Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP.
+ Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair.
+ Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training.
Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:
+ 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter mechanical work to include but not limited to: inspection, assembly/ disassembly, repair, replace, troubleshooting, rig checks, test of a variety of hydraulic components, airframes, landing gear assembly, bridge assembly, and rotor head systems.
+ Installs, adjusts, aligns, and performs final functional/ operational tests on a variety of major aircraft systems, assemblies, sub-assemblies, components: hydraulic servo’s, pumps, main/tail rotor blades, flight controls systems.
+ Disassemble, and reassemble components/sub-systems and determines the required repairs, completes check out procedures to ensure proper operation.
+ Visually check component for corrosion, improper wear, and adjustments.
+ Be able to use a variety of precision measuring instruments, special tools, scales, test stands, and external power sources.
+ Duties may include minor preservation on various components and blades.
+ Knowledge of the makeup, operation, installation, and adjustment of a variety of major interrelated and/or integrated aircraft systems, subsystems, and assemblies such as hydraulic, pneumatic systems, airframes, surface repair, and landing gear.
+ Inspect main mounts, and tail wheel shocks, struts for cracks, damage, security, leaks, and proper lubrication.
+ Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematic diagrams.
Qualifications:
+ QAR/CDQAR, A&P license (not required if service specific quals are validated), or military equivalent such as Technical Inspector, and Restricted Technical Inspector, or 7 level are required.
Clearance Requirements:
+ Must be able to obtain and maintain a NAC(T3) Background Investigation and drug test. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. May be required to obtain and maintain a secret clearance. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing.
Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:
+ To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
+ Must be able to walk and stand on level and/or inclined surfaces for certain periods throughout the day. Also be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
+ May be required to lift 50 pounds.
+ Must be able to distinguish color and judge three-dimensional depth.
Other Responsibilities:
+ Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks, and serving on safety committees and teams.
+ Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.
+ Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job.
