# ******Job Description Summary******

Substation Automation Engineer with Cyber Security Specialization executes substation automation system engineering activities for the projects assigned considering the quality/Cost/ time delivery criteria. This role involves planning design activities, managing project design budget, implementing design change process, supervising, and coordinating all engineering activities required to execute the project, whether done in house or by suppliers/subcontractors, and ensuring technical compliance to project specification.  
  
Employee is responsible for cyber security design, configuration, implementation, assurance and training in the cluster. The candidate will liaise with tendering team (ITO) to recommend, clarify and propose appropriate cyber security solution based on customer specification and RFQs and liaise with execution team (OTR) in preparing, reviewing documents/drawings, configuration and conducting cyber security FAT and SAT. This role covers all GA business product lines including PAC, CIC and M&D.

# **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

*As part of Technical Tendering*

* Man-days (MD) estimation for design activities during ITO stage.
* Work closely with ITO team to support new opportunities preparation and negotiations. This includes conducting site surveys, deals estimations and prequalification support.
* Review any RFQ’s that touch on Cyber Security or could potentially have an impact on Cyber Security. List recommendations on how to proceed and list any clarifications or exceptions we might take to the bid concerning Cyber Security, using GE and GE Renewable energy Policies, coordinating with relevant teams (Grid Solutions, Renewable Energy, Legal).
* Proposing appropriate cyber security solutions to customer referring to customer specification and GE capabilities/products ensuring core system (DS Agile, GPG, CCS, CIC etc) compatibility.
* Creating an architecture reference that could be used for Inquiry to Order (ITO) proposals that require Cyber Security.
* Creating the Security Assurance Plan (SAP) for all projects which require it, be able to discuss it with relevant teams in GE and with the Customer.
* Creating a BOM template for Cyber security devices using a standardized format across GA.
* Creating a template that could be used for estimating costs associated with implementing cyber security (including parts, labor and testing of cyber architecture).
* Developing DOR for cybersecurity project execution by internal and external stake holders.

  

*As part of Execution*

* Demonstrate EHS compliance and ensure Zero Deviation Plan is implemented within the team and setting the example by demonstrating the proper acts and actively observes work conditions and behaviors, giving constructive feedback and celebrating EHS effective prevention.
* Man-days (MD) control for design activities during OTR stage.
* Liaise with other members of a multidisciplinary team to specify and design the project, whilst meeting the required technical standards.
* Preparation of all applicable production documentations needed for panels integration
* Ensure on-time delivery of design to stakeholders with suitable quality including partner documents.
* Participate in cost reduction process through standardization and out of the box ideas that optimize the provided solutions.
* Approve the technical evaluation of offers from suppliers, Support Procurement during commercial negotiation for POs issuance and during post order stage.
* Support site organization during site preparation and commissioning stage when required and ensure compliance with Quality Procedures, work instructions and processes defined at Unit and project level.
* Support factory during FAT preparation and conduct internal validation followed by customer FAT to ensure successful project delivery.
* Participate and contribute to the project multidisciplinary design reviews according to PL procedures and per the project strategy.
* Manage design issues up to resolution and validate design throughout customer acceptance and check consistency of engineering documents before final release to customer while managing evolution of customer requirements & associated impacts.
* Analyze customer technical requirements, prepare and or consolidate clause by clause analysis and ensure compliance to Customer requirements through technical queries. Identify, track and manage potential exception and represents customer interests in the design decisions at PM request.
* Effectively communicate directly with customers to ensure excellent customer service and to build and maintain customer intimacy.
* Creating the Functional Design Spec (FDS) and all documents for the cyber security system which would also define the architecture being implemented.  In conjunction work with other internal and external entities to ensure the overall Cyber security design is cohesive.
* Conduct the FAT and SAT relating to Cyber Security. Detail on how the security of the system will be tested. Possibly help come up with a list of subcontractors that could be used.
* Configuring the Cyber security devices (Switches, hubs, servers, Jump box, firewalls, IDS etc.).
* Develop cyber security assurance and maintenance plan for all installed base and its execution.
* Align with core system team to implement and test cybersecurity during internal validation for system/solutions.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline technology from an accredited university
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in substation automation projects, and OT security
* Experience with security designs and architectures, best practices in network topology for OT
* Ability to prepare design documents and configuration/database for substation automation projects and conduct FAT.
* Good experience in OT protocols.
* Experience with security technologies, such as
    * LDAP, RADIUS, GPO, SSH, SFTP, HTTPS, SYSLOG
    * Encryption, TLS
    * DMZ, Virtualization
* Knowledge of cyber security standards and regulations affecting the utilities industry, such as IEC 62443, NERC CIP, IEEE 1686, IEC 62351.
* Fluent English speaking and writing mandatory
* Travelling: 50% of time for missions, tender/project support, customer meeting and marketing efforts.

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Knowledge in competitor products is advantage
* Experienced in GE DS Agile, GPG or similar SAS system
* Ability to present technical solutions to customer and identify possible solutions for an issue
* Ability to work effectively in a team and across functions, partnering with other teams in a worldwide environment
* Cyber security certification (ex. ISA, ISC2, SANS, ISACA, CISSP) is a plus.
* Ability to provide training for internal team/customers and external customer/suppliers Time and resource management skills.
* Demonstrated experience with Telecom and Network Equipment (Routers, Switches, next gen Firewalls, etc)
* Demonstrated experience with Intrusion detection system and protection equipment and software (like Nozomi)
* Strong customer service/growth mind-set and strong interpersonal skills
* Awareness of latest technical developments in the cyber security community
* Pro-activeness, sense of urgency, resistance to pressure, autonomy; ability to interact with multiple functions and teams worldwide
* Pro-activeness, sense of urgency, resistance to pressure, autonomy; ability to interact with multiple functions and teams worldwide

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with attention to detail and a results-oriented approach.

## Job Description

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Receiving Clerk is responsible for accurately receiving, inspecting, and recording all incoming goods and supplies. The role ensures that deliveries match purchase orders in terms of quantity, quality, and condition, while maintaining proper documentation and updating inventory records. It also involves identifying discrepancies, coordinating with suppliers and internal departments, and supporting effective stock control and smooth operational flow.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Receive all incoming goods, materials, and supplies from vendors and suppliers
    

* Inspect deliveries to ensure items match purchase orders in quantity, quality, and specifications
    

* Verify delivery documentation such as invoices, delivery notes, and purchase orders
    

* Record all received items accurately into the inventory or procurement system
    

* Report and document any damaged, missing, or incorrect items
    

* Coordinate with purchasing and suppliers to resolve discrepancies or issues
    

* Ensure proper labeling, tagging, and documentation of received stock
    

* Assist in organizing and storing goods in designated storage areas or warehouses
    

* Maintain accurate receiving logs and records for audit and tracking purposes
    

* Follow up on pending or partial deliveries with suppliers
    

* Ensure compliance with company policies and receiving procedures
    

* Assist in stock counts and inventory reconciliation when required
    

* Maintain cleanliness and order in the receiving area
    

* Ensure proper handling of perishable or sensitive items (if applicable)
    

* Support internal departments with supply requests and distribution coordination
    

* Maintain safety standards during unloading and handling of goods
    

* Assist in preparing reports related to receiving activities and inventory status
    

## Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent; diploma in logistics, supply chain, or business is an advantage
    

* 1–3 years of experience in receiving, warehousing, inventory, or stores operations (preferably in hospitality or retail)
    

* Basic understanding of inventory control and procurement processes
    

* Familiarity with purchase orders, delivery notes, and stock documentation
    

* Experience using inventory or ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, or similar systems is an advantage
    

* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for record keeping and reporting
    

## Additional Information

**SKILLS**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
    

* Good organizational and record-keeping skills
    

* Basic numerical and counting skills
    

* Ability to verify and inspect goods carefully
    

* Communication skills for coordinating with suppliers and internal teams
    

* Problem-solving skills to handle discrepancies and delivery issues
    

* Time management and ability to handle multiple deliveries
    

* Physical ability to handle loading/unloading tasks when required
    

* Teamwork and cooperation skills
    

* Integrity and honesty in handling goods and records
    

* Knowledge of safety and warehouse procedures
    

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines

The Income Auditor is responsible for reviewing, verifying, and reconciling all revenue transactions to ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records. job_title: Lifecycle Operations and Maintenance Manager - AVL Expert (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission
As our Lifecycle Operations & Maintenance Manager, you will play a key role in developing and managing BeWunder Lifecycle Operations activities across the Middle East. Working closely with our Director of Lifecycle Operations and our internal Project Management, Design & Engineering, Commercial, and Procurement teams, you will take ownership of the ongoing service and maintenance requirements of our permanently installed AVL and media technology projects such as museums, theatres and other venues.

Combining a strong AVL technical background with project, operational and account management skills , you will act as a key interface between our clients and internal teams. You will coordinate preventive, operational and reactive maintenance activities, manage service requirements and SLAs, maintain project and service documentation, and ensure our clients receive reliable and responsive support throughout the lifecycle of their installations.

At the same time, you will help further establish and develop our Lifecycle Operations function in the Middle East, introducing efficient processes, structures and solutions as our portfolio continues to grow.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Develop and implement comprehensive operations and maintenance concepts for permanently installed AVL, media and technology systems across our projects.

• Manage the lifecycle of service and maintenance assignments, including preventive maintenance, operational maintenance, reactive maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs.

• Coordinate service activities and ensure contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs), response times and client commitments are understood, monitored and met.

• Act as a key point of contact for our clients, building strong long-term relationships and ensuring clear, proactive communication throughout service and maintenance activities.

• Assess technical issues, coordinate the appropriate resources and specialists, and drive practical solutions through to successful resolution.

• Coordinate internal teams, external specialists, suppliers and subcontractors required for individual maintenance and service assignments.

• Support the preparation and calculation of service and maintenance requirements, cost estimates and maintenance concepts, working closely with our Commercial team.

• Coordinate the commercial administration of completed service assignments, including the preparation of relevant information for invoicing and commercial follow-up.

• Maintain a comprehensive overview of ongoing service activities, client requirements, open issues, maintenance schedules and project documentation.

• Ensure accurate and structured documentation of services rendered and maintain relevant information within Salesforce, Jira and other internal systems and databases.

• Develop clear reporting structures to ensure technical issues, service activities and outstanding actions are communicated to the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.

• Support supplier sourcing and negotiations in collaboration with Procurement to ensure suitable technical solutions, availability and commercial value.

• Help build and develop the Lifecycle Operations & Maintenance function in the Middle East, introducing new processes and continuously improving existing workflows and ways of working.

• Work independently as the regional point of contact while collaborating closely with the wider Lifecycle Operations team and leadership based in Germany.

• Provide first-level technical support and coordination when required, ensuring issues are appropriately assessed and escalated to the relevant technical specialists.

• Travel regularly to project sites across the Middle East, including Jeddah, Riyadh, Abu Dhabi and other locations, as required.

Your profile
• Several years of relevant experience in AVL, media technology, technical operations, project management, service management or lifecycle operations within permanently installed AV environments.

• Previous management experience within AV service, maintenance, project or technical operations.

• Strong technical understanding of audio, video and lighting (AVL) systems, media technology and related infrastructure.

• Good understanding of IT and networking fundamentals relevant to integrated AV and media systems.

• Experience with permanently installed technology environments such as theatres, cultural venues, museums, immersive experiences, entertainment destinations, malls or similar complex venues would be highly advantageous.

• Strong understanding of preventive and reactive maintenance, troubleshooting, service coordination and SLA-driven support environments.

• Ability to understand technical issues and coordinate appropriate solutions without necessarily being the hands-on technician carrying out every intervention.

• Strong client-facing and account management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and confidently manage client expectations.

• Commercial awareness and an understanding of how technical service delivery, client satisfaction and commercial performance work together.

• Experience coordinating suppliers, subcontractors and specialist technical resources; previous exposure to supplier negotiations would be advantageous.

• Strong organisational and documentation skills, with confidence managing multiple projects, service requests and priorities simultaneously.

• Familiarity with CRM, ticketing and project management systems such as Salesforce and Jira, as well as a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• A proactive, flexible and solution-oriented mindset, with the energy and motivation to build processes, challenge existing approaches and drive improvements independently.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the Middle East.

• Fluent English and Arabic are strongly preferred; German language skills would be an additional advantage.

About Us:

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

About Us:
At Raytheon, by combining our vast resources and investments, we are able to dedicate ourselves to solving mission-level vs. product-level customer challenges – together we can anticipate more, move faster and make a bigger impact on the big picture.

Job Summary:
This role is responsible for growing Raytheon’s business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) as well as pipeline development, external customer engagement and serving as the voice of the customer to internal Raytheon stakeholders. This position is located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and will be a member of the country team reporting to the Raytheon Director of Requirements & Capabilities.

Additionally, this role will assist the Country R&C Director by euring compliance with all internal operational policies, procedures, and practices within the RTN R&C Organization. This position will coordinate the planning and management of customer correspondence, capture/proposal gate reviews, leadership visits, trade shows, external consultants and internal team reviews. This individual will also develop associated financial tools and track relevant metrics, to include 5-Year Plan assessments, New Business Investment (NBI) requirements and Enterprise Raytheon Pipeline Manager (ERPM) opportunities. This individual will be accountable for the day-to-day cadence of tasks, processes and implementation of enabling infrastructure necessary to operate the RTN SA R&C function effectively and efficiently.

Responsibilities to Anticipate:

- Partner with requirements & capabilities, product line and functional leaders across the enterprise to evaluate customer insights and market dynamics to support the development and implementation of an enterprise-wide strategy for the Royal Saudi Armed forces.
- Regularly update Raytheon stakeholders with customer needs assessments, market data, opportunity identification and development status and key pursuits and milestones.
- Understand and communicate the budgeting and requirements process for the KSA customer, including but not limited to the process steps that the customer uses.
- Develop input to country strategies, driving the development and communication of those strategies back to RTN strategic business units.
- Strategy should be linked to operational analysis and show how the customer will employ capabilities against existing and future threats.
- Articulate through customer intimacy, the priorities of the customer and their concept of operations to help align internal priorities of RTN to meet the requirements of the customer.
- Based on customer priorities and gaps, develop and shape new business opportunities to aid the customer in filing the gaps in line with their priorities.
- Institute an internal network to enable reach back for product and service knowledge and support.
- Develop and maintain customer contact and engagement plans to establish a one Raytheon approach to managing the customer relationship.
- Lead the conduct of RTN SA R&C staff calls and opportunity reviews.
- Organize logistics and management of outside business development consultants.
- Manage ERPM opportunities in coordination with business area capture leads and R&C ops.
- Track customer engagements and coordinate on internal visitors for KSA.
- Lead the development of visitor guide (agendas, background material) for senior leadership visits.
- Facilitate implementation of initiatives across the function focused on continuous improvement and efficiency achievement.
- Track Integrated Product Development System (IPDS) milestones for KSA opportunities and apply IPDS best practice processes.
- Provide support to the development of the overall RTX strategy for KSA.
- Leverage Requirements & Capabilities metrics for continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications You Must Have:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Business, International Affairs, Engineering or other relevant discipline.
- Experience navigating intricacies of doing business with MODEA, and related services.
- Ability to work effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced dynamic environment with time criticality.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with all levels of management, and fluency in spoken and written English.
- Strong collaboration skills enabling business results working internally and externally
- Typically, requires12 years of experience with progressive leadership positions in Business Development or Defense Sales.
- Demonstrated success in relationship building in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
- Ability to leverage customer knowledge to identify potential growth opportunities in KSA.
- Understanding of the global competitive defense market, including customers and industry players, within KSA.
- Experience tracking financial metrics and plans.
- Experience with CRMs, like Microsoft ERPM.
- History of providing clear direction and leading teams to success.

Qualifications We Value:

- Prior military or defense market experience.
- Direct experience with MODEA, Royal military services (including MNG) and GAMI.
- Knowledge of Raytheon Technologies (RTX) products and services.
- Prior involvement with KSA MoD programs, captures, and product lines.
- Demonstrated ability to communicate directly and effectively with key decision makers.
- Experience with RTX (or equivalent) financial planning and analyses (FP&A) processes and procedures.
- Understanding of customer culture, political and military environment and cultural customs and norms of the region.
- Understanding of the procurement, fiscal and regulatory environment within the country.

Hexagon Autonomous Solutions is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented a Project Engineer to be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing technical projects to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. This role combines engineering expertise with project management skills, overseeing the full project lifecycle from design and implementation to testing and handover. Key responsibilities include developing project plans, managing resources, monitoring progress, mitigating risks, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. Strong problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills are essential for success in this role

SCOPE OF THE ROLE

• To have a strong and broad high-level knowledge of the mining systems deployed.

• To be a point of escalation for technical issues that the team raise as they are working on projects and to work through the escalation process to seek resolution to problems outside of the responsibility of the Project Engineers and other technical staff.

• To work with Project Managers to ensure the efficient deployment of mining systems on time and within budget.

• To ensure that the deployment of systems and products is carried out as efficiently as possible.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Actively work on product/project deployment of complex mining solutions in a hands-on manner.

• Support and maintain software.

• Deliver bespoke customization as required.

• Troubleshoot system issues.

• Own and implement customer system configurations.

• Implement system customizations using scripting tools.

• Participate in onsite system installation efforts.

• Undertake complex problem solving involving multiple integrated systems.

• To ensure that relevant stakeholders are aware of risks and or issues with the product and the technical solutions being deployed to customer sites.

• Escalation of critical issues requiring other stakeholders’ input to resolve issues, specifically the relevant Mining Services or supporting teams representative.

• Maintain technical knowledge of the current and upcoming product offerings.

• Maintain knowledge of current, new and evolving strategies and technologies in relation to systems support through appropriate industry links and professional memberships.

• Regular reporting of current project issues, including updates on status and resolution methods.

• Utilizing relationships developed with customers and other contacts to advise Mining Services Team of potential issues affecting customers as well as other opportunities for Hexagon.

• Work collaboratively with the sales team in a pre-sales capacity (e.g. attending / leading technical presentations).

• Representing Hexagon Mining in a helpful, professional and courteous manner at all times.

• Maintain, enhance and adhere to Hexagon documentation and reporting standards, systems and processes.

• Compliance with Hexagon Mining’s Workplace Health and Safety policies and procedures, participation in audits and compliance with instructions given with respect to the health and safety of himself/herself and the safety of others.

• Other duties as required from time to time.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Strong prioritizing and time management skills.

• Well-developed communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Ability to form strong relationships with customers and represent the company professionally.

• Ability to set and meet the team and individual goals and deadlines.

• Ability to resolve technical and complex issues.

• Ability to rapidly grasp technical solutions, concepts and products.

• Maintaining and supporting Linux/Unix environments.

• Developing or supporting open-source software.

• Setup and support of relational databases.

• The desire to expand own knowledge and skill set as well as sharing knowledge with other team members wherever possible.

KEY BEHAVIOUR

• Protect the company brand and reputation by exhibiting good behavior and reporting on any noncompliance to safety, procedural, or other customer dictated regulations.

• Maintain good relations with the customer ‘s personnel and clearly communicate any issues that may arise.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with managers, technicians and engineers.

• Continuously seek opportunities to improve the quality of the systems, installations, and support procedures

EDUCATION BACKGROUND

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign degree equivalent in Engineering (Computer / Mining / Electrical /Electronic), Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3 years previous Mining Industry experience of progressive experience in job offered, or as a software engineer, software consultant, mining engineer, or related occupational title.

• Proficient in English, with additional fluency in French and Portuguese considered an asset.

• Experience in Postgres, SQLite, SQL Server, LINUX, LINUX shell scripting, Ubuntu.

• Previous experience working remote teams (Highly Desirable)

TRAVEL

• Travel (local, national and international) will be a requirement of this role to deliver services to clients at client sites.

• Valid Driver's License and passport or Visa (if appropriate) required.

Hexagon Autonomous Solutions is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented a Project Engineer to be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing technical projects to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. This role combines engineering expertise with project management skills, overseeing the full project lifecycle from design and implementation to testing and handover. Key responsibilities include developing project plans, managing resources, monitoring progress, mitigating risks, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. Strong problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills are essential for success in this role

SCOPE OF THE ROLE

• To have a strong and broad high-level knowledge of the mining systems deployed.

• To be a point of escalation for technical issues that the team raise as they are working on projects and to work through the escalation process to seek resolution to problems outside of the responsibility of the Project Engineers and other technical staff.

• To work with Project Managers to ensure the efficient deployment of mining systems on time and within budget.

• To ensure that the deployment of systems and products is carried out as efficiently as possible.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Actively work on product/project deployment of complex mining solutions in a hands-on manner.

• Support and maintain software.

• Deliver bespoke customization as required.

• Troubleshoot system issues.

• Own and implement customer system configurations.

• Implement system customizations using scripting tools.

• Participate in onsite system installation efforts.

• Undertake complex problem solving involving multiple integrated systems.

• To ensure that relevant stakeholders are aware of risks and or issues with the product and the technical solutions being deployed to customer sites.

• Escalation of critical issues requiring other stakeholders’ input to resolve issues, specifically the relevant Mining Services or supporting teams representative.

• Maintain technical knowledge of the current and upcoming product offerings.

• Maintain knowledge of current, new and evolving strategies and technologies in relation to systems support through appropriate industry links and professional memberships.

• Regular reporting of current project issues, including updates on status and resolution methods.

• Utilizing relationships developed with customers and other contacts to advise Mining Services Team of potential issues affecting customers as well as other opportunities for Hexagon.

• Work collaboratively with the sales team in a pre-sales capacity (e.g. attending / leading technical presentations).

• Representing Hexagon Mining in a helpful, professional and courteous manner at all times.

• Maintain, enhance and adhere to Hexagon documentation and reporting standards, systems and processes.

• Compliance with Hexagon Mining’s Workplace Health and Safety policies and procedures, participation in audits and compliance with instructions given with respect to the health and safety of himself/herself and the safety of others.

• Other duties as required from time to time.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Strong prioritizing and time management skills.

• Well-developed communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Ability to form strong relationships with customers and represent the company professionally.

• Ability to set and meet the team and individual goals and deadlines.

• Ability to resolve technical and complex issues.

• Ability to rapidly grasp technical solutions, concepts and products.

• Maintaining and supporting Linux/Unix environments.

• Developing or supporting open-source software.

• Setup and support of relational databases.

• The desire to expand own knowledge and skill set as well as sharing knowledge with other team members wherever possible.

KEY BEHAVIOUR

• Protect the company brand and reputation by exhibiting good behavior and reporting on any noncompliance to safety, procedural, or other customer dictated regulations.

• Maintain good relations with the customer ‘s personnel and clearly communicate any issues that may arise.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with managers, technicians and engineers.

• Continuously seek opportunities to improve the quality of the systems, installations, and support procedures

EDUCATION BACKGROUND

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign degree equivalent in Engineering (Computer / Mining / Electrical /Electronic), Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3 years previous Mining Industry experience of progressive experience in job offered, or as a software engineer, software consultant, mining engineer, or related occupational title.

• Proficient in English, with additional fluency in French and Portuguese considered an asset.

• Experience in Postgres, SQLite, SQL Server, LINUX, LINUX shell scripting, Ubuntu.

• Previous experience working remote teams (Highly Desirable)

TRAVEL

• Travel (local, national and international) will be a requirement of this role to deliver services to clients at client sites.

• Valid Driver's License and passport or Visa (if appropriate) required.

You will play a critical role in supporting the Continuous Improvement team in driving operational excellence through the application of Lean, Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, and process improvement methodologies. This aligns with the organization's focus on enhancing efficiency, reducing waste, improving quality, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

**Continuous Improvement Projects**

  

* Support Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen, and operational excellence projects.
* Assist in identifying process improvement opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and support functions.
* Participate in project teams to improve productivity, quality, delivery performance, and cost efficiency.
* Collect and validate project data and assist in preparing project documentation.

**Process Analysis & Optimization**

  

* Conduct process mapping and value stream mapping exercises.
* Identify waste, bottlenecks, and non-value-added activities.
* Support implementation of standardized work and process optimization initiatives.
* Assist in monitoring improvement actions and sustainability plans.

  

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

  

* Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools.
* Support performance reviews by providing trend analysis and improvement insights.
* Maintain project trackers and improvement databases.

  

**Problem Solving**

  

* Participate in structured problem-solving activities using:
    * PDCA
    * DMAIC
    * 5 Why Analysis
    * Fishbone Diagram
    * Pareto Analysis
    * A3 Problem Solving

* Support Lean awareness and training programs.
* Participate in Kaizen events, Gemba walks, and workshops.
* Assist in promoting a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement.
* Support Lean Six Sigma certification activities and project reviews.

* Maintain improvement project records and lessons learned.
* Support development of work instructions, standard operating procedures, and best practices.

Position requires a skilled electrician with the ability to perform Planned Maintenance Interval Inspections (PMI), Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level maintenance on H-60 helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of engines, flight controls, fabrication of electrical systems and components. Extensive knowledge in wire, and connector repair is required. Position is in Jubail Saudi Arabia.

**Essential Responsibilities****:**

* Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to:
* Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, and wire and connector replacements on the H-60 aircraft and related systems.

* Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on electrical and utilities systems.

* Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify use, and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair.

* Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP.

* Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training.

**Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:**

* 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to: inspections, testing, adjusting, aligning, assembly/disassembly, repair, replace, modification, troubleshooting, of aircraft electrical system, equipment, AC/DC power, flight controls, fire detection, power distribution, fuel, and utilities systems.

* Ability to correct discrepancies by removal, repair, or replacement of defective circuits, wires, connectors, control units, plugs, switches, circuit breakers, diodes, resistors, capacitors, relays, and other parts of aircraft electrical systems.

* Performs final functional checks on existing and newly installed aircraft electrical systems, equipment, wiring, and cables to check continuity, resistance, amperage and insulation breakdown with standard and specialized tools and equipment.

* Comprehensive knowledge of electrical theory, principles, circuitry, circuit configuration, aircraft electrical systems and their interrelationships and a working knowledge of electronic principles.

* Must be able to trace signal paths through printed circuits, aircraft wiring to troubleshoot, modify, repair, overhaul, and maintain complex electrical systems on aircraft such as antiskid, automatic flight control, and fuel indicating systems.

* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic diagrams, and technical directives.

* Must be able to pass a background check, and drug test. Also, may be required to obtain and maintain a secret clearance.

description:
Location: [Jubail Saudi Arabia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fzPG3q1TysGiKNtG9)

  

**Description:**

Position requires a skilled MH-60/H-60 Avionics Technician AT with the ability to perform Planned Maintenance Interval Inspections (PMI), Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level maintenance on **H-60** helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of aircraft radio’s, radar, navigation equipment, and other rapid communication devices. Extensive knowledge in wire, and connector repair is required. Position is in Jubail Saudi Arabia.

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter Avionics work to include but not limited to:
* Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, and wire and connector replacements on the MH-60R aircraft and related systems.
* Have a knowledge of electronic theory.
* Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on electrical and utilities systems.
* Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair.
* Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP.
* Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training.

  

**Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:**

* 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to: installation, tests, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, alignments, modification, performing final test calibrations, and solving maintenance problems in highly complex navigation identification, radar electronic devices, navigational radar, electronic countermeasure systems, global positioning system (GPS), and armament systems.
* Must be able to solve complicated problems encountered by pilots while in flight. Often these problems cannot be duplicated on the ground.
* Have a thorough understanding of flight characteristics and their effects on electronic systems. Systems includes search/ navigational radar, communication, navigation, electronic countermeasures, data computing, recording equipment, weapons computer, and inertial measurement systems.
* Be able to use test equipment such as voltmeters, signal generators, sweep/ pulse generators, dual trace oscilloscopes, deviation meters, sweep carts, precision power, and frequency measuring devices. Also, must use various test sets that detect discrepancies that often do not appear during bench rework in work centers.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic diagrams, and technical directives
* Work with miniaturized solid-state circuits and devices. Able to use a full range of hand tools common to the trade. Must have a thorough knowledge of digital/ analog computers, algebra, and trigonometry.
* Must be able to pass a background check, and drug test.

  

**Preferences**:

* **Navy Aviation Avionics - AE MH-60R HSM HSC**

* **Open-Architecture Mission Computer**

Located at the intersection of King Salman Road and King Fahad Road in northern Riyadh, the development spans more than 390,000 square metres and will bring together world-class retail, hospitality, entertainment, lifestyle, and residential experiences in a single integrated destination. As one of Hilton’s most significant luxury developments globally, The Avenues – Riyadh offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of hospitality in one of the world’s fastest-growing markets, creating an unparalleled destination for residents, visitors, and international travellers alike. How You’ll Make an Impact As a Managing Director at a Waldorf Astoria, Conrad and Canopy property, you’re not just leading the strategic hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. Guide and inspire hotel leadership teams: Provide leadership, direction and governance to the General Managers of Conrad and Canopy, fostering accountability, collaboration and performance while preserving the distinct identity, guest proposition and positioning of each brand. Drive commercial and revenue excellence: Oversee cluster sales, marketing and revenue management strategies across the development, maximizing performance across all business segments and ensuring the optimal utilisation of guestrooms, meeting and event spaces, and food and beverage venues. Ensure operational excellence across the portfolio: Maintain brand compliance and operational integrity across all properties, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiencies, scalability and service delivery across shared functions and resources. Build a culture of high performance and inclusion: Develop exceptional leadership teams, strengthen succession pipelines, support Saudization objectives and foster a culture that is unified in purpose while reflecting the unique character and service ethos of each brand. Job Title: Database Administrator (DBA)
Location: Saudi Arabia
Nationality: Saudi National
Experience: 3–5 Years
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Database Administrator (DBA) with 3 –5 years of hands-on experience managing and supporting enterprise database environments. The ideal candidate should have strong experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and/or MySQL .
Key Responsibilities

• Perform standard DBA activities including database administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

• Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain database systems.

• Manage database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery activities.

• Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and health.

• Perform SQL and database performance tuning .

• Manage users, roles, permissions, and database security.

• Troubleshoot and resolve database-related incidents and performance issues.

• Support database migrations, upgrades, and maintenance activities.

• Ensure data integrity, availability, and reliability.

• Maintain database documentation, procedures, and configurations.

• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and development teams on database-related requirements.

Required Skills

• 3–5 years of experience as a Database Administrator.

• Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and/or MySQL .

• Good knowledge of SQL, performance tuning, backup/recovery, and troubleshooting .

• Experience with HA/DR and database replication .

• Knowledge of database security, access management, and monitoring tools.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Saudi National .

job_title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (relocation to Latvia)
description:
We are looking for a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team with eventual relocation to Latvia. EPAM is renowned for delivering cutting-edge technological solutions to transform businesses worldwide.
We are building AI-native solutions for our clients - products where LLM and its harness are the core of the value. This is a builder's role: you and your team are responsible for building agentic systems, writing the production code, and standing up the evals and observability. You will work closely with SMEs and end-users to understand where the real value lies, and you design the feedback loops.
The deadline for submission is 01.12.2026.

Responsibilities
• Design, build and ship end-to-end AI-native systems including agents, workflows, RAG and integration harnesses
• Write production-grade Python code for integrations, APIs, data access and deployment
• Work directly with subject matter experts and end-users through interviews, user acceptance testing and workflow observations
• Engage early in projects to shape use cases and check technical feasibility
• Build evaluation pipelines and use them to prove system utility
• Design for failure in the agent loop by implementing retries, model fallbacks, cost limits and human-in-the-loop actions
• Capture domain expertise and repeatable workflows to ensure success across engagements. Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges in collaboration with the broader team
• Ensure adherence to engineering excellence standards including test-driven development and continuous integration practices

Requirements
• 7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of building production AI and LLM applications
• Expert-level Python skills and solid software engineering fundamentals
• Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and major LLM providers
• Strong RAG and retrieval skills including vector databases, embeddings, hybrid search and context management
• Production deployment experience on major cloud platforms like AWS, Azure or GCP with containerization and CI/CD
• Proven experience evaluating generative AI quality using custom evaluation frameworks and observability tools
• Proven capability to work closely with clients, lead discovery conversations and explain technical trade-offs to diverse audiences
• Strong agent-design judgment and sound engineering judgment under ambiguity to balance speed, quality and scope
• C1 level English language proficiency
• An academic degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

Nice to have
• Experience designing experiments, A/B testing and iterating on AI products against real user behavior
• Strong background in NLP, Data Science or applied machine learning with experience moving models into production
• Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), Agent Skills and emerging agent standards
• Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Databricks Genie or Microsoft Foundry
• Exposure to AI governance, security and compliance including guardrails and prompt-injection prevention

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, in an on-site working mode. In this role, you will lead the discovery, design, implementation and scaling of GenAI products for Downstream Oil & Gas and refinery operations. You will collaborate closely with refinery stakeholders, engineers, IT teams and leadership to deliver AI-powered solutions that are technically feasible, operationally reliable and deliver measurable business impact. This role offers an opportunity to influence large-scale industrial AI adoption and contribute to digital transformation initiatives in a mission-critical domain.
The deadline for submission is 04/11/2026 .

Responsibilities
• Own the vision, roadmap and strategy for GenAI products that support refinery workflows and Downstream operations
• Conduct discovery sessions, operational assessments and user research on-site with refinery teams
• Translate refinery-specific requirements into scalable enterprise product capabilities
• Lead end-to-end GenAI solution delivery from proof-of-concept to production-grade implementation and adoption
• Define requirements for AI copilots, decision-support tools and engineering knowledge assistants
• Establish governance and monitoring for AI systems, focusing on reliability, safety and continuous improvement
• Collaborate with technical teams to define integration points for industrial systems (e.g., SAP, PI System, LIMS)
• Ensure compliance with security, data governance and enterprise architecture standards
• Engage senior stakeholders, prepare decision papers and manage product updates and demonstrations
• Oversee product backlogs, release plans, risk and dependency management and acceptance criteria

Requirements
• 8–10 years of overall experience with 5–6 years in technical product management or related leadership roles
• Strong understanding of Downstream Oil & Gas processes, including refinery operations
• Hands-on experience delivering AI or GenAI products in complex enterprise settings
• Expertise in stakeholder management, roadmap planning and business process mapping
• Familiarity with integration of enterprise data systems (e.g., SAP, PI, maintenance platforms)
• Ability to work effectively with engineering, cybersecurity and data governance teams
• Excellent communication and leadership skills
• Fluent English communication skills (B2 level or higher)
• Academic degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
• Valid SCE (Saudi Council of Engineers) certificate (with IT related discipline) is required for this position

Nice to have
• Experience with AI copilots, knowledge assistants and document-intelligence solutions
• Awareness of private cloud, hybrid and on-premise deployment models (e.g., OpenShift, Kubernetes)
• Background in industrial IoT or predictive maintenance solutions

The American International School - Riyadh is seeking a licensed full-time Elementary School Teacher for the 2027-2028 school year. Please only apply if you meet the minimum criteria below; candidates who do not meet the minimum criteria will not be considered.

The AIS-R Teacher

The Purpose of the AIS-R Teacher: To cause thinking, learning and action; to cultivate inquisitive, independent, and resilient learners who inspire positive change in their communities.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of a bachelor's degree and valid teaching certificate (North American or equivalent certification).

• Certification in subject area and/or grade level is required.

• Master’s degree in Education or related field preferred.

• A proven record of excellence in prior teaching posts for a minimum of two years (full-time, K-12 teaching).

• Expertise in subject matter.

• Fluency in English.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Reports to: Designated Divisional Principal(s)

The Understandings, Skills, Values, and Mindset of an AIS-R Teacher are:

• A continuous learner, a model of AIS-R’s Core Values, committed to the AIS-R Mission and the Profile of an Exemplary Educator.

• A qualified and dedicated global citizen and educator who is genuinely passionate about teaching and learning.

• An attitude of respect, open-mindedness, adaptability, resilience and commitment to life-long learning and continual professional development.

• Understands and implements AIS-R’s Core Competencies for Faculty.

• Keeps up to date with AIS-R policies and expectations; fulfills all expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook , and makes a difference beyond the school day.

• Meets professional duties effectively and adheres to the AIS-R Code of Conduct , professional dress code , and Child Safeguarding agreements.

• Understands and implements student safeguarding practices, including mandatory reporting as well as participation in any inquiry regarding an AIS-R community member.

• Understands and supports the school in creating a positive, nurturing and engaging environment that addresses the individual needs of each student.

• Designs and delivers lessons, content and materials, in line with AIS-R’s standard curriculums and teaching standards, and utilizes various learning mediums to meet differences in learning preferences.

• Demonstrates knowledge of student individual strengths, interests, motivations and abilities and plans coherent instruction in order to challenge and support student learning and well-being.

• Maintains effective classroom control, organization and management.

• Manages student behavior, keeps records of behavior, and monitors progress.

• Creates a caring, respectful student-centered environment conducive to developmentally appropriate learning.

• An engaging presence in the classroom, plans and prepares coherent learning plans with clearly defined outcomes aligned with subject level standards and benchmarks using the Understanding by Design framework.

• Systematically gathers, analyzes, and utilizes all relevant data to measure and facilitate student academic progress.

• Clearly communicates learning targets and assessment criteria.

• Prioritizes instructional strategies aligned with AIS-R’s Learning Principles.

• Assesses student learning with clear criteria that are aligned with learning goals.

• Collaborates with colleagues, parents, and community members to collectively advance our mission and enhance student learning.

• Organizes, plans, and runs clubs/after-school activities as a part of AIS-R’s co-curricular program.

• Engages in the school’s professional development program and professional growth & evaluation process.

• Partners with families through ongoing communication, conferences, and the accurate reporting of student progress, honoring divisional reporting timelines/expectations .

• Honors AIS-R policies and procedures and maintains a high standard of personal conduct.

Terms of Employment and Additional Responsibilities : Salary is assigned from the Faculty salary schedule; the contract term is 190 days. Compensation will be determined based on the established Faculty salary schedule.
Contractual hours: 8:00 am - 4:30 pm (5:00 pm on Tuesdays)

Faculty are expected to fulfill duties that extend beyond the school day, including commitments to after-school activities (ASAs), after-school learning (ASL), and coaching (requirement for Physical Education teachers).

All PE teachers are required to coach at least one sport in AIS-R’s Athletics program annually.

Learning and Growth: Performance is appraised through the AIS-R Professional Growth and Evaluation framework and in accordance with school policy by the designated Supervisor.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Housekeeping Supervisor , you’re not just ensuring the upkeep and cleanliness of the hotel – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
+ Supervise the housekeeping team: Train, schedule, and oversee team members to ensure cleanliness and quality standards in guest rooms
+ Conduct room and area inspections: Perform routine checks of checkout rooms, spot inspections of occupied rooms, and review service areas, storage, and corridors to ensure cleanliness and maintenance standards are met
+ Coordinate maintenance needs: Report and promptly follow up on any maintenance issues or facility concerns
+ Oversee special projects: Schedule and supervise periodic deep cleaning and special housekeeping initiatives
+ Manage inventory and equipment: Maintain stock levels and ensure proper maintenance of housekeeping equipment
+ Delight our guests: Ensure excellent service, including VIP and special guest requests
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
Housekeeping Supervisor – Saudi National Only
Education & Qualifications
+ High School Diploma or equivalent as a minimum requirement.
+ Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
+ Additional training or certifications in Housekeeping, Hospitality, Hygiene, or Health & Safety are an advantage.
Experience
+ Minimum 1–2 years of relevant experience in Housekeeping or Hospitality.
+ Previous supervisory or team-lead experience is preferred.
+ Previous experience in a 4- or 5-star hotel is an advantage.
Required Skills
+ Good command of English, both written and spoken.
+ Strong leadership and team-management skills.
+ Ability to assign tasks, monitor staff performance, and ensure compliance with hotel standards.
+ Good knowledge of housekeeping operations, room cleaning standards, and public-area cleanliness.
+ Ability to conduct room and public-area inspections and follow up on corrective actions.
+ Knowledge of Lost & Found procedures and guest service standards.
+ Basic knowledge of cleaning chemicals, equipment, and safe handling procedures.
+ Good understanding of Health, Safety & Hygiene standards.
+ Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
+ Ability to work under pressure and in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
+ Basic computer skills; experience with PMS or housekeeping systems is an advantage.
How We’ll Help You Thrive
At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:
Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.
Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands (https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/) , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

## Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Maintenance & Equipment Engineer to support the PMC team in the planning and delivery of ORAT activities for a major aviation project. The role will focus on ensuring that aviation facilities, equipment, systems, maintenance processes, and operational resources are ready for safe and effective operations prior to transition to the operational team.

**Key Responsibilities**  
• Lead and coordinate maintenance and equipment readiness activities as part of the overall ORAT program.  
• Develop and maintain maintenance readiness plans, equipment readiness schedules, and transition requirements.  
• Review facility and equipment design to ensure operability, maintainability, accessibility, reliability, and lifecycle requirements are adequately addressed.  
• Identify and track equipment and maintenance readiness requirements through construction, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.  
• Coordinate with operational stakeholders to define maintenance requirements, procedures, staffing, training, spare parts, tools, and consumables.  
• Develop and maintain asset registers, equipment databases, tagging requirements, and maintenance data required for operational readiness.  
• Review and validate preventive and corrective maintenance strategies, maintenance plans, and maintenance schedules.  
• Coordinate the development and review of O&M manuals, maintenance procedures, equipment documentation, warranties, spare parts lists, and technical handover records.  
• Support testing, commissioning, operational trials, demonstrations, and readiness exercises to verify equipment and systems are operationally ready.  
• Participate in ORAT inspections, readiness assessments, operational demonstrations, and scenario-based exercises.  
• Identify equipment and maintenance-related readiness gaps, risks, and constraints, and develop and track corrective actions.  
• Coordinate with the Contractor, equipment suppliers, operators, and Client stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of equipment and maintenance readiness issues.  
• Support the development and implementation of maintenance training and competency requirements for operational and maintenance personnel.  
• Verify the availability of critical spares, specialist tools, consumables, equipment, and maintenance resources prior to operational commencement.  
• Support asset acceptance, operational handover, and transition from the project delivery team to the operator.  
• Coordinate with ORAT workstreams to ensure maintenance and equipment requirements are integrated with operations, facilities, ICT, security, HSE, and other operational functions.  
• Support the development and execution of operational readiness and transition activities.  
• Prepare readiness reports, dashboards, risk registers, action trackers, and management updates related to maintenance and equipment.  
• Ensure maintenance and equipment readiness activities comply with aviation regulations, authority requirements, project standards, and operational procedures.

## Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aviation Engineering, or related discipline.  
• 8+ years of relevant experience in maintenance, equipment engineering, asset management, operational readiness, or airport operations.  
• Proven experience in aviation/airport projects, preferably with direct involvement in ORAT or operational transition programs.  
• Strong understanding of ORAT principles, operational readiness, activation, transition, and facility handover.  
• Experience developing and implementing maintenance strategies, asset registers, preventive maintenance programs, and O&M requirements.  
• Experience coordinating equipment readiness, testing and commissioning, operational trials, training, and handover activities.  
• Knowledge of airport facilities, aviation systems, specialist equipment, and operational interfaces is highly desirable.  
• Experience working with airport operators, maintenance teams, Contractors, equipment suppliers, Designers, and Client stakeholders.  
• Familiarity with asset management, maintenance management, and equipment lifecycle requirements.

description:
Key Responsibilities:
• Implement QA/QC activities, including surveillance of subcontractor and sub-supplier works, in accordance with approved ITPs, procedures, method statements, quality plans, and other control documents.
• Prepare, complete, and sign applicable records for quality surveillance, inspections, and testing.
• Conduct surveillance inspections to verify compliance with approved processes, procedures, specifications, and project requirements.
• Perform material receiving inspections to verify compliance with approved MTCs, project specifications, purchase orders, and material traceability requirements.
• Conduct and witness Welding Procedure Qualification Tests (WPQT/PQR) and Welder Qualification Tests (WQT) in accordance with client specifications and applicable international standards.
• Verify that welding activities are performed by qualified welders using approved WPSs and qualified welding consumables.
• Conduct fit-up, joint preparation, preheating, welding parameter, and visual inspections before, during, and after welding.
• Review and verify welding records, weld maps, material traceability, consumable control records, PWHT records, and weld repair history.
• Coordinate and witness Non-Destructive Examination (NDE) activities, including:
o Radiographic Testing (RT)
o Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
o Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)
o Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT)
o Hardness Testing
• Ensure NDE activities are performed in accordance with approved procedures, project specifications, and applicable standards
• Witness flange management activities and piping/pipeline hydrostatic and pneumatic pressure testing.
• Review welding and inspection reports and ensure all quality records are complete, accurate, and maintained as per project requirements.
• Coordinate inspection activities with construction, engineering, subcontractors, third-party inspectors, and client representatives to ensure timely inspection, testing, and approval.
• Verify that all measuring and inspection equipment is properly calibrated and used within its validity period.
• Ensure full compliance with approved ITPs, Method Statements, Quality Plans, project specifications, and client quality requirements.
• Monitor and support the timely closure of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and verify implementation of appropriate corrective actions.
• Issue Inspection Release Notes (IRNs) for accepted products/works and sign or verify applicable test packs and QC dossiers.
• Participate in quality audits, toolbox talks, lessons learned, Right First Time (RFT) initiatives, and continual improvement programs.
• Maintain accurate inspection documentation and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports as required.
• Promote a strong quality culture while ensuring compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices during all inspection activities.
Minimum Qualifications & Experience:
• 8–10 years of progressive experience as a QC Welding/Piping Inspector.
• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in the petrochemical industry, with strong exposure to welding and piping inspection activities.
• Previous SABIC project experience is highly preferred/required.
• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
• Valid and recognized welding inspection certification such as: o CSWIP 3.1 / equivalent o AWS CWI o Or another internationally recognized equivalent certification.
• Strong knowledge of welding, piping, NDE, pressure testing, material traceability, and quality control requirements.
• Good knowledge of applicable international codes, standards, project specifications, and client requirements
• Experience in reviewing and implementing ITPs, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, inspection procedures, and quality documentation.
• Strong communication and coordination skills with construction teams, subcontractors, third-party inspectors, and client representatives.

Key Technical Competencies :
• Welding Inspection & Surveillance
• Piping Inspection
• Material Inspection & Traceability
• WPS/PQR & Welder Qualification
• Fit-Up & Visual Inspection
• NDE Coordination & Witnessing
• PWHT Inspection
• Hydrostatic & Pneumatic Testing
• Flange Management
• Weld Mapping & Documentation
• NCR Management & Close-Out
• Test Pack / QC Dossier Review

The Cybersecurity Consultant is a hands-on cybersecurity professional responsible for conducting vulnerability assessments, penetration testing activities, and security reviews across customer environments. This role works closely with customers, infrastructure teams, application owners, and security stakeholders to identify security weaknesses, validate risks, and provide practical remediation recommendations.

  

The role combines technical security testing, customer engagement, and cybersecurity consultancy to help organizations strengthen their security posture, reduce risk, and improve compliance with security best practices and regulatory requirements.

  
  

**Key responsibilities:**

* Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across network, infrastructure, server, application, and cloud environments.
* Perform internal and external network penetration testing within approved scopes and rules of engagement.
* Conduct web application and API security assessments using recognized industry methodologies and frameworks.
* Perform authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability scanning using approved commercial and open-source security tools.
* Validate vulnerabilities identified by automated tools and remove false positives before reporting.
* Perform controlled exploitation activities to confirm vulnerability impact while minimizing operational risk.
* Assess Windows, Linux, Active Directory, databases, network devices, and security infrastructure for security weaknesses.
* Evaluate vulnerabilities based on exploitability, asset criticality, technical severity, and business impact.
* Assign risk ratings using CVSS and applicable customer risk-classification methodologies.
* Prepare technical assessment reports, executive summaries, and remediation recommendations.
* Present assessment findings and risk remediation plans to technical and business stakeholders.
* Conduct remediation workshops and provide technical guidance to customer teams.
* Perform remediation validation and retesting activities.
* Maintain assessment evidence, testing records, screenshots, tool outputs, and supporting documentation.
* Support assessment planning activities, including scope definition, methodology selection, and rules of engagement.
* Ensure all testing activities comply with approved authorization requirements and security testing procedures.
* Support security consulting initiatives related to system hardening, vulnerability remediation, application security, and infrastructure security.
* Assist with security assessments aligned to recognized frameworks including NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and PCI DSS.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of internal security testing methodologies, reporting templates, and knowledge repositories.
* Support presales activities by providing technical input for customer proposals, assessment scope definitions, and effort estimates.
* Perform any other cybersecurity consulting, vulnerability management, or penetration testing activities as required.

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing methodologies.
* Hands-on experience conducting network, infrastructure, web application, and API security testing.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPNs, firewalls, and enterprise network services.
* Good working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory environments.
* Familiarity with common attack techniques including privilege escalation, credential attacks, lateral movement, and Active Directory exploitation.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CVSS, CWE, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.
* Practical experience using security assessment tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, Metasploit, Wireshark, OWASP ZAP, and Kali Linux.
* Ability to manually validate vulnerabilities and distinguish genuine findings from false positives.
* Understanding of common security technologies including WAF, IDS/IPS, NAC, EDR, SIEM, and secure remote access solutions.
* Basic scripting capabilities using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think from an attacker's perspective.
* Strong report writing, evidence documentation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate technical vulnerabilities and risks to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple customer engagements and work independently while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
* Strong professional integrity and commitment to maintaining customer confidentiality.

  

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience may be considered where strong hands-on security testing expertise is demonstrated.
* **Preferred certifications include:** OSCP, CREST CRT, GPEN, PNPT, eCPPT, CompTIA PenTest+, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP), CEH / CEH Practical

  

**Required experience:**

* 5-7 years of cybersecurity, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or security consulting experience.
* Minimum 3 years of recent hands-on vulnerability assessment and penetration testing experience.
* Demonstrated experience conducting internal and external network penetration tests.
* Hands-on experience performing web application and API security assessments.
* Experience using vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7.
* Strong working experience with tools including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, and Wireshark.
* Experience performing vulnerability validation, exploitation, remediation verification, and retesting.
* Experience preparing professional technical security reports and presenting findings to customers and stakeholders.
* Experience assessing Windows, Linux, Active Directory, network infrastructure, and enterprise environments.
* Experience working directly with customer engagements within a cybersecurity consulting, systems integration, or professional services environment.
* Experience with Active Directory security testing is strongly preferred.
* Cloud, wireless, mobile application, container security, or red team experience is advantageous.
* Exposure to NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or related security frameworks is considered beneficial.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; Arabic language capability is an advantage.
