The role will focus on the planning, review, and supervision of **airside civil works**, including aircraft aprons, pavements, taxiway interfaces, internal roads, earthworks, drainage systems, site investigations, borehole surveys, topographical surveys, GPR scanning, utility coordination, and civil works associated with airport buildings and facilities.

The successful candidate will ensure that all design and construction activities are executed in accordance with project requirements, approved drawings, technical specifications, and applicable industry standards, including **ICAO, GACAR, FAA, Saudi Building Code, and relevant international engineering standards**. The role requires close collaboration with contractors, consultants, airport operations, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure the safe, efficient, and compliant delivery of airport infrastructure projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and supervise the design and construction of **aircraft aprons, taxiways, airside pavements, service roads, and airport infrastructure**.
* Oversee pavement engineering activities including **rigid, flexible, heavy-duty, and aircraft stand pavements**, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
* Monitor **earthworks, grading, excavation, compaction, drainage, and roadworks** within operational airport environments.
* Review and coordinate **geotechnical investigations, borehole surveys, topographical surveys, and GPR scanning activities**.
* Assess survey data, geotechnical reports, pavement designs, utility investigations, and construction methodologies.
* Coordinate interfaces with **AGL, drainage, utilities, fuel hydrant, ICT/CNS, electrical, structural, architectural, and MEP systems**.
* Conduct design reviews at Concept, Schematic, Detailed Design, Tender, and IFC stages.
* Review technical submissions including **RFIs, shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, ITPs, NCRs, and as-built documentation**.
* Perform site inspections and monitor contractor performance, workmanship, quality control, testing, and compliance with approved designs.
* Support PMC and project management teams through technical reporting, issue resolution, stakeholder coordination, and progress monitoring.

## Qualifications

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in **Civil Engineering** (Professional Engineering certification preferred).
* **9+ years of Civil Engineering experience**.
* Minimum **3 years of airport, aviation, or airside infrastructure project experience** preferred.
* Proven experience in:
    * Airside civil works and aircraft pavements
    * Airport roads and infrastructure
    * Earthworks and grading
    * Geotechnical investigations and boreholes
    * Topographical surveys and GPR scanning
    * Design review and construction supervision
    * QA/QC, testing, inspections, and technical documentation

* Strong knowledge of airport standards including **ICAO Annex 14, GACAR, FAA Advisory Circulars, ASTM, AASHTO, and Saudi Building Code**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD and Microsoft Office**; BIM/CDE/EDMS experience is an advantage.
* Excellent technical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Preferred Background
    
* Experience in **PMC, consultancy, or client-side supervision roles**.
* Familiarity with working in **operational airport environments**, managing airside constraints, phased construction activities, and safety-critical infrastructure.
* What You'll Bring
    
* Strong technical knowledge of airport civil infrastructure and pavement engineering.
* Ability to identify design, constructability, and operational risks early.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and contractors.
* Commitment to quality, safety, technical compliance, and successful project delivery.

## Job Description

The Inspector (Civil/Structural) is responsible for providing construction supervision, inspection, and quality assurance services on behalf of the Client under the PMCM framework. The role ensures that all civil and structural works are executed in accordance with approved designs, contract requirements, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, quality requirements, HSE regulations, and project schedules.

The Inspector acts as the Client’s site representative for monitoring Contractor activities, verifying construction quality, identifying deficiencies, and supporting the PMCM team in delivering projects safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

Construction Inspection & Supervision  
• Conduct daily inspections of civil and structural construction activities.  
• Verify compliance of works with approved shop drawings, specifications, method statements, and contract requirements.  
• Monitor site activities including but not limited:  
• Earthworks and excavation  
• Foundations and substructures  
• Reinforced concrete works  
• Structural steel erection  
• Masonry and architectural concrete works  
• Roads, pavements, and external works  
• Utility and infrastructure work  
• Ensure works are executed using approved materials, equipment, and construction methodologies.  
• Witness inspections, testing, and quality control activities in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).

Quality Assurance & Quality Control  
• Review and verify Inspection Requests (IRs) submitted by Contractors.  
• Ensure compliance with Quality Management Systems and PMCM procedures.  
• Monitor material deliveries and verify compliance with approved material submittals.  
• Witness laboratory and field-testing activities.  
• Identify non-conforming works and recommend corrective actions.  
• Assist in the issuance and close-out of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Site Observation Reports (SORs), and Corrective Action Requests (CARs).  
• Verify rectification and completion of defective works.

Contract Compliance  
• Monitor Contractor compliance with contract requirements and approved construction schedules.  
• Assist Engineers in recording delays, deviations, variations, and potential claims.  
• Verify quantities and progress of completed works for reporting purposes.  
• Maintain records supporting project payment certifications and progress assessments.

Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance  
• Monitor field activities for compliance with approved HSE plans and procedures.  
• Identify unsafe practices, conditions, and environmental violations.  
• Report on safety concerns to the Resident Engineer and HSE team.  
• Support implementation of project safety initiatives and regulatory requirements.

Coordination & Stakeholder Management  
• Coordinate with PMCM Engineers, Contractors, Design Consultants, Stakeholders, and Client representatives.  
• Attend construction progress meetings and technical coordination meetings as required.  
• Assist in resolving site construction issues and interface conflicts.  
• Provide technical feedback regarding constructability and workmanship matters.

Documentation & Reporting  
• Prepare daily inspection reports documenting site activities, progress, quality observations, and safety concerns.  
• Maintain inspection records, photographs, testing records, and project documentation.  
• Record Contractor manpower, equipment deployment, and construction progress.  
• Support preparation of weekly and monthly project reports.

Testing, Commissioning & Handover  
• Participate in pre-commissioning and final inspection activities.  
• Verify completion of punch-list items and outstanding work.  
• Support substantial completion, taking-over, and project closeout activities.  
• Ensure as-built documentation reflects completed construction works.

## Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or related discipline.

• Professional certification or membership in SCE is mandatory.  
• Valid certification for construction inspection activities is an advantage.  
• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in construction supervision and inspection.  
• Aviation experience is preferred.  
• Experience on large-scale PMCM, infrastructure, transportation, building, mixed-use, industrial, or utility projects. Aviation projects are highly desirable.  
• Previous experience working for Engineering Consultants, PMCM Consultants, or Supervision Consultants preferred.  
• GCC/KSA experience is highly desirable.  
• Familiarity with local building codes, international architectural quality standards, and fire-rated assembly requirements.  
• Proficiency in document control platforms (Aconex), CAD software (AutoCAD), and MS Office.  
• Strong eye for detail, quality control mindset  
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.

The Electrical Inspector will be responsible for inspecting and monitoring electrical works on site to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, applicable codes and standards, and project quality requirements. The role will support the project team in maintaining construction quality, identifying deficiencies, and ensuring timely resolution of electrical issues.

The Electrical Inspector will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and compliance of electrical installations.

• Monitor installation of street lighting, Apron floodlighting, GPUs, AGL, SAS, and telecom infrastructure.  
• Conduct regular surveillance of site work against documented processes.  
• Conduct daily inspections of ICT and ELV installations, including structured cabling, racks, termination panels, and active/passive components.

Omtera is a technology consulting and solutions company helping ambitious businesses build better products, understand customer behaviour, accelerate growth and deploy world-class technology.

We work with leading global software platforms across Product Analytics, Customer Engagement, AI, Data and Work Management, supporting enterprise and high-growth companies across EMEA.

As one of Mixpanel’s leading partners in the region, we work closely with product, growth, marketing, data and executive teams to help companies turn behavioural data into better decisions and measurable business outcomes.

We are now looking for a Solutions Consultant – Product Analytics & Growth to take ownership of our Mixpanel business across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain and Qatar .

This is a highly customer-facing role combining solution consulting, product analytics, pre-sales, commercial ownership and account development .

You will not simply support sales from the sidelines.

You will own opportunities, understand customer problems, design solutions, deliver demos, coordinate technical discussions, build commercial proposals and help move customers from the first conversation through implementation and long-term growth.

Tasks

You will take ownership of Mixpanel customers and opportunities across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain and Qatar.

You will work directly with existing customers, prospects, Mixpanel teams and Omtera’s internal teams to develop opportunities and deliver successful solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

Solution Consulting & Discovery

• Meet directly with prospective and existing customers.

• Understand their product, customer journeys, business model and growth objectives.

• Identify challenges across acquisition, activation, conversion, engagement, retention and monetisation.

• Translate business problems into practical product analytics solutions.

• Design relevant Mixpanel use cases based on the customer’s priorities.

• Recommend measurement frameworks, KPIs, event structures and analytics approaches.

• Act as a trusted advisor to Product, Growth, Marketing, Data and leadership teams.

Mixpanel Demos & Technical Pre-Sales

• Lead Mixpanel product demonstrations for prospects and customers.

• Build demos around real customer use cases rather than generic product walkthroughs.

• Explain how Mixpanel can help teams answer specific product and growth questions.

• Demonstrate funnels, retention, cohorts, user journeys, segmentation, session replay and other relevant Mixpanel capabilities.

• Support technical discovery around SDKs, event tracking, integrations, data architecture and implementation.

• Work with customer data and engineering teams when deeper technical discussions are required.

• Coordinate proof-of-concepts, trials and evaluations.

Commercial Ownership

• Take ownership of opportunities from discovery through commercial discussion and closing.

• Build proposals together with Omtera’s commercial team.

• Understand customer requirements around users, events, data volumes, products and contract structure.

• Prepare and present commercial options.

• Manage follow-ups and next steps with customers.

• Work closely with Mixpanel account teams on pricing, deal structure and partner opportunities.

• Help customers build internal business cases for adopting or expanding Mixpanel.

• Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

You should be comfortable discussing both product value and commercial value .

Customer & Account Development

• Build strong relationships with existing Mixpanel customers.

• Understand how customers are using the platform and where additional value can be created.

• Identify adoption challenges, new use cases and expansion opportunities.

• Coordinate with Omtera’s implementation and consulting teams where deeper delivery support is required.

• Support renewals and account growth.

• Maintain clear ownership of customer actions, opportunities and follow-ups.

GCC Market Development

You will help Omtera grow its Mixpanel business specifically across:

Saudi Arabia United Arab Emirates Bahrain Qatar

You will:

• Develop relationships with product, growth, digital, marketing and data leaders across the region.

• Help identify and develop new enterprise and high-growth opportunities.

• Participate in customer meetings, executive briefings and partner sessions.

• Build relationships within the regional product and technology ecosystem.

• Represent Omtera and Mixpanel at relevant conferences, roundtables, meetups and industry events.

• Help organise Omtera and Mixpanel customer events in the region.

• Follow opportunities consistently from first interaction through commercial outcome.

Some international travel across the GCC will be expected.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who is slightly beyond junior level and ready to take real ownership .

You may currently be working in product analytics, SaaS consulting, pre-sales, customer success, product management, growth or digital analytics and looking for a role with significantly more responsibility.

Ideally, you will have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience .

You should have:

• Experience working directly with customers in SaaS, consulting, technology or digital products.

• Strong understanding of product analytics and digital customer journeys.

• Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, Adobe Analytics, Contentsquare, Heap or similar platforms.

• Understanding of concepts such as:

• Funnels and conversion

• Activation

• Retention

• Cohort analysis

• Engagement

• Segmentation

• User journeys

• Churn

• Experimentation

• Product and growth KPIs

• The ability to understand a business problem and turn it into a clear solution.

• Confidence presenting software and solutions to customers.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Commercial awareness and an interest in how technology solutions are bought and sold.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong organisation and follow-up discipline.

• The ability to manage several customers and opportunities simultaneously.

• A proactive and accountable working style.

Particularly Valuable Experience

The following would be strong advantages:

• Hands-on Mixpanel experience.

• Creating tracking plans or event taxonomies.

• Product analytics implementation experience.

• Basic understanding of APIs, SDKs and data integrations.

• Basic SQL knowledge.

• Experience working with mobile or web products.

• Experience in SaaS, fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces, gaming, telecom or digital businesses.

• Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC market.

• Arabic language skills.

• Experience delivering software demonstrations.

• Experience supporting commercial proposals or SaaS sales processes.

• Experience organising or participating in customer events.

You do not need to be a software engineer.

However, you should be comfortable having technical conversations with product, analytics and engineering teams and be curious enough to understand how things work.

Benefits

The Person We Are Looking For

More than anything, we are looking for someone who takes ownership.

When you receive an opportunity, we expect you to think:

“This is my customer. I need to understand what they are trying to achieve and figure out how we can make it happen.”

You should be comfortable moving between very different conversations during the same day:

• A product manager may ask how to measure activation.

• A data team may ask how Mixpanel events should be structured.

• A CMO may want to understand customer retention.

• A prospect may ask for a product demonstration.

• A procurement team may want a commercial proposal.

• A customer may need help building a business case.

• We want someone who enjoys connecting all of those pieces and moving things forward.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help customers:

• Understand what their users are actually doing.

• Build reliable product analytics practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve activation, conversion and retention.

• Make better product and growth decisions.

• Successfully evaluate and adopt Mixpanel.

• Expand their use of Mixpanel as their organisation grows.

At the same time, you will help Omtera:

• Develop new Mixpanel opportunities.

• Build deeper relationships with existing customers.

• Grow Mixpanel adoption across the GCC.

• Create strong customer references.

• Run successful regional events and customer engagements.

• Build a scalable Product Analytics practice across the region.

What We Offer

• 100% remote working environment.

• Significant ownership from day one.

• Direct exposure to enterprise and high-growth companies across the GCC.

• Opportunity to work closely with Mixpanel and other leading global technology companies.

• International customer portfolio.

• Opportunities to travel across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar and other markets.

• Participation in customer events, conferences and executive meetings.

• Exposure to Product Analytics, AI, Customer Engagement, Growth and Data projects.

• Learning, certification and professional-development opportunities.

• Private health insurance.

• Birthday leave.

• Flexible remote-working culture.

• A fast-moving environment where good ideas can quickly become reality.

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a traditional account-management role.

It is not purely sales.

It is not purely consulting.

And it is not purely technical.

It sits at the intersection of customer problems, technology, product strategy and commercial execution.

If you enjoy understanding businesses, solving problems, presenting technology, working directly with customers and taking ownership of opportunities, this role will give you significant room to grow.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction explaining your experience with product analytics, customer-facing technology projects and why you are interested in working with customers across the GCC.

job_title: Diabetes Nurse Specialist / Diabetes Nurse Educator #060
description:
Position Overview
A well-established healthcare organization in Riyadh needs an experienced Diabetes Specialist Nurse to take ownership of specialist care and education for patients living with diabetes. You will work with people managing Type 1, Type 2, and other forms of the condition, and help them take real control of it.
This is hands-on, patient-facing work. You will teach insulin technique, explain what a CGM reading actually means, and sit down with families to build plans they can follow at home. You will also work side by side with endocrinologists, dietitians, and pharmacists, so your input shapes each patient's care.
Diabetes is managed mostly outside the clinic. The education you give today decides whether a patient avoids complications years from now. If you have at least three years in diabetes care and you care about teaching as much as treating, this role deserves your attention.
Key Responsibilities
Specialist Patient Care

• Provide specialist nursing care and support to patients with Type 1, Type 2, and other forms of diabetes.

• Monitor each patient's progress and spot where they need further clinical intervention or education.

Patient and Family Education

• Teach patients and families about medication, insulin administration, glucose monitoring, nutrition, lifestyle changes, and preventing complications.

• Help patients build self-management plans that are practical and sustainable in their daily lives.

Diabetes Technology

• Train patients to use blood glucose meters, continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), and other diabetes technologies with confidence.

• Help patients read and act on their own data between appointments.

Multidisciplinary Collaboration

• Coordinate care with physicians, endocrinologists, dietitians, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals.

• Bring the education and self-management picture into team discussions so care plans reflect how patients actually live.

Quality and Documentation

• Apply and promote evidence-based practice in diabetes care and patient education.

• Keep accurate clinical documentation and contribute to quality and patient-safety initiatives.

Qualifications
Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Nursing from a recognized institution.

• Current nursing registration, or eligibility for licensure with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS).

• At least 3 years of experience in diabetes care and management.

• Direct experience with patients who need ongoing diabetes management, not just acute episodes.

Technical Knowledge

• Strong practical knowledge of diabetes management, including insulin therapy and glucose monitoring.

• Familiarity with CGM systems and other diabetes technologies.

• Preferred: a recognized diabetes certification such as CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist), CDE (Certified Diabetes Educator), or a comparable international credential.

Leadership & Communication

• You explain complex clinical information in plain language that patients and families can act on.

• You work well inside a multidisciplinary team and speak up for your patients' needs.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

Work Environment
You will be based on-site at the organization's facility in Riyadh, working within a professional multidisciplinary clinical team. Your days will mix one-to-one education sessions, patient follow-ups, and case discussions with colleagues. Clinical documentation is part of daily work, and English is the working language of the team.

This role sits within the Residential Business Unit at Qiddiya Investment Company and supports senior leadership in shaping the future rollout of a large and evolving residential portfolio.

The Director - Strategic Market Analysis will provide the market intelligence and quantitative analysis required to guide product strategy, development phasing and investment decisions across multiple residential masterplans. The role will assess economic, demographic, regulatory and financing trends affecting the Riyadh residential market, build and maintain supply-and-demand models, and translate market data into clear recommendations on product mix, pricing, positioning and rollout timing.

Working closely with Development Strategy, Development, Investment, Design and senior management, the role will also support highest and best-use assessments, scenario analysis and management presentations for key decision-making forums.

**Responsibilities**

* Assess and segment Riyadh residential market to inform product rollout
* Monitor, assess, and report on any shifts and trends in residential market dynamics; including changes in regulation, legal, financing, etc..
* Identify high value products to increase marketability and yield
* Create and maintain a supply/demand model that focuses on residential assets
* Scenario analysis on residential demand
* Develop high level best-use analysis for various masterplans and plots
* Create presentations for N-1 panels, management, and inputs for BoD presentations.

* Worked extensively on supply/demand models
* Created highest and best use models and trade area assessments

## Company Description

SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 89,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,600 offices and laboratories around the world.

## Job Description

The Health & Safety Country Manager provides strategic and operational leadership to drive a proactive, risk-based Health & Safety culture across the country, aligned with SGS global standards and business objectives.

The role is accountable for embedding effective risk management, strengthening operational discipline, and ensuring that Health & Safety is integrated into all business activities to support sustainable and safe growth.

Acting as a trusted advisor to the Managing Director and leadership teams, the role influences decision-making and ensures strong governance, leadership accountability, and continuous improvement across all locations.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Provide strategic leadership by translating global and regional H&S strategy into a clear and actionable country roadmap aligned with business priorities.
* Drive a risk-based approach focusing on identification, assessment, and control of critical risks, ensuring effectiveness of controls rather than simple compliance.
* Lead the development of a strong safety culture, reinforcing leadership behaviors, accountability, and employee engagement across all levels of the organisation.
* Ensure robust incident reporting, investigation, and learning processes, with a focus on root cause analysis and prevention of recurrence.
* Build organisational capability through coaching, training, and development of H&S personnel and operational leaders.
* Ensure compliance with local regulations and SGS standards, and support integration of H&S into acquisitions, projects, and operational changes.

**CORE LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

* Strategic Risk Leadership – Anticipates, prioritizes, and manages critical risks using data-driven insights and proactive approaches.
* Influencing & Engagement – Builds trust, influences stakeholders at all levels, and integrates Health & Safety into business decision-making.
* Safety Culture Leadership – Drives behavioural change, ownership, and accountability, fostering a positive and proactive safety culture.
* Operational Excellence – Ensures consistent and effective implementation of the Health & Safety Management System with measurable performance outcomes.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building – Develops high-performing teams and builds capability through coaching, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

## Qualifications

* Degree in Health & Safety or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in Health & Safety management, including corporate leadership roles in complex or multi-site environments.
* Professional certification (e.g. NEBOSH, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor) is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change, influence senior stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience in site and lab operations setup.

CoorB is all about digital finance. We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.  

**About CoorB**  

  

We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.  

**Role purpose**  

The Portfolio Manager is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of all banking programs and workstreams within CoorB's agreed scope for an assigned client. The role ensures that the portfolio delivers its business, financial, quality, and contractual commitments while maintaining one consolidated view of priorities, risks, dependencies, resources, and performance.  

**Key responsibilities**  

• Own the portfolio roadmap, priorities, delivery plan, budget, resource plan, and governance calendar.

• Align programs and projects with client objectives, contractual commitments, and CoorB's business targets.  

• Provide clear executive reporting on scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, dependencies, and decisions.  

• Lead portfolio governance, steering meetings, change control, and escalation management.  

• Hold Program and Project Managers accountable for delivery, quality, financial performance, and timely escalation.  

• Manage cross-program dependencies, capacity constraints, vendors, and delivery risks through closure.  

• Oversee release readiness, testing progress, defect trends, operational readiness, and production stability.  

• Own portfolio forecasting, invoicing readiness, utilization, revenue visibility, margin performance, and commercial risks.  

• Serve as CoorB's senior delivery focal point for the client and maintain alignment with business and technology stakeholders.  

• Lead and coach the portfolio management team and promote accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.  

**Decision authority**  

The Portfolio Manager owns day-to-day portfolio prioritization, governance, reporting, resource balancing, and recovery actions within approved scope and authority. Material contractual, budget, strategic, regulatory, or cross-account matters are escalated to the Head of PMO and relevant executives.  

**Key performance measures**  

On-time delivery and business outcomes; effective prioritization of the portfolio backlog with the business, ensuring commitments remain achievable within available capacity and delivery constraints; budget, revenue, margin, and forecast accuracy; quality and production stability; risk and dependency closure; resource utilization; governance effectiveness; and client stakeholder satisfaction.  

  

  

### Requirements

  

**Required qualifications and experience**  

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.  

• At least 10 years of project and program delivery experience, including 3 or more years managing a complex portfolio or multiple concurrent programs.  

• Banking or financial-services delivery experience is required, preferably in digital banking or large-scale technology transformation.  

• Proven experience managing senior client stakeholders, multidisciplinary teams, vendors, budgets, commercial commitments, and delivery recovery.  

• Strong knowledge of portfolio governance, software delivery lifecycles, Agile and hybrid delivery, testing, release management, risk, and financial management.  

• Professional certification is preferred: PfMP or PgMP is most relevant to the role; PMP is highly valued; PMI-ACP, SAFe, PRINCE2, or equivalent Agile credentials are advantageous.  

• Professional fluency in English is required; Arabic is advantageous.  

**Core competencies**  

Portfolio leadership; banking-domain understanding; executive communication; commercial and financial acumen; prioritization; risk and dependency management; delivery recovery; stakeholder influence; and people leadership.

## Job Description

The Reliability Engineer will provide on-site support to external customers by conducting failure analyses and reliability assessments of rotating equipment, with a particular focus on sealing systems. The role involves identifying performance and reliability improvement opportunities, troubleshooting equipment issues, and conducting root cause analyses (RCA) using established methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, Ishikawa (Fishbone) Diagrams, Apollo RCA, and other structured problem-solving techniques.

The position also includes providing on-site technical support for John Crane products, supporting customer maintenance activities, and assisting with the installation, dismantling, inspection, and assembly of mechanical seals and related equipment.

**SPECIFIC DUTIES, ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO**:

* Perform reliability analyses of customer rotating equipment, with a focus on sealing system performance and optimization.
* Lead and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations involving sealing systems and rotating equipment, including site assessments, data collection, analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings and recommendations to customers.
* Conduct field troubleshooting activities, including problem diagnosis, development of corrective actions, and implementation of appropriate solutions in collaboration with customer teams.
* Deliver detailed technical presentations and recommendations to customers to support reliability improvement initiatives, sales opportunities, and RCA activities.
* Support customer sites with equipment measurements, seal installation, commissioning, and technical inspections.
* Ensure all work is performed in accordance with John Crane standards, procedures, quality requirements, and safety policies.
* Develop and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support and professional communication.

## Qualifications

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in rotating equipment and sealing systems, with a strong focus on maintenance, reliability, and asset performance improvement.
* Solid understanding of industrial plant operations and maintenance environments, including work management systems, turnaround planning, maintenance planning, and scheduling processes.
* Experience working in a proactive, multinational, and multicultural environment.
* Strong technical knowledge of rotating equipment reliability principles and maintenance best practices.
* Knowledge of the John Crane product portfolio is considered an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as Vibration Analysis, Machinery Lubrication, Thermography, Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), or Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) are highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills are an advantage.

Description:
Position requires a skilled MH-60/H-60 Avionics Technician AT with the ability to perform Planned Maintenance Interval Inspections (PMI), Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level maintenance on H-60 helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of aircraft radio’s, radar, navigation equipment, and other rapid communication devices. Extensive knowledge in wire, and connector repair is required. Position is in Jubail Saudi Arabia.
Essential Responsibilities:
+ Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter Avionics work to include but not limited to:
+ Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, and wire and connector replacements on the MH-60R aircraft and related systems.
+ Have a knowledge of electronic theory.
+ Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on electrical and utilities systems.
+ Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair.
+ Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP.
+ Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training.
Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:
+ 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to: installation, tests, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, alignments, modification, performing final test calibrations, and solving maintenance problems in highly complex navigation identification, radar electronic devices, navigational radar, electronic countermeasure systems, global positioning system (GPS), and armament systems.
+ Must be able to solve complicated problems encountered by pilots while in flight. Often these problems cannot be duplicated on the ground.
+ Have a thorough understanding of flight characteristics and their effects on electronic systems. Systems includes search/ navigational radar, communication, navigation, electronic countermeasures, data computing, recording equipment, weapons computer, and inertial measurement systems.
+ Be able to use test equipment such as voltmeters, signal generators, sweep/ pulse generators, dual trace oscilloscopes, deviation meters, sweep carts, precision power, and frequency measuring devices. Also, must use various test sets that detect discrepancies that often do not appear during bench rework in work centers.
+ Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic diagrams, and technical directives
+ Work with miniaturized solid-state circuits and devices. Able to use a full range of hand tools common to the trade. Must have a thorough knowledge of digital/ analog computers, algebra, and trigonometry.
+ Must be able to pass a background check, and drug test.
Preferences :
+ Navy Aviation Avionics - AE MH-60R HSM HSC
+ Airborne Low-Frequency Sonar (ALFS): AN/AQS-22
+ Sonobuoy Processing System
+ Multi-Mode Radar: AN/APS-153(V)
+ Open-Architecture Mission Computer
Clearance Requirement:
+ Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret Clearance. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing. US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.
Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:
+ To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
+ Must be able to walk, and stand on level, inclined surfaces for certain periods throughout the day. Also be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
+ Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
+ Distinguish color and judge three-dimensional depth.

Deployment, Testing & Production Operations - Develop automated testing and validation approaches for bots, APIs, workflows, and AI enabled automation components. - Implement Git, version control, CI/CD, and structured software development practices for automation assets and supporting code. - Set up and maintain production monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, bot schedules, and operational runbooks. - Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions. - Ensure automation solutions comply with enterprise security, access control, segregation of-duties, audit, and data protection requirements. 4. Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer - Partner with Finance, Operations, Commercial, HR, IT, Data, Security teams, and external technology vendors to deliver end-to-end automation solutions. - Work closely with the Technology & Data Lead / Senior Manager – AI Projects on architecture, integration, code quality, and production-readiness standards. - Prepare technical documentation, support knowledge transfer, and enable internal teams to operate and maintain deployed automations. - Contribute to AI CoE standards, reusable libraries, technical templates, frameworks, and engineering best practices. Success Measures - Deliver reliable, accurate, and scalable automations that achieve agreed STP, quality, cycle time, and productivity targets. - Ensure production bots operate with effective monitoring, exception handling, auditability, and support ownership. - Deliver measurable business benefits beyond proof-of-concept implementations. - Develop reusable automation components that reduce delivery time for future use cases. - Ensure RPA solutions are integrated into the broader AI and technology architecture rather than operating as isolated scripts. Benefits - Attractive Salary & Benefits

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Surveyor will be responsible for carrying out all surveying activities related to bridge and infrastructure construction works on the Projects. The role involves providing accurate site measurements, setting out works, verifying construction alignment and levels, conducting as-built surveys, and supporting project teams to ensure all works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.

## Your role

**Surveying & Setting Out**

* Perform site surveys, control point establishment, and setting out for bridge and infrastructure works.
    
* Conduct horizontal and vertical alignment checks for bridges, roads, retaining walls, culverts, and associated structures.
    
* Set out foundations, pile locations, abutments, piers, bridge decks, utility corridors, and roadway elements.
    
* Verify coordinates, levels, dimensions, and structural positioning before and during construction activities.
    
* Ensure survey control networks are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
    

**Construction Support**

* Provide survey support to construction, engineering, and quality teams.
    
* Monitor construction tolerances and ensure compliance with approved design requirements.
    
* Assist in resolving field measurement discrepancies and coordinate with design and site teams.
    
* Prepare and validate as-built surveys for completed construction works.
    
* Support progress measurement and quantity verification activities.
    

**Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure all surveying activities comply with project specifications, client requirements, and industry standards.
    
* Maintain accurate survey records, reports, and documentation.
    
* Verify contractor survey submissions and provide technical recommendations as required.
    
* Support quality inspections and audits related to survey activities.
    

**Technology & Data Management**

* Operate and maintain survey equipment including:
    
    * Total Stations
        
    * GPS/GNSS Systems
        
    * Digital Levels
        
    * Laser Scanners (where applicable)
        
* Process field survey data and produce survey reports, drawings, and coordinate files.
    
* Utilize survey software and CAD platforms for data analysis and reporting.
    
* Ensure integrity and accuracy of all survey information generated on site.
    

**Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance**

* Adhere to all project HSE requirements and safe working practices.
    
* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings, and project safety initiatives.
    
* Ensure surveying operations are conducted safely in active construction environments.
    

## About you

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
    
* Professional surveying certification or registration is preferred.
    
* Minimum 5-10 years of surveying experience within major civil infrastructure projects.
    
* Minimum 3 years of dedicated bridge construction experience.
    
* Previous experience on GCC or KSA projects is highly desirable.
    
* Experience working with international consultants, contractors, or government infrastructure projects is preferred.
    
* Strong understanding of bridge geometry, structural alignment, and construction tolerances.
    
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, IFC drawings, and survey control data.
    
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure construction methodologies.
    
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    
* Effective communication and coordination abilities.
    
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams.
    
* Strong organizational and reporting skills.
    
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.
    

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
    
* Life insurance coverage.
    
* Medical insurance.
    
* Annual leave balance.
    
* Company gratuity scheme.
    
* Discretionary bonus program.
    
* Annual flight contribution.
    
* Transportation & housing allowances.
    
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
    

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

description:
### **Job Description**

## Overview

The QA Engineer will be responsible for implementing, monitoring, and maintaining quality assurance processes throughout the construction phase of major building and hospitality projects. The role ensures that construction activities, materials, workmanship, and project deliverables comply with contract requirements, project specifications, approved quality plans, applicable standards, and client expectations.

## Your role

**Quality Assurance Management**

* Ensure compliance with project quality objectives, contractual requirements, and approved quality management procedures.
* Monitor contractor quality control activities and verify the effectiveness of quality assurance processes.
* Review and assess quality documentation, inspection records, test reports, and material approvals.
* Identify quality risks and proactively recommend preventive measures to avoid construction defects and non-conformities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project quality performance.

**Inspection, Testing and Compliance**

* Witness inspections, material testing, and commissioning activities to ensure compliance with approved standards and specifications.
* Verify that construction works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, technical specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Review submitted inspection requests and ensure timely completion and closure of quality-related inspections.
* Monitor compliance with international standards, industry best practices, and project-specific quality requirements.
* Ensure proper management of hold points, witness points, and inspection checkpoints throughout project execution.

**Non-Conformance and Corrective Actions**

* Review and monitor non-conformance reports (NCRs) and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Investigate recurring quality issues and recommend appropriate solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
* Track closure of quality observations, defects, and punch list items.
* Coordinate with project teams to verify the effectiveness of corrective measures implemented by contractors.
* Maintain records of quality incidents, root cause analyses, and improvement actions.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Liaise with Client representatives, Resident Engineers, contractors, and consultants on quality-related matters.
* Participate in progress meetings and provide updates on project quality performance and compliance status.
* Support technical discussions concerning workmanship standards, material quality, and construction practices.
* Assist in Quality Management System awareness and training initiatives for project personnel.
* Promote a culture of quality excellence across all project activities and stakeholders.

**Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports summarizing inspections, audits, non-conformities, and quality trends.
* Maintain comprehensive records of inspections, test results, approvals, and quality documentation.
* Review contractor quality reports and verify the accuracy of submitted information.
* Track quality key performance indicators and provide regular performance updates to project management.
* Ensure all project quality documentation is properly controlled, updated, and archived.

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance is preferred.
* Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification in ISO 9001 is highly desirable.
* Membership in a recognized engineering or quality management professional organization is preferred.
* Additional certifications related to construction quality, inspection, or project management are advantageous.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 8-12 years of professional experience in quality assurance and quality management within construction projects.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in site supervision consultancy or construction supervision assignments.
* Proven experience on large-scale buildings, convention centers, hotels, resorts, and mixed-use developments.
* Strong experience in managing quality audits, inspections, testing programs, and quality compliance activities.
* Previous GCC experience, preferably within Saudi Arabia, is highly desirable.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and ISO 9001 requirements.
* Thorough understanding of construction materials, building systems, testing procedures, and inspection methodologies.
* Experience in quality auditing, documentation control, non-conformance management, and corrective action processes.
* Familiarity with local regulations, international standards, and construction quality best practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, quality management software, and reporting tools.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence.
* Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Risk Manager** to join our team in a **client-side PMO environment**. In this role, you will act as the vital link between project delivery and strategic risk governance, ensuring that one of the world's most ambitious infrastructure developments remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with our client’s objectives.

As a core member of the client-side **Program Management Office (PMO)**, you will provide independent oversight of risk across a portfolio of complex Design–Build projects, shaping risk strategy, standards, and reporting frameworks. You will work closely with client leadership, delivery partners, and contractors to ensure risks are proactively identified, transparently communicated, and effectively mitigated—supporting informed decision-making and the long-term success of the Kingdom’s landmark infrastructure program.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Oversee all risk reporting within the client-side PMO, including risk exposure analysis, risk-adjusted forecasts, and integration with cost planning, budgeting, and cash flow forecastingto give the client a clear view of risk impacts.
    
* Develop and maintain program-level risk registers for complex contracts (FIDIC, NEC, or bespoke), ensuring full adherence to contractual obligations, KSA regulations, and client governance standards.
    
* Proactively identify strategic, contractual, technical, and financial risks early in the project lifecycle, developing robust mitigation strategies and contingency plans to protect the Client’s interests.
    
* Lead the assessment and analysis of major risk events related to variations, change orders, and potential disputes, providing client-side recommendations and negotiation support.
    
* Act as the primary risk management point of contact for the Client, government authorities, and major contractors, ensuring risk information is clear, timely, and aligned with client priorities.
    
* Mentor and lead a team of Risk Analysts, Project Controls, and Commercial Specialists, fostering a culture of transparency, professional integrity, and risk-aware decision-making.
    
* Provide strategic direction and leadership for all risk governance activities across the program, defining standards, procedures, and reporting cadence within the PMO.
    
* Develop and implement risk management strategies and frameworks to support project objectives, ensure timely delivery of outputs, and maximize value for the client.
    
* Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions through risk-based oversight of claims, variations, and disputes, advising on exposure and resolution strategies.
    
* Provide expert advice on contract risk allocation, interpretation, and mitigation strategies, supporting the client in negotiations and decision-making.
    
* Support the development and management of project and program budgets by highlighting risk allowances, contingencies, and potential cost impacts.
    
* Monitor risk-related cost and schedule drivers and implement robust control measures to prevent overruns and reduce likelihood/impact of key risks.
    
* Prepare detailed risk reports, dashboards, forecasts, and analytics for senior client management, governance boards, and PMO leadership.
    
* Coordinate with the procurement team to ensure that risk considerations are embedded into procurement strategies, tender documents, and evaluation criteria.
    
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, contractors, and consultants to ensure early visibility of emerging risks and collaborative mitigation.
    
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program-wide risks throughout the project lifecycle, including strategic, operational, technical, financial, and stakeholder risks.
    
* Develop contingency plans and early-warning indicators to address potential challenges before they impact client outcomes.
    
* Lead and mentor the risk and project controls team, fostering a culture of collaboration, excellence, and proactive risk management.
    
* Provide training and guidance to PMO and project team members to enhance risk awareness, tools usage, and reporting quality.
    
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, contractors, and consultants, to ensure alignment on risk priorities, ownership, and actions.
    
* Represent the client-side PMO in risk-related discussions and negotiations with stakeholders, supporting informed, defensible decisions.
    
* Ensure adherence to legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements by integrating compliance risks into the overall risk management framework.
    
* Prepare and present comprehensive risk and assurance reports to stakeholders and senior client management, highlighting key exposures, trends, and recommended actions.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Risk Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
    
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in risk management and/or commercial/project controls across multiple construction or infrastructure sectors, including client-side roles.
    
* Extensive knowledge of risk management principles, cost & commercial management, procurement processes, and contract management frameworks.
    
* Proven track record of managing large-scale, complex projects or programs and supporting delivery within budget and schedule through effective risk governance.
    
* Familiarity with local KSA regulations, industry standards, and best practices in client-side PMO environments.
    
* Proficiency in project management, project controls, and risk analysis tools (e.g., Primavera P6, risk modeling software, financial tools).
    
* Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to present complex risk information clearly to senior client stakeholders.
    
* Ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships, facilitate workshops, and support dispute avoidance and resolution from a risk perspective.
    

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Professional certification such as RMPRMP, PMPPMP, MRICSMRICS, or equivalent is preferred.
    
* Experience in PMO / client-side Delivery Partner projects is highly desirable.
    
* Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to align risk strategies to client objectives.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including qualitative and quantitative risk analysis.
    
* Demonstrated leadership and team management expertise in multidisciplinary environments.
    
* Attention to detail and accuracy in risk, financial, and performance reporting.
    
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities and risks effectively.

* Experience with FIDIC or similar international contract frameworks and Design-Build, EPC, PMC, or Delivery Partner delivery models.
* Familiarity with BIM coordination, digital quality management systems, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness programs.

description:
### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Lead QA Engineer will oversee and manage all quality assurance activities associated with the construction and site supervision phases of major building developments. The role is responsible for establishing and maintaining project-wide quality management systems, ensuring compliance with contractual and technical requirements, leading quality audits and inspections, and driving continuous quality improvement across all project stakeholders.

## Your role

**Quality Management Leadership**

* Develop, implement, and monitor project quality objectives, procedures, and quality assurance strategies.
* Review and approve contractor quality plans, inspection and test plans, method statements, and quality procedures.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality management processes throughout all construction activities.
* Establish quality performance metrics and monitor compliance against defined project targets.
* Promote a culture of quality excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement among project teams.

**Quality Audits and Compliance**

* Lead internal and external quality audits to verify compliance with project requirements and quality standards.
* Monitor contractor compliance with quality management systems, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure construction works are executed in accordance with approved specifications, codes, and industry best practices.
* Identify quality deficiencies and recommend corrective measures to ensure project compliance.
* Oversee closure of audit findings and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

**Inspection and Testing Oversight**

* Oversee inspection and testing activities for all construction disciplines to ensure compliance with approved procedures.
* Review material approvals, testing reports, inspection records, and commissioning documentation.
* Ensure proper implementation of hold points, witness points, and quality control checkpoints.
* Verify that testing laboratories, inspection agencies, and contractor quality teams meet project quality requirements.
* Monitor quality trends and recommend actions to improve construction quality and reduce defects.

**Non-Conformance and Corrective Action Management**

* Lead the review and disposition of non-conformance reports, quality observations, and defect reports.
* Ensure root cause analyses are conducted and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
* Monitor recurring quality issues and drive effective preventive measures across project activities.
* Verify closure of quality-related issues and assess effectiveness of implemented solutions.
* Maintain oversight of punch lists, snagging activities, and final quality closeout processes.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Client representatives, Resident Engineer, discipline engineers, contractors, and consultants on quality matters.
* Participate in management meetings and provide strategic advice regarding project quality performance.
* Support regulatory inspections, third-party audits, and Client quality reviews.
* Facilitate quality awareness programs and technical workshops for project teams.
* Establish effective communication channels to ensure timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare comprehensive weekly, monthly, and executive quality reports for project management and Client review.
* Monitor and report quality key performance indicators, audit findings, and compliance trends.
* Maintain control of quality records, audit reports, approvals, inspection documentation, and testing data.
* Ensure quality databases and document management systems are accurate and up to date.
* Provide management with recommendations for quality improvements and risk mitigation measures.

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Quality Management is preferred.
* Lead Auditor certification in ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems is highly desirable.
* Professional certification from recognized quality or engineering organizations is preferred.
* Membership in a recognized engineering institution or professional body is advantageous.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in quality assurance and quality management within large construction projects.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in site supervision consultancy or engineering consultancy environments.
* Proven experience managing quality programs for large-scale building developments, convention centers, hotels, resorts, and mixed-use projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary quality teams and overseeing complex construction activities.
* Previous experience in GCC countries, with Saudi Arabian project experience being highly preferred.

**Technical Competencies**

* Extensive knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and construction quality assurance practices.
* Strong understanding of building construction methodologies, materials, testing procedures, and commissioning requirements.
* Expertise in conducting quality audits, inspections, root cause analyses, and corrective action management.
* Familiarity with international building codes, Saudi regulations, and industry construction standards.
* Proficiency in quality management software, document control systems, and Microsoft Office applications.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail with a proactive approach to quality improvement.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced project environment.

## Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Tax-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation & housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The BIM/GIS Manager will lead the implementation, management, and integration of Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) throughout the construction supervision phase of major building and hospitality developments. The role is responsible for ensuring effective digital project delivery, model coordination, information management, spatial data integration, and compliance with project BIM and GIS standards to support efficient decision-making and project execution.

## Your role

**BIM Management**

* Develop and implement BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in accordance with client requirements and project objectives.
* Monitor contractor and consultant compliance with BIM standards, protocols, and information delivery requirements.
* Lead model review sessions and ensure multidisciplinary coordination of architectural, structural, MEP, and infrastructure models.
* Establish model quality control procedures to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Oversee model updates and ensure timely incorporation of approved design changes and site modifications.

**GIS Management**

* Develop and maintain GIS databases to support project monitoring, planning, and asset information management.
* Integrate geospatial data from surveys, site investigations, utility networks, and project stakeholders into project GIS platforms.
* Ensure spatial data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with project information management requirements.
* Support site supervision and project teams through GIS-based analysis, mapping, and reporting tools.
* Coordinate development and maintenance of project geospatial records for future operations and asset management.

**Digital Coordination and Information Management**

* Establish project-wide information management procedures to ensure effective collaboration among stakeholders.
* Manage Common Data Environment (CDE) platforms and oversee document and model control processes.
* Monitor information exchange workflows and ensure timely submission of BIM deliverables by project participants.
* Coordinate digital reviews to identify clashes, constructability concerns, and model discrepancies.
* Support project teams in utilizing digital technologies to improve project efficiency and communication.

**Quality Assurance and Compliance**

* Ensure BIM and GIS deliverables comply with project specifications, contractual obligations, and industry standards.
* Conduct regular audits of BIM models, GIS databases, and information management systems.
* Monitor adherence to approved project workflows, naming conventions, classification standards, and data structures.
* Verify the quality and completeness of submitted digital deliverables before acceptance.
* Identify non-compliance issues and coordinate corrective actions with project stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Liaise with Client representatives, consultants, contractors, surveyors, and project management teams on BIM and GIS matters.
* Facilitate BIM coordination meetings and technical workshops to address project information management requirements.
* Support multidisciplinary teams in resolving coordination conflicts and digital delivery challenges.
* Collaborate with project controls, engineering, construction, and asset management teams to enhance project reporting capabilities.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to BIM coordinators, GIS specialists, and project personnel.

**Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on BIM implementation, GIS activities, model coordination status, and compliance performance.
* Maintain records of model reviews, clash detection reports, digital audits, and information management assessments.
* Monitor BIM and GIS key performance indicators and communicate progress to project management and clients.
* Review contractor BIM and GIS reports and verify the accuracy of submitted information.
* Ensure all digital project records are properly maintained and archived in accordance with project requirements.

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Geomatics, GIS, Surveying, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in BIM Management, Digital Engineering, GIS, or a related field is preferred.
* Professional certification in BIM, GIS, Digital Engineering, or Information Management is highly desirable.
* Certification in Autodesk BIM solutions, Esri GIS platforms, or equivalent technologies is preferred.
* Membership in a recognized professional engineering, BIM, or GIS organization is advantageous.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 12-15 years of professional experience in BIM, GIS, digital engineering, or information management.
* Minimum 7 years of experience managing BIM and GIS functions on major construction or site supervision consultancy projects.
* Proven experience on large-scale buildings, convention centers, hotels, resorts, and mixed-use developments.
* Demonstrated experience in model coordination, Common Data Environment management, and digital project delivery.
* Previous GCC experience, particularly within Saudi Arabia, is highly desirable.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of BIM standards, information management principles, and digital project delivery methodologies.
* Extensive experience with Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, ArcGIS, and related platforms.
* Thorough understanding of model coordination, clash detection, 4D planning, and digital asset information management.
* Experience in GIS database development, spatial analysis, geospatial data integration, and mapping applications.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, reporting platforms, and project collaboration systems.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement abilities.

About the role We are seeking a Senior Associate to manage end‑to‑end post‑trade custody operations for the Saudi Arabia (KSA) market , covering securities settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions and income, reconciliations, and onboarding/account setup – Sunday to Thursday . This role requires strong familiarity with local market practices and a solid understanding of the KSA post‑trade ecosystem: trading on Saudi Exchange , clearing via Muqassa (CCP) , and depository/settlement via Edaa , with settlement cash movements supported through SAMA . Why this role is important to us State Street is one of the world’s largest global custodians, with over USD 51.7 trillion in AUC/A , and is executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. As part of this strategy, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market , supported by Vision 2030 reforms , increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical to: Enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post‑trade operations aligned to local market infrastructure and rules. Ensuring a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, strong exception management, and robust controls as KSA market activity expands. Supporting the firm’s ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves. Key responsibilities (KSA-specific) 1) Clearing & settlement operations (Cash Market – Equities / ETFs / Sukuk & Bonds as applicable) Manage settlement processing for Saudi Exchange transactions settling at Edaa , ensuring accurate, timely completion across relevant cycles (e.g., T+2 for normal exchange trades; negotiated deals T+0–T+5 ; buy‑ins T+0 , as applicable). Reconcile and validate trade/settlement obligations by aligning client instructions and broker confirmations with clearing outcomes (Muqassa) and settlement processing (Edaa); investigate and resolve exceptions promptly. Monitor settlement status proactively, manage potential fails, and follow KSA fails workflows noting that fails management procedures are defined and conducted by Muqassa , with Edaa rollover/cancellation and market-claim handling where applicable. Manage lifecycle of settlement instructions (including amendments/cancellations/partial settlement where permitted) in line with Edaa procedures and local cut‑offs. 2) Cash settlement & funding (SAMA) Ensure funding readiness for DvP settlement , understanding that KSA settlement is gross on the securities leg and netted on the cash leg , with cash settlement executed via SAMA settlement member accounts. Perform cash reconciliations linked to settlement activity; investigate breaks and drive timely resolution within cut‑offs. 3) FX operations (operational support) Process FX-related operational activities supporting settlement and client cash requirements (settlement-linked and standalone requests per operating model), validating confirmations and ensuring correct value dating and SSI usage. 4) Corporate actions, dividends & income Manage corporate actions and income events, ensuring accurate entitlements, timely postings, and robust reconciliations; coordinate vendor feeds and security setup with internal market data/static data teams as required. 5) Client onboarding & investor identification Support onboarding/account setup and documentation in line with Edaa account structures and membership rules; ensure correct capture/validation of investor identification in Edaa’s framework (Investor Identification Number / Investor ID ). Support QFI onboarding requirements within the local custody/account operating model to ensure settlement readiness. 6) Messaging, controls & stakeholder management Use SWIFT ISO 15022 (MT) and exposure to ISO 20022 (MX) standards for settlement/reconciliation/corporate actions messaging with clients/custodians and market counterparts, supporting high STP and clean exception handling. Execute daily controls and checklists on time; ensure adherence to local cut‑offs and internal policies; escalate high‑risk/time‑sensitive issues with clear impact articulation. Partner with internal teams (Operations, Risk, Client Services) and external stakeholders (brokers, clearing/settlement participants, custodians, relevant market entities) to resolve issues and improve outcomes. Experience & preferred qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or above) in Finance, Accounting, or related field. 3–5 years’ experience in custody/post‑trade operations (KSA market experience strongly preferred). Strong understanding of KSA post‑trade flow across Muqassa (clearing/CCP) and Edaa (CSD/settlement) , and the implications of T+2 and DvP cash settlement via SAMA . Strong analytical/problem-solving skills, attention to detail, ability to work under strict cut-offs, and strong stakeholder management.
